words.definition: suddenly, shortly, sharp
words.translation: 突然地；唐突地

examples.en: The path ends off abruptly.
examples.zh: 这条路突然到头了。

examples.en: The ground rises abruptly.
examples.zh: 地势突然隆起。

words.definition: to take in liquid, gas, or another substance from the surface or space around something; attract, engage, see, read, seize
words.translation: 吸收（液体、气体等）；吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注

examples.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
examples.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

words.definition: to treat someone in a cruel and violent way, often sexually; punishment, vice; strain, maltreat
words.translation: 滥用，虐待；滥用；虐待；辱骂；弊端；恶习，陋习

examples.en: Williams abused his position as Mayor to give jobs to his friends.
examples.zh: 威廉斯滥用市长权力，给不少朋友安排了工作。

words.definition: relating to education, especially at college or university level; theoretical, collegial; undergraduate, don, scholar, college student, university student
words.translation: 学校(院)的，学术的；学术的；理论的；学院的；大学生，大学教师；学者

examples.en: He possessed no academic qualifications.
examples.zh: 他没有学历。

examples.en: a program to raise academic standards
examples.zh: 旨在提高学术水平的计划

words.definition: to find information, especially on a computer; the right to enter a place, use something, see someone etc; make use of, fashion, employ, border, exercise; opening, admittance
words.translation: 获取；接近，入口；使用；[计]存取；接近；进入；使用权；[电]通路

examples.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
examples.zh: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

words.definition: a place, building, or object that is accessible is easy to reach or get into; accostable, comprehensible
words.translation: 易接近的；可进入的；可理解的

examples.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
examples.zh: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

examples.en: There is a church which is easily accessible from my home.
examples.zh: 有座教堂离我家很近。

words.definition: to provide someone with a place to stay, live, or work; adapt, contain, suit, accept, serve; adjust, adapt to something
words.translation: 适合， 提供住宿；容纳；使适应；供应；调解；适应

examples.en: The island was used to accommodate child refugees.
examples.zh: 该岛用于收容儿童难民。

words.definition: to succeed in doing something, especially after trying very hard; carry out, come true, perform, complete, fulfill
words.translation: 完成；实现；达到

examples.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
examples.zh: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

examples.en: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
examples.zh: 大功告成。

words.definition: to gradually get more and more money, possessions, knowledge etc over a period of time; store up; scrape up
words.translation: 积累，增加；累积；积聚；积攒

examples.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
examples.zh: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

words.definition: correct and true in every detail; precise, mathematical, strict, rigid, refined
words.translation: 精确的，准确的；精确的

examples.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
examples.zh: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

words.definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard; accomplish, carry out, perform, complete, fulfil; gain one's ends, Make it.
words.translation: 完成，实现；达到；完成；达到目的；如愿以偿

examples.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
examples.zh: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

examples.en: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
examples.zh: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

examples.en: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
examples.zh: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

words.definition: to admit or accept that something is true or that a situation exists; accept, agree, recognize, grant, face
words.translation: 承认(…的权威)；承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到

examples.en: The family acknowledge the need for change.
examples.zh: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

examples.en: Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
examples.zh: 克莱尔承认有罪。

examples.en: The government must acknowledge what is happening and do something about it.
examples.zh: 对于目前的情况，政府必须承认其存在并对此采取措施。

words.definition: to obtain something by buying it or being given it; earn, buy, score, find, make
words.translation: 获得；取得；学到；捕获

examples.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
examples.zh: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

examples.en: She has acquired an email address and a site on the World Wide Web.
examples.zh: 她获得了一个电子邮件地址和万维网网址。

words.definition: acute senses such as hearing, taste, touch etc are very good and sensitive; serious, bad, keen
words.translation: 敏锐的；严重的，[医][植]急性的；[数][生物]敏锐的；激烈的；尖声的

examples.en: Young children have a particularly acute sense of smell.
examples.zh: 幼儿的嗅觉特别灵敏。

words.definition: to gradually change your behaviour and attitudes in order to be successful in a new situation; condition, suit, season; adjust, accomodate to, accommodate to
words.translation: 适应于；使适应；改编；适应

examples.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
examples.zh: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

words.definition: the need to take a harmful drug regularly, without being able to stop; addicted to, indulgence
words.translation: 上瘾；上瘾，沉溺；[内科]癖嗜

examples.en: She helped him fight his drug addiction.
examples.zh: 她帮助了他对抗自己的毒瘾。

words.definition: more than what was agreed or expected; attached, added, plus, more, excess
words.translation: 额外的；附加的，额外的

examples.en: Additional information can be obtained from the centre.
examples.zh: 可以从中心获取更多信息。

words.definition: if you address a problem, you start trying to solve it; undertake, pursue, have; speech, lecture, talk
words.translation: 解决；演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；[计]地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧

words.definition: enough in quantity or of a good enough quality for a particular purpose; suitable, competent, appropriate, proper, becoming
words.translation: 足够的；充足的；适当的；胜任的

examples.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
examples.zh: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

examples.en: Some creams we tested failed to give adequate protection against UV light.
examples.zh: 我们检测的有些防晒霜不能提供足够的防紫外线保护。

examples.en: The standard of his work is barely adequate .
examples.zh: 他的工作水准勉强合格。

words.definition: the activities that are involved in managing the work of a company or organization; governance, management, supervision, regulation, enforcement
words.translation: 管理，政府；[管理]管理；行政；实施；行政机构

examples.en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
examples.zh: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

examples.en: The health service spends too much on administration.
examples.zh: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

words.definition: relating to the work of managing a company or organization; regulatory, managing, executive
words.translation: 管理的；管理的，行政的

examples.en: The job is mainly administrative.
examples.zh: 这份工作主要是行政方面的。

words.definition: to respect and like someone because they have done something that you think is good; praise, celebrate, bless; speak well of, think the world of
words.translation: 钦佩，称赞；钦佩；赞美；称赞

examples.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
examples.zh: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

words.definition: a feeling of great respect and liking for something or someone; envy, envious of
words.translation: 钦佩，称赞；钦佩；赞赏；羡慕；赞美

examples.en: Daniel gazed at her in admiration .
examples.zh: 丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

words.definition: a statement in which you admit that something is true or that you have done something wrong; recognition, acknowledgement
words.translation: 准许进(加)入；入场费；承认；进入许可；坦白；录用

examples.en: Reese, by his own admission , lacks the necessary experience.
examples.zh: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

words.definition: to agree unwillingly that something is true or that someone else is right; accept, recognize, agree, acknowledge, grant; accept, recognize
words.translation: 承认，容许；承认；准许进入；可容纳；容许

examples.en: ‘Okay, so maybe I was a little bit scared,’ Jenny admitted.
examples.zh: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

examples.en: I must admit , I didn’t actually do anything to help her.
examples.zh: 我必须承认，实际上我并没有帮她什么忙。

examples.en: Admit it! I’m right, aren’t I?
examples.zh: 承认吧！我对了，是不是？

words.definition: before something happens or is expected to happen; development, growth, making, progress, increase; introduce, present, prefer, file, put in; go ahead, move ahead; up-front, prevenient
words.translation: 前进，提前；发展；前进；增长；[会计]预付款；提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前；进展；上涨；预先的；先行的

examples.en: I should warn you in advance that I’m not a very good dancer.
examples.zh: 我要先提醒你，我跳舞不是很好。

examples.en: Many thanks, in advance, for your help.
examples.zh: 对你的帮助预先表示万分感谢。

examples.en: Could you distribute copies well in advance of the meeting?
examples.zh: 开会前把复印件早早分发下去，好吗？

words.definition: studying or dealing with a school subject at a difficult level; senior, aged, high, old, ancient; rose, improved
words.translation: 高级的；先进的；晚期的；年老的；前进；增加；上涨（advance的过去式和过去分词形式）

examples.en: advanced learners of English
examples.zh: 高级程度的英语学习者

examples.en: advanced physics
examples.zh: 高等物理（学）

words.definition: progress or development in your job, level of knowledge etc; promotion, progress, ongoing, headway
words.translation: 进步，提升；前进，进步；提升

examples.en: career advancement
examples.zh: 职业发展

examples.en: advancements in science
examples.zh: 科学进步

words.definition: an opinion you give someone about what they should do; suggestion, proposal, information, instance, notice
words.translation: 建议；忠告；劝告；通知

examples.en: You should have followed my advice.
examples.zh: 你真该听我的建议。

words.definition: an official warning or notice that gives information about a dangerous situation; consulting, directory; report, announcement, declaration
words.translation: 报告；咨询的；顾问的；劝告的；公告

examples.en: The State Department issues travel advisories about conditions overseas.
examples.zh: 国务院就海外局势发布旅游警报。

words.definition: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly; maintain, submit; prophet, supporter
words.translation: 倡导；提倡，主张，拥护；提倡者；支持者；律师

examples.en: Mr. Williams is a conservative who advocates fewer government controls on business.
examples.zh: 威廉斯先生是一位提倡减少政府对商业的控制的保守人士。

words.definition: champion, prophet
words.translation: 主张者，倡导者；提倡者，拥护者

words.definition: showing in a gentle way that you love someone and care about them
words.translation: 深情的，柔情的

examples.en: an affectionate hug
examples.zh: 亲切的拥抱

words.definition: opinion, assurance, claim, advocacy
words.translation: 断言，肯定；主张，肯定；断言

examples.en: On the other hand, when he/she is being positive, reply in affirmation and enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 另一方面，当他处于积极状态时，要用肯定和热情的话语来答复。

examples.en: But when you’re wondering whether to press onward or give up entirely, what you need is affirmation.
examples.zh: 但是当你已经知道是否向前推进或彻底放弃的时候，你需要的是一个肯定。

examples.en: On the other hand, when he/she is being positive, reply in affirmation and enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 另一方面，如果他/她正处于积极状态，给予肯定积极的答复。

words.definition: to state publicly that something is true; declare, to be certain; recognize, confirm on
words.translation: 断言，声明；肯定；断言；确认

examples.en: The general affirmed rumors of an attack.
examples.zh: 将军证实了袭击的传闻。

words.definition: to have enough money to buy or pay for something; allow, deal, extend, deliver, tender
words.translation: 负担得起；给予，提供；买得起

examples.en: I couldn’t afford the rent on my own.
examples.zh: 我单靠自己付不起房租。

examples.en: How can she afford to eat out every night?
examples.zh: 每天晚上下馆子她怎么能负担得起？

words.definition: an organization or department, especially within a government, that does a specific job; procuration, intermediary agent
words.translation: 机构；[贸易]代理，[经]中介；代理处，经销处

examples.en: a UN agency responsible for helping refugees
examples.zh: 负责为难民提供帮助的联合国机构

examples.en: the Environmental Protection Agency
examples.zh: 环保局

words.definition: behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone; invasive, enterprising
words.translation: 挑衅的，好斗的；有上进心的；侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的

examples.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
examples.zh: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

examples.en: Teachers apparently expect a certain amount of aggressive behaviour from boys.
examples.zh: 老师显然料到男孩子多少会有些好勇斗狠的行为。

words.definition: a book that you put photographs, stamps etc in
words.translation: 粘贴簿，集邮簿，像册

examples.en: a photograph album
examples.zh: 相册

words.definition: drinks such as beer or wine that contain a substance which can make you drunk; ethanol, ethylalcohol
words.translation: 酒精；[有化]酒精，乙醇

examples.en: I don’t drink alcohol anymore.
examples.zh: 我不再喝酒了。

examples.en: {"GLOSS":["when someone drinks too much"],"COLLOINEXA":["alcohol abuse"]}
examples.zh: 酗酒

examples.en: people with alcohol problems
examples.zh: 有酗酒问题的人

words.definition: to make someone realize something important or dangerous; giving all your attention to what is happening, being said etc; alarm, warn; vigilant, precautious; guard, vigilance
words.translation: 提醒；机警的；警告；使警觉，使意识到；[军]警惕的，警觉的；留心的；[军]警戒，警惕；警报

examples.en: The animal raised its head, suddenly alert.
examples.zh: 那只动物突然警觉地抬起头来。

examples.en: Taking notes is one of the best ways to stay alert in lectures.
examples.zh: 记笔记是听课时集中注意力的最佳方法之一。

words.definition: to change, or to make someone or something change; influence, fashion, shift, vary, modify; modify, veer from
words.translation: 改变；改变，更改；修改

examples.en: Her face hadn’t altered much over the years.
examples.zh: 过了这么多年，她的容貌并没有多大改变。

examples.en: The city centre has altered beyond recognition (=  changed very much  ) .
examples.zh: 市中心变得都认不出来了。

examples.en: Nothing can alter the fact that the refugees are our responsibility.
examples.zh: 我们有责任帮助难民，这一事实无法改变。

words.definition: the height of an object or place above the sea; height, raise, elevation, rise
words.translation: 海拔, 高度；高地；高度；[数]顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级

examples.en: The aircraft had reached its cruising altitude of about 39,000 feet.
examples.zh: 那架飞机已经达到了大约三万九千英尺的巡航高度。

words.definition: determined to be successful, rich, powerful etc; thirsty, eager-beaver
words.translation: 有雄心的，野心勃勃的；野心勃勃的；有雄心的；热望的；炫耀的

examples.en: Alfred was intensely ambitious, obsessed with the idea of becoming rich.
examples.zh: 艾尔弗雷德雄心勃勃，一心想着发财。

words.definition: break down
words.translation: 分析；对…进行分析，分解（等于analyse）

examples.en: How do you analyze this change?
examples.zh: 你该如何分析这种变化？

examples.en: You have to hoover anything before you can analyze it.
examples.zh: 在你不具备分析能力之前，你只得胡乱吸收你所能学到的东西。

examples.en: We should learn to discern and analyze the essentials of complicated questions.
examples.zh: 我们应该学会认识和分析复杂问题的本质。

words.definition: belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago; old, aged, advanced; elder, old folk
words.translation: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的；古代人；老人

examples.en: the ancient civilizations of Asia
examples.zh: 亚洲的古代文明

words.definition: to officially tell people about something, especially about a plan or a decision; indicate, bill, forecast, shadow
words.translation: 宣布，声称；宣布；述说；预示；播报

examples.en: They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
examples.zh: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

examples.en: At the end of their meeting, it was announced that an agreement had been reached.
examples.zh: 会议最后宣布已达成一项协议。

words.definition: happening once a year; yearly, etesian; year book, almanac
words.translation: 每年的；年度的；[统计]每年的；年刊，[图情]年鉴；一年生植物

examples.en: The school trip has become an annual event.
examples.zh: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

words.definition: yearly
words.translation: 每年，一年一次；每年；一年一次

examples.en: This is a perennating rhizome from which flowering shoots arise annually.
examples.zh: 这是一种每年发芽开花的多年生根茎。

words.definition: to expect that something will happen and be ready for it; hope, presume upon
words.translation: 预感；预期，期望；占先，抢先；提前使用

examples.en: Sales are better than anticipated.
examples.zh: 销量比预期要好。

examples.en: A good speaker is able to anticipate an audience’s needs and concerns.
examples.zh: 好的演讲者能够预先考虑到听众需要什么、关注什么。

words.definition: a piece of furniture, jewellery etc that was made a very long time ago and is therefore valuable; ancient, old; curiosity, virtu
words.translation: 古玩，古董；古老的，年代久远的；过时的，[古]古董的；古风的，古式的；[古]古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格

examples.en: The palace is full of priceless antiques.
examples.zh: 宫殿里到处都是价值连城的古董。

examples.en: They bought the clock at an antique shop in Bath.
examples.zh: 他们在巴斯一家古玩店里买了这只钟。

examples.en: an antique dealer
examples.zh: 古玩商

words.definition: a set of rooms on one floor of a large building, where someone lives; chamber, flat
words.translation: 公寓；[建]公寓；房间

examples.en: She lives in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 她住在一套小公寓里。

words.definition: an urgent request for something important; attract, clamour for; asking, request, motion, charm
words.translation: 吸引，呼吁；呼吁，恳求；[法]上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判；呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；诉诸裁判

examples.en: The girl’s family have made a public appeal for help to try and catch her killer.
examples.zh: 那名遇害女孩的家人吁请公众协助捉拿凶手。

words.definition: the way someone or something looks to other people; occurrence, aspect, emergence, external, outside
words.translation: 外表, 出现；外貌，外观；出现，露面

examples.en: He was always criticising his wife’s appearance.
examples.zh: 他老是批评妻子的外表。

examples.en: We are often attracted to somebody first by their physical appearance .
examples.zh: 我们经常先被一个人的外貌吸引。

examples.en: Women, in general, tend to be more concerned than men about their personal appearance .
examples.zh: 总的来说，女性比男性更注重自己的仪容。

words.definition: a desire for food; weakness, habit, hobby
words.translation: 欲望, 胃口；[生理]食欲；嗜好

examples.en: Her husband always had a huge appetite.
examples.zh: 她丈夫向来胃口极大。

examples.en: Symptoms include tiredness and loss of appetite.
examples.zh: 症状包括疲倦和食欲不振。

words.definition: someone who has formally asked, usually in writing, for a job, university place etc; postulant, proposer
words.translation: 申请人；[专利]申请人，申请者；请求者

examples.en: We have had lots of applicants for these positions.
examples.zh: 对这些职位我们已有了很多申请人。

words.definition: a formal, usually written, request for something such as a job, place at university, or permission to do something; adhibition, Apps
words.translation: 申请，应用；应用；申请；应用程序；[药]敷用

examples.en: We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
examples.zh: 我们每年收到数百封求职信。

examples.en: I filled in the application form and sent it off.
examples.zh: 我填完申请表后把它寄了出去。

examples.en: You have to submit your application before the end of the month.
examples.zh: 月底之前必须递交申请。

words.definition: to make a formal request, usually written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something; put in for, enter one's name for; demand, put in for
words.translation: 应用, 申请；申请；涂，敷；应用；适用；请求

examples.en: We need to apply for planning permission to build a garage.
examples.zh: 我们建车库需要申请规划许可。

words.definition: to choose someone for a position or a job; install, constitute, name, place, specify; nominate sb to, institute to
words.translation: 任命，委派；约定，确定，指定；任命；指定；约定；委派

examples.en: officials appointed by the government
examples.zh: 政府任命的官员

words.definition: an arrangement for a meeting at an agreed time and place, for a particular purpose; convention, bond, nomination
words.translation: 约会；[管理]任命；约定；任命的职位

examples.en: All consultations are by appointment only .
examples.zh: 就诊必须预约。

words.definition: used to thank someone in a polite way or to say that you are grateful for something they have done; enjoy, see, grasp; value added, rise in price
words.translation: 感激，欣赏；欣赏；感激；领会；鉴别；增值；涨价

examples.en: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
examples.zh: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

examples.en: I appreciate your concern , but honestly, I’m fine.
examples.zh: 谢谢你关心，不过说真的，我很好。

examples.en: I’d appreciate it if you let me get on with my job.
examples.zh: 如果你能让我继续工作，我会非常感激。

words.definition: a feeling of being grateful for something someone has done; thank, acknowledgement
words.translation: 评价，感激；欣赏，鉴别；[经]增值；感谢

examples.en: He was presented with a watch in appreciation of his long service.
examples.zh: 他获赠一块手表，作为对其长期服务的感谢。

words.definition: to move towards or nearer to someone or something; a method of doing something or dealing with a problem; method, way, system, mechanism, medium; border, go on for; come near to, draw near
words.translation: 靠近；接近，方法；方法；途径；接近；着手处理

examples.en: As I approached the house, I noticed a light on upstairs.
examples.zh: 我走近那幢房子的时候注意到楼上有灯光。

examples.en: She heard footsteps approaching.
examples.zh: 她听到有脚步声走过来。

words.definition: to think that someone or something is good, right, or suitable; confirm, agree, uphold, authorize; to ratify, give someone the green light
words.translation: 赞成，同意；批准；赞成；为…提供证据；满意

examples.en: You've never approved of Henry, have you?
examples.zh: 你从未赞赏过亨利，是吧？

words.definition: when a plan, decision, or person is officially accepted; confirmation, authorization, validation, ratification
words.translation: 批准，认可，赞成；批准；认可；赞成

examples.en: The president has already given his approval to the plan.
examples.zh: 总统已经批准了这个计划。

examples.en: It is just three months since we received official approval to go ahead with the project.
examples.zh: 三个月前我们刚刚得到正式批准进行这个项目。

examples.en: A company cannot be sold without the approval of the shareholders.
examples.zh: 没有股东的同意不能出售公司。

words.definition: around, something
words.translation: 大约；大约，近似地；近于

words.definition: someone whose job is to design buildings
words.translation: 建筑师

examples.en: But I am an architect.
examples.zh: 但是我是一名建筑师。

examples.en: They commissioned an architect to design the new library.
examples.zh: 他们委托一位建筑师设计这座新图书馆。

examples.en: The building was constructed from the design of that architect.
examples.zh: 这幢大楼是按那位建筑师的设计建造的。

words.definition: a place where a large number of historical records are stored, or the records that are stored; chancery
words.translation: 档案文件；档案馆

examples.en: an archive of the writer’s unpublished work
examples.zh: 那位作家未发表作品的档案

words.definition: schedule, budget, place in, settle, form; place in, treat, form
words.translation: 把…（系统地）分类；安排；排列；整理；协商

words.definition: if the police arrest someone, the person is taken to a  police station  because the police think they have done something illegal; absorb, attract, engage, dispute, draw; prison, imprisonment
words.translation: 逮捕；[法]逮捕；阻止；吸引；监禁

examples.en: He was arrested and charged with murder.
examples.zh: 他遭到逮捕并被指控谋杀。

examples.en: I got arrested for careless driving.
examples.zh: 我因鲁莽驾驶被捕。

words.definition: feeling very sorry and embarrassed because of something you have done; compunctious
words.translation: 害羞的；惭愧的，感到难为情的；耻于……的

examples.en: Everyone cries sometimes – it’s nothing to be ashamed of.
examples.zh: 每个人都会有哭的时候——没什么好难为情的。

words.definition: if you assemble a large number of people or things, or if they assemble, they are gathered together in one place, often for a particular purpose; aggregate, fall in; concentrate, collect, aggregate, mass, crowd
words.translation: 组装；集合；集合，聚集；装配；收集

examples.en: A large crowd had assembled outside the American embassy.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚集在美国大使馆外。

examples.en: He looked around at the assembled company (=  all the people who had come there  ) .
examples.zh: 他环顾四周聚集的人群。

examples.en: She had assembled a collection of her favourite songs.
examples.zh: 她收集了一些自己最喜欢听的歌。

words.definition: the process of putting the parts of something together; concentration, convergence, fishing, set, gathering
words.translation: 装配；[机]装配；集会，集合

examples.en: instructions for assembly
examples.zh: 装配说明（书）

words.definition: the things that a company owns, that can be sold to pay debts; substance, virtue, advantage, finances
words.translation: 有价值的人(或物)资产；[经]资产；优点；有用的东西；有利条件

examples.en: the value of a company’s assets
examples.zh: 公司的资产价值

words.definition: to give someone a particular job or make them responsible for a particular person or thing; portion, part, ticket
words.translation: 分配，布置；分配；指派；[计][数]赋值

examples.en: When I taught, I would assign a topic to children that they would write about.
examples.zh: 教书时，我会给孩子们布置个写作题。

words.definition: a piece of work that a student is asked to do; allocation, distribution, role, mission, task
words.translation: 作业；分配；任务；功课

examples.en: a history assignment
examples.zh: 历史作业

words.definition: to make a connection in your mind between one thing or person and another; company, travel, sort, mix; brother, partner, fellow, comrade, colleague; combine; deputy, linked, vice, joint, auxiliary
words.translation: 交往；把……联系起来；结交；[管理]同事，伙伴；关联的事物；联想；使联合；使发生联系；副的；联合的

examples.en: Through science we've got the idea of associating progress with the future.
examples.zh: 通过科学我们已有了将进步与未来联系起来的观念。

words.definition: to think that something is true, although you do not have definite proof; undertake, adopt, accept, shoulder, sustain; attitudinize, put on the dog
words.translation: 假定，认为；承担；假定；采取；呈现；装腔作势；多管闲事

examples.en: I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
examples.zh: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

examples.en: When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
examples.zh: 到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

words.definition: something that you think is true although you have no definite proof; conception, perhaps, if
words.translation: 假定，假设；假定；设想；担任；采取

examples.en: You would be making an assumption that's not based on any fact that you could report.
examples.zh: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

words.definition: to surprise someone very much; emmarvel, gast
words.translation: 使惊讶，使大为吃惊；使惊讶

examples.en: Her reply astonished me.
examples.zh: 她的回答让我大吃一惊。

examples.en: It astonished him that she had changed so little.
examples.zh: 他很惊讶，她几乎没怎么变。

examples.en: What astonishes me most is his complete lack of fear.
examples.zh: 最令我吃惊的是，他什么都不怕。

words.definition: the feeling that an event or place gives you; mood, ambience
words.translation: 气氛；大气；空气；[心理]气氛；[气象][地物]大气

examples.en: The hotel had a lovely relaxed atmosphere .
examples.zh: 那家宾馆的气氛轻松愉快。

examples.en: The atmosphere at home was rather tense.
examples.zh: 家里的气氛很紧张。

words.definition: an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult; essay, attack, push; undertake, offer, sample, purpose, essay
words.translation: 尝试，试图；企图，试图；攻击；尝试

examples.en: Weather conditions prevented them from attempting the jump.
examples.zh: 天气状况使他们无法尝试跳伞。

words.definition: an automatic machine is designed to work without needing someone to operate it for each part of a process; inevitable, mechanical, certain, necessary, unconscious; robot
words.translation: 自动的；[军][自]自动的；无意识的；必然的；自动机械；[军]自动手枪

examples.en: an automatic weapon
examples.zh: 自动武器

examples.en: an automatic gearbox
examples.zh: 自动变速箱

examples.en: My camera is fully automatic .
examples.zh: 我的照相机是全自动的。

words.definition: something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found; valid, effective, virtual, telling, significant
words.translation: 可利用的，现有的；可获得的；[交]有效的，可得的；可利用的；空闲的

examples.en: Tickets are available from the box office.
examples.zh: 售票处有票出售。

examples.en: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
examples.zh: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

examples.en: Further building can continue when money is made available .
examples.zh: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

words.definition: be of help, have it; have it, to advantage; behalf, utility, benefit, sake, profit
words.translation: 有益, 有帮助；有用，有利；有利，有用；效用，利益

words.definition: the average amount is the amount you get when you add together several quantities and divide this by the total number of quantities; evenness, typical value; mean, ordinary, general
words.translation: 平常的；平均；[数]平均数；[保险]海损；[数]平均的；普通的

examples.en: The age of the candidates ranged from 29 to 49 with an average age of 37.
examples.zh: 候选人的年龄29岁至49岁不等，平均37岁。

examples.en: The average cost of making a movie has risen by 15%.
examples.zh: 制作一部影片的平均成本上升了15%。

examples.en: Last winter was colder than average.
examples.zh: 去年冬天比平常冷。

words.definition: the science or practice of flying in aircraft; avigation, airmanship
words.translation: 航空；[航]航空；飞行术；飞机制造业

examples.en: ...the aviation industry.
examples.zh: …航空工业。

words.definition: to pilot or fly in an aircraft; wing, to fly
words.translation: 驾驶飞机；飞行

examples.en: There is long-distance medical system in the boat, aviate board has near one thousand square meters , can help many model copters rise and drop.
examples.zh: 飞行甲板面积近千平方米，可供多种型号的直升机起降；

words.definition: to prevent something bad from happening; eliminate, escape, shun
words.translation: 避免；避开，躲避；消除

examples.en: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
examples.zh: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

examples.en: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
examples.zh: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

examples.en: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
examples.zh: 艾伦险出事故。

words.definition: to officially give someone something such as a prize or money to reward them for something they have done; something such as a prize or money given to someone to reward them for something they have done; grant, give; prize, sentence
words.translation: 授予；判给；奖(金)；判定；奖品；判决

examples.en: Moodie has been awarded a golf scholarship at the University of Hawaii.
examples.zh: 穆迪获授夏威夷大学高尔夫奖学金。

words.definition: knowledge or understanding of a particular subject or situation; consciousness, knowledge, cognition
words.translation: 意识；意识，认识；明白，知道

examples.en: Health officials have tried to raise awareness (=  improve people’s knowledge  ) about AIDS.
examples.zh: 卫生部官员努力提高人们对艾滋病的认识。

words.definition: someone’s family, education, previous work etc; prehistory
words.translation: 背景；[物]背景；隐蔽的位置

examples.en: Students with a background in chemistry will probably find the course easier.
examples.zh: 学过化学的学生可能会觉得这门课程容易些。

examples.en: It’s important to understand other people, people from different backgrounds .
examples.zh: 要理解别人，理解那些来自不同背景的人，这是很重要的。

examples.en: Do you know anything about his background?
examples.zh: 关于他的背景，你知道什么吗？

words.definition: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing; retarded, inverted; contrary, counter
words.translation: 向后的；反向的；发展迟缓的；向后地；相反地

examples.en: The diver flipped over backward into the water.
examples.zh: 跳水运动员向后翻转跳入水中。

examples.en: He took two steps backward.
examples.zh: 他往后退了两步。

words.definition: to say that something must not be done, seen, used etc; bar, inhibit, forbid; restraining order, injunction
words.translation: 禁止；禁止，[法]取缔；禁令，禁忌

examples.en: Smoking is banned in the building.
examples.zh: 大楼内禁止吸烟。

words.definition: without enough money to pay what you owe; broke, belly-up; put out of business, bust; insolvent
words.translation: 破产的，倒闭的；[经]破产的；[经]使破产；[经]破产者

examples.en: The firm went bankrupt before the building work was completed.
examples.zh: 建筑工程尚未竣工，公司就破产了。

examples.en: In 1977 he was declared bankrupt (=  by a court  ) .
examples.zh: 1977年，他被宣布破产。

examples.en: Mr Trent lost his house when he was made bankrupt .
examples.zh: 特伦特先生破产以后房子也没有了。

words.definition: trade, special, truck, compact; bar tack, make a deal; bar tack
words.translation: 讨价还价；交易；契约；特价商品；成交；拿…做交易

examples.en: Is she a bawd that she should bargain?
examples.zh: 她会是一个要讨价还价的鸨母吗?

words.definition: a fight between opposing armies, groups of ships, groups of people etc, especially one that is part of a larger war; war, conflict, campaign; campaign, fight, war
words.translation: 战争，战役；战役；斗争；作战

examples.en: the Battle of Trafalgar
examples.zh: 特拉法尔加战役

examples.en: a pitched battle (=  a long and serious battle  ) between police and drug gangs
examples.zh: 警方和贩毒团伙之间的一场激战

words.definition: to do things that are good, bad, sensible etc; conduct oneself, bear oneself, run, go
words.translation: 表现；（机器等）运转；举止端正；（事物）起某种作用

examples.en: She behaved in a very responsible way .
examples.zh: 她表现得很有责任心。

words.definition: having a good effect; helpful, useful, favorable, advantageous, conducive
words.translation: 有利的，有益的；有益的，有利的；可享利益的

examples.en: a drug that has a beneficial effect on the immune system
examples.zh: 有益于免疫系统的一种药物

examples.en: an arrangement that is mutually beneficial
examples.zh: 一项互惠互利的协定

words.definition: if you benefit from something, or it benefits you, it gives you an advantage, improves your life, or helps you in some way; behalf, sake, profit, advantage, plus; profit, be good for
words.translation: 有益于，有助于；利益，好处；救济金；有益于，对…有益

examples.en: They are working together to benefit the whole community.
examples.zh: 他们在为整个社区的利益共同努力。

words.definition: an offer to pay a particular price for something, especially at an  auction; tell, tender for; tender for; offer
words.translation: 出价，投标；投标；[贸易]出价；表示；吩咐；[贸易]投标；叫牌；努力争取

examples.en: the person who places the highest bid
examples.zh: 出价最高的人

examples.en: We’ve made a bid of nearly £400 million for the company.
examples.zh: 我们出价近四亿英镑收购那家公司。

examples.en: A takeover bid for the airline was launched today.
examples.zh: 今天有人出价收购该航空公司。

words.definition: to say or think that someone or something is responsible for something bad; talk to, tell off; duty, liability, error, burden, trust
words.translation: 指责，责怪；责备；归咎于；责任；过失

examples.en: Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
examples.zh: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

examples.en: I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
examples.zh: 怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

words.definition: if God blesses someone or something, he helps and protects them; celebrate, praise
words.translation: 祝福；保佑；赞美

examples.en: May God bless you.
examples.zh: 愿上帝保佑你。

words.definition: to stop something happening, developing, or succeeding; piece, mass, barrier, bottleneck; stem, dispute, prohibit, discourage; batched, wholescale
words.translation: 阻碍；街区；[计]块；[建]街区；大厦；障碍物；阻止；阻塞；限制；成批的，大块的；交通堵塞的

examples.en: The Senate blocked publication of the report.
examples.zh: 参议院阻止这个报告发表。

examples.en: laws designed to block imports of cheap tobacco
examples.zh: 旨在阻挠廉价烟草进口的法规

words.definition: not true or real, although someone is trying to make you think it is; false, spurious
words.translation: 假冒的；假的；伪造的

examples.en: bogus insurance claims
examples.zh: 虚报的保险索赔

examples.en: bogus applications for asylum
examples.zh: 虚假的避难申请

words.definition: an increase in the amount of power available to a  rocket  , piece of electrical equipment etc; to increase or improve something and make it more successful; facilitate, promote, enhance, further, jack; pick pocket, rip off; assistance, motivation, hand, aid, publicity
words.translation: 推动,宣扬；促使，促进；促进；增加；支援；宣扬；偷窃；推动；帮助

examples.en: It would get the economy going and give us the boost that we need.
examples.zh: 这会推动经济发展并带给我们所需要的推动力。

words.definition: to make the effort to do something; eat, burden; worry, go to trouble; trouble, worry, headache
words.translation: 打扰；麻烦；烦扰，打扰；使……不安；使……恼怒；操心，麻烦；烦恼

examples.en: Why bother to go abroad, when there are so many nice places here?
examples.zh: 这里有这么多好地方，干吗还要费事去国外？

words.definition: a road, river, or part of someone’s body etc that is broad is wide; wider, obvious, prominent, marked, noted
words.translation: 宽的；宽的，辽阔的；显著的；大概的

examples.en: We went along a broad passage.
examples.zh: 我们走在一条宽阔的走廊上。

examples.en: He was six feet tall, with broad shoulders.
examples.zh: 他身高六英尺，肩膀宽阔。

words.definition: the money that is available to an organization or person, or a plan of how it will be spent; to carefully plan and control how much money you spend and what you will buy with it; spend; place in, engage, settle; low-cost, penny-a-line
words.translation: 预算；编预算；[财政]预算，预算费；安排，预定；把…编入预算；廉价的

examples.en: We had a really tight budget .
examples.zh: 我们的预算很紧。

words.definition: something difficult or worrying that you are responsible for; liability, duty, weight, strain, trust; eat, bother
words.translation: 负担，包袱；负担；责任；船的载货量；使负担；烦扰；装货于

examples.en: His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
examples.zh: 家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

words.definition: a government department or a part of a government department in the US; department, innings
words.translation: 局；[管理]局，处；衣柜；[家具]办公桌

examples.en: the Federal Bureau of Investigation
examples.zh: 联邦调查局

words.definition: to find out how much something will cost, how long something will take etc, by using numbers; figure, cast; expect, propose, forecast, cast, find
words.translation: 计算；以为；作打算；预测；认为；打算

examples.en: These instruments calculate distances precisely.
examples.zh: 这些仪器计算距离非常精确。

words.definition: a series of actions intended to achieve a particular result relating to politics or business, or a social improvement; war, battle; movement, activity, exercise, sport, battle
words.translation: 活动；作战；参加竞选；参加活动；运动；战役

examples.en: Jones ran a good campaign.
examples.zh: 琼斯的活动搞得很成功。

examples.en: Police have launched a campaign to crack down on drug dealers.
examples.zh: 警方发起了一场严厉打击毒贩的运动。

words.definition: to decide that something that was officially planned will not happen; recall, call it off; call it off, declare off; withdrawal, revocation
words.translation: 取消；[计]取消；删去；相互抵销；[计]取消，撤销

examples.en: Our flight was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我们的航班取消了。

examples.en: I’m afraid I’ll have to cancel our meeting tomorrow.
examples.zh: 恐怕我得取消我们明天的会议。

examples.en: You’ll just have to ring John and cancel.
examples.zh: 你只能打电话给约翰取消了。

words.definition: someone who is being considered for a job or is competing in an election; examinee
words.translation: 申请求职者；投考者；候选人；候选人，候补者；应试者

examples.en: a presidential candidate
examples.zh: 总统候选人

words.definition: a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply; mess, refectory
words.translation: 食堂；食堂，小卖部；水壶

examples.en: Rennie had eaten his supper in the canteen.
examples.zh: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。

words.definition: having the qualities or ability needed to do something; able, competent
words.translation: 能干的，有能力的；能干的，能胜任的；有才华的

examples.en: I don’t think he’s capable of murder.
examples.zh: 我认为他没有能力杀人。

examples.en: The company isn’t capable of handling an order that large.
examples.zh: 那家公司没有能力应付那么大的订单。

examples.en: I’m perfectly capable of looking after myself, thank you!
examples.zh: 我完全能够自己照顾自己，多谢了！

words.translation: 照料者

examples.en: In addition to fulfilling the traditional roles of caregiver and homemaker, many Orthodox women also assume the role of primary breadwinner so their husbands can pursue religious studies full time.
examples.zh: 除了要践行传统的照料者和主妇角色，许多东正教女性也要承担起养家的责任以便她们的丈夫可以全身心进行宗教研究。

words.definition: not paying enough attention to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes, damage things etc; unwary, sloppy
words.translation: 粗心的；无忧无虑的；淡漠的

examples.en: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 他忘了锁门，真是粗心大意。

examples.en: a careless mistake
examples.zh: 粗心造成的错误

examples.en: careless driving
examples.zh: 粗心驾驶

words.definition: relaxed and not worried, or seeming not to care about something; extraordinary, temporary, informal, odd; leisure suit, slack suit
words.translation: 偶然的，随便的；随便的；非正式的；临时的；偶然的；便装；临时工人；待命士兵

examples.en: a casual manner
examples.zh: 漫不经心的态度

examples.en: His eyes were angry, though he sounded casual.
examples.zh: 虽然他的语气满不在乎，但他的眼神充满怒气。

examples.en: Marsha was quite casual about appearing on TV.
examples.zh: 玛莎对于上电视很无所谓。

words.definition: to make a complete list of all the things in a group; directory, content, list
words.translation: 把……编入目录；[图情][计]目录；（美）大学情况一览

examples.en: The manuscripts have never been systematically catalogued.
examples.zh: 一直没有系统地为这些手稿编过目录。

words.definition: the quality of being very careful to avoid danger or risks; warning, care; alarm, alert, warn
words.translation: 小心，谨慎；警告，警示；警告

examples.en: The physician must exercise caution when prescribing antidepressants.
examples.zh: 医师在开抗抑郁药处方时必须谨慎。

words.definition: careful to avoid danger or risks; prudent, wary
words.translation: 谨慎的；十分小心的

examples.en: a cautious driver
examples.zh: 一位谨慎的司机

examples.en: a cautious approach to the crisis
examples.zh: 处理危机的谨慎态度

examples.en: The air-pollution board has reacted with cautious optimism to the announcement.
examples.zh: 空气污染委员会对这项通告表示谨慎乐观。

words.definition: an important social or religious event, when a traditional set of actions is performed in a formal way; service, protocol, exercise
words.translation: 典礼，仪式；礼节，礼仪；客套，虚礼

examples.en: a wedding ceremony
examples.zh: 婚礼

examples.en: the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games
examples.zh: 奥运会开幕式

words.definition: something that tests strength, skill, or ability, especially in a way that is interesting; dare, doubt
words.translation: 挑战；质疑；怀疑

examples.en: They threw down the challenge that he couldn’t wash 40 cars in one hour (= invited him to try to do it ) .
examples.zh: 他们激将他，说他不可能在1小时内擦洗40辆汽车。

words.definition: a man, especially a man you know and like; apple, customer, checking, egg, guy
words.translation: 小伙子，小家伙，家伙；小伙子；家伙；龟裂

examples.en: a decent sort of chap
examples.zh: 一个正派的小伙子

words.definition: the particular combination of features and qualities that makes a thing or place different from all others; quality, role, workers, identity, tang; print...
words.translation: 角色；性格，品质；特性；[计]字符；印，刻；使具有特征

examples.en: A soulless shopping centre stands across from one of the few buildings with character, the town hall.
examples.zh: 一座毫无生气的购物中心对面就是少有的几个别具特色的建筑物之一：市政厅。

words.definition: to be typical of a person, place, or thing
words.translation: 以……特点

examples.en: Bright colours characterize his paintings.
examples.zh: 明亮的色彩是他绘画作品的特点。

words.definition: an organization that gives money, goods, or help to people who are poor, sick etc; tolerance, mercy
words.translation: 慈善（行为）；慈善；施舍；慈善团体；宽容；施舍物

examples.en: Several charities sent aid to the flood victims.
examples.zh: 有几家慈善机构已向洪灾灾民送去了救援物资。

words.definition: the soft round part of your face below each of your eyes; bottom, vizard
words.translation: 脸颊；面颊，脸颊；臀部

examples.en: Lucy stretched up to kiss his cheek.
examples.zh: 露西伸长了脖子去亲吻他的脸颊。

examples.en: Billy had rosy cheeks and blue eyes.
examples.zh: 比利脸颊红润，长着一双蓝眼睛。

examples.en: her tear-stained cheeks
examples.zh: 她泪痕斑斑的脸颊

words.definition: a skilled cook, especially the main cook in a hotel or restaurant; cook, kitchener
words.translation: 厨师；厨师，大师傅

examples.en: a master chef
examples.zh: 手艺高超的厨师长

examples.en: a pastry chef
examples.zh: 糕饼师傅

words.definition: relating to substances, the study of substances, or processes involving changes in substances; chymic
words.translation: 化学的 n. 化学制品；[化工]化学的

examples.en: the chemical composition of bleach
examples.zh: 漂白剂的化学成分

examples.en: a chemical analysis of the soil
examples.zh: 对土壤的化学分析

words.definition: to be unable to breathe properly because something is in your throat or there is not enough air; control, stay, restrain; plug up, block up; asphyxia, apnea
words.translation: 使窒息；呛；阻塞；抑制；扑灭；窒息；说不出话来；噎；[动力]阻气门

examples.en: Six people choked to death on the fumes.
examples.zh: 六人被烟呛死。

words.definition: the combination of facts, events etc that influence your life, and that you cannot control; context, situation, setting, event, occurrence, thing, scene
words.translation: 环境，境遇；环境，情况；事件；境遇

examples.en: He was a victim of circumstance .
examples.zh: 他是客观环境的牺牲品。

words.definition: to mention something as an example, especially one that supports, proves, or explains an idea or situation; reference, think of
words.translation: 引用；传讯；想起；表彰

examples.en: The judge cited a 1956 Supreme Court ruling in her decision.
examples.zh: 法官在她的判决中引用了1956年最高法院的一项裁决。

words.definition: someone who lives in a particular town, country, or state; people, municipality
words.translation: 公民；[法]公民；市民；老百姓

examples.en: We need our schools to teach students to be good citizens.
examples.zh: 我们需要学校把学生培养为好公民。

examples.en: The mayor urged citizens to begin preparing for a major storm.
examples.zh: 一场特大暴风雨即将到来，市长敦促市民做好准备。

words.definition: anyone who is not a member of the military forces or the police; many-headed; populace, common man
words.translation: 平民，百姓；民用的；百姓的，平民的

examples.en: Many innocent civilians were killed during the war.
examples.zh: 许多无辜的平民在战争中丧生。

words.definition: a civilized society is well organized and developed, and has fair laws and customs; polite, courteous; cultivated
words.translation: 文明的；有礼貌的；教化；使…文明；启发（civilize的过去分词）

examples.en: Such things should not happen in a civilized society.
examples.zh: 文明社会不应该有这种事情发生。

words.definition: to decide what group something belongs to; categorize, sort through
words.translation: 把…分类，把…分级；分类；分等

examples.en: We’d classify Drabble’s novels under ‘Romance’.
examples.zh: 我们把德拉布尔的小说归类为“言情小说”。

examples.en: Families are classified according to the father’s occupation.
examples.zh: 各个家庭按父亲的职业分类。

words.definition: a process in which you put something into the group or class it belongs to; category, degree, grade, rate, rank
words.translation: 分类，级别；[生物][图情]分类；类别，等级

examples.en: the classification of wines according to quality
examples.zh: 葡萄酒按品质的分类

examples.en: There are five job classifications.
examples.zh: 有五种工作类别。

words.definition: someone who gets services or advice from a professional person, company, or organization; customer, consumer, principal, guest, correspondent
words.translation: 客户；[计][经]客户；顾客；[审计]委托人

examples.en: a meeting with an important client
examples.zh: 与一位重要客户的会面

words.definition: a place, often in a hospital, where medical treatment is given to people who do not need to stay in the hospital; ambulatorium
words.translation: 诊所；[临床]临床

examples.en: an appointment at an outpatient clinic
examples.zh: 门诊预约

words.definition: moving or doing things in a careless way, especially so that you drop things, knock into things etc; awkward, inept
words.translation: 笨拙的，不圆滑的；笨拙的

examples.en: A clumsy waiter spilled wine all over her new skirt.
examples.zh: 一名笨手笨脚的服务员把葡萄酒洒得她新裙子上到处都是。

examples.en: a clumsy attempt to catch the ball
examples.zh: 笨拙的接球动作

words.definition: someone who trains a person or team in a sport; drilling, mentors; discipline, supervise
words.translation: 教练；旅客车厢；[车辆]长途公车；四轮大马车；训练；指导

examples.en: a tennis coach
examples.zh: 网球教练

examples.en: the Norwegian national coach
examples.zh: 挪威国家队教练

words.definition: someone you work with – used especially by professional people; brother, fellow, associate
words.translation: 同事；同事，同僚

examples.en: a colleague of mine from the bank
examples.zh: 我在银行的一位同事

examples.en: She discussed the idea with some of her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她和几位同事讨论了这个想法。

words.definition: a strong disagreement between two people or groups; interference, conflict, war, crash, impact
words.translation: 撞击；冲突；[物]碰撞

examples.en: They were on their way to the airport when their van was involved in a collision with a car.
examples.zh: 他们正往机场赶路的时候，其货车和一辆小汽车相撞了。

words.definition: if you combine two or more different things, or if they combine, they begin to exist or work together; bond, associate; band, bond, couple, become one, connect; integrated works, Konzern
words.translation: 联合，结合；使化合；使联合，使结合；化合；[农机]联合收割机；联合企业

examples.en: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
examples.zh: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

examples.en: Ruth hesitated, uncertain of how to combine honesty and diplomacy in her answer.
examples.zh: 露丝犹豫了，她不知道怎样回答才能既诚实又婉转。

words.definition: an opinion that you express about someone or something; opinion, criticism, mind, judgement, thinking; declare oneself, air one's opinion
words.translation: 评论；意见；批评；发表评论；发表意见

examples.en: He was fined for making abusive comments to the referee.
examples.zh: 他因谩骂裁判而被罚款。

words.definition: to do something wrong or illegal; sin, do sth. wrong
words.translation: 犯罪，承担义务；犯罪，做错事；把...交托给；指派…作战；使…承担义务

examples.en: Women commit fewer crimes than men.
examples.zh: 女性犯罪比男性少。

words.definition: a promise to do something or to behave in a particular way; assurance, certification, guarantee, security, compliance
words.translation: 承诺，保证；委托；承担义务；献身

examples.en: Are you ready to make a long-term commitment ?
examples.zh: 你是否准备好作出长久的承诺？

words.definition: a group of people chosen to do a particular job, make decisions etc; council, soviet
words.translation: 委员会

examples.en: a committee meeting
examples.zh: 委员会会议

words.definition: to consider two or more things or people, in order to show how they are similar or different; contradistinguish, be confronted with; match; parabole
words.translation: 比较，对照；比较；对照；比喻为；相比

examples.en: The report compares the different types of home computer available.
examples.zh: 这份报告比较了市场上不同类型的家用计算机。

words.definition: to force someone to do something; pressure, force, enforce
words.translation: 强迫；强迫，迫使；强使发生

examples.en: ...the introduction of legislation to compel cyclists to wear a helmet.
examples.zh: …强制骑车人戴头盔的法律的引入。

words.definition: to replace or balance the effect of something bad; make good, to make up for
words.translation: 弥补，补偿；补偿，赔偿；抵消；付报酬

examples.en: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
examples.zh: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

words.definition: money paid to someone because they have suffered injury or loss, or because something they own has been damaged; payment, consideration, insurance, reward, offset
words.translation: 弥补，补偿；[会计]补偿；报酬；[保险]赔偿金

examples.en: People who are wrongly arrested may be paid compensation .
examples.zh: 被误抓的人有可能得到补偿费。

words.definition: if one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or servicesrather than those available from another company or country; contest, war, cope
words.translation: 竞争；比赛；对抗

examples.en: Me: What do you mean "compete"?
examples.zh: 我：你的“竞争”是什么意思？

words.definition: the ability of a company, country, or a product to compete with others; competitive strength
words.translation: 竞争力；[经]竞争力，好竞争

examples.en: New machinery has enhanced the company’s productivity and competitiveness.
examples.zh: 新机器帮助公司提高了生产力，增强了竞争力。

examples.en: Europe’s competitiveness in international markets
examples.zh: 欧洲在国际市场上的竞争力

words.definition: a person, team, company etc that is competing with another; equal, opponent, rival, match, contestant
words.translation: 竞争者，对手；[劳经]竞争者，对手

examples.en: Last year they sold twice as many computers as their competitors.
examples.zh: 去年他们的计算机销量是竞争对手的两倍。

words.definition: a feeling of satisfaction with a situation or with what you have achieved, so that you stop trying to improve or change things – used to show disapproval; satisfaction, content, fill
words.translation: 自满，满足；自满；满足；自鸣得意

examples.en: Doctors have warned against complacency in fighting common diseases.
examples.zh: 医生警告说，治疗常见病不能一见好就掉以轻心。

examples.en: Despite yesterday’s win, there is clearly no room for complacency if the team want to stay top of the league.
examples.zh: 尽管这支球队昨天赢了，但要在联赛中独占鳌头，就不能骄傲自满。

words.definition: to say that you are annoyed, not satisfied, or unhappy about something or someone; whine about, beef; beef about, rail against
words.translation: 抱怨；投诉；发牢骚；诉说；控诉

examples.en: Residents are complaining because traffic in the area has increased.
examples.zh: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

examples.en: ‘You never ask my opinion about anything,’ Rod complained.
examples.zh: “你什么事都不问问我的看法。”罗德抱怨道。

examples.en: Employees complained bitterly about working conditions.
examples.zh: 雇员们对工作条件十分不满。

words.definition: a statement in which someone complains about something; sickness, complain of
words.translation: 抱怨; 投诉；抱怨；诉苦；疾病；委屈

examples.en: If you wish to make a complaint, you should see the manager.
examples.zh: 如果你要投诉，应该去找经理。

examples.en: The sales assistants are trained to deal with customer complaints in a friendly manner.
examples.zh: 售货员都受过培训，要以友好的态度处理顾客的投诉。

words.definition: to finish doing or making something, especially when it has taken a long time; used to emphasize that a quality or situation is as great as it could possibly be; whole, thorough, full, absolute, total; accomplish, carry out, achieve, perform, fulfil
words.translation: 完成；完整的，彻底的；[数]完整的；完全的；彻底的

examples.en: Students must complete the course.
examples.zh: 学生必须学完这门课程。

examples.en: The building took two years to complete.
examples.zh: 这幢大楼花了两年时间才完工。

words.definition: difficult to understand or deal with, because many parts or details are involved; involved, detailed, sophisticated, elusive
words.translation: 复杂的，难懂的；难懂的，复杂的

examples.en: a complicated voting system
examples.zh: 复杂的选举制度

examples.en: For young children, getting dressed is a complicated business.
examples.zh: 对幼童来说，穿衣服是件复杂的事。

words.definition: to do what you have to do or are asked to do; engage, abide by/obey/observe
words.translation: 遵从；遵守；顺从，遵从；答应

examples.en: The newspaper was asked by federal agents for assistance and agreed to comply.
examples.zh: 联邦探员要求这家报社给予协助，报社同意配合。

words.definition: one of several parts that together make up a whole machine, system etc; constituent; module, element, constituent
words.translation: 成分；[天]组成的，构成的；组件；[电子]元件

examples.en: companies that make electronic components for computer products
examples.zh: 为计算机产品生产电子零件的公司

words.definition: a large amount of something in a particular place or among particular people; thickness, compression, assembly, convergence, set
words.translation: 集中；[物][化学]浓度；浓缩；专心；集合

examples.en: The area has one of the world's greatest concentrations of wildlife.
examples.zh: 该地区有世界上野生生物最集中的区域之一。

words.definition: an idea of how something is, or how something should be done; idea, sense, notion, construct
words.translation: 观点，观念；观念，概念

examples.en: a new concept in business travel
examples.zh: 商务旅行的新理念

examples.en: our basic concepts of decent human behaviour
examples.zh: 我们对得体的人类行为的基本观念

examples.en: It’s very simple, once you grasp the concept .
examples.zh: 你一旦掌握了这个概念之后就很简单了。

words.definition: something that is important to you or that involves you; deal with, to relate to; relationship, connection, attention, consideration, bearing
words.translation: 涉及，关系到；使担心；关系；关心；关心的事

examples.en: His main concern is to be able to provide for his family.
examples.zh: 他最为关心的事就是能够养家。

words.definition: something you decide after considering all the information you have; outcome, ending, consequence, verdict
words.translation: 结论；结局；推论

examples.en: These are the report’s main conclusions.
examples.zh: 这些就是这篇报告的主要结论。

examples.en: It is still too early to reach a conclusion on this point.
examples.zh: 在这一点上作出结论还为时过早。

examples.en: There are perhaps two main conclusions to be drawn from the above discussion.
examples.zh: 从以上的讨论也许可以得出两个主要的结论。

words.definition: the feeling that you can trust someone or something to be good, work well, or produce good results; faith, trust, secret, privacy, hope
words.translation: 信心；信任；秘密

examples.en: I felt I was doing well and my confidence began to grow.
examples.zh: 我觉得自己干得不错，自信心就开始增加了。

words.definition: to show that something is definitely true, especially by providing more proof; identify, favor, sustain, validate
words.translation: 确认；证实；批准；确定；使巩固

examples.en: New evidence has confirmed the first witness’s story.
examples.zh: 新的证据证实了第一个证人的说法。

examples.en: To confirm my diagnosis I need to do some tests.
examples.zh: 为了证实我的诊断，我要做一些化验。

words.definition: if two ideas, beliefs, opinions etc conflict, they cannot exist together or both be true; interference, difference, war, battle, collision; combat, collide with
words.translation: 冲突；冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执；冲突，抵触；战斗

examples.en: Personal ethics and professional ethics sometimes conflict.
examples.zh: 个人道德与职业道德之间有时会相冲突。

words.definition: to obey a law, rule etc; accord, meet with; accord, reconcile; united, consistent, matching, uniform, corresponding
words.translation: 相一致，遵守；符合；遵照；适应环境；使遵守；使一致；使顺从；一致的；顺从的

examples.en: It is a solid, proven solution for adopting multiple standards -- whether your goal is to conform to the law or to improve your business practices.
examples.zh: 它是一个坚固的、已经证实采用多个标准的解决方案，不管你的目标是遵守法律还是改善你的商业实践。

words.definition: if a problem, difficulty etc confronts you, it appears and needs to be dealt with; front, compare
words.translation: 面对；遭遇；比较

examples.en: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
examples.zh: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

words.definition: the ability of computers and other electronic equipment to connect with other computers or programs; formation communication
words.translation: 连接，联系；[数][电][计]连通性

examples.en: a growing demand for high-speed connectivity
examples.zh: 对高速连接功能日益增长的需求

examples.en: Internet connectivity software
examples.zh: 具有因特网连接功能的软件

words.definition: the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is morally right or wrong
words.translation: 良心

examples.en: Well, at least I can face them all with a clear conscience (= the knowledge that you have done nothing wrong ) .
examples.zh: 好吧，至少我可以问心无愧地面对他们所有人。

examples.en: I can’t tell you what to do – it’s a matter of conscience (= something that you must make a moral judgment about ) .
examples.zh: 我不能告诉你怎么办——这是良心问题。

examples.en: a crisis of conscience among medical staff (= a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what is the right thing to do )
examples.zh: 医务人员中的良心危机

words.definition: an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with or accepts; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, keeping
words.translation: 一致意见；一致；舆论；合意

examples.en: The EU Council of Finance Ministers failed to reach a consensus on the pace of integration.
examples.zh: 欧盟财政部长会议未能就一体化的进度达成共识。

examples.en: the current consensus of opinion
examples.zh: 目前观点上的一致

examples.en: The general consensus was that technology was a good thing.
examples.zh: 大家都认为科技是好东西。

words.definition: to give your permission for something or agree to do something; agreement about something; grant, comply, engage; agreement, accordance, unity, identity, yes
words.translation: 允许，同意；同意，一致；同意；赞成；答应；（意见等的）一致

examples.en: He finally consented to go.
examples.zh: 他最终同意去。

words.definition: something that happens as a result of a particular action or set of conditions; outcome, product, result, significance, event, conclusion
words.translation: 结果，成果；结果；重要性；推论

examples.en: Her lawyer said she understood the consequences of her actions and was prepared to go to jail.
examples.zh: 她的律师说她明白自己行为的后果并准备去坐牢。

words.definition: not liking changes or new ideas; standpat, backward-looking; old guard, pontificator
words.translation: 保守的，传统的；保守的；保守派，守旧者

examples.en: a very conservative attitude to education
examples.zh: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

examples.en: conservative views
examples.zh: 保守的观点

words.definition: fairly large, especially large enough to have an effect or be important; crucial, important, material, big, major
words.translation: 相当大(或多)的；相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的

examples.en: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

examples.en: issues of considerable importance
examples.zh: 相当重要的问题

examples.en: The series has aroused considerable interest.
examples.zh: 这套系列节目引起了观众相当浓厚的兴趣。

words.definition: much or a lot; relatively, fairly, comparatively, reasonably, pretty
words.translation: 相当地，非常地；相当地；非常地

examples.en: It’s considerably colder today.
examples.zh: 今天冷多了。

examples.en: Conditions have improved considerably over the past few years.
examples.zh: 过去几年里条件已经得到了很大的改善。

words.definition: always thinking of what other people need or want and being careful not to upset them; thoughtful, wary
words.translation: 体贴的；考虑周到的；体谅的

examples.en: He was always kind and considerate.
examples.zh: 他总是很善良，为别人着想。

words.definition: make up, be composed of
words.translation: 由……组成；组成；在于；符合

examples.en: My diet consisted almost exclusively of chocolate-covered cookies and glasses of milk.
examples.zh: 我的饮食几乎只包含裹上巧克力的曲奇饼和一杯杯牛奶。

words.definition: always behaving in the same way or having the same attitudes, standards etc – usually used to show approval; united, corresponding, uniform, matching, solid
words.translation: 一致的；始终如一的，[数]一致的；坚持的

examples.en: She’s the team’s most consistent player.
examples.zh: 她是该队中表现最为稳定的选手。

words.definition: very easy to notice; obvious, prominent, marked, noted, outstanding
words.translation: 显著地；显著的；显而易见的

examples.en: The notice must be displayed in a conspicuous place.
examples.zh: 通告一定要贴在显眼的地方。

examples.en: a bird with conspicuous white markings
examples.zh: 一种长有醒目白斑的鸟

examples.en: I felt very conspicuous in my red coat.
examples.zh: 我穿着红外套，感觉自己十分显眼。

words.definition: happening regularly or all the time; permanent, steady; invariable
words.translation: 不断的，持续的；不变的；恒定的；经常的；[数]常数；恒量

examples.en: There was a constant stream of visitors to the house.
examples.zh: 参观这幢房子的游客川流不息。

examples.en: Amy lived in constant fear of being attacked.
examples.zh: 埃米一直生活在害怕遭到袭击的恐惧之中。

examples.en: He kept in constant contact with his family while he was in Australia.
examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚时一直和家人保持着联系。

words.definition: all the time, or very often; forever, continually, unceasingly, straight, endlessly
words.translation: 不断地，时常地；不断地；时常地

examples.en: He talked constantly about his work.
examples.zh: 他不断地谈到他的工作。

examples.en: The English language is constantly changing .
examples.zh: 英语在不断地变化。

words.definition: the process of building things such as houses, bridges, roads etc; interpretation, explanation, fabric, building, structure
words.translation: 建筑；[建]建设；建筑物；解释；造句

examples.en: a road construction project
examples.zh: 道路修建计划

examples.en: construction workers
examples.zh: 建筑工人

words.definition: useful and helpful, or likely to produce good results; putative
words.translation: 建设的，建设性的；建设性的；推定的；构造上的；有助益的

examples.en: The meeting was very constructive.
examples.zh: 这次会议很有建设性。

examples.en: We welcome any constructive criticism .
examples.zh: 我们欢迎任何有建设性的批评。

words.definition: to ask for information or advice from someone because it is their job to know something; look up, speak together; take advice, seek advice
words.translation: 咨询；查阅；商量；向…请教；请教；商议；当顾问

examples.en: If symptoms persist, consult a doctor without delay.
examples.zh: 如果症状持续的话，马上咨询医生。

words.definition: someone whose job is to give advice on a particular subject; adviser, counselor
words.translation: 顾问；[经]顾问；咨询者；会诊医生

examples.en: a management consultant
examples.zh: 管理顾问

words.definition: the amount of energy, oil, electricity etc that is used; expense, depletion
words.translation: 消费，消耗；[经]消费；消耗；肺痨

examples.en: Vigorous exercise increases oxygen consumption.
examples.zh: 剧烈运动增加氧的消耗。

words.definition: communication with a person, organization, country etc; touch, link; meet, to link
words.translation: 联系，接触；[电][电子]接触，联系；联系，[电][电子]接触

examples.en: The town is cut off from contact with the outside world.
examples.zh: 小镇与外界的联系被切断了。

words.definition: belonging to the present time; coeval; modern-day, cotemporary
words.translation: 当代的，现代的；同时代的人；同时期的东西；当代的；同时代的；属于同一时期的

examples.en: She writes a lot of contemporary music for people like Whitney Houston.
examples.zh: 她为惠特尼·休斯敦等人创作大量当代音乐作品。

words.definition: the ideas, facts, or opinions that are contained in a speech, piece of writing, film, programme etc; satisfaction, directory, bulk, list, fill; satisfactory, well-pleasing; gratify, appease
words.translation: 内容；内容，目录；满足；[物]容量；满意的；使满足

examples.en: The content of the media course includes scripting, editing and camera work.
examples.zh: 大众传媒课程的内容包括稿件写作、剪辑和摄像操作。

words.definition: the situation, events, or information that are related to something and that help you to understand it; circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 背景，环境；环境；[计]上下文；来龙去脉

examples.en: The meaning of ‘mad’ depends on its context. mad
examples.zh: 一词的意义要视上下文而定。

words.definition: an official agreement between two or more people, stating what each will do; communicate, shrink; affect, catch, communicate; compact, engagement
words.translation: 合同；收缩；感染；订约；使缩短；[经]合同；婚约

examples.en: Employees who refuse to relocate are in breach of contract (= have done something not allowed by their contracts ) .
examples.zh: 员工拒绝调动岗位是违反合约的。

words.definition: something that is very different from something else; if two things contrast, the difference between them is very easy to see and is sometimes surprising; parallel, distinction, differential
words.translation: 对比，反差；对比；差别；对照物

examples.en: The sauce is quite sweet, so add dried thyme as a contrast.
examples.zh: 这调味汁很甜，所以要加点干百里香作为陪衬。

words.definition: to give money, help, ideas etc to something that a lot of other people are also involved in; make contribution, offer up
words.translation: 捐款，贡献；贡献，出力；[图情]投稿；[经]捐献

examples.en: The three sons also contribute to the family business.
examples.zh: 3个儿子也为家族企业做贡献。

words.definition: something that you give or do in order to help something be successful; subscription, contributing to
words.translation: 贡献；捐献；投稿

examples.en: a campaign contribution
examples.zh: 竞选捐款

words.definition: useful to you because it saves you time, or does not spoil your plans or cause you problems; commodious, expedient
words.translation: 方便的

examples.en: Mail-order catalogs are a convenient way to shop.
examples.zh: 使用邮购目录是一种方便的购物方式。

examples.en: My secretary will call you to arrange a convenient time to meet.
examples.zh: 我的秘书会打电话给你安排一个方便的时间见面。

words.definition: a conventional method, product, practice etc has been used for a long time and is considered the usual type; traditional, usual, familiar, classical
words.translation: 传统的；符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的

examples.en: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
examples.zh: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

examples.en: Bake for 20 minutes in a conventional oven; 8 in a microwave.
examples.zh: 在传统的烤炉中烘烤20分钟，在微波炉里则烤8分钟。

words.definition: to communicate or express something, with or without using words; communicate, release, transport
words.translation: 传达，传递；传达；运输；让与

examples.en: All this information can be conveyed in a simple diagram.
examples.zh: 所有这些信息可以通过一张简单的图表来表示。

examples.en: Ads convey the message that thin is beautiful.
examples.zh: 广告传递的信息是: 瘦就是美。

examples.en: He was sent to convey a message to the UN Secretary General.
examples.zh: 他被派去向联合国秘书长传达一条信息。

words.definition: willing to cooperate; coefficient, collaborative; artel, co-op
words.translation: 合作的；[农经]合作的；合作社的；[农经]合作社

examples.en: He was doing his best to be cooperative.
examples.zh: 他在尽全力配合。

examples.en: a cooperative witness
examples.zh: 肯配合的目击者

words.definition: shared by or involving all the members of a group; mutual, entire, common, collective, universal
words.translation: 法人的；团体的；社团的；[法]法人的；共同的，全体的

examples.en: corporate responsibility
examples.zh: 共同的责任

words.definition: to advise someone; advice, discussion; agree to sb, make suggestions
words.translation: 忠告，建议；法律顾问；忠告；商议；讨论；决策；建议；劝告

examples.en: My advisers counselled me to do nothing.
examples.zh: 我的顾问建议我不要做任何事情。

words.definition: two people who are married or having a sexual or romantic relationship; immune to, conjugality; bond, become one, combine; become one, join together
words.translation: 夫妻，情侣；对；夫妇；数个；结合；成婚；连接；连合

examples.en: a newly married couple
examples.zh: 一对新婚夫妇

examples.en: the couple next door
examples.zh: 隔壁的那对夫妇

words.definition: brave; game, brave
words.translation: 有勇气的；有胆量的，勇敢的

examples.en: He was wrong, and courageous enough to admit it.
examples.zh: 他是错了，而且有勇气承认自己错了。

examples.en: a courageous decision
examples.zh: 勇敢的决定

words.definition: to have an accident in a car, plane etc by violently hitting something else; collision, precipitation, impact; fall of, fall to pieces; hit, impact on; quickie
words.translation: 坠落;坠毁;撞击；碰撞；崩溃；坠落；破碎；撞碎；[航]坠毁；闯；突然倒台；速成的

examples.en: The jet crashed after take-off.
examples.zh: 这架喷气式飞机起飞后就坠毁了。

words.definition: the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things etc; creative power, originality
words.translation: 创造力；创造性

examples.en: artistic creativity
examples.zh: 艺术创造力

examples.en: Teachers have been attacked for stifling creativity in their pupils.
examples.zh: 教师被批评压抑了学生的创造力。

examples.en: Editors complain about the lack of creativity in the ideas put to them.
examples.zh: 编辑们抱怨说交给他们的选题缺乏创意。

words.definition: a situation in which there are a lot of problems that must be dealt with quickly so that the situation does not get worse or more dangerous; defining moment, critical stage
words.translation: 危机；危险期；决定性时刻

examples.en: The country now faces an economic crisis .
examples.zh: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

examples.en: The Prime Minister was criticized for the way in which he handled the crisis .
examples.zh: 首相处理危机的方式遭到了批评。

examples.en: the current debt crisis
examples.zh: 当前的债务危机

words.definition: someone whose job is to make judgments about the good and bad qualities of art, music, films etc; commenter, reviewer
words.translation: 批评家，评论家；爱挑剔的人

examples.en: Mather was a film critic for many years.
examples.zh: 马瑟做过多年的电影评论家。

words.definition: if you are critical, you criticize someone or something; dangerous, crucial, final, decisive, marginal
words.translation: 批评的，爱挑剔的；鉴定的；[核]临界的；危险的；决定性的；评论的

examples.en: He made some highly critical remarks.
examples.zh: 他发表了一些严厉的批判性言论。

words.definition: to express your disapproval of someone or something, or to talk about their faults; observe on, to comment on
words.translation: 批评；评论；非难；苛求

examples.en: Ron does nothing but criticize and complain all the time.
examples.zh: 罗恩什么也不干，只是一味指责和抱怨。

examples.en: The new law has been widely criticized .
examples.zh: 这项新法律受到了广泛的批评。

words.definition: remarks that say what you think is bad about someone or something; comment, animadversion
words.translation: 批评；考证；苛求

examples.en: Despite strong criticism , the new system is still in place.
examples.zh: 尽管遭到了猛烈的批评，新制度依然原封不动。

examples.en: There has been widespread criticism of the decision.
examples.zh: 这一决定受到了普遍的批评。

examples.en: We try to give students constructive criticism .
examples.zh: 我们设法对学生提出有建设性的批评。

words.definition: to plant and take care of a particular crop; rear, foster, plant, nurse
words.translation: 培养；陶冶；耕作

examples.en: We cultivated maize and watermelons.
examples.zh: 我们种植玉米和西瓜。

words.definition: to control or limit something in order to prevent it from having a harmful effect; checking, control, restraint, suppression, inhibition; possess, contain, regulate, bit, bottle
words.translation: 控制；抑制；路边；勒马绳；勒住

examples.en: measures to curb the spread of the virus
examples.zh: 控制病毒扩散的措施

words.definition: the desire to know about something; treasure, pearl
words.translation: 好奇心；好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩

examples.en: I opened the packet just to satisfy my curiosity .
examples.zh: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

examples.en: The news aroused a lot of curiosity among local people.
examples.zh: 这条消息在当地人中间引起了很大的好奇心。

examples.en: She decided to follow him out of curiosity .
examples.zh: 她出于好奇决定跟踪他。

words.definition: wanting to know about something; critical, odd
words.translation: 好奇的；好奇的，有求知欲的；古怪的；爱挑剔的

examples.en: Puppies are naturally curious.
examples.zh: 小狗天生好奇。

words.definition: happening or existing now; recent, now, universal, late, present; tendency, direction, tide, trend, set
words.translation: 当前的；现在的；流通的，通用的；最近的；草写的；（水，气，电）[流]流；趋势；涌流

examples.en: the current President
examples.zh: 现任总统

examples.en: In its current state, the car is worth £1,000.
examples.zh: 这辆车按现在的车况来看值1,000英镑。

words.definition: at the present time; commonly, normally, generally
words.translation: 当前；一般地

examples.en: the products that are currently available
examples.zh: 目前供应的产品

examples.en: He is currently working on his first novel.
examples.zh: 他目前正在创作他的第一本小说。

words.definition: a sum of money that a person or organization owes; liability, loan, borrowing
words.translation: 债务；借款；罪过

examples.en: He had enough money to pay off his outstanding debts.
examples.zh: 他有足够的钱偿还亏欠的债务。

examples.en: students who run up huge debts
examples.zh: 欠下巨额债务的学生

words.definition: following moral standards that are acceptable to society; proper, goodish
words.translation: 正派的，体面的；正派的；得体的；相当好的

examples.en: a decent burial
examples.zh: 得体的葬礼

examples.en: Paul visited the local bars more frequently than was decent for a senior lecturer.
examples.zh: 保罗过于频繁地光顾当地酒吧，不太合乎高级讲师的身份。

examples.en: The chairman did the decent thing (= did what people thought he ought to ) and resigned.
examples.zh: 主席体面地辞去了职务。

words.definition: to decrease in quantity or importance; reduction, recession, fall; go down, slump; excuse oneself from
words.translation: 下降，减少；拒绝；下降；衰退；斜面；衰落；谢绝；婉拒

examples.en: Spending on information technology has declined.
examples.zh: 用于信息技术的支出减少了。

examples.en: Car sales have declined by a quarter.
examples.zh: 汽车销量下滑了四分之一。

examples.en: After the war, the city declined in importance.
examples.zh: 战后这座城市的重要性下降了。

words.definition: to paint the inside of a room, put special paper on the walls etc; paint, hang, make, post; set sth out, trick out
words.translation: 装饰；布置；授勋给

examples.en: The bathroom is decorated in green and yellow.
examples.zh: 浴室里是用绿色和黄色装潢的。

examples.en: We plan to spend the weekend decorating.
examples.zh: 我们计划用这个周末来装修。

words.definition: a phrase or sentence that says exactly what a word, phrase, or idea means; difinition, sharpness
words.translation: 定义；[数]定义；[物]清晰度；解说

examples.en: a dictionary definition
examples.zh: 词典里的释义

words.definition: a unit for measuring temperature. It can be shown as a symbol after a number. For example, 70° means 70 degrees.; extent, classification, measure, grade, plane
words.translation: 程度；程度，等级；度；学位；阶层

examples.en: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.
examples.zh: 把烘箱预热至425度。

words.definition: to wait until a later time to do something; wait, hold over; hold over, stand over; raincheck, postponement
words.translation: 推迟，延期；延期；耽搁；被耽搁或推迟的时间

examples.en: Don’t delay – send off for the information now.
examples.zh: 别犹豫——即刻去函索取信息。

examples.en: He delayed his decision on whether to call an election.
examples.zh: 在是否宣布举行选举一事上，他推迟作出决定。

words.definition: intended or planned; intended, studied, designed, contained, conscious; negotiate, mull over
words.translation: 故意的；深思熟虑的；从容的；仔细考虑；商议

examples.en: a deliberate attempt to humiliate her
examples.zh: 对她的故意羞辱

examples.en: The attack on him was quite deliberate.
examples.zh: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

words.definition: lovely, pleasant, pretty, taking, grateful
words.translation: 高兴的；可爱的，可喜的；令人愉快的

words.definition: to make a speech etc to a lot of people; afford, allow, extend, deal, free; come true, come to pass
words.translation: 发表；交付；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生；实现；传送；履行；投递

examples.en: The king delivered a televised speech to the nation on November 5.
examples.zh: 国王在11月5日向全国发表了电视讲话。

words.definition: the need or desire that people have for particular goods and services; exact, lack, desire, call for; wish, have need of; necessity, need, do, desire, want
words.translation: 需求，要求；要求；需要；查询；[计]请求；查问；[经]需求

examples.en: Production is still increasing faster than demand.
examples.zh: 生产仍比需求增长快。

words.definition: controlled by representatives who are elected by the people of a country; popular
words.translation: 民主的；民主政治的；大众的

examples.en: a democratic government
examples.zh: 民主政府

examples.en: the role of the media in the democratic process
examples.zh: 民主进程中媒体的作用

words.definition: to show or prove something clearly; prove, give evidence of
words.translation: 证明；展示；论证

examples.en: The study demonstrates the link between poverty and malnutrition.
examples.zh: 这项研究证明了贫困与营养不良之间的联系。

examples.en: The government now has an opportunity to demonstrate its commitment to reform.
examples.zh: 政府现在有机会表明改革的决心了。

words.definition: the degree to which an area is filled with people or things; specific mass
words.translation: 密度；[物]密度

examples.en: areas of high population density
examples.zh: 人口密度高的地区

words.definition: one of the groups of people who work together in a particular part of a large organization such as a hospital, university, company, or government; ministry, division, bureau, sector
words.translation: 部门；部；[管理]部门；系；科；局

examples.en: the personnel department
examples.zh: 人事部

examples.en: the English department
examples.zh: 英语系

words.definition: an area, industry etc that is depressed does not have enough economic or business activity; blue, disappointed; disheartened
words.translation: 沮丧的；萧条的；压低的；使沮丧；使萧条（depress的过去式和过去分词形式）；压低

examples.en: Britain’s depressed housing market
examples.zh: 英国不景气的房产市场

words.definition: making you feel very sad; repressive, discouraging
words.translation: 令人沮丧的；压抑的；使人沮丧的

examples.en: It’s a depressing thought.
examples.zh: 这是个令人沮丧的想法。

examples.en: The whole experience was very depressing.
examples.zh: 整个经历非常令人沮丧。

words.definition: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it; shear, strip of
words.translation: 剥夺，夺去，使丧失；使丧失，剥夺

examples.en: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
examples.zh: 他们无法得到住房取暖必需的燃料。

words.definition: to get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something; to originate
words.translation: 得到，导出；起源

examples.en: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
examples.zh: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

words.definition: to have earned something by good or bad actions or behaviour; be deserving of
words.translation: 值得；应受，应得

examples.en: What have I done to deserve this?
examples.zh: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

examples.en: I’m sorry for the kids. They deserve better (= deserve to be treated in a better way ) .
examples.zh: 我为这些孩子感到难过，他们应该过得更好。

examples.en: Ledley deserves a place in the team.
examples.zh: 莱德利应该在队里占有一席之地。

words.definition: a strong hope or wish; requirement, wants, do, need, wish; feel like, wanna, require, mean, exact; rare, aspire, long for, yearn for, die for
words.translation: 渴望，欲望；欲望；要求，心愿；性欲；想要；要求；希望得到…；渴望

examples.en: female sexual desire
examples.zh: 女性的性欲

words.definition: used to say that something happens or is true even though something else might have prevented it; in spite of, for all that; hate, hatred, contempt
words.translation: 不管；尽管，不管；轻视；憎恨；侮辱

examples.en: Despite all our efforts to save the school, the authorities decided to close it.
examples.zh: 尽管我们竭力想保住这所学校，当局还是决定把它关闭。

words.definition: sweet food served after the main part of a meal
words.translation: 甜点

examples.en: She had homemade ice cream for dessert.
examples.zh: 她吃了些自制冰淇淋当餐后甜点。

words.definition: a single feature, fact, or piece of information about something; specific, minutia; expand on, enlarge on
words.translation: 细节；细节，详情；详述；选派

examples.en: This issue will be discussed in more detail in Chapter 5.
examples.zh: 这个问题将在第五章里作更为详细的论述。

words.definition: containing or including a lot of information or details; complicated, strict, particular, specific, involved; specified
words.translation: 细节的，详细的；详细的，精细的；复杂的，详尽的；详细说明（detail的过去分词）

examples.en: a beautifully detailed carving
examples.zh: 漂亮精致的雕刻

words.definition: to notice or discover something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear etc; explore, perceive
words.translation: 觉察;检测；察觉；发现；探测

examples.en: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
examples.zh: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

words.definition: when something is found that is not easy to see, hear etc, or the process of looking for it; exploration, discovery, occurrence, find
words.translation: 侦查；察觉；侦查，探测；发觉，发现

examples.en: ...the early detection of breast cancer.
examples.zh: …乳腺癌的早期发现。

words.definition: a police officer whose job is to discover information about crimes and catch criminals; tec, hawkshaw
words.translation: 侦探

examples.en: She hired a detective to find out if her husband was having an affair.
examples.zh: 她雇了一个私人侦探调查她丈夫是否有外遇。

words.definition: if something determines something else, it directly influences or decides it; condition, conclude; identify, drop, finish, judge
words.translation: 决定；下决心；判决；使…下定决心；确定；判决，终止

examples.en: The amount of available water determines the number of houses that can be built.
examples.zh: 可用的水量决定可以建造多少房子。

examples.en: The age of a wine is a determining factor as to how it tastes.
examples.zh: 酒的年份对于酒的味道是个决定性因素。

words.definition: decision, resolution, push, backbone
words.translation: 意志；决心；果断

words.definition: apparatus, installation, strategy, unit, gear
words.translation: 装置，设备；[机]装置；策略；图案
