examples.zh: 宝宝时刻都要有人照看。

words.definition: to think that something is probably true, based on what you know; expect, have, count, say, guess; believe, imagine
words.translation: 料想，以为；假定；期望；假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想；猜想；料想

examples.en: There were many more deaths than was first supposed.
examples.zh: 死亡人数远远超过最初的预料。

examples.en: (= it is unlikely that ) he’s lying.
examples.zh: 没有理由认为他在说谎。

words.definition: to ride on waves while standing on a special board; ocean wave, sea wave
words.translation: 冲浪；海浪，拍岸浪

examples.en: I'm going to buy a surfboard and learn to surf.
examples.zh: 我要去买个冲浪板来学冲浪。

words.definition: to ask a large number of people questions in order to find out their attitudes or opinions; a set of questions that you ask a large number of people in order to find out about their opinions or behaviour; investigation, measurement, probe, research; examine, check into
words.translation: 调查，审视，仔细考虑；勘测，测量，测绘，调查；调查；测量；审视；纵览；[测][油气]勘测；俯瞰

examples.en: Of the 100 companies surveyed, 10% had a turnover of £50 m to £99 m.
examples.zh: 被调查的 100 家公司中，10% 的公司营业额在 5,000 万到 9,900 万英镑之间。

words.definition: to think that something is probably true, especially something bad; someone who is thought to be guilty of a crime; sus; doubtful, questionable; dispute, imagine, wonder, question; wonder, imagine, question, suppose
words.translation: 怀疑，猜想；嫌疑犯；[法]嫌疑犯；可疑的；不可信的；怀疑；猜想

examples.en: She strongly suspected he was lying to her.
examples.zh: 她非常怀疑他在对她撒谎。

examples.en: She’s not going to be very happy about this, I suspect .
examples.zh: 我想对于此事她不会太高兴。

words.definition: maintain, undertake, support, accept, favor
words.translation: 维持；支撑，承担；忍受；供养；证实

examples.en: Wants, or desires, are things we would like to have but they do not sustain us.
examples.zh: 想法或愿望，是我们想要拥有的东西但是他们不能维持我们的生活。

words.definition: able to continue without causing damage to the environment
words.translation: 可持续的

examples.en: The government should do more to promote sustainable agriculture.
examples.zh: 政府应该做更多工作来推动可持续农业的发展。

examples.en: the sustainable use of rainforest resources
examples.zh: 雨林资源的可持续利用

examples.en: Cycling is a totally sustainable form of transport.
examples.zh: 骑自行车是一种绝对环保的交通方式。

words.definition: happening or done quickly and immediately; quick, rapid, fast, forward, ready; quickly, rapidly, fast, promptly, ready
words.translation: 迅速的；快的；敏捷的；立刻的；迅速地

examples.en: My letter received a swift reply.
examples.zh: 我的信很快就得到了回复。

examples.en: She shot a swift glance at Paul.
examples.zh: 她迅速瞥了保罗一眼。

words.definition: to change from doing or using one thing to doing or using another
words.translation: 转变，改变

examples.en: The terrorists will switch tactics .
examples.zh: 恐怖分子会改变战术。

words.definition: a picture or shape that has a particular meaning or represents a particular organization or idea; significant, seal, indication, flag
words.translation: 象征，标志；象征；符号；标志

examples.en: The symbol on the packet is a guarantee that the food has been produced organically.
examples.zh: 包装盒上的这个标识保证这种食物是有机生产的。

words.definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is in a bad situation; acceptance, feeling, compassion, pity
words.translation: 同情心；同情；慰问；赞同

examples.en: Our sympathies are with the families of the victims.
examples.zh: 我们向受害者家庭表示慰问。

words.definition: to try to deal with a difficult problem; equipment, tool, arm, setup; grasp, root, cope with
words.translation: 处理；[机]滑车；装备；用具；扭倒；抓住；固定；与…交涉

examples.en: There is more than one way to tackle the problem.
examples.zh: 解决这个问题不止一个办法。

examples.en: It took twelve fire engines to tackle the blaze .
examples.zh: 出动了12辆消防车来扑救那场大火。

words.definition: If you tailor something such as a plan or system to someone's needs, you make it suitable for a particular person or purpose by changing the details of it; dressmaker, needlecraft, sartor, seamster
words.translation: 调整使适应；[服装]裁缝

examples.en: We can tailor the programme to the patient's needs.
examples.zh: 我们可以根据病人的需要调整这个方案。

words.definition: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground
words.translation: 起飞

examples.en: What time is takeoff?
examples.zh: 起飞时间是什么时候？

words.definition: a large container for storing liquid or gas; trough, mere; beat, best
words.translation: 油箱，水箱；[军]坦克；水槽；池塘；把…贮放在柜内；打败

examples.en: The water tank is leaking.
examples.zh: 水箱在漏水。

examples.en: Somehow the chemical got from a storage tank into water supplies.
examples.zh: 不知怎么的，这种化学物从储存箱进入了供水系统。

examples.en: the plane’s fuel tank
examples.zh: 飞机的油箱

words.definition: food or drink that is tasteless is unpleasant because it has no particular taste; milk-and-water, flavourless
words.translation: 无味的；[食品]无味的；无鉴赏力的

examples.en: The fish was mushy and tasteless.
examples.zh: 这鱼烧得烂而无味。

words.definition: connected with knowledge of how machines work; specialized, express
words.translation: 技术的；工艺的，科技的；技术上的；专门的

examples.en: Our staff will be available to give you technical support .
examples.zh: 有我们的员工向你提供技术支持。

examples.en: I have no technical knowledge at all.
examples.zh: 我一点技术知识都没有。

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["technical training"]}
examples.zh: 技术培训

words.definition: a special way of doing something; skill, science, mechanics, tips
words.translation: 技术，技能；技巧，手艺；技巧，技术；手法

examples.en: He’s a great player, with brilliant technique.
examples.zh: 他是个伟大的球员，球技十分精湛。

words.definition: someone whose job is to check equipment or machines and make sure that they are working properly; lab-technician
words.translation: 技术员，技师；[劳经]技师，技术员；技巧纯熟的人

examples.en: a laboratory technician
examples.zh: 实验室技术人员

examples.en: a hospital technician
examples.zh: 医院技术人员

words.definition: dreary, dreich
words.translation: 单调沉闷的；沉闷的；冗长乏味的

examples.en: The audience coughed down the tedious speaker.
examples.zh: 听众用咳嗽声阻挠演讲人的沉闷发言。

examples.en: There's no point in labouring at a tedious task.
examples.zh: 辛苦地干单调乏味的工作没有意义。

words.definition: a strong desire to have or do something even though you know you should not; invitation, allurement
words.translation: 诱惑，引诱；引诱；诱惑物

examples.en: Resist the temptation to buy the item until you’re certain you need it.
examples.zh: 要抵挡住购买的诱惑，除非你确有需要。

examples.en: I finally gave in to the temptation and had a cigarette.
examples.zh: 我最终还是屈从诱惑，抽了一支烟。

words.definition: a nervous worried feeling that makes it impossible for you to relax; strain, intensity, stress; stress, wind up
words.translation: 紧张；张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压；使紧张；使拉紧

examples.en: The tension was becoming unbearable, and I wanted to scream.
examples.zh: 这种紧张变得难以忍受，我真想大声尖叫。

words.definition: a shelter consisting of a sheet of cloth supported by poles and ropes, used especially for camping; residence, accommodation
words.translation: 帐篷；住处；帷幕

examples.en: We looked for a flat spot where we could pitch our tent (= put up our tent ) .
examples.zh: 我们寻找一个平缓的地方搭帐篷。

words.definition: very; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 可怕地，非常；非常；可怕地；极度地

examples.en: I’m terribly sorry to have kept you waiting.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，让你久等了。

examples.en: The coach was not terribly worried about his team’s poor performance.
examples.zh: 教练对他所执教球队的糟糕表现并不是十分担忧。

words.definition: the treatment of an illness or injury over a fairly long period of time; cure, medical treatment
words.translation: 疗法 治疗；治疗，[临床]疗法

examples.en: new drug therapies
examples.zh: 新的药物疗法

examples.en: radiation therapy for cancer treatment
examples.zh: 治疗癌症的放射疗法

words.definition: to say that you will cause someone harm or trouble if they do not do what you want; indicate, forecast, shadow, cow; to menace, hang over
words.translation: 威胁；恐吓；预示；可能来临

examples.en: Postal workers are threatening a strike if they don’t receive a pay increase.
examples.zh: 邮政工人威胁如果不加薪，他们就要罢工。

words.definition: a current of water caused by the tide; tendency, direction, trend, stream, set
words.translation: 顺应潮水航行；趋势，[海洋]潮流；潮汐

examples.en: Strong tides make swimming dangerous.
examples.zh: 遇上大潮时游泳很危险。

words.definition: straiten
words.translation: 紧的，紧缩的；绷紧；变紧

words.definition: extremely small; micro, few, little, minute
words.translation: 微小的；很少的

examples.en: a tiny community in the Midwest
examples.zh: 中西部地区一个极小的社区

examples.en: The earrings were tiny.
examples.zh: 耳环很小。

examples.en: a tiny little baby
examples.zh: 丁点大的婴儿

words.definition: willingness to allow people to do, say, or believe what they want without criticizing or punishing them; patience, charity, mercy
words.translation: 宽容，容忍；[机]公差；宽容；容忍；公差

examples.en: ...his tolerance and understanding of diverse human nature.
examples.zh: …他对各种人性的宽容和理解。

words.definition: a pain in a tooth; odontalgia, dentagra
words.translation: 牙痛，牙疼；[口腔]牙痛

examples.en: I’ve got toothache .
examples.zh: 我牙痛。

examples.en: I had terrible toothache all last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我一整夜牙疼得厉害。

words.definition: a line of marks left on the ground by a moving person, animal, or vehicle; path, railway, tail, trajectory, orbit; clear, trail; go, walk, step
words.translation: 跟踪,足迹；[铁路]轨道；[古生]足迹，踪迹；小道；追踪；通过；循路而行；用纤拉；走；留下足迹

examples.en: We followed the tyre tracks across a muddy field.
examples.zh: 我们顺着车辙穿过一块泥泞的田地。

examples.en: The tracks, which looked like a fox’s, led into the woods.
examples.zh: 这些足迹看着像是狐狸留下的，一直通向树林里。

words.definition: a particular quality in someone’s character; quality, tang, identity, sort, distinction
words.translation: 性格；特性，特点；[心理]品质；少许

words.definition: a business deal or action, such as buying or selling something; relations, trade, truck
words.translation: 交易，业务，事务；[贸易]交易；[计]事务；办理；会报，[图情]学报

examples.en: The bank charges a fixed rate for each transaction.
examples.zh: 银行对每一笔业务收取固定费用。

examples.en: financial transactions
examples.zh: 金融业务

words.definition: to move from one place, school, job etc to another, or to make someone do this, especially within the same organization; negotiation, diversion; make over, dispose of; hand, negotiate
words.translation: 转换，调换；转让；[计]转移；传递；过户；转学；换车；[计]使转移；调任

examples.en: Ideas that work well in one school often don’t transfer well to another.
examples.zh: 在一所学校行得通的理念套用在另一所学校上往往行不通。

words.definition: a system or method for carrying passengers or goods from one place to another; carriage, traffic
words.translation: 运输；[交]运输；运输系统；运输工具；流放

examples.en: The city needs to improve its public transportation (= buses, trains etc ) .
examples.zh: 这座城市需要改善公共交通。

words.definition: something that is done to cure someone who is injured or ill; therapy, transactions, settlement, disposal, computing
words.translation: 治疗，对待；[临床]治疗，疗法；处理；对待

examples.en: Just lately, Kyra has been giving me the silent treatment (= refusing to speak to me because she is angry with me ) .
examples.zh: 就在最近，凯拉一直对我不理不睬。

words.definition: to shake slightly in a way that you cannot control, especially because you are upset or frightened; roll, rock; roll, frisson
words.translation: 颤抖；发抖；战栗；焦虑；摇晃

examples.en: His lip started to tremble and then he started to cry.
examples.zh: 他的嘴唇开始颤抖，接着就哭了起来。

words.definition: an important victory or success after a difficult struggle; victory, success, win; arrive, win, make good
words.translation: 胜利；胜利，凯旋；欢欣；获得胜利，成功

examples.en: Winning the championship is a great personal triumph .
examples.zh: 赢得冠军是伟大的个人成就。

words.definition: teaching, especially in small groups; schooling
words.translation: 学费；讲授

examples.en: I had to have extra tuition in maths.
examples.zh: 我不得不上数学补习课。

words.definition: knub, phyma
words.translation: 瘤；肿瘤；肿块；赘生物

examples.en: The tumor will soon be resolved.
examples.zh: 这个肿瘤很快就会消掉的。

examples.en: He literally pulled those cells out of their blood and grew billions more of them in laboratory dishes, enough to have a chance at overwhelming a tumor.
examples.zh: 他精确地把那些细胞从他们的血液中抽离出来，在实验室的培养皿中让其增值数十亿倍，大到足以有可能制服一个肿瘤。

words.definition: finally, after everything else has been done or considered; eventually, finally, basically, lastly, either
words.translation: 最后，最终；最后；根本；基本上

examples.en: Ultimately, the decision rests with the child’s parents.
examples.zh: 最终，决定权在这孩子的父母手中。

examples.en: a long but ultimately successful campaign
examples.zh: 一场历时很久但最终成功的运动

words.translation: 买不起的，负担不起的

examples.en: You have to become awfully large to be unaffordable -- there's lots of cash, lots of capital out there for acquisitions.
examples.zh: 制药业者坐拥很多现金,进行收购的资本雄厚,你必须变成让人买不起的超大公司.

words.definition: feeling doubt about something; changeable, vague
words.translation: 不确定的；无常的；含糊的；靠不住的；迟疑不决的

examples.en: My whole future now seemed uncertain.
examples.zh: 现在我的前途似乎是个未知数。

words.definition: If you undermine someone's efforts or undermine their chances of achieving something, you behave in a way that makes them less likely to succeed; destroy, founder
words.translation: 暗中破坏；破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基

examples.en: The continued fighting threatens to undermine efforts to negotiate an agreement.
examples.zh: 持续的战斗有可能破坏通过谈判达成协议的努力。

words.definition: unusually good and special; distinct, individual, one, sole, picturesque
words.translation: 独特的，唯一的；独特的，稀罕的；[数]唯一的，独一无二的

examples.en: a unique opportunity to study these rare creatures
examples.zh: 研究这些珍稀动物的难得机会

words.definition: involving everyone in the world or in a particular group; widespread, entire, corporate, worldwide, current; general concept
words.translation: 普遍的，宇宙的，全世界的；普遍的；通用的；[天]宇宙的；全世界的；全体的；一般概念；普通性

examples.en: free universal healthcare
examples.zh: 免费的全民保健制度

examples.en: These stories have universal appeal.
examples.zh: 这些故事人人都喜欢。

examples.en: a topic of universal interest
examples.zh: 人们普遍感兴趣的一个话题

words.definition: the way that your parents care for you and teach you to behave when you are growing up; nursing, breeding
words.translation: 养育，培养，教养；教养；养育；抚育

examples.en: Mike had had a strict upbringing.
examples.zh: 迈克从小家教很严。

words.definition: to add the most recent information to something; renovate, refresh; modernization, renewal
words.translation: 更新，使现代化；更新；校正，修正；使现代化；现代化

examples.en: The files need updating.
examples.zh: 这些档案需要更新。

words.definition: a valid ticket, document, or agreement is legally or officially acceptable; available, effective, virtual, telling, significant
words.translation: 有效的；有效的，有根据的；正当的

examples.en: a valid credit card
examples.zh: 有效信用卡

examples.en: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
examples.zh: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

words.definition: to think that someone or something is important; importance, significance, price, stress, weight; score, rate, prize
words.translation: 重视；[数]值；[经]价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义；评价；估价

examples.en: Shelley valued her privacy.
examples.zh: 谢利很重视自己的隐私。

words.definition: to disappear suddenly, especially in a way that cannot be easily explained; disappear, blank; unmake
words.translation: 消失；[数]消失；突然不见；成为零；使不见，[数]使消失

examples.en: My keys were here a minute ago but now they’ve vanished.
examples.zh: 我的钥匙刚刚还在这里，现在却不翼而飞了。

examples.en: The bird vanished from sight.
examples.zh: 那只鸟从视线中消失了。

examples.en: She seemed to have just vanished into thin air (= suddenly disappeared in a very mysterious way ).
examples.zh: 她好像就蒸发了似的。

words.definition: a lot of things of the same type that are different from each other in some way; category, manner, nature, kind, sort
words.translation: 多样；种类；杂耍

examples.en: The girls come from a variety of different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 这些女孩出身背景各不相同。

words.definition: a machine with an engine that is used to take people or things from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck; instrument, engine, tool, gear, implement
words.translation: 车辆；[车辆]车辆；工具；交通工具；运载工具；传播媒介；媒介物

examples.en: a description of the stolen vehicle
examples.zh: 对被盗车辆的描述

examples.en: Have you locked your vehicle?
examples.zh: 你锁车了吗？

words.definition: a copy of something that has been changed so that it is slightly different; edition, translation
words.translation: 版本；[计]版本；[图情]译文；倒转术

examples.en: the human version of mad cow disease
examples.zh: 疯牛病的人类变体

words.definition: to think about something or someone in a particular way; observation, opinion, scenery, scope, comment; watch, study, regard, think of, think about
words.translation: 看待；观察；视野；意见；风景；考虑；查看

examples.en: an opportunity to view the film before it goes on general release
examples.zh: 在影片公映之前观影的机会

words.definition: to disobey or do something against an official agreement, law, principle etc; let, act against
words.translation: 违反；侵犯，妨碍；亵渎

examples.en: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
examples.zh: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

examples.en: regimes that violate human rights
examples.zh: 侵犯人权的政权

words.definition: almost; actually, really, almost, nearly, most
words.translation: 几乎，差不多；事实上，几乎；实质上

examples.en: Virtually all the children come to school by bus.
examples.zh: 几乎所有的孩子都乘公交车上学。

examples.en: He was virtually unknown before running for office.
examples.zh: 他在参加竞选之前几乎不为人知。

words.definition: a very small living thing that causes infectious illnesses; vindictiveness, Vyrus
words.translation: 病毒；[病毒]病毒；恶毒；毒害

examples.en: children infected with the Aids virus
examples.zh: 感染艾滋病病毒的儿童

examples.en: a virus infection
examples.zh: 病毒感染

words.definition: the distance it is possible to see, especially when this is affected by weather conditions
words.translation: 能见度

examples.en: Visibility on the roads is down to 20 metres due to heavy fog.
examples.zh: 道路能见度因浓雾降至20米。

words.definition: something that is visible can be seen; obvious, distinct, seen, evident
words.translation: 看得见的；明显的；现有的；可得到的

examples.en: The comet is visible to the naked eye (= can be seen without using special equipment ).
examples.zh: 这颗彗星肉眼看得见。

examples.en: Check the plant for any visible signs of disease.
examples.zh: 检查一下植物是否有患病的迹象。

words.definition: extremely important and necessary for something to succeed or exist; dynamic, life-or-death
words.translation: 重要的；至关重要的；生死攸关的；有活力的

examples.en: The work she does is absolutely vital.
examples.zh: 她所做的工作至关重要。

examples.en: It is vital to be honest with your children.
examples.zh: 对自己的孩子坦诚十分重要。

examples.en: The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.
examples.zh: 旅游业对国家的经济至关重要。

words.definition: all the words that someone knows or uses; lexis
words.translation: 词汇；[语]词汇；词表

examples.en: Teachers were impressed by his vocabulary.
examples.zh: 他的词汇量给老师们留下了深刻的印象。

words.definition: to show which person or party you want, or whether you support a plan, by marking a piece of paper, raising your hand etc; election, poll; make the offer, propone; poll
words.translation: 投票，选举；选票；得票数；提议，使投票；投票决定；公认；选举，投票

examples.en: In 1918 British women got the right to vote.
examples.zh: 1918年，英国妇女获得了选举权。

words.definition: wise decisions and actions are sensible and based on good judgment; intelligent, learned, knowing, bright, clever; enlighten, indoctrinate; know about, learn about, get to know, make sth of
words.translation: 聪明的，有智慧的；明智的；聪明的；博学的；使知道；教导；了解

examples.en: a wise precaution
examples.zh: 明智的预防措施

examples.en: I don’t think that would be a very wise move (= not be a sensible thing to do ).
examples.zh: 我认为那样做不是很明智。

words.definition: someone who sees a crime or an accident and can describe what happened; proof, teste; demonstrate, prove, argue
words.translation: 目击者，目击；[法]证人；目击者；证据；目击；证明；为…作证

examples.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to come forward.
examples.zh: 警方呼吁目击者站出来。

examples.en: an eye witness (= someone who sees an event ) to the robbery
examples.zh: 抢劫案的一名目击者

words.definition: to become worse or make something worse; go ill, change for the worse; aggravate, complicate
words.translation: （使）变得更坏；恶化；变得更坏；更坏；使恶化；使变得更坏

examples.en: A lot of teachers expect the situation to worsen over the next few years.
examples.zh: 许多老师认为接下来的几年情形会更糟。

examples.en: Interfering now could worsen the problem.
examples.zh: 目前介入可能会使问题更严重。

words.definition: if something is worthwhile, it is important or useful, or you gain something from it
words.translation: 有价值的

examples.en: He wanted to do a worthwhile job.
examples.zh: 他想做有意义的工作。

examples.en: We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause (= one that helps people ) .
examples.zh: 我们决定把这笔钱投入到慈善事业中。

words.definition: to produce a result, answer, or piece of information; the amount of profits, crops etc that something produces; desert, quit; succumb, to surrender; crop, output, harvest, proceeds
words.translation: 屈服，产出；产量；[力]屈服；出产；放弃；[力]屈服，投降；[经]产量；收益

examples.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
examples.zh: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

words.definition: including all the necessary facts, details, or problems that need to be dealt with; extensive, integrated, synthetic, widespread, general
words.translation: 综合的，全面的；综合的；广泛的；有理解力的

examples.en: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
examples.zh: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

examples.en: a comprehensive guide to British hotels and restaurants
examples.zh: 一本介绍英国酒店和餐厅的详尽指南

examples.en: The following guidelines do not aim to be totally comprehensive.
examples.zh: 以下指导原则并非想要面面俱到。

words.definition: produced by combining different artificial substances, rather than being naturally produced; comprehensive, integrated, artificial, general; composition
words.translation: 合成的，人造的；综合的；合成物

examples.en: synthetic chemicals
examples.zh: 合成化学品

words.definition: if you undergo a change, an unpleasant experience etc, it happens to you or is done to you; experience, stand, stomach, tough, abide
words.translation: 承受；经历，经受；忍受

examples.en: The country has undergone massive changes recently.
examples.zh: 这个国家最近经历了巨大的变化。

examples.en: He has been released from prison to undergo medical treatment in the United States.
examples.zh: 他获释出狱去美国接受治疗。

examples.en: She has been undergoing tests since Monday.
examples.zh: 她从星期一开始一直在接受各种检查。

words.definition: an outdoor event, at which there are large machines to ride on, games to play, and sometimes farm animals being judged and sold; beautiful, fine, clear, just, impartial; definitely, directly, equally, immediately, straight; expo, exhibition, beauty
words.translation: 集市；公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象]晴朗的；公平地；直接地；清楚地；[经]展览会；市集；美人

examples.en: a horse fair
examples.zh: 马市

words.definition: a place where bread and cakes are baked, or a shop where they are sold; tommy-shop
words.translation: 面包店；[食品]面包店

examples.en: A smell of bread drifted from some distant bakery.
examples.zh: 一股面包的味道从远处的某个面包店飘来。

words.definition: circuit, knee; invest, case, wash; tap, close in on
words.translation: 膝盖；一圈；下摆；山坳；使重叠；拍打；包围；重叠；轻拍；围住

words.definition: with the side, rather than the front or back, facing forwards; laterad
words.translation: 向侧面；向侧面地；向一旁

examples.en: They brought the piano sideways through the front door.
examples.zh: 他们把钢琴侧着从前门抬进来。

words.definition: to make food or drink go down your throat and towards your stomach; stomach, go, stand, abide, tough; get sth down, get down
words.translation: 咽下，吞下；忍受；吞没；吞下；咽下

examples.en: He swallowed the last of his coffee and asked for the bill.
examples.zh: 他喝完最后一口咖啡，要求结账。

examples.en: Most snakes swallow their prey whole .
examples.zh: 大多数蛇都是把猎物囫囵吞下。

words.definition: steel, wear
words.translation: 持久；耐久性；坚固；耐用年限

examples.en: A: Why do we have to do durability test?
examples.zh: 我们为什么要做耐久性测试?

examples.en: Another problem of cigarettes as money is their lack of durability.
examples.zh: 香烟作为货币的另一个问题是它缺少耐久性。

examples.en: They estimate that they will need between five and ten years to commercialize their technology because uncertainties remain regarding the durability of organic cells.
examples.zh: 他们估计要用五到十年的时间使他们的技术商业化，因为关于这种有机电池的耐久性还不确定。

words.definition: if something symbolizes a quality, feeling etc, it represents it; indicate, image, figure
words.translation: 象征；用符号表现

examples.en: Crime often symbolizes a wider social problem.
examples.zh: 犯罪问题往往反映出更广泛的社会问题。

examples.en: Growing discontent has been symbolized by the protests.
examples.zh: 与日俱增的不满通过一次又一次的抗议表现出来。

words.definition: continuing for ever, even after someone has died; eternal, permanent, lasting, timeless
words.translation: 永恒的；接连不断的

examples.en: everlasting fame
examples.zh: 永久的名声

examples.en: a symbol of God’s everlasting love
examples.zh: 上帝永恒之爱的象征

examples.en: a belief in life everlasting
examples.zh: 对永生的信念

words.definition: a marriage ceremony, especially one with a religious service; marriage, combination, coupling, bond, join
words.translation: 婚礼；婚礼，婚宴；结婚；结合

examples.en: She’s busy planning her daughter’s wedding.
examples.zh: 她正忙着筹备女儿的婚礼。

examples.en: When is the wedding?
examples.zh: 婚礼是什么时候？

words.definition: a larger amount of something than is allowed or needed; immoderation, exorbitance; additional, added, attached, extra, plus
words.translation: 过量，过度；超过，超额；过度，过量；无节制；额外的，过量的；附加的

examples.en: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
examples.zh: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

words.definition: for example; situation, case, circumstance, suggestion, advice, proposal, thing
words.translation: 情况，例子；实例；情况；建议

examples.en: We need to rethink the way we consume energy. Take, for instance, our approach to transport.
examples.zh: 我们需要重新考虑我们使用能源的方式，例如我们的运输方式。

words.definition: Slightly means to some degree but not to a very large degree
words.translation: 轻微地

examples.en: His family then moved to a slightly larger house.
examples.zh: 他的家后来搬到了一间稍微大一点儿的房子。

examples.en: Each person learns in a slightly different way.
examples.zh: 每个人学习的方式都略有不同。

words.definition: to accept that you are responsible for a piece of work, and start to do it; accept, pursue, address, try, offer
words.translation: 承担；承担，保证；从事；同意；试图

examples.en: He undertook to pay the money back in six months.
examples.zh: 他保证在六个月之内还钱。

words.definition: to make an angry, unhappy, or confused expression, moving your  eyebrows  together; disagree with, to disapprove of; mowe
words.translation: 皱眉；不同意；皱眉，蹙额

examples.en: She frowned as she read the letter.
examples.zh: 她看着信皱起了眉头。

words.definition: superimposed load, surcharge
words.translation: 向……多收费；[电]过度充电；[交]超载；装药过多

examples.en: Rural medics get an average stipend of $65 a year, leading some to overcharge their patients.
examples.zh: 这些医生每年仅得到65美元，这导致他们向病人高收费。

words.definition: the network of electricity supply wires that connects  power stations  and provides electricity to buildings in an area; reseau, latticework
words.translation: 输电网；[电子]网格；[数]格子，栅格

examples.en: the national grid
examples.zh: 国家电网

words.definition: if several things of the same type vary, they are all different from each other; pass, change from; influence, fashion, shift, innovate
words.translation: 变化；不同；变异；违反；改变；使多样化；变奏

examples.en: Test scores vary from school to school.
examples.zh: 测验成绩各校不同。

examples.en: The heights of the plants vary from 8 cm to 20 cm.
examples.zh: 这些植物的高度从8厘米到20厘米不等。

examples.en: Medical treatment varies greatly from state to state.
examples.zh: 医疗制度州与州之间差异很大。

words.definition: relating to the way in which plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; growing, developmental, changing
words.translation: 演变的，进化的；进化的；发展的；渐进的

examples.en: the evolutionary development of birds
examples.zh: 鸟类的进化过程

examples.en: Some scientists have rejected evolutionary theory.
examples.zh: 有些科学家拒绝接受进化论。

words.definition: someone who is trained in psychology
words.translation: 心理学家

examples.en: a clinical psychologist
examples.zh: 临床心理学家

words.definition: someone who does someone else’s job for a limited period of time, especially in a sports team or school; replacement, proxy; supply, fill in; replace, cover for, take the place of somebody, stand in for sb
words.translation: 代替；代用品；代替者；[计]替代

examples.en: Germany brought on a substitute at half time.
examples.zh: 德国队在比赛半场时换上一名替补队员。

examples.en: substitute goalkeeper
examples.zh: 替补守门员

words.definition: to tell someone exactly what they must do or how they must behave; require, order, command; instruction, order, bidding, telling, word
words.translation: 命令，规定；命令；口述；使听写；指示

examples.en: Federal funds have to be used as dictated by Washington.
examples.zh: 联邦款项得按照华盛顿规定的途径使用。

examples.en: The US government attempted to dictate the terms of the agreement.
examples.zh: 美国政府企图规定协议的条款。

words.definition: when something is subdivided, or the parts that result from doing this; branch, subsection
words.translation: 分区；细分；分部；供出卖而分成的小块土地

examples.en: Months are a conventional subdivision of the year.
examples.zh: 月份是年的常规分支。

words.definition: a service such as gas or electricity provided for people to use; practical use, public facility; applied, universal, current
words.translation: 使用，公共设施；实用；效用；公共设施；功用；实用的；通用的；有多种用途的

examples.en: Does your rent include utilities?
examples.zh: 你的房租包括公用事业费吗？

words.definition: excessively, exorbitantly
words.translation: 过分地，非常地；禁止地；过高地；过分地

words.definition: to influence someone so that they change their opinion; affect, influence, impact of, impact on, reach; impact of, impact on, work on; effect, influence, infection, impression, governance
words.translation: 影响；统治；使摇动；摇摆

examples.en: Don’t allow yourself to be swayed by his promises.
examples.zh: 你可不要听了他的许诺就改变主意呀。

words.definition: relating to the process of producing babies, young animals, or plants; generative, regenerative
words.translation: 生殖的，再生的；生殖的；再生的；复制的

examples.en: the human reproductive system
examples.zh: 人类生殖系统

examples.en: reproductive organs
examples.zh: 生殖器官

words.definition: to make someone feel extremely tired; issue, drain out; air out; air discharge, flue gas
words.translation: 使筋疲力尽；排出；耗尽；使精疲力尽；彻底探讨；排气；废气；排气装置

examples.en: A full day’s teaching exhausts me.
examples.zh: 讲一整天课令我精疲力竭。

words.definition: relating to or happening in one particular country and not involving any other countries; internal, household, home, family; servant
words.translation: 国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的；国货；佣人

examples.en: ...over 100 domestic flights a day to 30 leading U.S. destinations.
examples.zh: …每天飞往美国30个主要目的地的100多个国内航班。

words.definition: If you fetch something or someone, you go and get them from the place where they are; absorb, attract, engage, draw, strike; take; taking, procurement, scheme, fraud
words.translation: 取回；取来；接来；到达；吸引；拿；取物；卖得；取得；诡计

examples.en: Sylvia fetched a towel from the bathroom.
examples.zh: 西尔维娅从浴室拿来一条毛巾。

examples.en: Fetch me a glass of water.
examples.zh: 给我拿杯水来。

words.definition: to learn or to teach someone the skills that are needed to do a different job; reeducate
words.translation: 再教育；再训练；重新教育

examples.en: One solution is to retrain the long-term unemployed.
examples.zh: 一个解决办法是对长期失业的人进行再培训。

words.definition: relating to the natural processes performed by living things; biotic, organismal
words.translation: 生物的；[生物]生物的；生物学的

examples.en: the biological functions of the body
examples.zh: 人体的生物机能

examples.en: Depression is both biological and psychological.
examples.zh: 抑郁症与生理和心理都有关系。

words.definition: Perception is the recognition of things using your senses, especially the sense of sight; consciousness, viewpoint, sense, feel, insight
words.translation: 感知；知觉；[生理]感觉；看法；洞察力；获取

examples.en: And when they do, what do you think their perception will be?
examples.zh: 当他们这样做时，你觉得他们的知觉是怎样的？

words.definition: to use time, energy, goods etc; waste, to use up; peter, spend
words.translation: 消费，消耗；消耗，消费；使…著迷；挥霍；耗尽，毁灭；耗尽生命

examples.en: Only 27% of the paper we consume is recycled.
examples.zh: 我们消耗的纸张只有 27% 得到回收利用。

examples.en: A smaller vehicle will consume less fuel.
examples.zh: 汽车小耗费燃料也少。

words.definition: not involving anything or anyone else; alone, exclusively, individually
words.translation: 单独地，唯一地

examples.en: Scholarships are given solely on the basis of financial need.
examples.zh: 奖学金完全是根据经济需要发放的。

examples.en: I shall hold you solely responsible for anything that goes wrong.
examples.zh: 出现任何差错的话，我唯你是问。

words.definition: a quality or feature of something or someone that is typical of them and easy to recognize; typical, representative, proper, very, own; quality, identity, tang, specific, distinction
words.translation: 特点；典型的；特有的；表示特性的；特征；特性；特色

examples.en: Genes determine the characteristics of every living thing.
examples.zh: 基因决定每个生物的特征。

words.definition: consisting of many different parts and often difficult to understand; sophisticated, involved, synthetic, detailed, intricate
words.translation: 复杂的；合成的

examples.en: a complex system of highways
examples.zh: 复杂的公路网

examples.en: Photosynthesis is a highly complex process.
examples.zh: 光合作用是一个非常复杂的过程。

examples.en: Peter seemed to have an instant understanding of the most complex issues.
examples.zh: 再复杂的问题彼得似乎也是一看就明白。

words.definition: something that is done as a reaction to something that has happened or been said; reaction, behavior, reception, reply, answer
words.translation: 反应；响应；回答

examples.en: His immediate response was one of disbelief.
examples.zh: 他的第一反应是不相信。

examples.en: Emmett’s new exhibition has met with a favourable response from critics.
examples.zh: 埃米特的新展览得到评论家的好评。

words.definition: the number of times something happens, or the number of examples of something within a certain period; degree, classification, coefficient, price, value; assess, count, find, guess, feel; hop on, tell someone off
words.translation: 比率，速率；[数]比率，率；[力]速度；价格；等级；认为；估价；责骂；被评价

examples.en: Immediately his heart rate (= the number of beats per minute ) increased.
examples.zh: 他的心率立即加快了。

words.definition: hard or firm, with a fixed shape, and not a liquid or gas; responsible, honest, united, consistent, reliable; cube
words.translation: 扎实的，坚实的；[物]固体的；可靠的；[数]立体的；结实的；一致的；[物]固体；[数]立方体

examples.en: The lake was frozen solid .
examples.zh: 湖水冻得结结实实。

examples.en: It was good to be back on solid ground again.
examples.zh: 又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。

examples.en: Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?
examples.zh: 宝宝吃固体食物了吗？

words.definition: to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future; provide, make, fix
words.translation: 做准备；准备；使适合；装备；起草

examples.en: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
examples.zh: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

words.definition: not wanting to do something and refusing to do it; narrow, reluctant
words.translation: 不愿意的；不情愿的；勉强的

examples.en: an unwilling helper
examples.zh: 勉强来帮忙的人

words.definition: someone, especially a child or young person, who is mature behaves in a sensible and reasonable way, as you would expect an adult to behave; developed, adult, due; age, flower
words.translation: 成熟的；[农学][地质]成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的；[农学][地质]成熟；到期

examples.en: Laura is very mature for her age .
examples.zh: 相对她的年龄来说劳拉是很成熟的。

examples.en: We’re mature enough to disagree on this issue but still respect each other.
examples.zh: 我们都很成熟，尽管我们对此事意见不同，但还是彼此尊重。

words.definition: a date or time by which you have to do or complete something
words.translation: 最后期限

examples.en: I’m always working under pressure to meet deadlines (= finish something on time ) .
examples.zh: 我总是在赶工期的压力下工作。

words.definition: when you stop working, usually because of your age; superannuation
words.translation: 退休；[劳经]退休，[军]退役

examples.en: She took early retirement (= retired at an earlier age than usual ) last year.
examples.zh: 她去年提前退休了。

examples.en: Dad’s approaching retirement age .
examples.zh: 爸爸快到退休年龄了。

words.definition: attractive or interesting; attractive, affecting, moving, absorbing, melting; soliciting
words.translation: 吸引人的；动人的；引起兴趣的；恳求似的；恳求（appeal的ing形式）；将…上诉

examples.en: The city offers an appealing combination of sporting and cultural events.
examples.zh: 这座城市集体育活动和文化活动于一身，颇具吸引力。

examples.en: It creates an atmosphere which visitors find so appealing .
examples.zh: 它创造了一种吸引游客的氛围。

words.definition: almost not; merely, simply, just, only, but
words.translation: 仅仅，几乎不；仅仅，勉强；几乎不；公开地；贫乏地

examples.en: She was barely aware of his presence.
examples.zh: 她几乎没有注意到他的存在。

examples.en: Joe and his brother are barely on speaking terms.
examples.zh: 乔和他哥哥几乎不说话。

words.definition: too unpleasant, painful, or annoying to deal with; impossible, insufferable
words.translation: 无法忍受的；难以忍受的；承受不住的

examples.en: The pain was almost unbearable.
examples.zh: 那疼痛几乎难以忍受。

examples.en: He was making life unbearable for his parents.
examples.zh: 他把父母的生活弄得不堪忍受。

words.definition: the place in the ground where a dead body is buried; important, serious, significant, great, cracking; death, end; brand, heart, engrave
words.translation: 坟墓；重大的；严肃的；黯淡的；墓穴，坟墓；死亡；雕刻；铭记

examples.en: At the head of the grave there was a small wooden cross.
examples.zh: 坟头上有一个小小的木十字架。

words.definition: a suggestion that is not made directly but that people are expected to understand or accept; connotation, meaning, import, involvement, reminder
words.translation: 含义，暗示；含义；暗示；[法]牵连，卷入

examples.en: They are called ‘Supertrams’, the implication being that (= which is meant to suggest that ) they are more advanced than earlier models.
examples.zh: 它们被称作“超级电车”，这是暗指它们比先前的型号更先进。

words.definition: a list of all the kinds of food that are available for a meal, especially in a restaurant; carte, memu
words.translation: 菜单；[计]菜单

examples.en: Could we have the menu, please?
examples.zh: 请把菜单给我们，好吗？

examples.en: a three course set menu
examples.zh: 三道菜的套餐

words.definition: a way of thinking about people, situations, ideas etc; viewpoint, perspective, outlook, eye, sentiment
words.translation: 立场；观点

examples.en: a discussion of marriage from the standpoint of women
examples.zh: 从女性角度对婚姻的探讨

words.definition: fairness in the way people are treated; judge, right, judicature
words.translation: 公正；司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，[法]审判员

examples.en: Children have a strong sense of justice.
examples.zh: 儿童有很强的正义感。

examples.en: His people came to him demanding justice.
examples.zh: 他的手下来找他，寻求公正。

words.definition: what you think or hope will happen; Prospects, looking forward to, be
words.translation: 期望；期待；预期；指望

examples.en: Having raised expectations (= made people more hopeful ), he went on to help only a few people.
examples.zh: 他唤起了大家的希望，但接着只是帮助了几个人。

examples.en: The show exceeded all expectations (= was much better than expected ).
examples.zh: 这场演出比人们预期的要好得多。

examples.en: The number of people who attended fell short of expectations (= was lower than expected ).
examples.zh: 出席的人数比预期的要少。

words.definition: showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work; vocational, specialized, occupational; career man
words.translation: 专业的；职业的；职业性的；[管理]专业人员；职业运动员

examples.en: This business plan looks very professional.
examples.zh: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

examples.en: a more professional approach to work
examples.zh: 更专业的工作方法

words.definition: thoroughly, entirely, primarily, completely, fully
words.translation: 完全地，彻底地；根本上；彻底地；以激进的方式

words.definition: done willingly and without being forced; autonomous, willing, studied, designed, intended
words.translation: 自愿的，主动的；自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的

examples.en: Workers are being encouraged to take voluntary redundancy.
examples.zh: 工人被鼓励主动离职。

words.definition: off one's own bat, on one's own
words.translation: 独立地；自立地

examples.en: In each of these cases, one of the models evolved independently of the other.
examples.zh: 在这里的每种情况下，其中一个模型独立于另一个模型而发展。

examples.en: Service each copy independently: You can update one copy without affecting any of the other ones.
examples.zh: 独立维护每个副本： 可以独立更新某一个副本，而不影响其他的副本。

examples.en: We have two motors, one on each rear wheel, so the control system has to control each motor independently.
examples.zh: 而且我们有两个，每一个后轮都有一个，说以控制系统必须独立地控制每一个电机。

words.definition: agree, love, uphold, make sure, sustain; affection, keen on
words.translation: 偏好, 赞同；赞成；喜欢；像；赐予；证实；喜爱；欢心；好感

words.definition: confusing and difficult to understand or explain; delusive; confusing, enchanting
words.translation: 令人困惑的；使迷惑的；使莫明其妙的；使迷惑（puzzle的ing形式）

examples.en: a puzzling fact
examples.zh: 令人费解的情况

examples.en: Gary found her reaction puzzling.
examples.zh: 加里对她的反应感到迷惑。

words.definition: very big, fast, powerful etc; huge, enormous, massive, macro, vast
words.translation: 巨大的；极大的，巨大的；惊人的

examples.en: Suddenly, there was a tremendous bang, and the whole station shook.
examples.zh: 突然一声巨响，整个车站都晃动了。

examples.en: She was making a tremendous effort to appear calm.
examples.zh: 她竭力表现出平静的样子。

examples.en: She praised her husband for the tremendous support he had given her.
examples.zh: 她称赞丈夫给了她巨大支持。

words.definition: to injure a muscle or part of your body by using it too much or making it work too hard; tension, burden, weight; tauten, take pains; abuse, tighten up
words.translation: 扭伤，拉伤；张力；[力]拉紧；负担；[外科]扭伤；血缘；尽力；滥用；滤去；竭力

examples.en: I’ve strained a muscle in my leg.
examples.zh: 我的腿有一处肌肉拉伤。

examples.en: You’ll strain your eyes trying to read in this light.
examples.zh: 在这样的光线下看书会伤眼睛的。

words.definition: a show of paintings, photographs, or other objects that people can go to see; expo, display, show, fair, manifestation
words.translation: 展览；展览，显示；展览会；展览品

examples.en: ...an exhibition of expressionist art.
examples.zh: …一场印象主义艺术展览会。

words.definition: a large building where people can see famous pieces of art; hall, passage, corridor, underground, subway
words.translation: 美术馆；画廊；走廊；旁听席；地道

examples.en: an exhibition of African art at the Hayward Gallery
examples.zh: 海沃德美术馆的非洲艺术展览

words.definition: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is; value, score, rate, prize; to assess, to appraise
words.translation: 评价；估价；求…的值

examples.en: You should be able to evaluate your own work.
examples.zh: 你应该能够评估自己的工作。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the success of the campaign.
examples.zh: 我们要评估一下这次运动是否成功。

examples.en: It can be difficult to evaluate the effectiveness of different treatments.
examples.zh: 要对各种治疗方法的效果作出评估会很难。

words.definition: dry powder consisting of extremely small bits of dirt that is in buildings on furniture, floors etc if they are not kept clean; powder, dirt; sift
words.translation: 灰尘；[环境]尘埃；尘土；撒；拂去灰尘

examples.en: All the furniture was covered in dust .
examples.zh: 所有的家具都蒙上了灰尘。

examples.en: a thick layer of dust
examples.zh: 厚厚的一层灰尘

examples.en: There’s not a speck of dust in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里一尘不染。

words.definition: to go somewhere with someone; attend, keep company
words.translation: 陪伴；陪伴，伴随；伴奏

examples.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zh: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

examples.en: Wherever her husband went, she would accompany him.
examples.zh: 不论丈夫去哪里，她都陪伴左右。

words.definition: to give a plan, piece of writing etc to someone in authority for them to consider or approve; maintain, advocate; put in, hand in
words.translation: 提交；使服从；主张；呈递；[计]提交；服从

examples.en: They submitted their reports to the chancellor yesterday.
examples.zh: 他们昨天向财政大臣提交了他们的报告。

words.definition: terrible, august, horrible, awesome, fearful; extremely, full, most, rare
words.translation: 可怕的，骇人的；可怕的，吓人的；糟糕的，糟透的（口语）；庄严的，威严的；十分，极其

examples.en: The weather was awful.
examples.zh: 天气很糟糕。

words.definition: to talk in a friendly informal way, especially about things that are not important; visit with, chew the fat; chinwag, chit-chat
words.translation: 聊天；闲谈

examples.en: John and I sat up until the early hours chatting.
examples.zh: 我和约翰聊到凌晨才睡。

words.definition: to show that something is important; emphasize, stress, highlight
words.translation: 强调；在…下面划线；预告

examples.en: This tragic incident underlines the need for immediate action.
examples.zh: 这一悲剧事件突显了立即采取行动的必要性。

words.definition: the state of continuing to live or exist; remanet, leavings
words.translation: 幸存；幸存，残存；幸存者，残存物

examples.en: The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
examples.zh: 医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。

examples.en: A lot of small companies are having to fight for survival (= work hard in order to continue to exist ) .
examples.zh: 很多小公司不得不挣扎求生。

words.definition: not honest, and so deceiving or cheating people; insincere, deceptive
words.translation: 不诚实的；欺诈的

examples.en: dishonest traders
examples.zh: 奸商

examples.en: People on welfare are wrongly seen as lazy or dishonest.
examples.zh: 靠福利救济的人被误以为懒惰或不老实。

words.definition: to fail to look after someone or something properly; ignore, be forgetful of; omission, oversight
words.translation: 忽视；疏忽，忽视；忽略；怠慢

examples.en: She smoked and drank, neglected the children, and left the clothes unmended.
examples.zh: 她抽烟喝酒，既不照顾孩子，也不缝补衣服。

examples.en: a neglected garden
examples.zh: 疏于打理的花园

examples.en: The building has been badly neglected.
examples.zh: 这栋大楼严重疏于维护。

words.definition: to keep and care for something that is very special, important, or valuable to you; wealth, estate, money, fortune, property; cherish, enshrine
words.translation: 珍爱；财富，财产；财宝；珍品；珍藏

examples.en: Jim treasured the gold pocket watch that his grandfather had given him.
examples.zh: 吉姆十分珍爱祖父送给他的金怀表。

words.definition: careful, thorough, and exact; strict, rigid, precise, severe, tight
words.translation: 严格的；严格的，严厉的；严密的；严酷的

examples.en: a rigorous analysis of defence needs
examples.zh: 对国防需求的缜密分析

examples.en: the rigorous standards required by the college
examples.zh: 大学规定的严格标准

words.definition: consulting service, consultation service, advisory services; advising, admonishing
words.translation: 咨询服务；建议；劝告；商讨（counsel的ing形式）

examples.en: If the answer is no, you really need to get some professional counseling to determine if this marriage should be saved.
examples.zh: 如果回答是否定的，你就真的该去咨询一下专家，决定一下你是否改维持这段婚姻了。

examples.en: In this study, the participants who took advantage of group and individual counseling offered as part of the diets had far greater success than those who chose to go it alone.
examples.zh: 在这个研究中，充分利用作为饮食原则一部分的团队和个人咨询的参与者你那些选择自己进行的参与者得到了更大的成效。

examples.en: Despite counseling and written advice about how to maintain their new weights, they gained an average of 12 pounds back over the next year.
examples.zh: 尽管有如何保持研究者各自重获得的新体重方面的咨询与书面建议，但在过去一年里平均每人仍增重12磅左右。

words.definition: having enough skill or knowledge to do something to a satisfactory standard; able, capable, efficient, sufficient, adequate
words.translation: 胜任的，有能力的；胜任的；有能力的；能干的；足够的

examples.en: A competent mechanic should be able to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 一名合格的机修工应该能够解决这个问题。

words.definition: coming from or relating to God or a god; remarkable, extraordinary, wonderful, excellent, famous; predict, prognosticate; soothsay; minister, priest, preacher
words.translation: 神圣的；非凡的；天赐的；极好的；占卜；预言；用占卜勘探；使用占卜勘探矿；牧师；神学家

examples.en: divine power
examples.zh: 神的力量

examples.en: divine love
examples.zh: 上帝的慈爱

words.definition: to make a judgment about a person or situation after thinking carefully about it; evaluate, rate, value, prize
words.translation: 评价；评定；估价；对…征税

examples.en: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
examples.zh: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

words.definition: to think about something again carefully in order to decide whether to change your opinion or judgment about it; revalue
words.translation: 重新评估；再评价；再课税；再摊派

examples.en: This has caused us to reassess the way we approach our planning.
examples.zh: 这件事让我们重新审视了我们的规划方式。

words.definition: speaking or behaving in a way that is not polite and is likely to offend or annoy people; angry, robust, crude
words.translation: 粗鲁的；无礼的；狂暴的；未开化的

examples.en: a rude remark
examples.zh: 粗鲁的话

examples.en: I didn’t mean to be rude, but I had to leave early.
examples.zh: 我并不想显得无礼，但我不得不早走。

words.definition: difficult to do or deal with; difficult, strong, hard, rough, firm; varlet, Highbinder; stay, stomach, go, abide, resist; doggedly, pertinaciously
words.translation: 困难的；艰苦的，困难的；坚强的，不屈不挠的；坚韧的，牢固的；强壮的，结实的；恶棍；坚持；忍受，忍耐；强硬地，顽强地

examples.en: It was a tough race.
examples.zh: 比赛打得很艰难。

examples.en: She’s had a tough life.
examples.zh: 她的生活十分艰辛。

examples.en: The company admitted that it had been a tough year.
examples.zh: 公司承认那是艰难的一年。

words.definition: to give an acceptable explanation for something that other people think is unreasonable
words.translation: 证明……正当

examples.en: Ministers must appear before Parliament and justify their actions.
examples.zh: 大臣们必须就自己的行为向议会作出解释。

words.definition: continuing to exist or happen, especially for longer than is usual or desirable; fixed, consistent, set
words.translation: 持续的，坚持的；固执的，坚持的；持久稳固的

examples.en: persistent rumours
examples.zh: 持续流传的谣言

examples.en: persistent headaches
examples.zh: 持续头疼

examples.en: a persistent problem
examples.zh: 长期问题

words.definition: to be even better or greater than someone or something else; overcome, top, exceed, cap, transcend
words.translation: 超过；超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解

examples.en: He had surpassed all our expectations .
examples.zh: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

examples.en: The number of multiple births has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
examples.zh: 多胎产首次突破了 10 万例。

words.definition: a situation in which it is very difficult to decide what to do, because all the choices seem equally good or equally bad; difficulty, corner, fix, predicament
words.translation: 困境；进退两难；两刀论法

examples.en: a moral dilemma
examples.zh: 道德上进退两难的窘境

examples.en: This placed Robert Kennedy in a dilemma.
examples.zh: 这让罗伯特·肯尼迪陷入了两难的境地。

examples.en: Many women are faced with the dilemma of choosing between work and family commitments.
examples.zh: 许多女性面临着出去工作还是照顾家庭的两难境地。

words.definition: to produce or cause something; go on, call into being
words.translation: 产生；使形成；发生；[生物]生殖

examples.en: a useful technique for generating new ideas
examples.zh: 能产生新创意的有用技术

examples.en: The program would generate a lot of new jobs.
examples.zh: 这个项目将创造许多新的就业岗位。

words.definition: most important; elementary, major, central, main, leading; original color, fundamental colour
words.translation: 主要的，基本的；主要的；[数]初级的；基本的；原色；最主要者

examples.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

examples.en: Many of the villagers rely on fishing as their primary source of income.
examples.zh: 很多村民以打鱼作为他们的主要收入来源。

examples.en: Personal safety is of primary importance .
examples.zh: 人身安全至关重要。

words.definition: in a very important or necessary way; extremely, most, rare
words.translation: 极其重要地；极其；紧要地；生死攸关地

examples.en: A sensible diet is vitally important if you want to remain in good health.
examples.zh: 如想保持健康，合理的饮食十分重要。

words.definition: to think wrongly that a person or thing is someone or something else; cloud, discombobulate
words.translation: 使混淆，迷惑；使混乱；使困惑

examples.en: People might well confuse the two products.
examples.zh: 人们很容易混淆这两种产品。

words.translation: 重新装裱

examples.en: How could you reframe them?
examples.zh: 你将如何重新定义它们？

examples.en: “We think work is the opposite of happiness,” Achor says. Instead, he suggests workers reframe the way they think about their jobs.
examples.zh: “我们认为工作和快乐是对立的，”阿克尔说，相反，他建议工作者们重新审视他们的工作。

examples.en: When you reframe the situation to something more adequate, you can act again in an effective way and you can find and keep the love that you need.
examples.zh: 当你重新理清情况，进行更为合理的解释，你将能能有效的行动，找到并拥有一份自己需要的爱情。

words.definition: a question you ask in order to get information; investigation, exploration, probe, research, search
words.translation: 询问；探究；调查；质询

examples.en: I don’t know who sent the gift, but I’ll make some inquiries.
examples.zh: 我不知道礼物是谁送的，但我会打听一下。

words.definition: a plan or desire to do something; goals, purpose, sake, meaning, will
words.translation: 打算，意图；意图；目的；意向；愈合

examples.en: They went into town with the intention of visiting the library.
examples.zh: 他们进了城，打算参观图书馆。

words.definition: the part of a vehicle that produces power to make it move; facilities, instrument, vehicle, tool, gear
words.translation: 引擎，发动机；引擎，[动力]发动机；[铁路]机车，火车头；工具

examples.en: Is the engine running smoothly?
examples.zh: 发动机运转平稳吗？

examples.en: We were stranded with engine trouble on a deserted highway.
examples.zh: 我们因发动机故障而被困在空无一人的公路上。

words.definition: An occasion is a time when something happens, or a case of it happening; opportunity, chance, opening, sake, reason; attract, cause, produce, operate, induce
words.translation: 场合；时机，机会；理由；引起，惹起

examples.en: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago in New Orleans.
examples.zh: 我经常深情地想起一些年前在新奥尔良所发生的一幕。

words.definition: wide, vastly
words.translation: 广泛地；广阔地；广大地

examples.en: The new rocket was extensively tested and debugged by the army.
examples.zh: 这种新式火箭由军方进行了广泛的测试和调试。

examples.en: Dr Alloway, from the University of Stirling in Scotland, has extensively studied working memory and believes it to be far more important to success and happiness than IQ.
examples.zh: 来自苏格兰的斯特灵大学阿洛韦博士，已经广泛的研究“工作记忆”，并认为它是比智商更为重要对于成功和幸福来说。

words.definition: an article on a particular subject or by a particular writer that appears regularly in a newspaper or magazine; pillar, tier
words.translation: 专栏；纵队，[数]列；圆柱，柱形物

examples.en: He writes a weekly column for ‘The Times’.
examples.zh: 他每周为《泰晤士报》写一篇专栏文章。

words.definition: if something solid melts or if heat melts it, it becomes liquid; flux, fuse; oil, soften up; fusion, burnoff
words.translation: 融化；熔化，[化学]溶解；渐混；使融化；使熔化；使软化；使感动；熔化；熔化物

examples.en: It was warmer now, and the snow was beginning to melt.
examples.zh: 现在天气暖和了，雪开始融化。

examples.en: Melt the butter in a saucepan.
examples.zh: 把黄油放在深平底锅里化开。

words.definition: reasonable, practical, and showing good judgment; obvious, aware, distinct, wise, visible
words.translation: 明智的；明显的；意识到的；通晓事理的

examples.en: She seems very sensible.
examples.zh: 她好像很明智。

examples.en: sensible advice
examples.zh: 合理的建议

examples.en: It’s sensible to keep a note of your passport number.
examples.zh: 把你的护照号码记下来是明智的。

words.definition: extremely important and necessary; elementary, fundamental, basic, necessary, primary; element, principle, entity, necessity, requirement, texture
words.translation: 本质的，必须的；基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的；本质；要素；要点；必需品

examples.en: Window locks are fairly cheap and absolutely essential.
examples.zh: 窗锁相当便宜，绝对有必要安装。

examples.en: Even in small companies, computers are an essential tool.
examples.zh: 即使在小公司里，计算机也是不可或缺的工具。

words.definition: to find or provide a way of dealing with a problem; decide, settle, resolve, do, work out
words.translation: 解决；解答；溶解

examples.en: Charlie thinks money will solve all his problems.
examples.zh: 查理认为钱能解决他所有的问题。

examples.en: the best way of solving our dilemma
examples.zh: 解决我们两难处境的最佳办法

words.definition: to take hold of something suddenly and violently; grasp, absorb, see, read, noble; lock, do with
words.translation: 抓住；夺取；理解；逮捕；利用；（机器）卡住

examples.en: Suddenly he seized my hand.
examples.zh: 他突然抓住我的手。

words.definition: If one thing is an alternative to another, the first can be found, used, or done instead of the second; selective, vicissitudinary
words.translation: 代替品；供选择的；选择性的；交替的

examples.en: New ways to treat arthritis may provide an alternative to painkillers.
examples.zh: 治疗关节炎的新方法可能会提供一种止痛药的替代品。

words.definition: when people have money and everything that is needed for a good life; success, victory, winning, up, hit
words.translation: 繁荣；繁荣，成功

examples.en: a time of economic prosperity
examples.zh: 经济繁荣时期

words.definition: the protection of natural things such as animals, plants, forests etc, to prevent them from being spoiled or destroyed; preservation, protection, maintenance, lee, safeguard
words.translation: 保护，保存；保存，保持；保护

examples.en: wildlife conservation
examples.zh: 野生生物保护

examples.en: a local conservation group
examples.zh: 当地的一个环境保护团体

words.definition: something that is slippery is difficult to hold, walk on etc because it is wet or  greasy; designing, knowing, subtle, unstable
words.translation: 模糊的，不明确的，滑的；滑的；狡猾的；不稳定的

examples.en: In places, the path can be wet and slippery.
examples.zh: 路上有些地方可能又湿又滑。

examples.en: Harry’s palms were slippery with sweat.
examples.zh: 哈里手心滑溜溜的都是汗。

words.definition: the act or process of destroying something or of being destroyed; breaking, death, blasting, disruption, demolition
words.translation: 破坏；破坏，毁灭；摧毁

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["weapons of mass destruction"]}
examples.zh: 大规模杀伤性武器

examples.en: the environmental destruction caused by the road building programme
examples.zh: 筑路工程造成的环境破坏

examples.en: The floods brought death and destruction to the area.
examples.zh: 洪水给该地区带来了死亡和破坏。

words.definition: to save something or someone from being harmed or destroyed; maintain, save, secure, corn, sustain; conservation area, conservation district
words.translation: 保护；保存；维持；腌；禁猎；保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

examples.en: We must encourage the planting of new trees and preserve our existing woodlands.
examples.zh: 我们必须鼓励栽种新树木，同时也要保护现有的林地。

words.definition: based on general ideas or principles rather than specific examples or real events; brief, summary, resume; deep, nonobjective; extract, brief
words.translation: 抽象的；[图情]摘要；抽象；抽象的概念；深奥的；提取；使……抽象化

examples.en: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
examples.zh: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

examples.en: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
examples.zh: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

words.definition: an event, situation etc that people do not understand or cannot explain because they do not know enough about it; secret, privacy, confidence
words.translation: 迷，神秘的事物；神秘，秘密；奥秘；神秘的事物

examples.en: Twenty years after the event, his death remains a mystery .
examples.zh: 事情过去二十年了，他的死仍然是个谜。

examples.en: The way her mind worked was always a mystery to him.
examples.zh: 她脑子里在想些什么对他来说始终是个谜。

examples.en: ‘Why did he do it?’ ‘I don’t know. It’s a complete mystery .’
examples.zh: “他为什么这么做？” “我不知道，这完全是个谜。”

words.definition: to improve a method, plan, system etc by gradually making slight changes to it; improve, polish up
words.translation: 改善，精炼；精炼，提纯；改善；使…文雅

examples.en: Car makers are constantly refining their designs.
examples.zh: 汽车制造商在不断完善他们的设计。

words.definition: a sentence or phrase from a book, speech etc which you repeat in a speech or piece of writing because it is interesting or amusing; citing, citation
words.translation: 引文；[贸易]报价单；引用语；引证

examples.en: The following quotation is taken from a nineteenth century travel diary.
examples.zh: 下文引自19世纪的一篇旅行日记。

examples.en: a dictionary of quotations
examples.zh: 引语词典，语录汇编

words.definition: to behave in a particular way or show a particular emotion because of something that has happened or been said; impact of, impact on, work on
words.translation: 对……作出反应；反应；影响；反抗；起反作用

examples.en: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.
examples.zh: 说他撒谎，他非常生气。

examples.en: She reacted very badly (= was very upset ) when her parents split up.
examples.zh: 父母离婚的时候，她非常难过。

examples.en: You have to react quickly to circumstances.
examples.zh: 你必须对形势迅速作出反应。

words.definition: when you get something that is newer or better than the one you had before; restoration, substitute
words.translation: 代替；更换；复位；代替者；补充兵员

examples.en: Our old car is badly in need of replacement.
examples.zh: 我们的旧车急需更换。

examples.en: replacement windows
examples.zh: 新换的窗户

words.definition: as a result; therefore, hence, accordingly, thus, as a result of
words.translation: 结果；因此；所以

examples.en: Most computer users have never received any formal keyboard training. Consequently, their keyboard skills are inefficient.
examples.zh: 大多数的电脑使用者都没有经过正规的键盘操作训练，因此他们的键盘技巧不够熟练。

examples.en: The molecules are absorbed into the bloodstream and consequently affect the organs.
examples.zh: 这些分子被吸收到血液里，从而影响到器官。

words.definition: to increase quickly to a high level; rise, tower, rear; flying high, upsurge
words.translation: 猛增；高飞；高耸；往上飞舞；高涨

examples.en: Her temperature soared.
examples.zh: 她的体温骤然升高。

examples.en: The price of petrol has soared in recent weeks.
examples.zh: 最近几个星期汽油价格猛涨。

examples.en: soaring unemployment
examples.zh: 急剧上升的失业率

words.definition: if a situation, fact etc inclines you to do or think something, it influences you towards a particular action or opinion; pitch, slope, affect; slope, lean; hill, slope, decline, pitch
words.translation: 倾向于；倾斜；倾向；易于；使倾斜；使倾向于；斜面；斜坡

examples.en: ...the factors that incline us toward particular beliefs.
examples.zh: …使我们倾向于特定信念的种种因素。

words.definition: small and not very important or serious, especially when compared with other things; secondary, supporting, peripheral, less; infant, pupil
words.translation: 小的；未成年的；次要的；较小的；小调的；二流的；未成年人；小调；副修科目

examples.en: We have made some minor changes to the program.
examples.zh: 我们对那个程序做了一些小改动。

examples.en: a relatively minor error
examples.zh: 相对较小的错误

examples.en: a minor road
examples.zh: 小路

words.definition: extreme sadness, especially because someone you love has died; disaster, evil
words.translation: 悲伤；悲痛；忧伤；不幸

examples.en: Every change in our lives brings with it griefs.
examples.zh: 我们生活当中的每一个变化都有让人伤心的一面。

words.definition: To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen; promote, boost, further
words.translation: 使便利，促进；促进；帮助；使容易

examples.en: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism.
examples.zh: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。

words.definition: to make something easier or less complicated; predigest, deformalize
words.translation: 简化；使单纯；使简易

examples.en: an attempt to simplify the tax system
examples.zh: 简化税制的尝试

examples.en: The law needs to be simplified.
examples.zh: 这部法律需要简化。

examples.en: a simplified version of the game
examples.zh: 这个游戏的简化版

words.definition: a way of doing something, especially the correct or usual way; routine, program, move, step
words.translation: 程序；程序，[管理]手续；步骤

examples.en: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
examples.zh: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

words.definition: If you do someone or something a disservice, you harm them in some way; harm, punishment, abuse
words.translation: 伤害，帮倒忙；伤害；帮倒忙的行为；不亲切的行为；虐待

examples.en: He said the protesters were doing a disservice to the nation.
examples.zh: 他表示，抗议者们的行为正对国家造成危害。

words.definition: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand; wonder, miracle
words.translation: 现象；[物]现象；奇迹；杰出的人才

examples.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
examples.zh: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

words.definition: to put someone or something in danger of being hurt, damaged, or destroyed; jeopard, imperil
words.translation: 危及，危害，濒临危险；危及；使遭到危险

examples.en: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
examples.zh: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

words.definition: very large or greater, more important etc than any other; inundatory, preponderant; drowning
words.translation: 压倒性的；势不可挡的；压倒；淹没（overwhelm的ing形式）；制服

examples.en: There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages your health.
examples.zh: 有难以辩驳的证据表明吸烟有损健康。

examples.en: An overwhelming majority of the members were against the idea.
examples.zh: 占压倒性多数的成员反对这项主张。

examples.en: The proposal has been given overwhelming support.
examples.zh: 这一提议得到了压倒性多数的支持。

words.definition: to do what you are supposed to do according to a law or agreement; watch, quo, tell, talk, respect; look into, take stock of
words.translation: 遵守；观察；说；注意到；评论

examples.en: So far the ceasefire has been observed by both sides.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，双方都遵守着停火协定。

words.definition: things such as films, television, performances etc that are intended to amuse or interest people; recreation, pleasure, sport, occupation, amusement
words.translation: 娱乐；消遣；款待

examples.en: The town provides a wide choice of entertainment.
examples.zh: 该镇提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

examples.en: There will be live entertainment (= performed then, not recorded ) throughout the day.
examples.zh: 现场表演将持续一整天。

examples.en: The dolphins give good entertainment value (= a lot of amusement and interest ).
examples.zh: 海豚具有很高的娱乐价值。

words.definition: believing that good things will happen in the future; rose-colored, rosy
words.translation: 乐观的；乐观主义的

examples.en: Andrew took a more optimistic view.
examples.zh: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

words.definition: a situation in which you have a lot of problems that seem to be caused by bad luck; disaster, tragedy, evil, grief
words.translation: 逆境，不幸；逆境；不幸；灾难；灾祸

examples.en: his courage in the face of adversity
examples.zh: 他面对逆境的勇气

words.definition: to guide or direct wrongly or badly; mislead, misdirect
words.translation: 误导；使误入歧途

examples.en: In addition, they will also misguide the innocent, which becomes a vicious circle.
examples.zh: 此外，他们将误导那些思想单纯的人，这将导致一个恶心循环。

examples.en: The other type of behavior is non-deceptive information misguide or incompleteness of information, namely, significant omission of information disclosure.
examples.zh: 另一种行为是非欺骗性的误导或者信息不充分, 即信息披露的重大遗露.

examples.en: One sort of behavior is incomplete or distorted information disclosure mentioned by Williamson, especially purposeful misguide, distortion, concealment and confusion, etc.
examples.zh: 第一种行为是威廉森提出的不完全或者扭曲的信息披露, 特别是故意误导, 扭曲和隐藏相关信息以及制造疑惑等等.

words.definition: having or needing a lot of energy or determination; active, positive, male, live, vigorous
words.translation: 精力充沛的；积极的；有力的

examples.en: an energetic man
examples.zh: 精力旺盛的男子

examples.en: an energetic drive to get more customers
examples.zh: 争取更多客户的十足干劲

words.definition: Unintended results were not planned to happen, although they happened; mechanical, automatic, unconscious, spontaneous
words.translation: 意想不到的；无意识的；非计划中的

examples.en: ...the unintended consequences of human action.
examples.zh: ...人类行为无心的结果。

words.definition: the place where something is or where something happens, and the general environment; context, circumstance, installation, arrangement, surrounding; putting, positioning, laying
words.translation: 背景，环境；环境；安装；布置；[天]沉落；放置；沉没；使…处于某位置（set的ing形式）

examples.en: I’ve worked with children in various settings, mainly in secondary school.
examples.zh: 我在许多地方教过孩子，主要是在中学。

words.definition: something that is tempting seems very good and you would like to have it or do it; attractive, absorbing; enticing
words.translation: 诱人的，吸引人的；吸引人的；诱惑人的；引诱（tempt的ing形式）

examples.en: a tempting job offer
examples.zh: 一个诱人的工作机会

examples.en: That pie looks tempting.
examples.zh: 那馅饼看上去很诱人。

words.definition: break, disturbance, obstacle
words.translation: 打扰，中断；[计]中断；干扰；中断之事

examples.en: For tasks that execute code in a loop, it is common to check for interruption only once per loop iteration.
examples.zh: 对于执行一个循环中的代码的任务，通常只需为每一个循环迭代检查一次中断。

words.definition: a piece of paper on which a doctor writes what medicine a sick person should have, so that they can get it from a  pharmacist; tradition, instruction, convention, usage, pointing
words.translation: 处方；[医]药方；指示；惯例

examples.en: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
examples.zh: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

examples.en: a repeat prescription
examples.zh: 重复处方

words.definition: a situation that seems strange because it involves two ideas or qualities that are very different
words.translation: 悖论，自相矛盾

examples.en: It’s a paradox that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.
examples.zh: 在如此富有的国家却有这么多的贫穷现象，真是矛盾。

words.definition: used when saying the names of the people or things you are referring to; viz., i.e.
words.translation: 即，也就是；也就是；即是；换句话说

examples.en: Three students were mentioned, namely John, Sarah and Sylvia.
examples.zh: 有三名学生被提到，即约翰、萨拉和西尔维娅。

words.definition: strictly, real
words.translation: 无疑；确实地，无庸置疑地

examples.en: This is undoubtedly important.
examples.zh: 这无疑是重要的。

examples.en: While such ways of traveling certainly have their benefits, there are also undoubtedly some disadvantages.
examples.zh: 这种旅行方式当然有它们的长处所在，但毫无疑问也有一些缺憾。

words.definition: having a special quality, character, or appearance that is different and easy to recognize; unusual, different, apart
words.translation: 独特的，与众不同的；有特色的，与众不同的

examples.en: a rock band with a distinctive sound
examples.zh: 音色独特的摇滚乐队

words.definition: to move away from the enemy after being defeated in battle; withdrawal, pullback; withdraw, bug out
words.translation: 退避，后退；撤退；休息寓所；退避；向后倾

examples.en: The rebels retreated to the mountains.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子撤退到山区。

examples.en: They were attacked and forced to retreat.
examples.zh: 他们受到攻击，被迫撤退。

words.definition: to give someone the official right to do or have something
words.translation: 使具有权利，使具有资格

examples.en: If the warranty is limited, the terms may entitle you to a replacement or refund.
examples.zh: 如果保修单有限制，这些条款可让你有权换货或退款。

words.definition: critical, curious
words.translation: 大惊小怪的，小题大做的；爱挑剔的，难取悦的；易烦恼的

examples.en: A lot of small children are fussy eaters (= they dislike many types of food ) .
examples.zh: 许多小孩子挑食。

words.definition: a machine that washes dishes
words.translation: 洗碗机

examples.en: I was a short-order cook and a dishwasher.
examples.zh: 我曾是一名快餐厨师兼洗碗工。

words.definition: an organization, meeting, TV programme etc where people have a chance to publicly discuss an important subject; consultation, seminar
words.translation: 论坛；论坛，讨论会；法庭；公开讨论的广场

examples.en: Members of the council agreed that was an important forum for discussion.
examples.zh: 理事会成员们一致认为那是一个用于讨论的重要论坛。

words.definition: a feeling that you are not as good, clever, skilled etc as other people; insufficiency, impropriety
words.translation: 不足；不适当，不充分；不完全；不十分

examples.en: Unemployment can cause feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem.
examples.zh: 失业会使人缺乏自信，产生自卑感。

words.definition: a wide passage or large hall just inside the entrance to a public building; to try to persuade the government or someone with political power that a law or situation should be changed; sala, salle
words.translation: 大堂；游说；大厅；休息室；会客室；游说议员的团体

examples.en: a hotel lobby
examples.zh: 宾馆大堂

examples.en: I’ll meet you in the entrance lobby.
examples.zh: 我们在入口大厅见。

words.definition: a person or company that represents another person or company, especially in business; deputy, factor, secondary, proxy; acting, deputy
words.translation: 代理商；[法][贸易]代理人，代理商；药剂；特工；[法][贸易]代理的

examples.en: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
examples.zh: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

words.definition: to make someone feel certain that something is true; assure, reason, satisfy, argue
words.translation: 使相信；说服；使确信，使信服

examples.en: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
examples.zh: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

words.definition: the ability to change or be changed easily to suit a different situation; give, elasticity, adaptability
words.translation: 灵活性；适应性；[力]弹性

examples.en: Employees expect flexibility in the workplace.
examples.zh: 员工们盼望工作安排有弹性。

words.definition: made of plastic; mouldable, malleable; restricting, true-up
words.translation: 塑料的；[塑料][力]塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的；[塑料]塑料制品；整形；[力]可塑体

examples.en: a plastic spoon
examples.zh: 塑料汤匙

examples.en: plastic bags
examples.zh: 塑料袋

words.definition: a structure made of wood, metal, plastic etc that surrounds something such as a picture or window, and holds it in place; configuration, mechanics, texture, structure; design, construct, engineer, style, project
words.translation: 框架；[建][计]框架；结构；[电影]画面；设计；建造；陷害；使…适合

examples.en: They removed the picture from its wooden frame.
examples.zh: 他们把画从木镜框中取下来。

words.definition: a piece of material that water cannot pass through which people sleep on when they are camping
words.translation: 防潮布

examples.en: One more thing, remind me to get some kind of groundsheet or we'll end up getting filthy.
examples.zh: 还有一件事，记得提醒我带一些防潮布之类的东西，否则我们结束的时候会一片狼籍。

examples.en: One more thing, remind me to get some kind of groundsheet or we'll end up getting filthy.
examples.zh: 另外，提醒我带上防潮布，在我们结束的时候可以收集垃圾。

examples.en: One more thing, remind me to get some kind of groundsheet or we'll end up getting filthy.
examples.zh: 还有件事，记得提醒我带一些好的防潮布，以免我们最后结束的时候都脏兮兮的。

words.translation: 地理的

examples.en: User community and geographic distribution of users.
examples.zh: 用户社区和用户的地理分布。

words.definition: relating to or involving the work of diplomats; foreign, experienced
words.translation: 外交的；外交上的；老练的

examples.en: Diplomatic efforts to end the fighting began on October 25.
examples.zh: 停战的外交努力于10月25日开始。

words.definition: opinion, appraisal, evaluation, comment, view
words.translation: 判断，决定；意见；判断力；[法]审判；评价

examples.en: He trusted in his judgement.
examples.zh: 他相信他的判断。

examples.en: All action is based on judgement.
examples.zh: 一切行动均以判断为基础。

examples.en: The judgement is often biased by interest.
examples.zh: 判断往往因利害关系而有偏差。

words.definition: for use by one person or group, not for everyone; chamber, cabinet; seaman second class
words.translation: 私人的；私有的；私下的；列兵；二等兵

examples.en: Morris has a private jet.
examples.zh: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

examples.en: He made some notes for his private use.
examples.zh: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

examples.en: They objected to any form of private property .
examples.zh: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

words.definition: comfortable, pleasant, easy
words.translation: 舒适的；舒适的，惬意的

examples.en: Come over to the fire and cozy up a bit.
examples.zh: 到火炉这边来会感到舒适一点。

examples.en: “It is extremely expensive, but at least I have a cozy bed, ” he said.
examples.zh: 他说：“这房子真是太贵了，但至少我有一张舒适的床了。”

words.definition: a building containing a large machine for crushing grain into flour; factory, plant, work; mix round, churn up
words.translation: 工厂；[工经]工厂；磨坊；[化工][粮食][机]磨粉机；制造厂；压榨机；搅拌；[机]碾磨；磨细；使乱转

examples.en: ...a steel mill.
examples.zh: …一家钢厂。

words.definition: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity to do it; capacitate, empower
words.translation: 使能够……；使能够，使成为可能；授予权利或方法

examples.en: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early.
examples.zh: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

words.definition: taking a lot of time and effort; tough, trying, rough
words.translation: 费力的；勤劳的；艰苦的；费劲的

examples.en: the laborious business of drying the crops
examples.zh: 把收获的庄稼晒干这一艰苦的工作

words.definition: a feeling of great pleasure and satisfaction; joy, cheerfulness; pleasure, be pleased; glad, pleasure, satisfy
words.translation: 高兴；使高兴

examples.en: Throughout the house, the views are a constant source of surprise and delight.
examples.zh: 整个房子，目之所及不停带来惊奇和欣喜。

words.definition: the size or level of something, or the amount that something is happening; dimensions, ratio, graduation, calibration; chip, shell, climb; sound, gauge
words.translation: 规模，比例；规模；[测][数]比例；[动]鳞；[仪]刻度；天平；数值范围；衡量；攀登；剥落；[环境]生水垢；测量；刮鳞；依比例决定

examples.en: A structural survey revealed the full scale of the damage.
examples.zh: 结构检验揭示了实际受损程度。

examples.en: I was shocked by the sheer scale (= very big scale ) of the destruction.
examples.zh: 破坏程度之大让我大为震惊。

examples.en: Large firms benefit from economies of scale (= ways of saving money because they are big ) .
examples.zh: 大公司从规模经济中得益。

words.definition: funny and entertaining; colorful, funny; sending
words.translation: 有趣的，好玩儿的；有趣的，好玩的；引人发笑的；逗乐；打发；使…高兴（amuse的ing形式）

examples.en: I don’t find his jokes at all amusing .
examples.zh: 我觉得他的笑话一点都不好笑。

examples.en: a highly amusing (=  very amusing  ) film
examples.zh: 非常有趣的电影

words.definition: alarm; unfounded; flurry
words.translation: 恐慌的；恐慌，惊慌；[金融]大恐慌；没有理由的；使恐慌

examples.en: Her face distorted in panic.
examples.zh: 她的脸因恐慌而变相了。

examples.en: The panic-stricken fled in all directions.
examples.zh: 惊慌的人群向四面八方逃去。

examples.en: They ascribed courage to me for something I did out of sheer panic.
examples.zh: 由于我纯粹因惊慌而做的事，他们认为我很有勇气。

words.definition: your mind and your thoughts; feel, aesthesia
words.translation: 意识；[心理]意识；知觉；觉悟；感觉

examples.en: The painful memories eventually faded from her consciousness.
examples.zh: 那些痛苦的回忆最终从她的意识中淡去了。

examples.en: Hypnosis is an altered state of consciousness .
examples.zh: 催眠状态是一种被改变的意识状态。

examples.en: research into human consciousness
examples.zh: 对人类意识的研究

words.definition: quantitative data on any subject, esp data comparing the distribution of some quantity for different subclasses of the population; correlations, numerical statement
words.translation: 统计学；数据；[统计]统计；统计资料

examples.en: statistics for earnings by different age groups

words.definition: a woman at the time she gets married or just after she is married; judy, colleen
words.translation: 新娘；姑娘，女朋友

examples.en: Guests toasted the bride and groom with champagne.
examples.zh: 客人们以香槟为新娘新郎敬酒。

words.definition: not at work, school, a meeting etc, because you are sick or decide not to go; missing, vacant
words.translation: 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

examples.en: He has been absent from his desk for two weeks.
examples.zh: 他已经两个星期没来了。

words.definition: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient; harry, ply with; brown off; worry, trouble
words.translation: 使反感，厌烦；骚扰；惹恼；打搅；令人讨厌；烦恼（等于annoyance）

examples.en: Try making a note of the things that annoy you.
examples.zh: 试着把让你心烦的事记下来。

examples.en: It annoyed me that I didn't have time to do more ironing.
examples.zh: 没有时间熨更多的衣服让我心烦了。

words.definition: to demand that something should happen; emphasize, stay, tough, stress, highlight; stay, stand on
words.translation: 主张，坚持；坚持，强调

examples.en: Stay for supper – I insist!
examples.zh: 留下来吃晚餐——一定的！

words.definition: the finger next to your thumb; first finger
words.translation: 食指；[解剖]食指

examples.en: He took the pen between his thumb and forefinger.
examples.zh: 他用拇指和食指夹起笔。

words.definition: to bend the top part of your body forward in order to show respect for someone important, or as a way of thanking an  audience; stem, Yumi; stoop down, bend down; curve, winding, flexural, crooked
words.translation: 鞠躬；弓；船首；弯腰；弯曲的

examples.en: She bowed and left the stage.
examples.zh: 她鞠了一躬，离开了舞台。

examples.en: Corbett entered the room, bowing respectfully.
examples.zh: 科比特走进房间，恭敬地鞠了一躬。

examples.en: The servant bowed low and handed his master the sealed note.
examples.zh: 仆人深深一鞠躬，把那个封好的短笺递给了主人。

words.definition: a movement of part of your body, especially your hands or head, to show what you mean or how you feel; motion, sign, stance
words.translation: 手势，姿势；姿态；手势

examples.en: Luke made an obscene gesture with his finger.
examples.zh: 卢克用手指做了一个下流的手势。

words.definition: the time when crops are gathered from the fields, or the act of gathering them; outcome, product, event, crop, result; gather, crop, net; mow
words.translation: 丰收，收获；收获；产量；结果；收割；得到；收割庄稼

examples.en: There was about 300 million tons of grain in the fields at the start of the harvest.
examples.zh: 收割伊始田间大约有三亿吨的谷物。

words.definition: made of or covered with a substance that sticks to surfaces; glutinous, viscous
words.translation: 粘的；[胶粘]粘的；粘性的

examples.en: There’s some sticky stuff in your hair.
examples.zh: 你的头发上有什么黏糊糊的东西。

examples.en: a sticky floor
examples.zh: 黏糊糊的地板

words.definition: fighting against someone who is attacking you; resisting force, rebellion
words.translation: 抵制, 抵抗力；阻力；[电]电阻；[力]抵抗；[法]反抗；抵抗力

examples.en: disease resistance
examples.zh: 抗病能力

words.definition: very small living things, some of which cause illness or disease; microbe, bacilus
words.translation: 细菌

examples.en: Is it possible to multiply bacteria in the laboratory?
examples.zh: 有可能在实验室繁殖细菌吗?

examples.en: When you eat off the plate, all of those bacteria go into your stomach.
examples.zh: 当你吃掉了盘子里的食物时，这些细菌就会进入你的肚子。

words.definition: a very small piece of something; grain, granule
words.translation: 微粒；颗粒；[物]质点；极小量；小品词

examples.en: dust particles
examples.zh: 尘埃

words.definition: your gums are the two areas of firm pink flesh at the top and bottom of your mouth, in which your teeth are fixed; chutty, cachou
words.translation: 牙龈；口香糖；[林]树胶；橡皮

examples.en: The toothbrush gently removes plaque without damaging the gums or causing bleeding.
examples.zh: 牙刷轻轻地刷去齿菌斑，没有伤及牙床或引起出血。

words.definition: to look like or be similar to someone or something; favor
words.translation: 像，相似；类似，像

examples.en: It’s amazing how closely Brian and Steve resemble each other.
examples.zh: 布赖恩和史蒂夫真是惊人地相像。

examples.en: He grew up to resemble his father.
examples.zh: 他长大了，很像他父亲。
