words.definition: a small sign that shows that someone or something was present or existed; go back, carry up; represent, figure, trail; suggestion, mark, tail, drop
words.translation: 痕迹；[审计]追溯；沿路走；追踪，查探；描绘；回溯；[法]痕迹，踪迹；[气象]微量；[仪]迹线；缰绳

examples.en: There was no trace of anyone having entered the room since then.
examples.zh: 没有任何迹象表明在那以后有人进过这房间。

examples.en: Petra’s lost all trace of her German accent.
examples.zh: 彼得拉已完全没有德国口音。

examples.en: Officers were unable to find any trace of drugs.
examples.zh: 警察未能找到毒品的蛛丝马迹。

words.definition: the practice of treating one person or group differently from another in an unfair way; distinction, differentiation
words.translation: 歧视；区别，辨别；识别力

examples.en: laws to prevent discrimination
examples.zh: 防止歧视的法律

words.definition: worthless or not likely to have any useful result; empty, meaningless
words.translation: 无意义的；钝的；不尖的；不得要领的

examples.en: Life just seemed pointless to me.
examples.zh: 生活对我来说简直没什么意义。

examples.en: a pointless quarrel
examples.zh: 无谓的争吵

words.definition: the money that you pay to use a car, television, or other machine over a period of time; letting, leasing; leasehold
words.translation: 租；租金收入，租金；租赁；租赁的；收取租金的

examples.en: Video rental is usually £3.
examples.zh: 录像带的租金通常是3英镑。

words.definition: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it; neutral, insignificant
words.translation: 冷漠的；漠不关心的；无关紧要的；中性的，中立的

examples.en: People have become indifferent to the suffering of others.
examples.zh: 人们已经变得对别人的痛苦漠不关心。

words.definition: if a person or a thing is reflected in a mirror, glass, or water, you can see an image of the person or thing on the surface of the mirror, glass, or water; glass, image; give back, flash back
words.translation: 反映；反射，照出；反省；反射，映现；深思

examples.en: The drop in consumer spending reflects concern about the economy.
examples.zh: 消费支出的下降反映出人们对经济的担忧。

words.definition: release, emancipation
words.translation: 解放；释放，解放

examples.en: They pant after liberation.
examples.zh: 他们渴望解放。

examples.en: All his life was submerged in the liberation of the people.
examples.zh: 他的一生全部献身于人民的解放事业。

examples.en: They consecrated their lives to the liberation of their motherland.
examples.zh: 他们把生命献给了祖国的解放事业。

words.definition: a choice you can make in a particular situation; election, choice
words.translation: 选择；[计]选项；选择权；买卖的特权

examples.en: There are a number of options available.
examples.zh: 有多种选择。

examples.en: He had two options.
examples.zh: 他有两种选择。

examples.en: This was not the only option open to him.
examples.zh: 这并非是他的唯一选择。

words.definition: at the beginning; originally, firstly, primarily
words.translation: 最初，起初；最初，首先；开头

examples.en: Stan initially wanted to go to medical school.
examples.zh: 斯坦最初想进医学院。

examples.en: Initially, I thought I would only stay there a year.
examples.zh: 起初，我以为我只会在那儿待一年。

words.definition: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation; particularity, idiosyncracy; ascribe to
words.translation: 归因于；属性；特质；归属；把…归于

examples.en: Women tend to attribute their success to external causes such as luck.
examples.zh: 女性往往把她们的成功归因于外因，如运气。

words.definition: if a process accelerates or if something accelerates it, it happens faster than usual or sooner than you expect; improve, increase speed
words.translation: 加速；促进；增加

examples.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
examples.zh: 加快经济增长速度的措施

words.definition: a ball shape; extent, boundary, region, scope, spectrum, territory, range; case, invest
words.translation: 球体, 范围；范围；[数]球体；包围；放入球内；使…成球形

examples.en: Because the earth spins, it is not a perfect sphere.
examples.zh: 因为地球旋转，所以它不是个完完全全的球体。

words.definition: existing or happening in many places or situations, or among many people; extensive, universal, comprehensive, ruling, generalized
words.translation: 普遍的，广泛的；分布广的

examples.en: the widespread use of chemicals in agriculture
examples.zh: 化学品在农业中的广泛使用

words.definition: to completely change the appearance, form, or character of something or someone, especially in a way that improves it; influence, fashion, vary, innovate; veer from, to change
words.translation: 改变；改变，使…变形；转换；[数][电]变换，改变；转化

examples.en: Increased population has transformed the landscape.
examples.zh: 人口的增加使景观发生了变化。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is too big or too extreme to be measured; huge, infinite, boundless
words.translation: 无法估量的；无限的；[数]不可计量的；不能测量的

examples.en: The refugee problem has now reached immeasurable proportions.
examples.zh: 难民问题现在已经到了无法估量的程度。

words.definition: to make a place or substance dirty or harmful by putting something such as chemicals or poison in it; soil, mud, spot, dirty, poison
words.translation: 污染，弄脏

examples.en: Drinking water supplies are believed to have been contaminated.
examples.zh: 据信饮用水已受到污染。

words.definition: land that is owned or controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force; domain, province, world, extent, boundary, region, kingdom
words.translation: 领土，领域；范围；地域；[地理]版图

examples.en: Hong Kong is a Chinese territory.
examples.zh: 香港是中国的领土。

words.definition: made, done, seen etc on the Internet or on a computer, rather than in the real world; valid, available, effective, telling, significant
words.translation: 虚拟的；[计][物]虚拟的；有效的；实质上的，事实上的

examples.en: The website allows you to take a virtual tour of the art gallery.
examples.zh: 这个网站可让你对美术馆作一番虚拟参观。

examples.en: constructing virtual worlds
examples.zh: 构筑虚拟世界

words.definition: if something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is true; always, toujours
words.translation: 不变地，一直；总是；不变地；一定地

examples.en: It invariably rains when I go there.
examples.zh: 我每次去那儿都下雨。

examples.en: The security guards were invariably ex-servicemen.
examples.zh: 保安人员毫无例外地都是退伍军人。

words.definition: used to ask and talk about particular amounts of time; tall, full-bottomed; rare, aspire; chronically, ever more
words.translation: 渴望；长的；过长的；做多头的；热望；长期地；始终

examples.en: How long will it take to get there?
examples.zh: 到那里去要多长时间？

examples.en: Try to keep going foras long as possible.
examples.zh: 能坚持多久就坚持多久。

examples.en: Ittookme longerthan I thought it would.
examples.zh: 我用的时间比原先想的要长。

words.definition: someone’s welfare is their health and happiness; happiness, weal
words.translation: 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁

examples.en: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
examples.zh: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

words.definition: to become smaller in size, importance, or value, or make something do this; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 减少；减轻；变小

examples.en: Gradually her anxiety lessened.
examples.zh: 她的焦虑慢慢减轻了。

words.definition: a political situation in which people protest or behave violently; tension, unease
words.translation: 不安定，动荡；不安；动荡的局面；不安的状态

examples.en: There is growing unrest throughout the country.
examples.zh: 全国各地日益动荡不安。

words.definition: an authoritative book, account etc is respected because the person who wrote it knows a lot about the subject; magisterial, cathedratic
words.translation: 权威的；有权威的；命令式的；当局的

examples.en: the most authoritative work on English surnames
examples.zh: 有关英语姓氏的最权威著作

words.definition: not supporting any of the people or groups involved in an argument or disagreement; indifferent, litmusless; fence-sitter, mugwump
words.translation: 中立的；中立的，[生物]中性的；中立国的；非彩色的；中立国；中立者；非彩色；齿轮的空档

examples.en: I always tried to remain neutral when they started arguing.
examples.zh: 他们争论起来的时候我总是努力保持中立。

examples.en: Clive decided to adopt a neutral position.
examples.zh: 克莱夫决定采取中立立场。

examples.en: The British government acted as a neutral observer during the talks.
examples.zh: 英国政府在会谈中扮演了中立观察员的角色。

words.definition: ethnically
words.translation: 种族上地；人种上；按人种

examples.en: Mr. Obama is the first president since Richard M. Nixon to be elected while living in a city neighborhood, in his case, Chicago’s racially and economically diverse Hyde Park.
examples.zh: 奥巴马是自理查德.尼克松总统以来第一位住在城市社区中当选的总统，奥巴马住在芝加哥种族和经济多元化的海德公园。

examples.en: Despite his criticism of Wright's racially-tinged comments over the years, Obama said he will not disown his former minister.
examples.zh: 尽管他批评了赖特多年来富有种族色彩的评论，奥巴马说，他不会抛弃他过去的牧师。

words.definition: not as good as you hoped or expected; disillusionary, cauld
words.translation: 令人失望的；令人扫兴的

examples.en: disappointing profit figures
examples.zh: 令人失望的盈利数字

examples.en: The Lakers’ loss in the playoffs was very disappointing.
examples.zh: 湖人队在季后赛中的失利令人十分失望。

words.definition: a factory or building where an industrial process happens; factory, equipment, furniture, facility, mill; cultivate, crop, establish, rear, station; put in, to raise
words.translation: 工厂；[工经]工厂，车间；[植]植物；设备；庄稼；种植；培养；栽培；安置

examples.en: a huge chemical plant
examples.zh: 一座大型化工厂

words.definition: an official whose job is to check that something is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed; supervisor, looker
words.translation: 检查员；[经管][交]检查员；巡视员

examples.en: ticket inspectors
examples.zh: 查票员

examples.en: a Health and Safety inspector
examples.zh: 健康安全督察员

examples.en: Standards of discipline at the school were strongly criticized in the inspector’s report.
examples.zh: 督察员在报告里狠狠地批评了这所学校的纪律水准。

words.definition: to place in or establish as headquarters
words.translation: 设立总部，在…设立总部

words.definition: If something exists or happens worldwide, it exists or happens throughout the world; universal
words.translation: 全世界范围地；全世界的

examples.en: His books have sold more than 20 million copies worldwide.
examples.zh: 他的书在全世界卖出了两千多万本。

words.definition: a group of people that are chosen to make rules, laws, or decisions, or to give advice; committee, session, congress, meeting, soviet
words.translation: 议会；委员会；会议；理事会；地方议会；顾问班子

examples.en: the council for civil liberties
examples.zh: 公民自由委员会

examples.en: the UN Security Council
examples.zh: 联合国安全理事会

words.definition: an object or piece of information that helps someone solve a crime or mystery; action, plot, scenario
words.translation: 线索；（故事等的）情节

examples.en: Police have found a vital clue .
examples.zh: 警方发现了至关重要的线索。

examples.en: Archaeological evidence will provide clues about what the building was used for.
examples.zh: 考古证据将为这幢建筑的用途提供线索。

examples.en: a desperate search for clues
examples.zh: 拼命寻找线索

words.definition: to behave in a dishonest way in order to win or to get an advantage, especially in a competition, game, or examination; sell, fox, kid; kid, pull a fast one; fraud, sharp, deception
words.translation: 欺骗, 作弊；[法]欺骗；骗取；作弊；[法]欺骗，作弊；骗子

examples.en: He had cheated in the test by using a calculator.
examples.zh: 他在考试时作弊，用了计算器。

examples.en: Don’t look at my cards - that’s cheating .
examples.zh: 别看我的牌，那是作弊。

words.definition: to offend someone by saying or doing something they think is rude; hurt, abuse; despite, contumely
words.translation: 侮辱；辱骂；损害；凌辱；无礼

examples.en: Nobody insults my family and gets away with it!
examples.zh: 谁也别想侮辱了我的家人之后就这么算了！

examples.en: I hope Andy won’t be insulted if I don’t come.
examples.zh: 如果我不来，希望安迪不要介意。

words.definition: poverty, disaster, evil, want, grief; aggrieve
words.translation: 使痛苦，悲痛；危难，不幸；贫困；悲痛；使悲痛；使贫困

examples.en: The dream had distressed her greatly.
examples.zh: 这场梦使她深感不安。

words.definition: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions; stem, block, dispute, prohibit
words.translation: 使气馁, 阻碍；阻止；使气馁

examples.en: It may be difficult to do at first. Don't let this discourage you.
examples.zh: 开始时做起来也许比较困难。不要让这个泄你的气。

words.definition: arrive, flower, win, thrive
words.translation: 繁荣；繁荣，昌盛；成功

words.definition: to keep something or continue to have something; keep up, to keep
words.translation: 保留,留用；保持；雇；记住

examples.en: You have the right to retain possession of the goods.
examples.zh: 你有权保留这些物品。

examples.en: The state wants to retain control of food imports.
examples.zh: 政府想保留对食品进口的控制权。

words.definition: a competition or a situation in which two or more people or groups are competing with each other; argue against, chop logic; cope, rival; competition, match, combat
words.translation: 比赛；争辩；提出质疑；竞争；竞赛；争夺；争论

examples.en: Stone decided to hold a contest to see who could write the best song.
examples.zh: 斯通决定举行一场比赛，看谁能够写出最佳歌曲。

examples.en: I only entered the contest for fun.
examples.zh: 我只是为了好玩才参加这次比赛的。

examples.en: It is clear that the election will be a close contest .
examples.zh: 显然这次选举将是一场难分高下的角逐。

words.definition: a plan or suggestion which is made formally to an official person or group, or the act of making it; suggestion, advice, offer, instance, recommendation
words.translation: 提议；提议，建议；求婚

examples.en: The president is to put forward new proposals for resolving the country's constitutional crisis.
examples.zh: 总统将提出解决国家宪法危机的新议案。

words.definition: two or more different things that exist together or are used or put together; combined with, alliance, unity, union, association
words.translation: 联合，结合；结合；[数]组合；联合；[化学]化合

examples.en: a combination nightclub and café
examples.zh: 夜总会兼咖啡馆

words.definition: Promotional material, events, or ideas are designed to increase the sales of a product or service; encouraging, hortative
words.translation: 促销的；增进的；奖励的

examples.en: "Jeans," according to one company's promotional material, "are designed and made to be worn hard."
examples.zh: 根据一家公司促销材料上所说的，“牛仔裤为耐穿而设计和制作。”

words.definition: a smooth surface has no rough parts, lumps, or holes, especially in a way that is pleasant and attractive to touch; glabrous, favourable; eliminate, avoid, relax; quietly, glossily
words.translation: 光滑的；顺利的；平稳的；使光滑；消除（障碍等）；使优雅；缓和；光滑地；平稳地；流畅地

examples.en: Her skin felt smooth and cool.
examples.zh: 她的皮肤摸上去又滑又凉。

examples.en: a smooth pebble
examples.zh: 光滑的卵石

examples.en: The stone steps had been worn smooth .
examples.zh: 石阶被磨得光溜溜的了。

words.definition: having a very strong effect or felt very strongly; burning, stressed, sharp, warm, hot
words.translation: 强烈的；紧张的；非常的；热情的

examples.en: Young people today are under intense pressure to succeed.
examples.zh: 如今的年轻人面临要出人头地的巨大压力。

examples.en: the intense heat of the desert
examples.zh: 沙漠的炽热

examples.en: The pain was so intense I couldn’t sleep.
examples.zh: 疼得我都睡不着觉。

words.definition: having a shape, surface, pattern etc that is not even, smooth, or balanced; abnormal, orrow
words.translation: 不规律的；[语]不规则的；无规律的；[数]非正规的；不合法的

examples.en: a jagged, irregular coastline
examples.zh: 锯齿状不规则的海岸线

examples.en: It has a highly irregular shape, covered in bumps and indentations.
examples.zh: 它的外形极不规则，满是凸起和凹陷的地方。

words.definition: the number of times something happens, especially crime, disease etc; infection, impression, effect, influence, affection
words.translation: 几率，发生率；发生率；影响；[光]入射；影响范围

examples.en: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
examples.zh: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

words.definition: slight darkness or shelter from the direct light of the sun made by something blocking it; umbrage, fantom; dull, overshadow; graduate
words.translation: 阴凉处；树荫；阴影；遮阳物；（照片等的）明暗度；少量、些微；细微的差别；使阴暗；使渐变；为…遮阳；使阴郁；掩盖；（颜色、色彩等）渐变

examples.en: a plant that needs a lot of shade
examples.zh: 喜阴植物

words.definition: an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill; retirement pay, subsidy
words.translation: 养老金；退休金，[劳经]抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费

examples.en: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
examples.zh: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

examples.en: If you are self-employed, you should think about taking out a private pension .
examples.zh: 如果你是自由职业者，应该考虑办理私人养老金事宜。

examples.en: Many people find it hard to live on a basic state pension .
examples.zh: 许多人发现仅凭国家基本养老金不能养活自己。

words.definition: if a serious situation deepens, it gets worse – used especially in news reports
words.translation: 使加深，加剧

examples.en: The recession continues to deepen.
examples.zh: 经济衰退继续加剧。

examples.en: a deepening international crisis
examples.zh: 日益加深的国际危机

words.definition: to make a good combination with someone or something else; make up a loss, make sth up
words.translation: 补充；补足，补助

examples.en: John and Bob complemented each other well.
examples.zh: 约翰和鲍勃互相配合得很好。

examples.en: The dark red walls complement the red leather chairs.
examples.zh: 深红色的墙和红色的皮椅很相配。

words.definition: to press something firmly together with your fingers or hand; force one's way, thread one's way; compression, commission, purchase
words.translation: 压，榨；挤；紧握；勒索；压榨；拥挤；佣金

examples.en: She smiled as he squeezed her hand.
examples.zh: 他捏了捏她的手，她笑了。

examples.en: He squeezed the trigger, but nothing happened.
examples.zh: 他扣动扳机，但没有反应。

words.definition: a society that is well organized and developed, used especially about a particular society in a particular place or at a particular time; culture, kultur
words.translation: 文明；文化

examples.en: modern American civilization
examples.zh: 现代美国文明

words.definition: very much greater or more impressive than usual; remarkable, particular, temporary, special, wonder
words.translation: 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的

examples.en: a woman of extraordinary beauty
examples.zh: 容貌出众的女子

examples.en: an extraordinary talent
examples.zh: 非凡的才华

words.definition: containing poison or producing poison; toxic, evil, rank, vicious, venomous
words.translation: 有毒的，有害的；有毒的；恶毒的；讨厌的

examples.en: Some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
examples.zh: 一些蘑菇有剧毒。

examples.en: poisonous gases such as hydrogen sulfide
examples.zh: 硫化氢等有毒气体

examples.en: poisonous substances
examples.zh: 有毒物质

words.definition: to put used objects or materials through a special process so that they can be used again; regeneration, breeding, rebirth
words.translation: 循环，再利用；再生；再循环；重复利用

examples.en: We take all our bottles to be recycled.
examples.zh: 我们把我们所有的瓶子都回收利用。

examples.en: packaging made of recycled paper
examples.zh: 再生纸包装材料

words.definition: to ask someone for information; question, query
words.translation: 询问；查究；问明；询价

examples.en: ‘Why are you doing that?’ the boy inquired.
examples.zh: “你为什么这么做？”男孩问道。

examples.en: Toby would have liked to inquire further (= ask more questions ).
examples.zh: 托比本想问更多的问题。

words.definition: to hide your feelings or the truth about a situation; blind, face-piece; dissimulate, make sb up; belie, disguise
words.translation: 掩饰；面具；口罩；戴面具；化装；使模糊

examples.en: Men often mask their true feelings with humour.
examples.zh: 男人常常用幽默来掩饰他们真实的情感。

words.definition: something wrong with your body or mind which shows that you have a particular illness; premonitor, prefiguration
words.translation: 症状；[临床]症状；征兆

examples.en: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
examples.zh: 精神分裂症最常见的症状之一是幻听。

words.definition: to cause pain, suffering, or trouble to someone, especially for a long period of time; disaster, trouble, headache; harry, worry, trouble, tear, devil
words.translation: 使困扰；[医]瘟疫；灾祸；麻烦；讨厌的人；折磨；使苦恼；使得灾祸

examples.en: Financial problems continued to plague the company.
examples.zh: 资金问题持续困扰着该公司。

words.definition: to bend or turn something, such as wire, hair, or cloth, into a particular shape; screw, harry; distortion, strain; bend, double up
words.translation: 扭曲，使弯曲；捻；拧；扭伤；编织；使苦恼；[力]扭曲；扭动；弯曲

examples.en: Her hands began to twist the handles of the bag she carried.
examples.zh: 她的双手开始拧她拎着的那个包的拎柄。

words.definition: a big building where people wait to get onto planes, buses, or ships, or where goods are loaded; destination, limitation, threshold, bottom, goal; advanced, finishing, marginal
words.translation: 终点站，航空站；末端；[交]终点；[计]终端机；极限；[动]末端的；[交]终点的；晚期的

examples.en: the airport’s passenger terminal
examples.zh: 机场航站楼

words.definition: obediently, submissively
words.translation: 消极地；被动地；顺从地

words.definition: the final result of a meeting, discussion, war etc – used especially when no one knows what it will be until it actually happens; product, result, conclusion, event, feedback
words.translation: 结果；结果，结局；成果

examples.en: People who had heard the evidence at the trial were surprised at the outcome.
examples.zh: 在审判过程中听过证词的人都对此结果感到吃惊。

words.definition: your name written in the way you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter, or on a cheque etc, to show that you have written it; a scratch of pen
words.translation: 签名；署名；信号

examples.en: Her signature is totally illegible (= cannot be read ) .
examples.zh: 她的签字完全无法辨认。

examples.en: The school collected 4,000 signatures for the petition.
examples.zh: 学校为这份请愿书收集到了四千个签名。

examples.en: The Ukrainians put their signatures to the Lisbon Protocol.
examples.zh: 乌克兰签署了《里斯本协议》。

words.definition: a piece of work that must be done, especially one that is difficult or unpleasant or that must be done regularly; job, work, role, pursuit, labor
words.translation: 任务，工作；工作，作业；[计]任务

examples.en: Sara had the task of preparing the agenda for meetings.
examples.zh: 萨拉的任务是准备会议议程。

examples.en: I was given the task of building a fire.
examples.zh: 我分配到生火的任务。

examples.en: the skills required to carry out these tasks
examples.zh: 执行这些任务所需要的技能

words.definition: making you believe that something is true or right; persuasive, potent; defogging
words.translation: 令人信服的；有说服力的；使相信；使明白（convince的现在分词）

examples.en: convincing evidence of his guilt
examples.zh: 证明他有罪的有力证据

words.definition: if a company or organization downsizes, it reduces the number of people it employs in order to reduce costs
words.translation: 裁员

examples.en: The airline has downsized its workforce by 30%.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司裁员30%。

words.definition: for as long as it is possible to know what is likely to happen; calculable
words.translation: 可以预见的；可预知的；能预测的

examples.en: The situation is likely to continue for the foreseeable future.
examples.zh: 这种局面在可预见的将来可能还会持续下去。

words.definition: the official legal position or condition of a person, group, country etc; capacity, ranking
words.translation: 地位；状态；情形；重要身分

examples.en: These documents have no legal status in Britain.
examples.zh: 这些文件在英国并无法律效力。

examples.en: What is your marital status (= are you married or not ) ?
examples.zh: 你的婚姻状况是什么？

words.translation: 优先地

examples.en: Heterosexuals should not be treated preferentially when the state carries out that role.
examples.zh: 当国家执行这个作用的时候不应该优先对待异性恋者。

examples.en: Then back in Spain, they trained a strain of Pseudomonas bacteria to preferentially nibble salt blooms.
examples.zh: 回到西班牙后，他们便培养了一种可以优先吞食盐层的假单胞菌。

examples.en: "We try to find which parts of the brain preferentially talk to which other parts, " he says. "We can sort of map that out, and at the end it sort of spits out a number.
examples.zh: “我们希望弄明白大脑中哪些部分优先和哪些部分通信”他说“我们可以从某种程度上将其映射出来，并最终以数字的方式反映出来，这就是“脑龄””。

words.definition: a thing, place, activity etc that you get something from; provenience, authorship
words.translation: 来源；水源；原始资料

examples.en: They get their money from various sources.
examples.zh: 他们从各种途径弄到钱。

words.definition: a situation in which a large crowd of people are behaving in a violent and uncontrolled way, especially when they are protesting about something; loose, commotion; sow one's wild oats, easy virtue; lose, spend, consume
words.translation: 暴乱；放纵；蔓延；骚乱；放荡；浪费，挥霍

examples.en: urban riots
examples.zh: 城市骚乱

examples.en: prison riots
examples.zh: 监狱暴乱

examples.en: His murder triggered vicious race riots (= caused by a problem between different races ) .
examples.zh: 他的被杀引发了严重的种族骚乱。

words.definition: the seeds of crops such as corn, wheat, or rice that are gathered for use as food, or these crops themselves; particle, texture, corn, commissariat
words.translation: 谷物，粮食；[粮食]粮食；[摄]颗粒；[作物]谷物；[木][纺][岩]纹理

examples.en: big sacks of grain
examples.zh: 大袋大袋的粮食

examples.en: Last year’s grain harvest was the biggest ever.
examples.zh: 去年粮食收成最好。

words.definition: a person or business that sells goods to customers in a shop; bania, tradesman
words.translation: 零售商；[贸易]零售商；传播的人

examples.en: Furniture and carpet retailers are among those reporting the sharpest annual decline in sales.
examples.zh: 家具和地毯零售商们是在那些报告最大年销售下滑的商家之中。

words.definition: to surprise someone very much; take aback, take by surprise
words.translation: 使吃惊

examples.en: Dave amazed his friends by suddenly getting married.
examples.zh: 戴夫突然结婚，令朋友们非常吃惊。

words.definition: the place or situation in which something begins to exist; birth, extraction, dawn
words.translation: 起源；[数]原点；出身；开端

examples.en: The tradition has its origins in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 这一传统源于中世纪。

examples.en: old folk tales of unknown origin
examples.zh: 起源不明的古老民间传说

words.definition: a ceremony at which university, college, or high school students receive their  diplomas; beginning, threshold, opening, conception, fresh
words.translation: 毕业典礼；开始，发端

examples.en: President Bush gave the commencement address today at the University of Notre Dame.
examples.zh: 布什总统今天在巴黎圣母院大学发表了毕业典礼演说。

words.definition: to start to use new ideas, methods, or inventions; to reform; found, construct, institute, influence, fashion
words.translation: 创新，革新；创新；改革；革新；改变；创立；创始；引人

examples.en: the need for large businesses to innovate
examples.zh: 大公司革新的需要

examples.en: The company has successfully innovated new products and services.
examples.zh: 公司成功地创出了新产品和服务。

words.definition: Hit is also a noun; dong, impact on; impact on, beat upon; success, prosperity, victory, blow, stroke
words.translation: 成功, 打击；打击；袭击；碰撞；偶然发现；伤…的感情；打；偶然碰上；（演出等）成功；讽刺

examples.en: First a house took a direct hit and then the rocket exploded.
examples.zh: 首先一幢房子被直接击中，接着火箭弹爆炸了。

words.definition: something that is crucial is extremely important, because everything else depends on it; important, considerable, material, critical, big
words.translation: 至关重要的；重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的

examples.en: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
examples.zh: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

words.definition: an important new discovery in something you are studying, especially one made after trying for a long time; penetration
words.translation: 突破；突破性进展

examples.en: The company looks poised to make a significant breakthrough in China.
examples.zh: 该公司看上去稳将在中国实现一次重大突破。

words.definition: someone who has been forced to live in exile; transportation, banishment; transport, banish
words.translation: 流放，放逐；流放，充军；放逐，被放逐者；流犯；放逐，流放；使背井离乡

examples.en: political exiles
examples.zh: 政治流亡者

words.definition: one part or feature of a whole system, plan, piece of work etc, especially one that is basic or important; theory, mechanism, factor, basic, essential
words.translation: 元素，要素；[数]元素；要素；原理；成分；自然环境

examples.en: Business and management elements are built into the course.
examples.zh: 本课程加入了商务和管理方面的内容。

words.definition: the way in which someone explains or understands an event, information, someone’s actions etc; explanation, translation, construction, account
words.translation: 阐释，说明；[计]解释；[语]翻译；演出

examples.en: One possible interpretation is that they want you to resign.
examples.zh: 一种可能的解释是，他们想要你辞职。

examples.en: It’s difficult to put an accurate interpretation on (= explain ) the survey results.
examples.zh: 对调查结果难以作出确切的解释。

examples.en: What exactly the author meant by that statement is open to interpretation (= able to be understood or explained in different ways ).
examples.zh: 作者这句话的确切含义可有各种理解。

words.definition: to make yourself or another person become used to a situation or place; habituate
words.translation: 使习惯；使习惯于

examples.en: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
examples.zh: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

words.definition: not studying or looking at something carefully and only seeing the most noticeable things; surface, external, facial, shallow; person, garment
words.translation: 肤浅的；表面的；表面文章；外表；浅薄的人

examples.en: They only have the most superficial understanding of prison life.
examples.zh: 他们对监狱生活只有最粗浅的了解。

words.definition: in the same order as the things you have just mentioned; separately, alone, in several
words.translation: 各自地；分别地；各自地，独自地

examples.en: The cups and saucers cost £5 and £3 respectively.
examples.zh: 茶杯和茶碟的价钱分别为5英镑和3英镑。

words.definition: in every way that is important or basic
words.translation: 根本上

examples.en: The conclusions of the report are fundamentally wrong .
examples.zh: 这份报告的结论从根本上来说就是错误的。

examples.en: The political culture of the US is fundamentally different .
examples.zh: 美国的政治文化迥然不同。

words.definition: behaviour or actions that deliberately cause pain to people or animals; fellness, rigorousness
words.translation: 残暴，残酷；残酷；残忍；残酷的行为

examples.en: The children had suffered cruelty and neglect.
examples.zh: 这些孩子遭受虐待，无人照管。

examples.en: There was a hint of cruelty in Brian’s smile.
examples.zh: 布赖恩的微笑里流露出一丝残暴。

words.definition: to officially and legally control a country and make all the decisions about taxes, laws, public services etc; manage, possess, conduct, run, regulate
words.translation: 管理，支配；管理；支配；统治；控制

examples.en: the leaders who govern the country
examples.zh: 治理这个国家的领导人

examples.en: The party had been governing for seven months.
examples.zh: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

words.definition: to make it difficult for something to develop or succeed; slow, impede; latter, back, rear
words.translation: 阻碍；打扰；后面的

examples.en: His career has been hindered by injury.
examples.zh: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

examples.en: policies that will hinder rather than help families
examples.zh: 对家庭有害无益的政策

words.definition: to think that someone or something is less important or valuable than they really are; make no account of
words.translation: 低估；低估...之价值；看轻

examples.en: Society undervalues staying at home and looking after children.
examples.zh: 社会低估了待在家里照看孩子的意义。

examples.en: Analysts claim that the firm’s assets were undervalued by £300 million.
examples.zh: 分析员称公司资产被低估了三亿英镑。

words.definition: a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is; appraisal, valuation, assessment, estimate, judgement
words.translation: 评价，评估；评价；[审计]评估；估价；求值

examples.en: We need to carry out a proper evaluation of the new system.
examples.zh: 我们要对新系统进行合理的评估。

examples.en: They took some samples of products for evaluation.
examples.zh: 他们抽取了一些产品样本以作评估。

words.definition: to describe something correctly and thoroughly, and to say what standards, limits, qualities etc it has that make it different from other things; regulate, state, rule
words.translation: 下定义，确定；定义；使明确；规定

examples.en: the ability to define clients’ needs
examples.zh: 确定客户需求的能力

examples.en: The duties of the post are difficult to define.
examples.zh: 这一职位的职责很难界定。

words.definition: to start doing the bad things that you used to do, after having improved your behaviour; reverse, retrogradation; corrupted
words.translation: 倒退，退步；倒退；堕落（过去式backslid，过去分词backslid，现在分词backsliding，第三人称单数backslides，名词backslider）；退步；背离宗教

examples.en: But if you backslide, Hiram says, “Start over.
examples.zh: 但假如你倒退了，海勒姆说，“那就重新开始。

examples.en: The national economy, meanwhile, is continuing to backslide.
examples.zh: 美国经济，在此期间，正在继续倒退。

examples.en: You've done a good job in the exam, I hope you won't backslide.
examples.zh: 你考试考得不错，我希望你不要退步。

words.definition: crime, guilt
words.translation: 过错，犯罪；犯罪，过错；进攻；触怒；引起反感的事物

examples.en: These efforts have led to a growing confidence among the public that corruption is a serious punishable offense in Albania.
examples.zh: 这些努力增强了公众的信心，即人们相信，腐败在阿尔巴尼亚是严重犯罪，能够受到惩罚。

words.definition: to prove or officially announce that someone is guilty of a crime after a  trial  in a law court; criminal offender, culprit
words.translation: 证明…有罪；罪犯

examples.en: a convicted murderer
examples.zh: 已定罪的谋杀犯

words.definition: to make a person or a group of people unimportant and powerless in an unfair way; ignore, reject
words.translation: 边缘化，排斥；排斥；忽视；使处于社会边缘；使脱离社会发展进程

examples.en: Female employees complained of being marginalized by management.
examples.zh: 女性雇员抱怨被管理层边缘化。

words.definition: to leave someone or something and no longer help or support them; yield, quit; run out on, walk out on; sands, wold; wild, hungry
words.translation: 抛弃；遗弃；放弃；逃跑；开小差；逃掉；[地理]沙漠；[农]荒原；应得的赏罚；[地理]沙漠的；荒凉的；不毛的

examples.en: Helen was deserted by her husband.
examples.zh: 海伦被丈夫遗弃了。

examples.en: Many of the party’s traditional voters deserted it at the last election.
examples.zh: 许多长期支持该党的选民在上一次选举中抛弃了它。

examples.en: The price rise caused many readers to desert the magazine.
examples.zh: 价格上涨导致许多读者放弃了这本杂志。

words.definition: a punishment that a judge gives to someone who is guilty of a crime; award, proposition; determine, adjudge
words.translation: 判决；[语][计]句子，命题；[法]宣判，判决；判决，[法]宣判

examples.en: She received an eight-year prison sentence.
examples.zh: 她被判八年徒刑。

examples.en: He has just begun a life sentence for murder.
examples.zh: 他犯了谋杀罪，刚开始服无期徒刑。

words.definition: to arrange for a place in a hotel, restaurant, plane etc to be kept for you to use at a particular time in the future; store, repertory; stay at, save from; book for, make reservation
words.translation: 留出，预定；[贸易][金融]储备，储存；自然保护区；[军][林]预备队；储备金；[贸易][金融]储备；保留；预约；预订

examples.en: Do you have to reserve tickets in advance?
examples.zh: 你必须预先订票吗？

words.definition: a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement; fine, amercement
words.translation: 惩罚；[经]罚款，罚金；[法]处罚

examples.en: No littering. Penalty $500.
examples.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾。 违者罚款500美元。

examples.en: Withdrawing the money early will result in a 10% penalty.
examples.zh: 提前支取这笔钱将被处以10%的罚金。

examples.en: If he is convicted, he could receive the death penalty (= be killed as a punishment ) .
examples.zh: 一旦定罪，他可能会被判处死刑。

words.translation: 合乎情理地，符合逻辑地

words.definition: something that is abundant exists or is available in large quantities so that there is more than enough; full, ample, plentiful, luxurious
words.translation: 大量的，丰富的；丰富的；充裕的；盛产

examples.en: an abundant supply of fresh water
examples.zh: 充足的淡水供应

examples.en: abundant opportunities for well qualified staff
examples.zh: 提供给高素质的员工的大量机会

words.definition: to talk about something in a way that makes it seem more important, serious etc than it really is; put it on, pile it on
words.translation: 夸张，夸大；夸张；夸大的叙述

examples.en: To say that all motorists speed in residential areas is overstating the case.
examples.zh: 说所有驾驶员都在住宅区内超速行驶是言过其实了。

examples.en: The importance of a child’s early years cannot be overstated (= is very important ).
examples.zh: 儿童幼年期的重要性怎么强调也不为过。

words.definition: a small amount of food that is eaten between main meals or instead of a meal; proportion, portion, percent, part, integral; nosh
words.translation: 零食，小吃；[贸易]小吃，快餐；一份，部分；吃快餐，吃点心

examples.en: I grabbed a quick snack.
examples.zh: 我赶紧吃了点零食。

examples.en: Drinks and light snacks are served at the bar.
examples.zh: 酒吧里供应饮料和小吃。

examples.en: snack foods like crisps and peanuts
examples.zh: 炸薯片和花生之类的小吃

words.definition: travelling through a place on the way to another place; by way of, THRU through
words.translation: 通过；取道，通过；经由

examples.en: We flew to Athens via Paris.
examples.zh: 我们经由巴黎飞往雅典。

words.definition: to gradually disappear; peter, color fading; discolor; stupid, literal-minded
words.translation: 逐渐消失；褪色；凋谢；使褪色；平淡的；乏味的

examples.en: Hopes of a peace settlement are beginning to fade.
examples.zh: 达成和平协议的希望日渐渺茫。

examples.en: Over the years her beauty had faded a little.
examples.zh: 岁月流逝，她的美貌已略逊当年。

words.definition: not damaged or affected by something; stubborn, rebellious
words.translation: 抵抗的，抵制的；[电][植保]抵抗的，反抗的；顽固的

examples.en: Some people are very resistant to the idea of exercise.
examples.zh: 一些人对锻炼的主意非常抵制。

words.definition: an idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something about life or the world, especially an idea that has not yet been proved to be true; mechanism, element, speculation, doctrine, guess
words.translation: 理论；原理；学说；推测

examples.en: Freudian theory has had a great influence on psychology.
examples.zh: 弗洛伊德理论对心理学产生过巨大影响。

words.definition: to come together to publicly express disapproval or opposition to something; exclaim at, take exception to; declare, aver; obtestation, remonstrance
words.translation: 抗议；断言

examples.en: ‘I don’t see why I should take the blame for this!’ she protested.
examples.zh: “我不明白为什么我要对此承担责任！”她抗议道。

words.definition: to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something; refuse, negative; inferior, degraded product
words.translation: 拒绝，驳回；拒绝；排斥；抵制；丢弃；被弃之物或人；次品

examples.en: Sarah rejected her brother’s offer of help.
examples.zh: 萨拉拒绝了她弟弟的帮助。

examples.en: Dexter flatly rejected (= completely rejected ) calls for his resignation.
examples.zh: 德克斯特断然拒绝让他辞职的要求。

examples.en: His proposal was rejected outright (= completely rejected ) .
examples.zh: 他的建议被彻底否决了。

words.definition: a mistake, mark, or weakness that makes something imperfect; checking, defect, deficiency, vice, fault; crack, fracture
words.translation: 缺点，错误；瑕疵，裂纹；缺点；一阵狂风；使无效；使破裂，使有缺陷

examples.en: A design flaw (= a mistake or weakness in the way something was made ) caused the engine to explode.
examples.zh: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

words.definition: appearing to have a particular quality, when this may or may not be true
words.translation: 表面上看

examples.en: seemingly unrelated bits of information
examples.zh: 似乎互不相关的零星信息

words.definition: a reason that you have for opposing or disapproving of something, or something you say that expresses this; opposition, exception, intervention, prevention, deficiency
words.translation: 反对；异议，反对；缺陷，缺点；妨碍；拒绝的理由

examples.en: Her objection was that he was too young.
examples.zh: 她反对的理由是他太小。

words.definition: fancy hotels, restaurants, cars etc are expensive and fashionable; interest, like, fantasy; expensive, rich, ideal, picked, dear; enjoy, vision, image; have vision of, to imagine
words.translation: 华丽的，别致的；幻想；想像力；爱好；想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的；想象；喜爱；设想；自负

examples.en: Harry took me to a fancy restaurant for our anniversary.
examples.zh: 哈里带我去了一家豪华餐厅，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

words.definition: the central and most important part of an area, system, activity etc, which all the other parts are connected to; center, focus
words.translation: 中心；毂；木片

examples.en: the commercial hub of the region
examples.zh: 该地区的商业中心

words.definition: extremely good, beautiful etc, and much better than others; unparalleled, matchless
words.translation: 无比的，无可匹敌的；无比的；无可匹敌的；不能比较的

examples.en: an incomparable view of San Marco
examples.zh: 圣马科美妙绝伦的景色

examples.en: a wine of incomparable flavour
examples.zh: 香醇无比的葡萄酒

words.definition: something that encourages you to work harder, start a new activity etc; motivation, stimulus, reason, excitement, needle; stimulative, hortatory
words.translation: 动机，刺激；动机；刺激；激励的；刺激的

examples.en: As an added incentive, there’s a bottle of champagne for the best team.
examples.zh: 给最优秀的队发一瓶香槟作为额外的鼓励。

words.definition: boot-up, starting up
words.translation: 启动，开办；启动；开办

examples.en: You should see something like  Figure 3 after startup.
examples.zh: 启动后，您应该看到类似于  图 3 的画面。

examples.en: You can use this for a variety of different solutions, but a common one is to startup a service or register the server and service existence.
examples.zh: 您可以将这个技巧用于各种不同的解决方案，但是一个共同点是要启动一个服务或注册服务器和服务存在性。

words.definition: to make a photograph or printed copy of something; generate, repeat; breed, increase
words.translation: 复制, 再生；复制；再生；生殖；使…在脑海中重现；繁殖

examples.en: Klimt’s artwork is reproduced in this exquisite book.
examples.zh: 这本精美的书里翻印了克里木特的艺术作品。

words.definition: clearly different or belonging to a different type; obvious, visible, unique, evident, individual
words.translation: 明显的；有区别的；独特的；清楚的

examples.en: two entirely distinct languages
examples.zh: 两种完全不同的语言

words.definition: if something that you value very much is at stake, you will lose it if a plan or action is not successful; bonus, dividend; encourage, carry, fund, second, back; lay, make a bet
words.translation: 风险；桩，棍子；赌注；火刑；奖金；资助，支持；系…于桩上；把…押下打赌；打赌

examples.en: They have to win the contract – thousands of jobs are at stake.
examples.zh: 他们必须拿下这份合同，这关系到数千个工作岗位。

examples.en: National pride is at stake in next week’s game against England.
examples.zh: 下星期对英格兰队的比赛关乎民族尊严。

words.definition: relating to the principles of what is right and wrong behaviour, and with the difference between good and evil; psychological, ethical; overtone
words.translation: 精神上的, 道德的；道德的；精神上的；品性端正的；道德；寓意

examples.en: It is easy to have an opinion on a moral issue like the death penalty for murder.
examples.zh: 对于判谋杀犯死刑这种涉及伦理道德的问题，有个观点并非难事。

examples.en: If we accept that certain babies should be allowed to die, we place doctors in a moral dilemma .
examples.zh: 如果我们同意应该允许某些婴儿死去，那就是让医生在道德上处于两难境地了。

examples.en: Man is gifted with a moral sense by which he distinguishes good from evil.
examples.zh: 人类天生有道德意识，能区分善与恶。

words.definition: someone who you try to defeat in a competition, game, fight, or argument; equal, anti, comparative, rival, match; contrary, adverse, against
words.translation: 对手；反对者；敌手；对立的；敌对的

examples.en: Graf’s opponent in today’s final will be Sukova.
examples.zh: 格拉芙今天的决赛对手将是苏科娃。

examples.en: He is admired even by his political opponents.
examples.zh: 他甚至受到政敌的钦佩。

words.definition: specifically, definitely, particularly, positively
words.translation: 直接地，明确地；明确地；明白地

examples.en: You have to grant us control explicitly.
examples.zh: 你们必须允许我们明确地控制。

examples.en: Tell them explicitly you want to continue the friendship.
examples.zh: 明确地告诉他们你想继续这段友谊。

examples.en: Therefore, you need to include these in your source files explicitly.
examples.zh: 因此，您需要将这些都明确地包含进源文件中。

words.definition: a person, group, or organization that you compete with in sport, business, a fight etc; equal, comparative, opponent, match, adversary; match, compete against; contest, cope, struggle to; competitive, vying
words.translation: 对手；[劳经]竞争者；与…竞争；比得上某人；[劳经]竞争；[劳经]竞争的

examples.en: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
examples.zh: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

examples.en: He finished 39 seconds ahead of his main rival .
examples.zh: 他比主要对手早39秒到达终点。

examples.en: She was 2 minutes faster than her nearest rival .
examples.zh: 她比紧随其后的对手快两分钟。

words.definition: a situation in which there is a lot of angry disagreement between two people or groups; war, antagonism
words.translation: 冲突，对抗；[军]对抗；面对；对质

examples.en: She had stayed in her room to avoid another confrontation.
examples.zh: 她待在自己的房间里，以避免再次发生冲突。

words.definition: bread or cake that is stale is no longer fresh or good to eat; banal, trite; urinate; urine, emiction
words.translation: 乏味的，没有新意的；陈腐的；不新鲜的；变陈旧；撒尿；变得不新鲜；尿

examples.en: French bread goes stale (= becomes stale ) very quickly.
examples.zh: 法式面包极易变味。

examples.en: stale cake
examples.zh: 不新鲜的蛋糕

words.definition: to give support to an opinion, idea, or feeling, and make it stronger; enhance, cement, muscle, supply, build up; strengthening, armoure
words.translation: 加强，强化；加强，加固；强化；补充；加强；加固物；加固材料

examples.en: The film reinforces the idea that women should be pretty and dumb.
examples.zh: 这部影片强化了这个观点——女人要漂亮，而且要笨一些。

words.definition: a small square area surrounded by ropes, where people  box  or  wrestle; sound; bell, annulus; invest, case
words.translation: 拳击台；按铃；敲钟；回响；成环形；戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物；包围；套住

words.definition: the number of people who attend a game, concert, meeting etc; presence
words.translation: 出席，到场；出席；到场；出席人数

examples.en: We have an average attendance of 4,000 fans per game.
examples.zh: 每场比赛平均有4,000名球迷来观战。

examples.en: Last year’s fair saw attendance figures of 32,000.
examples.zh: 去年的交易会有3.2万人参加。

words.definition: a smooth steady movement of liquid, gas, or electricity; stream, dance; flood, drown out; stream, flux, fresh, flood, quantity of
words.translation: 流动；[流]流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬；淹没，溢过；[流]流动；流量；涨潮，泛滥

examples.en: a new road system to improve traffic flow through the city centre
examples.zh: 疏导市中心车流的新道路系统

words.definition: the way you feel at a particular time; emotion, atmosphere, tone, spirit, feeling
words.translation: 心情；情绪，语气；心境；气氛

examples.en: You’re in a good mood this morning!
examples.zh: 你今天早晨心情不错啊！

examples.en: the general mood of depression in the office
examples.zh: 办公室里普遍的沮丧情绪

words.definition: two ideas or beliefs that are mutually exclusive cannot both exist or be true at the same time
words.translation: 互相地

examples.en: Note that different users of the system have different goals, and that these goals are often mutually exclusive.
examples.zh: 请注意系统的不同用户有不同的目标，而且这些目标经常是相互排斥的。

examples.en: In this hectic and often confusing world in which we live, one of the most priceless treasures I possess is a happy and mutually sustaining marriage.
examples.zh: 在我们生活的这个纷繁复杂的世界里，我拥有的一个最有价值的珍宝就是我们这段幸福而相互扶持的婚姻。

examples.en: Without honesty, your best efforts to resolve conflicts will be wasted because you will not understand each other well enough to find mutually acceptable solutions.
examples.zh: 没有诚实，就不能很充分很好地了解彼此以找到互相都能接受的解决方法也解决冲突的最大努力也将白费。

words.definition: a report on a series of events or a period of time, that mentions the most important parts; comment, retrospection; examine, inspect; look back to, look back on
words.translation: 回顾；复习；评论；检讨；检阅；检查；复审；复习功课；写评论

examples.en: a journalist who will review the events of the past six months
examples.zh: 将对过去六个月里所发生的事件进行回顾的记者

words.definition: beautiful, attractive, or graceful; graceful, exquisite
words.translation: 优雅的；高雅的，优雅的；讲究的

examples.en: a tall, elegant young woman
examples.zh: 身材高挑、举止优雅的年轻女子

examples.en: You can dine in elegant surroundings.
examples.zh: 你可以在雅致的环境中进餐。

words.definition: friendly, welcoming, and generous to visitors; pleasant, comfortable, easy
words.translation: 热情友好的；（环境）舒适的

examples.en: The local people were very kind and hospitable.
examples.zh: 当地人非常友好热情。

words.definition: if several people or things constitute something, they are the parts that form it; install, establish, form, found, build
words.translation: 组成；组成，构成；建立；任命

examples.en: We must redefine what constitutes a family.
examples.zh: 我们必须对家庭的构成重新定义。

words.definition: someone whose job is to write computer programs
words.translation: 程序设计员

examples.en: The computer programmer botched (up) the job and had to start over.
examples.zh: 计算机程序设计员把文件弄坏了，只好重做。

examples.en: This has served me well in my analyst/programmer jobs over the years.
examples.zh: 这一点对我这些年的分析师/程序员工作很有帮助。

examples.en: This element allows the programmer to take a set of nodes, group it by some criteria, and then process each group formed by that selection process.
examples.zh: 这个元素允许程序员获取一组节点，按某些标准来进行分组，然后处理由那一选择过程组成的每一个组。

words.definition: a sophisticated machine, system, method etc is very well designed and very advanced, and often works in a complicated way; complicated, experienced, involved, detailed, exquisite; mystified
words.translation: 复杂的；世故的；精致的；久经世故的；富有经验的；使变得世故；使迷惑；篡改（sophisticate的过去分词形式）

examples.en: sophisticated software
examples.zh: 很先进的软件

examples.en: a highly sophisticated weapons system
examples.zh: 非常精密的武器系统

words.definition: not knowing facts or information that you ought to know; dark, empty, innocent
words.translation: 无知的；愚昧的

examples.en: an ignorant and uneducated man
examples.zh: 不学无术的人

words.definition: to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves etc, especially in order to make people laugh; simulate, model after
words.translation: 模仿；模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制

examples.en: She was a splendid mimic and loved to imitate Winston Churchill.
examples.zh: 她是个出色的模仿者，喜欢模仿温斯顿·丘吉尔。

words.definition: to make something happen very quickly, especially a series of events; attract, produce, cause, operate, occasion; flip-flopper
words.translation: 引发，引起；[物化]引发，引起；[电子]触发；[军]扳机；[电子]触发器；制滑机

examples.en: The assassination triggered off a wave of rioting.
examples.zh: 这次暗杀事件引发了一阵骚乱。

examples.en: Certain forms of mental illness can be triggered by food allergies.
examples.zh: 某些精神疾病可能由食物过敏引发。

examples.en: His action triggered a massive response from the government.
examples.zh: 他的行动引发了政府的巨大反应。

words.definition: password, cryptogram; encode
words.translation: 代码，密码；代码，[遗][通信]密码；[计]编码；[法]法典；制成法典

examples.en: The spy sent his message in code.
examples.zh: 这个间谍用密码发送情报。

examples.en: But we have not yet implemented this in the code.
examples.zh: 但我们在代码中尚未实现此功能。

examples.en: The hacker came smack up against the company's policy of keeping its records in code.
examples.zh: 这个计算机黑客突然碰壁了，因这家公司实行了用密码保存公司纪录的政策。

words.definition: to try to find out the truth about something such as a crime, accident, or scientific problem; check into, inquire into
words.translation: 调查；研究

examples.en: The state police are investigating the incident.
examples.zh: 州警察正调查此事。

examples.en: The study investigates the impact of violent TV programming on children.
examples.zh: 该研究调查暴力电视节目对儿童的影响。

examples.en: I heard a noise and went downstairs to investigate.
examples.zh: 我听见响声，就下楼去看个究竟。

words.definition: someone who is outgoing likes to meet and talk to new people; egressive; issue, expense, flux, going out; exceeding
words.translation: 开朗的；外出的；即将离职的；乐于助人的；外出；流出；开支；超过；优于（outgo的ing形式）

examples.en: We’re looking for someone with an outgoing personality.
examples.zh: 我们在找一个性格外向的人。

words.definition: the scientific idea that plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time; unfolding, Monkey to Man
words.translation: 演变，进化；演变；[进化]进化论；进展

examples.en: the theory of evolution
examples.zh: 进化论

words.definition: good at finding ways of dealing with practical problems; heads-up, tactful
words.translation: 机智的；资源丰富的；足智多谋的

examples.en: a woman who is energetic and resourceful
examples.zh: 精力充沛且足智多谋的女人

words.definition: an ancient story, especially one invented in order to explain natural or historical events; fairy story, fairy tales
words.translation: 神话；虚构的人，虚构的事

examples.en: a book of Greek myths
examples.zh: 一本关于希腊神话的图书

examples.en: the giants of myth and fairytale
examples.zh: 神话和童话里的巨人

words.definition: an old, well-known story, often about brave people, adventures, or magical events; explanation, notes, romance, illustration
words.translation: 传奇；说明；[测]图例；刻印文字

examples.en: Local legend has it that (= says that ) the island was the original Garden of Eden.
examples.zh: 当地传说这个岛就是伊甸园的原型。

words.definition: someone who studies and develops ideas about the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil etc; wise man, rishi
words.translation: 哲学家；哲人

examples.en: Plato, Aristotle, and other Greek philosophers
examples.zh: 柏拉图、亚里士多德和其他希腊哲学家

words.definition: definite and specific; honest, effective, real; to freeze, clot; coagulation
words.translation: 具体的；[建]混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的；凝结；具体物；凝结物

examples.en: What does that mean in concrete terms ?
examples.zh: 具体来说那到底是什么意思？

examples.en: the lack of any concrete evidence
examples.zh: 缺少具体证据的

examples.en: a dialogue about concrete issues and problems
examples.zh: 有关具体事情和问题的对话

words.definition: to appear or come out from somewhere; ray, cast off
words.translation: 出现；浮现；摆脱；暴露

examples.en: The flowers emerge in the spring.
examples.zh: 花儿在春天开放。

words.definition: to move a liquid or substance around with a spoon or stick in order to mix it together; sensation, blockbuster; mill, occasion; spread abroad, to disseminate
words.translation: 搅动；煽动，激起；搅拌；轰动；激起；惹起；传播；走动

examples.en: Stir the paint to make sure it is smooth.
examples.zh: 将油漆搅拌至均匀。

words.definition: a  senior citizen; older, advanced, high; superior officer, nibs
words.translation: 老年人；高级的；年长的；地位较高的；年资较深的，资格较老的；上司；较年长者；毕业班学生

examples.en: Seniors can get a 10% discount.
examples.zh: 老年人可以享受10%的折扣。

words.definition: food that is nutritious is full of the natural substances that your body needs to stay healthy or to grow properly; alible, nourishing
words.translation: 营养的；有营养的，滋养的

examples.en: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
examples.zh: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。

examples.en: Nuts and fruit make nutritious snacks.
examples.zh: 坚果和水果是有营养价值的零食。

examples.en: The cookbook contains many simple yet highly nutritious meals.
examples.zh: 那本烹饪书里有许多简单却营养价值很高的食谱。

words.definition: having a special skill or special knowledge of a subject; skilled, accomplished, clever, diplomatic, practiced; operator, specialist
words.translation: 熟练的，内行的；熟练的；内行的；老练的；专家；行家；能手

examples.en: He cast his expert eye on the gardener’s work.
examples.zh: 他用内行的眼光看了看园丁干的活。

words.definition: someone whose job is making and repairing wooden objects; squareman, woodworker; to make
words.translation: 木匠；木匠，木工；制作

examples.en: He is a carpenter by profession.
examples.zh: 他以木工为业。

examples.en: At an early age, I was apprenticed to a carpenter.
examples.zh: 我小时候曾给木匠当过学徒。

examples.en: That carpenter wanted to become a lawyer， but he was advised to stick to his last.
examples.zh: 那个木匠想当律师， 但别人劝他安分守己地干他自己的老本行。

words.definition: to make something such as a feeling or activity less strong; control, restrain, stay; moisten
words.translation: 抑制；使…沮丧；使…潮湿；潮湿；丧气

examples.en: The light rain dampened the crowd’s enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 小雨使观众的热情减退了。

examples.en: Raising interest rates might dampen the economy.
examples.zh: 提高利率可能会抑制经济发展。

words.definition: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it; award, let, accept, recognize, agree; accept, see with, to agree with, agree on/upon, be agreeable to; appropriation
words.translation: 授予；允许；[法][专利]授予；承认；同意；拨款；[法][专利]授予物

examples.en: France has agreed to grant him political asylum.
examples.zh: 法国已经同意给予他政治庇护。

examples.en: Single parents tend to grant more independence to their children than other parents do.
examples.zh: 单亲父母往往比其他父母给予孩子们更多的自主性。

words.definition: things that are done to keep a person, building, or country safe from danger or crime; safety, assurance, certification, commitment, guarantee; safe, restricted
words.translation: 安全，安保；[安全]安全；保证；证券；抵押品；[安全]安全的；保安的；保密的

examples.en: The trial was held under tight security .
examples.zh: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

examples.en: lax security at airline check-in desks
examples.zh: 登机手续柜台松懈的安全措施

examples.en: terrorist activity that is a threat to national security
examples.zh: 威胁国家安全的恐怖活动

words.definition: a road, hill etc that is steep slopes at a high angle; tall, unreasonable; dip, dunk; crag, krantz
words.translation: 急剧升/降的；陡峭的；不合理的；夸大的；急剧升降的；泡；浸；使…充满；峭壁；浸渍

examples.en: The road became rocky and steep.
examples.zh: 路变得崎岖陡峭起来。

examples.en: a steep climb to the top
examples.zh: 到山顶的一段陡坡

words.definition: realization, completion, fulfillment
words.translation: 实现，履行；[计]实现；履行；安装启用

examples.en: They do, however, greatly affect the implementation of those patterns.
examples.zh: 然而，它们的确对那些模式的 实现影响很大。

examples.en: If I now scroll down to the actual implementation, now does this work or not work?
examples.zh: 如果现在我向下滚动到实际的执行中，这个是可用的还是不可用的呢？

examples.en: One file describes the interface to your service, while the other file describes your implementation of it.
examples.zh: 一个文件描述到您的服务的接口，而另一个文件描述这个接口的实现。

words.definition: to make someone or something less powerful or less important, or to become less powerful; shorten, to cut down; moderate, recoil from
words.translation: 减少，减弱；减少；使变弱；使变淡；变弱；畏缩；变软弱

examples.en: Over the last two years the president’s position has weakened.
examples.zh: 过去两年来，总统的地位被削弱了。

examples.en: Changes in policy have weakened the power of the trade unions.
examples.zh: 政策的变化削弱了工会的力量。

examples.en: The absence of this witness has weakened the case against the accused.
examples.zh: 这名证人的缺席削弱了对被告的指控力度。

words.definition: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused; baffle, discomfit; contemplate; enigma, difficult problem
words.translation: 迷惑；使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出；冥思苦想；谜；难题

examples.en: My sister puzzles me and causes me anxiety.
examples.zh: 我的妹妹常会让我不解，使我焦虑。

words.definition: to learn words, music etc so that you know them perfectly; retain, keep in mind
words.translation: 熟记，牢记；记住，背熟；记忆

examples.en: He studied his map, trying to memorize the way to Rose's street.
examples.zh: 他研究了地图，努力记住去罗丝家那条街的路。

words.definition: To cater to a group of people means to provide all the things that they need or want; humor, meet the demand
words.translation: 迎合；投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务

examples.en: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
examples.zh: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

words.definition: used to show that you are talking about someone or something that has not been mentioned before, or that your listener does not know about
words.translation: 一(个)；每一(个)

examples.en: We have a problem.
examples.zh: 我们遇到了一个麻烦。

examples.en: There was a hole in the fence.
examples.zh: 篱笆上有一个洞。

examples.en: Suddenly they heard a loud bang.
examples.zh: 他们突然听到砰的一声巨响。

words.definition: to leave someone, especially someone you are responsible for; loose, mania; desert, yield, quit
words.translation: 丢弃；放弃，抛弃；狂热；放任；遗弃；放弃

examples.en: How could she abandon her own child?
examples.zh: 她怎么能抛弃自己的孩子？

words.definition: the state of being able to do something; capacity, competence, talent, quality, power
words.translation: 能力；能耐，本领；能力，能耐；才能

examples.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
examples.zh: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

words.definition: clever or good at doing something; capable, efficient, competent
words.translation: 有能力的；出色的；能；[经管]有能力的；能干的

examples.en: one of my more able students
examples.zh: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

words.definition: very different from usual in a way that seems strange, worrying, wrong, or dangerous; unnatural, eccentric
words.translation: 不正常的；变态的；反常的，不规则的

examples.en: abnormal behaviour
examples.zh: 反常行为

examples.en: an abnormal level of cholesterol
examples.zh: 胆固醇水平异常

examples.en: My parents thought it was abnormal for a boy to be interested in ballet.
examples.zh: 我父母认为一个男孩子对芭蕾舞感兴趣并不正常。

words.definition: on or onto a ship, plane, or train; onboard, ashipboard
words.translation: 在船(车)上；上船；[航]在飞机上；[军][船][交]在船上；在火车上

examples.en: The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.
examples.zh: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

examples.en: The boat swayed as he stepped aboard.
examples.zh: 他上船时，船晃了起来。

words.definition: concerning or relating to a particular subject; concerning, as for, with reference to, round, in relation to; close-at-hand; around, approximately, everywhere, throughout, something
words.translation: 关于；在…周围；大约；在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的；周围；到处

examples.en: a book about politics
examples.zh: 一本有关政治的书

examples.en: She said something about leaving town.
examples.zh: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

examples.en: He lied about his age.
examples.zh: 他谎报年龄。

words.definition: beyond, without, than; hereinabove, thereinbefore
words.translation: 在…上面；高于；超过；在……上面；在……之上；在上面；在上文

examples.en: He lived in a flat above the shop.
examples.zh: 他住在那商店上面的一套房间里。

examples.en: The airliner flew above the clouds.
examples.zh: 大型客机在云层上面飞行。

words.definition: in or to a foreign country; foreign country
words.translation: (在)国外；到处；海外；异国

examples.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
examples.zh: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

examples.en: She often goes abroad on business.
examples.zh: 她经常出国公干。

examples.en: We never travelled abroad when we were kids.
examples.zh: 我们小时候从来没有去国外旅行过。

words.definition: when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away; shortage, deficiency, need, short of, drought
words.translation: 缺席，不在场；缺乏；没有；[法]缺席；不注意

examples.en: In the absence of any evidence, the police had to let Myers go.
examples.zh: 警察没有证据，只好把迈尔斯放了。

words.definition: used to emphasize your opinion about something or someone; strict, complete, full, positive, total
words.translation: 绝对的；纯粹的；[数]绝对的；完全的；专制的

examples.en: Some of the stuff on TV is absolute rubbish.
examples.zh: 电视上播放的有些东西简直就是垃圾。

examples.en: How did you do that? You’re an absolute genius.
examples.zh: 你是怎么做的？ 你绝对是个天才。

examples.en: That meal last night cost an absolute fortune.
examples.zh: 昨晚那顿饭花了一大笔钱。

words.definition: completely and in every way; totally, entirely, completely, thoroughly, strictly, fully
words.translation: 完全地；绝对地

examples.en: He made his reasons for resigning absolutely clear.
examples.zh: 他把辞职的理由讲得一清二楚。

examples.en: Are you absolutely sure?
examples.zh: 你绝对肯定吗？

examples.en: This cake is absolutely delicious.
examples.zh: 这蛋糕好吃极了。

words.definition: a college where students are taught a particular subject or skill; college, school
words.translation: 私立中学；专科院校；学院；研究院；学会

examples.en: a military academy
examples.zh: 军事学院

examples.en: the Royal Academy of Music
examples.zh: 皇家音乐学院

words.definition: a process in which something happens more and more quickly; promotion, impetus, speeding up
words.translation: 加速；加速度；[物]加速，促进；[力]加速度

examples.en: The latest model has excellent acceleration.
examples.zh: 这款最新型号加速性能优异。

words.definition: the way someone pronounces the words of a language, showing which country or which part of a country they come from; stress, trait; emphasize, stress, highlight
words.translation: 口音，腔调；重音；口音；[语]重音；强调；特点；重音符号；重读；带…口音讲话

examples.en: He had a strong Irish accent
examples.zh: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

words.definition: to take something that someone offers you, or to agree to do something that someone asks you to do; undertake, adopt, recognize, contain, shoulder; recognize, grant
words.translation: 接受；同意；承认；承担；承兑；容纳

examples.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
examples.zh: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

examples.en: He accepted the invitation to stay with us.
examples.zh: 他接受了邀请来我们家住。

examples.en: His school reports said that he is always ready to accept a challenge (=  agree to do something difficult  ) .
examples.zh: 他的学业报告上说他乐于接受挑战。

words.definition: good enough to be used for a particular purpose or to be considered satisfactory; receivable, admissible
words.translation: 可接受的，合意的；可接受的；合意的；可忍受的

examples.en: Students who achieve an acceptable standard will progress to degree studies.
examples.zh: 达到一定程度的学生可以进一步攻读学位。

examples.en: How do we reach an acceptable level of data security?
examples.zh: 我们如何使数据安全达到令人满意的程度？

words.definition: when you officially agree to take something that you have been offered; receiving, adoption
words.translation: 接受，验收；承认；接受；接纳；[金融]承兑；赞同

examples.en: He wrote a letter of acceptance (=  a letter in which you agree to accept a job, university place etc  ) to the university.
examples.zh: 他给那所大学写了一封接受函。

words.definition: subsidiary, incident, affiliated; decoration, attachment, enclosure
words.translation: 同谋，从犯；附属的；附带的；从犯的；附件；装饰品；从犯

words.definition: an event in which a car, train, plane etc is damaged and often someone is hurt; occurring, slip
words.translation: 意外的；事故；[安全]事故；意外；[法]意外事件；机遇

examples.en: Over 70,000 people are seriously injured every year in road accidents.
examples.zh: 每年在道路事故中受重伤的有七万多人。

examples.en: The accident happened at the junction of Forest Road and Pine Walk.
examples.zh: 事故发生在森林路与松树路的交叉口。

examples.en: a train accident
examples.zh: 火车事故

words.definition: happening without being planned or intended; unexpected, sudden, subsidiary, surprising, occasional
words.translation: 偶然的；非本质的；意外的；附属的；临时记号的

examples.en: an accidental discharge of toxic waste
examples.zh: 有毒废料的意外排放

examples.en: Buy an insurance policy that covers accidental damage .
examples.zh: 购买一份意外损害保单。

words.definition: residence, adjustment, conditioning
words.translation: 招待设备；预定铺位；住处，膳宿；[分子生物]调节；和解；预订铺位

words.definition: to give someone or something special attention or a particular type of treatment; agreement, unity, identity, keeping, consensus; afford, allow, deal, extend, deliver; cotton, identify, square, meet with, correspond with
words.translation: 使一致；给予；符合；一致；协议；自愿

examples.en: You will not be accorded any special treatment.
examples.zh: 你不会得到任何特殊待遇。

words.definition: unity, agreement, identity, consensus, keeping
words.translation: 一致；和谐；授予

words.definition: as a result of something; therefore, hence, consequently, thus, then
words.translation: 因此，所以；照着；因此，于是；相应地；照著

examples.en: Some of the laws were contradictory. Accordingly, measures were taken to clarify them.
examples.zh: 有些法律相互矛盾，因此，采取了措施将其阐明。

words.definition: an exact record of the money that a company has received and the money it has spent; interpretation, explanation, construction, sake, reason; result in, to interpret; count, find, guess, feel, rate
words.translation: 记述；解释；帐目；[会计]帐户；帐目，帐单；理由；导致；报帐；认为；把…视为

examples.en: The accounts for last year showed a profit of $2 million.
examples.zh: 去年的账目显示利润为200万美元。

words.definition: the ability to do something in an exact way without making a mistake
words.translation: 准确(性)；准确度

examples.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
examples.zh: 他传球准确无误。

words.definition: to say that you believe someone is guilty of a crime or of doing something bad; blame, law; law, come in for blame
words.translation: 指责；归咎于；控告，指控；谴责；控告

examples.en: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
examples.zh: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

words.definition: usual; usual, used, particular, common, exclusive
words.translation: 惯常的；习惯的；通常的；独有的

examples.en: The pans were in their accustomed places.
examples.zh: 那些锅在老地方。

words.definition: if part of your body aches, you feel a continuous, but not very sharp pain there; a continuous pain that is not sharp or very strong; rare, aspire; pain, achiness
words.translation: 痛；想念；疼痛；[临床]疼痛；渴望

examples.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
examples.zh: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

words.definition: something important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts; effort, completion, success, execution, accomplishment
words.translation: 完成；成就，成绩；成就；达到

examples.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
examples.zh: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

words.definition: a chemical substance that has a  pH  of less than 7. Strong acids can burn holes in material or damage your skin; acerbity; sour, vinegary
words.translation: 酸；酸的，酸性的；[化学]酸；<俚>迷幻药；[食品]酸的；讽刺的；刻薄的

examples.en: sulphuric acid
examples.zh: 硫酸

words.definition: someone you know, but who is not a close friend; knowledge, awareness
words.translation: 认识；了解；熟人；相识；知道

examples.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

examples.en: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
examples.zh: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

words.definition: a unit for measuring area, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,047 square metres; soil, domain, ground
words.translation: 英亩(=607亩)；土地，地产；英亩

examples.en: They own 200 acres of farmland.
examples.zh: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

examples.en: a 200-acre wood
examples.zh: 一片200英亩的林地

words.definition: through; opposite
words.translation: 横过；在…对面；穿过；横穿；在对面

words.definition: to do something in a particular way or for a particular reason; one thing that you do; play, take a part of; operate, bear oneself, conduct oneself; behavior, dealing, action, going, bill
words.translation: 行动；见效；行为；扮演；装作，举动像；扮演，充当；表现，举止；假装，演戏；起作用，见效；行为，行动；[法]法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势

examples.en: The company acted correctly in sacking him.
examples.zh: 公司解雇他做得对。

examples.en: The jury decided that Walker had acted in self-defence.
examples.zh: 陪审团裁定沃克的行为属于自卫。

examples.en: Politicians will only act when enough people demand that they do something.
examples.zh: 只有足够多的民众起来要求，政客们才会采取行动。

words.definition: the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing; movement, function, doing, campaign, working
words.translation: 行动；作用；功能；活动；战斗；情节

examples.en: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
examples.zh: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

examples.en: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
examples.zh: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

examples.en: Ambulance crews are ready to spring into action (=  suddenly start doing something  ) if anything goes wrong during the race.
examples.zh: 救护车急救人员随时准备出动，以应对比赛期间发生的意外。

words.definition: always busy doing things, especially physical or mental activities; positive, valid, available, effective, virtual; rustler
words.translation: 活跃的；积极的；[物化]活跃的；主动的；[电子]有效的；现役的；主动语态；积极分子

examples.en: games for active youngsters
examples.zh: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

examples.en: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
examples.zh: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

words.definition: things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim; movement, doing, campaign, working, act
words.translation: 活动；活力；行动；活跃

examples.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

examples.en: fund-raising activities
examples.zh: 筹款活动

examples.en: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
examples.zh: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

words.definition: someone who performs in a play or film
words.translation: 男演员；演剧的人

examples.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
examples.zh: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

words.definition: a woman who performs in a play or film
words.translation: 女演员

examples.en: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
examples.zh: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is real or exact; practical, sincere, real, effective, true
words.translation: 实际的；现行的；真实的，实际的；现行的，目前的

examples.en: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
examples.zh: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

examples.en: I know Germany won, but I can’t tell you the actual score.
examples.zh: 我知道德国队胜了，但我不知道确切的比分。

examples.en: Interest is only charged on the actual amount borrowed.
examples.zh: 利息只按实际借款额收取。

words.definition: used to add new information to what you have just said, to give your opinion, or to start a new conversation; really, effectively, virtually, even, practically
words.translation: 实际上；竟然；事实上

examples.en: I’ve known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
examples.zh: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

examples.en: Actually, on second thoughts, I don’t think I want to go out tonight.
examples.zh: 其实再想想，我今晚不打算出去了。

words.definition: an advertisement
words.translation: 广告

examples.en: She replied to a lonely hearts ad she spotted in the New York Times.
examples.zh: 她回复了在《纽约时报》上看到的一则求友广告。

words.definition: to put something with something else or with a group of other things; improve, gain, accelerate; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot; addition
words.translation: 添加，附加，掺加；[数]加；增加；加起来；做加法；增加，添加；补充说；计算…总和；加法，加法运算

examples.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
examples.zh: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

words.definition: the act of adding something to something else; add, accretion
words.translation: 加，加法；附加物；添加；[数]加法；增加物

examples.en: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
examples.zh: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

words.definition: a word that describes a noun or  pronoun  . In the phrase ‘black hat’, ‘black’ is an adjective and in the sentence ‘It makes her happy’, ‘happy’ is an adjective.; dependent, under
words.translation: 形容词；形容词的；[语]形容词的；从属的

examples.en: In “the black cat” the adjective “black”modifies the noun “cat”.
examples.zh: 在“那只黑猫”中，形容词“黑的”修饰名词“猫”。

examples.en: The "me" circuit hummed not only when they thought whether a particular adjective described themselves, but also when they considered whether it described their mother.
examples.zh: “我”神经回路不仅当他们想到一个特定形容词是否描述自我时接通，而且当他们思考该词是否形容自己母亲时也同样。

examples.en: Using phrases like “Darwinian selection” or “Darwinian evolution” implies there must be another kind of evolution at work, a process that can be described with another adjective.
examples.zh: 使用“达尔文选择”或“达尔文进化论”这样的短语意味着工作中必须有另一种进化形式，一种可以用另一个形容词来描述的过程。

words.definition: to change or move something slightly to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose; regulate, coordinate, frame, restructure; correct, adapt to something
words.translation: 调整，调节；校正；调整，使…适合；校准；调整，校准；适应

examples.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
examples.zh: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

examples.en: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning.
examples.zh: 尝尝汤的味道，然后调整佐料用量。

examples.en: If your employment status changes, your tax code will be adjusted accordingly.
examples.zh: 如果就业状况改变，你的免税代码也会作相应调整。

words.definition: to take someone else’s child into your home and legally become its parent; assume, take in sth
words.translation: 收养；采用；采取；接受；正式通过

examples.en: Sally was adopted when she was four.
examples.zh: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

examples.en: The couple are unable to have children of their own, but hope to adopt.
examples.zh: 那对夫妇自己无法生育，但希望领养孩子。

words.definition: a fully-grown person, or one who is considered to be legally responsible for their actions; fully grown or developed; developed, grown, mature; major, grown-up
words.translation: 成年人；成年的；成熟的

examples.en: Some children find it difficult to talk to adults.
examples.zh: 一些孩子觉得与大人很难谈得来。

words.definition: a good or useful feature that something has; behalf, superiority, asset, benefit, edge; gain, make a profit; favor of, be conducive to
words.translation: 优点，优势；好处；优势；[经]利益；有利条件；获利；有利于；使处于优势

examples.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (=  have an advantage  ) when applying for jobs.
examples.zh: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

words.definition: willingness to try new things, take risks etc; risk, throw, venture; take a chance, run a risk; take a risk, run a risk, stick one's neck out, take chances
words.translation: 冒险；惊险活动；冒险精神；投机活动；大胆说出

examples.en: Come on – where’s your sense of adventure?
examples.zh: 来吧——你的冒险精神哪里去了？

words.definition: a word that adds to the meaning of a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, such as ‘slowly’ in ‘He ran slowly’, ‘very’ in ‘It’s very hot’, or ‘naturally’ in ‘Naturally, we want you to come.’
words.translation: 副词

examples.en: Will you please compare the adverb “well”?
examples.zh: 请你说出副词“well”的原级、比较级和最高级好吗?

examples.en: In the class, the professor taught the students how to use an adverb in the sentence.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，教授教学生们如何在一个句子里用副词。

examples.en: For our purposes, we get the definition of a word as well as its pronunciation and type (for example, adjective, noun, verb, adverb).
examples.zh: 我们这里只涉及到词汇的定义、音标和词性（如形容词、名词、动词、副词等）。

words.definition: a picture, set of words, or a short film, which is intended to persuade people to buy a product or use a service, or that gives information about a job that is available, an event that is going to happen etc; publicity, bill, propaganda, dissemination, drumbeating
words.translation: 广告；公告；登广告；[经]广告，宣传

examples.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
examples.zh: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

examples.en: The organizers of the concert had taken out a full page advertisement in ‘The New York Times’.
examples.zh: 音乐会筹办者在《纽约时报》上刊登了整版广告。

examples.en: Only a handful of people answered the advertisement .
examples.zh: 只有寥寥数人对该广告作出了回应。

words.definition: suitable, wise, adequate, appropriate, proper
words.translation: 明智的；可取的；明智的，可取的，适当的

examples.en: I deem it advisable to buy property now.
examples.zh: 我认为现在购置房地产是明智的。

examples.en: It would't be advisable for us to kiss off their objections.
examples.zh: 对人家的意见不予理睬是不明智的。

words.definition: to tell someone what you think they should do, especially when you know more than they do about something; alarm, message; agree to sb, make suggestions
words.translation: 劝告；建议；通知；劝告，忠告；警告；与…商量

examples.en: She needed someone to advise her.
examples.zh: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

examples.en: ‘Make sure that you keep the documents in a safe place,’ Otley advised him.
examples.zh: “一定要把文件放在安全的地方。”奥特利向他建议道。

words.definition: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine; plane, airplane
words.translation: 飞机；[航]飞机（等于airplane）

examples.en: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
examples.zh: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

words.definition: public or political events and activities; thing, transaction, relations, business
words.translation: 事情，事件；事务；事情；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事

examples.en: Are you interested in world affairs?
examples.zh: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

examples.en: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
examples.zh: 外交部

examples.en: Women had little role in public affairs.
examples.zh: 女性过去几乎不参与公共事务。

words.definition: to do something that produces an effect or change in something or in someone’s situation; influence, impact of, impact on, catch, contract; tend, prefer; emotion, will, sensibility
words.translation: 影响；感动；感染；假装；倾向；喜欢；情感；引起感情的因素

examples.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
examples.zh: 受飓风影响的地区

examples.en: a disease that affects the central nervous system
examples.zh: 影响中枢神经系统的疾病

examples.en: decisions which affect our lives
examples.zh: 影响我们生活的决定

words.definition: a feeling of liking or love and caring; infection, impression, favor, effect, influence
words.translation: 慈爱，爱；爱慕；喜爱，[心理]感情；影响；感染

examples.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
examples.zh: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

examples.en: Their father never showed them much affection .
examples.zh: 他们的父亲对他们从来没有表现出多少慈爱。

examples.en: The church was held in great affection (=  loved and cared about a lot  ) by the local residents.
examples.zh: 教会深受当地民众爱戴。

words.definition: frightened because you think that you may get hurt or that something bad may happen; worried, scared
words.translation: 害怕的；担心的；恐怕

examples.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
examples.zh: 没有必要害怕。

words.translation: 非洲

examples.en: The giraffe ranges in Africa.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿生长在非洲。

examples.en: The practice still prevails in some parts of Africa.
examples.zh: 这种做法在非洲某些地区仍然很盛行。

examples.en: He traversed alone the whole continent of Africa from east to west.
examples.zh: 他只身长途跋涉， 从东向西横穿整个非洲大陆。

words.definition: relating to Africa or its people; someone from Africa
words.translation: 非洲的；非洲人

examples.en: ...the African continent.
examples.zh: …非洲大陆。

words.definition: when a particular event or time has happened, or when someone has done something; since, subsequently; in the back of; succeeding
words.translation: 在…以后；次于；后来，以后；在……之后；以后的

examples.en: After the war many soldiers stayed in France.
examples.zh: 战后，许多士兵留在法国。

examples.en: I go swimming every day after work.
examples.zh: 我每天下班后都去游泳。

examples.en: Do you believe in life after death?
examples.zh: 你相信人死后还有来生吗？

words.definition: the part of the day after the morning and before the evening; post meridian, arvo
words.translation: 下午，午后；午后，下午

examples.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
examples.zh: 星期四下午有个会议。

examples.en: It was very hot in the afternoon .
examples.zh: 下午很热。

examples.en: See you tomorrow afternoon .
examples.zh: 明天下午见。

words.definition: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned; since, subsequently
words.translation: 后来，以后；以后，后来

examples.en: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
examples.zh: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

words.definition: one more time – used when something has happened or been done before; moreover, besides, additionally, then, both
words.translation: 又一次；而且；又，此外；再一次

examples.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
examples.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

examples.en: I’ll never go there again.
examples.zh: 我再也不会去那儿了。

examples.en: Mr Khan’s busy. Can you try again later?
examples.zh: 卡恩先生正忙着。 你能不能过一会儿再打来？

words.definition: next to and touching an upright surface, especially for support; in opposition to, in contravention of; adverse, contrary, opposite, disadvantageous
words.translation: 倚在；逆，对着；反对，违反；靠；倚；防备；不利的；对立的

examples.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
examples.zh: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

examples.en: The younger policeman was leaning against the bureau with his arms folded.
examples.zh: 那位较年轻的警官两臂交叉，倚靠在办公桌旁。

words.definition: the number of years someone has lived or something has existed; to start looking older or to make someone or something look older; era, time, stage, phase, grade; mature, flower; grey, ripen
words.translation: 年龄；时代；变老；寿命，使用年限；阶段；成熟；使成熟；使变老，使上年纪

examples.en: Francis is the same age as me.
examples.zh: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

examples.en: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
examples.zh: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。
