examples.en: Dad retired at the age of 56.
examples.zh: 爸爸是在56岁时退休的。

words.definition: used to show how far back in the past something happened; previously, formerly, back; previous, past, back
words.translation: 以前；以前，以往；以前的；过去的

examples.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (=  a fairly long time ago  ) .
examples.zh: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

examples.en: We had our bicentenary celebrations not that long ago.
examples.zh: 不久前，我们举行了200周年庆典活动。

words.definition: very severe pain; unhappiness, vexation
words.translation: 极度痛苦；苦恼；极大的痛苦；临死的挣扎

examples.en: the agony of arthritis
examples.zh: 关节炎的剧烈疼痛

words.definition: to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else; undertake, accept, recognize, side, grant; accept, grant
words.translation: 同意；持相同意见；赞成；承认；意见一致

examples.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
examples.zh: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

words.definition: an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc; accordance, protocol, unity, identity, keeping
words.translation: 协定，协议；同意；[法]协议；同意，一致

examples.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
examples.zh: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

words.definition: the practice or science of farming; farming, extractive industry
words.translation: 农业，农艺；农学；[农]农业；农艺，[农学]农学

examples.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.
examples.zh: 75%以上的土地用于农耕。

words.definition: a short distance in front of someone or something; forth, in advance, previously, to, along; forward, antrorse
words.translation: 在前；向前；提前；领先；预先；领先的；向前的

examples.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
examples.zh: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

examples.en: We could see the lights of Las Vegas up ahead .
examples.zh: 我们能看到前方拉斯维加斯的灯光。

examples.en: Henry hurried on ahead (=  went in front of the others  ) .
examples.zh: 亨利赶紧跑到前面。

words.definition: help that you need to do a particular thing; assistance, friend, hand, help, boost; facilitate, bolster up; lend a hand, to help
words.translation: 帮助，救护；助手；援助；帮助；帮助者；有助于

examples.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
examples.zh: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

words.definition: to choose the place, person etc that you want to hit or reach and point a weapon or another object towards them; be calculated to, boot; propose, to intend; intention, purpose, sake, objective, target
words.translation: 瞄准，针对；致力；目的在于；引导；把…对准；打算；对准目标；目的；目标；对准

examples.en: Denver aimed his gun but did not shoot.
examples.zh: 丹佛举枪瞄准，但是没有射击。

words.definition: the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe; atmosphere, heaven, sky, high, look; sport, ventilate
words.translation: 空气；空中；外观；[气象]空气，[地物]大气；天空；样子；曲调；使通风，晾干；夸耀

examples.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
examples.zh: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

examples.en: You need to put some air in the tyres.
examples.zh: 你得给轮胎充气了。

words.definition: a plane or other vehicle that can fly; plane, airplane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机，飞行器；[航]飞机，航空器

examples.en: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed.
examples.zh: 飞机的返回航程被推迟了。

words.definition: a company that takes passengers and goods to different places by plane; vector, lane, airways
words.translation: 航空公司；航线；[航]航线

examples.en: an airline pilot
examples.zh: 航空公司飞行员

words.definition: a vehicle that flies through the air and has one or more engines; plane, aeroplane
words.translation: 飞机；[航]飞机

examples.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
examples.zh: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

examples.en: The new airplane flies at twice the speed of sound.
examples.zh: 这架新式飞机以两倍于音速的速度飞行。

examples.en: We beamed the airplane down safely.
examples.zh: 我们给飞机导航使它安全降落。

words.definition: a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in; landing field, aeroport
words.translation: 机场，航空站；[航]机场；航空站

examples.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
examples.zh: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

examples.en: Her family went to see her off at the airport.
examples.zh: 她的家人去机场送她。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that makes a loud noise to warn you of danger; panic, tocsin; exercise, alert, warn
words.translation: 惊恐，忧虑；警报；警报，[安全]警告器；惊慌；警告；使惊恐

examples.en: I forgot to set the burglar alarm.
examples.zh: 我忘记打开防盗警报器了。

examples.en: Car alarms are always going off in the street.
examples.zh: 街上总有汽车警报器在响。

examples.en: a sophisticated alarm system
examples.zh: 精密的警报系统

words.definition: very similar; similar, same, uniform, like, parallel; similarly
words.translation: 同样的，相同的；相似的；相同的；以同样的方式；类似于

examples.en: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
examples.zh: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

words.definition: still living and not dead; lively, activated
words.translation: 活着的；活跃的；活泼的；有生气的

examples.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
examples.zh: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

examples.en: My grandparents are still alive .
examples.zh: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

examples.en: We stayed alive by eating berries.
examples.zh: 我们靠吃浆果活命。

words.definition: entire, overall, total; utterly, sheerly; full, entirety, allness
words.translation: 全部的；全部；全然地；越发

words.definition: to let someone do or have something, or let something happen; afford, let, have, deal, extend; think of, think about
words.translation: 允许，准许；任；允许；给予；认可；容许；考虑

examples.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
examples.zh: 泳池内禁止跳水。

words.definition: a metal that consists of two or more metals mixed together; composition metal
words.translation: 合金；(金属的)成色；[材]合金

examples.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
examples.zh: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

words.definition: nearly, but not completely or not quite; nearly, most, virtually, practically, feckly
words.translation: 几乎，差不多；差不多，几乎

examples.en: Have you almost finished?
examples.zh: 你差不多完成了吗？

examples.en: Supper’s almost ready.
examples.zh: 晚饭就要做好了。

examples.en: It was almost midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜将至。

words.definition: if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you; Alone is also an adverb; independent, isolated, separate, sole; respectively, solely
words.translation: 单独的；单独地；独自的；孤独的；独自地

examples.en: She lives alone .
examples.zh: 她一个人生活。

examples.en: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
examples.zh: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

examples.en: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
examples.zh: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

words.definition: from one place on something such as a line, road, or edge towards the other end of it; going forward; forth, together, to, ahead, front; down
words.translation: 沿着；向前；一起；来到；顺着

examples.en: We were driving along Follyfoot Road.
examples.zh: 我们沿着福莱福特路行驶。

examples.en: She glanced anxiously along the line of faces.
examples.zh: 她焦急地扫视着这一排面孔。

examples.en: He slid his hand along her arm.
examples.zh: 他的手顺着她的臂膀滑下。

words.definition: if you read, laugh, say something etc aloud, you read etc so that people can hear you; out, loudly
words.translation: 出声地，大声地；大声地；出声地

examples.en: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
examples.zh: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

words.definition: a set of letters, arranged in a particular order, and used in writing; ABC, rudiments
words.translation: 字母表，字母系统；[语]字母表，字母系统；入门，初步

examples.en: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
examples.zh: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

words.definition: before now, or before a particular time; yet
words.translation: 早已，已经；已经，早已；先前

examples.en: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
examples.zh: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

examples.en: The performance had already started when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

words.definition: in addition to something else that you have mentioned; moreover, too, besides, either, likewise
words.translation: 亦，也；而且，还；也；而且；同样

examples.en: Information is also available on women’s health care.
examples.zh: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

examples.en: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
examples.zh: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

examples.en: The system was not only complicated but also ineffective.
examples.zh: 这套系统不仅复杂而且效率低。

words.definition: used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely; while, though, as, albeit
words.translation: 尽管，虽然；虽然，尽管

examples.en: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
examples.zh: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

examples.en: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
examples.zh: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

examples.en: Although I can’t help admiring the man’s courage, I do not approve of his methods.
examples.zh: 尽管我不得不佩服那个男子的勇气，却并不赞成他的方法。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something has been done completely or has finished completely; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully; birthday suit, entireness
words.translation: 完全；总而言之；完全地；总共；整个；裸体

examples.en: an old custom that has vanished altogether
examples.zh: 一个彻底消亡的古老习俗

examples.en: Congress could ban the procession altogether.
examples.zh: 国会可以完全禁止这次游行。

words.definition: a silver-white metal that is very light and is used to make cans, cooking pans, window frames etc. It is a chemical  element  : symbol Al
words.translation: 铝

examples.en: recycled aluminium cans
examples.zh: 再生铝罐

words.definition: all the time, at all times, or every time; forever and ever, immer
words.translation: 总是，一直；永远；永远，一直；总是；常常

examples.en: Always lock your bicycle to something secure.
examples.zh: 每次都要把自行车锁在牢固的物体上。

examples.en: She’d always assumed that Gabriel was a girl’s name.
examples.zh: 她一直认为加布里埃尔是个女孩名字。

examples.en: He hadn’t always been a butler.
examples.zh: 他并不是一直当管家。

words.definition: determination to be successful, rich, powerful etc; careerism, aspiration; pursue / pursuit, go after
words.translation: 雄心，抱负，野心；野心，雄心；抱负，志向；追求；有…野心

examples.en: He was young and full of ambition.
examples.zh: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

words.definition: a special vehicle that is used to take people who are ill or injured to hospital; meat wagon
words.translation: 救护车；野战医院；[车辆][医]救护车；战时流动医院

examples.en: the ambulance service
examples.zh: 救护车服务

examples.en: the ambulance service
examples.zh: 你觉得我们需要叫救护车吗？

words.definition: United States, U.S.A
words.translation: 美洲；美国；美洲（包括北美和南美洲）

examples.en: I may go to America or I may not,it all depends.
examples.zh: 我也许去美国，也许不去，要视情况而定。

examples.en: She scampered in London then went back to America.
examples.zh: 她在伦敦匆忙地游览了一番，然后回到了美国。

examples.en: Some of the mountains in America have not yet been mapped out.
examples.zh: 美洲有些山脉还没有在地图上标出来。

words.definition: relating to the US or its people; someone from the US
words.translation: 美洲的；美国人

examples.en: Her mother is American.
examples.zh: 她妈妈是美国人。

examples.en: a famous American writer
examples.zh: 一位著名的美国作家

words.definition: in or through the middle of a group of people or things; in the middle of, in the midst of
words.translation: 在…之中；在…中间

examples.en: The girl quickly disappeared among the crowd.
examples.zh: 女孩转眼消失在人群中。

examples.en: I could hear voices coming from somewhere among the bushes.
examples.zh: 我能听到灌木丛中某个地方传来说话的声音。

examples.en: We walked among the chestnut woods on the mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 我们走在山坡上的栗树林中。

words.definition: in the midst of, amidst
words.translation: 在…之中(=among)；在…之中；在…当中（等于among）

examples.en: Here in Trinity it is right that I should give you an account of how he lived amongst you during these years of his greatest achievement.
examples.zh: 正是在三一学院这儿，我将对你们阐述他如何在你们中间生活，如何在这些年中取得他的最伟大的成就。

words.definition: a quantity of something such as time, money, or a substance; foot, gross total; sum, quantity of, gross, total
words.translation: 总数；数量；和；[会计]总计，合计；相当于；[数]共计；产生…结果；总额，[数]总数

examples.en: Please pay the full amount (=  of money  ) by the end of the month.
examples.zh: 请在月底前全额付清。

words.translation: 安培

examples.en: And I prefer to an ampere meter being made of aluminum even though it has analog to another one.
examples.zh: 我还想要一个铝制的安培表，虽然它与另一个类似。

examples.en: A static magnetic field is measured in units of ampere per metre, (A/m) but is usually expressed in terms of the corresponding magnetic induction measured in units of tesla, (T) or millitesla (mT).
examples.zh: 静电磁场以每米具有的安培单位衡量(A/m)，但是通常以相应的电磁感应单位特斯拉(T)或毫伏特斯拉(mT)表示。

examples.en: Five nanogenerators working together produced about 1 micro ampere output current at 3 volts about the same voltage generated by two regular AA batteries.
examples.zh: 5个纳米发电机同时工作可以产生1微安培3伏特的输出电流，与2节普通的5号电池所产生的电压差不多。

words.definition: to make sound louder, especially musical sound; extend, zoom up; expand on, enlarge on
words.translation: 放大，增强；扩大；放大，扩大；增强；详述

examples.en: an amplified guitar
examples.zh: 带有扩音设备的电吉他

words.definition: to make time pass in an enjoyable way, so that you do not get bored; to entertain, wile away
words.translation: 逗…乐；给…娱乐；娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快

examples.en: Doing jigsaws would amuse Amy for hours on end.
examples.zh: 拼图能让埃米连续玩上几个小时。

examples.en: The kids amused themselves playing hide-and-seek.
examples.zh: 孩子们玩捉迷藏玩。

words.definition: to examine or think about something carefully, in order to understand it; study, break down
words.translation: 分析，分解，解析；分析；分解；细察

examples.en: She still needs to analyse the data.
examples.zh: 她仍需要分析这些数据。

examples.en: You need to sit down and analyse why you feel so upset.
examples.zh: 你得坐下来想一想自己为什么会那么生气。

examples.en: Joe had never tried to analyze their relationship.
examples.zh: 乔从未试图去理清他们的关系。

words.definition: a process in which a doctor makes someone talk about their past experiences, relationships etc in order to help them with mental or emotional problems; decomposition, dissolution
words.translation: 分析，分解，解析；[化学][数]分析；分解；验定

examples.en: She’s been in analysis for three years.
examples.zh: 她接受精神分析治疗已经三年了。

words.definition: a member of your family who lived a long time ago; father, root, grandfather
words.translation: 祖宗，祖先；始祖，[生物]祖先；被继承人

examples.en: My ancestors were French.
examples.zh: 我的祖先是法国人。

words.definition: a piece of heavy metal that is lowered to the bottom of the sea, a lake etc to prevent a ship or boat moving; to lower the anchor on a ship or boat to hold it in one place; kelleg, backer patron; fix, nail
words.translation: 锚；抛锚，停泊；[船]锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播；抛锚；[机]使固定；主持节目

examples.en: We dropped anchor a few yards offshore.
examples.zh: 我们在离岸几码远的地方抛锚停航。

examples.en: The next morning, they weighed anchor (=  lifted the anchor  ) and began to move south again.
examples.zh: 第二天早上他们起锚，又开始向南航行。

words.definition: used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way; granted, et, but, yet, only
words.translation: 和，又，并，则；和，与；就；而且；但是；然后

examples.en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
examples.zh: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。

examples.en: The film starred Jack Lemmon and Shirley Maclaine.
examples.zh: 这部电影由杰克·莱蒙和雪莉·麦克莱恩主演。

examples.en: We’ve dealt with items one, two, and eleven.
examples.zh: 我们已经处理了第一项、第二项和第十一项。

words.definition: a  spirit  who is God’s servant in heaven, and who is often shown as a person dressed in white with wings; cherubs, nat
words.translation: 天使，神差，安琪儿；天使；守护神；善人

examples.en: the angel Gabriel
examples.zh: 天使加百列

words.definition: a strong feeling of wanting to hurt or criticize someone because they have done something bad to you or been unkind to you; to make someone angry; wrath, bile; provoke, enrage; chafe at, be hot under the collar
words.translation: 怒，愤怒；使发怒；怒，[心理]愤怒；忿怒；使发怒，激怒；恼火；发怒

examples.en: There is growing anger among the people against the government.
examples.zh: 民众对政府越来越不满。

words.definition: the space between two straight lines or surfaces that join each other, measured in degrees; fish, figure for; hao, jiao
words.translation: 角，角度；钓鱼；谋取；角度，[数]角

examples.en: You didn’t measure the angle accurately.
examples.zh: 你没有量准角度。

words.definition: feeling strong emotions which make you want to shout at someone or hurt them because they have behaved in an unfair, cruel, offensive etc way, or because you think that a situation is unfair, unacceptable etc; riley, vexed
words.translation: 愤怒的，生气的；生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

examples.en: I was angry because he hadn’t told me his plans.
examples.zh: 我很生气，因为他没有告诉我他的计划。

examples.en: He was beginning to get angry .
examples.zh: 他开始发脾气了。

examples.en: His comments brought an angry response from opposition politicians.
examples.zh: 他的话激起反对派政客愤怒的回应。

words.definition: a living creature such as a dog or cat, that is not an insect, plant, bird, fish, or person; human feelings, desires etc that are connected with sex, food, and other basic needs; creature, zoon
words.translation: 动物，兽；动物的；[动]动物

examples.en: furry little animals
examples.zh: 毛茸茸的小动物

examples.en: The cosmetics have not been tested on animals.
examples.zh: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

examples.en: Beth is an animal lover (=  someone who likes animals  ) .
examples.zh: 贝丝是个喜欢动物的人。

words.definition: the joint between your foot and your leg; gambrel, malleolus
words.translation: 踝，踝节部；踝关节，[解剖]踝

examples.en: slender ankles
examples.zh: 纤细的脚踝

words.definition: someone who reads news or information on the television or radio; broadcaster
words.translation: 宣告者；播音员；[广播]广播员

examples.en: The radio announcer said it was nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 电台播音员报了9点。

words.definition: different, diverse, other, unlike, varying
words.translation: 再一个的；别的；又一，另一；另外的；不同的

examples.en: Can you cite another case like this one?
examples.zh: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

words.definition: to say something to someone as a reply when they have asked you a question, made a suggestion etc; reply, meet with; reply, accord; response, defence, reply, result
words.translation: 回答；响应；适应；符合；答案；[法]答辩

examples.en: She thought for a moment before answering.
examples.zh: 她想了一会儿才回答。

examples.en: He still hadn’t answered my question .
examples.zh: 他仍然没有回答我的问题。

examples.en: ‘Why don’t you just leave?’ ‘I’d like to,’ she answered, ‘but I have nowhere else to go.’
examples.zh: “你为什么不一走了之？”“我倒是想走，”她回答说，“但是我没有其他地方可去。”

words.definition: a small insect that lives in large groups; emmet, pismire
words.translation: 蚂蚁

examples.en: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁从地里成群地爬出来，爬满了她的鞋和腿。

words.definition: the feeling of being very worried about something; solicitude, aspiration
words.translation: 焦虑，忧虑；渴望；[心理]焦虑；挂念；令人焦虑的事

examples.en: his feelings of anxiety
examples.zh: 他焦虑的心情

examples.en: A high level of anxiety was created by the introduction of cameras into the factory.
examples.zh: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

examples.en: It can help if you discuss your anxieties with someone.
examples.zh: 与别人谈谈自己的忧虑会有帮助的。

words.definition: worried about something; eager, hungry, desired, sick, keen
words.translation: 忧虑的；渴望的；焦虑的；担忧的；急切的

examples.en: She gave me an anxious look.
examples.zh: 她焦急地看了我一眼。

words.definition: having, possessory; somewhat, in some sort
words.translation: 什么，一些；任何的；所有的；丝毫；稍微；少许

examples.en: We could not reason out which way the robbers escaped, because we were unable to find any trace of them.
examples.zh: 我们推断不出这些强盗是从哪个方向逃走的，因为我们找不到他们的任何踪迹。

words.translation: 任何人

examples.en: You should have a try, don't swallow anybody.
examples.zh: 不要轻信任何人，你得亲自去试一试。

examples.en: She swore me not to tell anybody about my secret.
examples.zh: 她向我发誓不把我的秘密告诉任何人。

examples.en: We shouldn't slight anybody even if he's a nobody.
examples.zh: 我们不应该轻视任何人，即使他是一个小人物。

words.definition: anyway, however
words.translation: 无论如何；总之；不管怎样

examples.en: You know nothing about her really, or about yourself in relation to her, and anyhow it's only one of those things and therefore it's of no importance.
examples.zh: 你对她一点儿都不了解，也不了解自己和她的关系，无论如何它只是那些事情之一,因此没有任何重要性。

words.definition: used to refer to any person, when it is not important to say exactly who
words.translation: 任何人

examples.en: Anyone could win tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚任何人都可能赢。

examples.en: They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。

examples.en: If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
examples.zh: 如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。

words.definition: any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which
words.translation: 任何事物；一切

examples.en: You can buy anything you want.
examples.zh: 你想要什么都可以买。

examples.en: He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
examples.zh: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

examples.en: Anything would be better than staying at home!
examples.zh: 做什么都比待在家里好！

words.definition: however, anyhow
words.translation: 无论如何；无论如何，不管怎样；总之

words.definition: You use anywhere in statements with negative meaning to indicate that a place does not exist; whithersoever; nowhere
words.translation: 在什么地方；在任何地方；无论何处；任何地方

examples.en: I haven't got anywhere to live.
examples.zh: 我没有任何地方住。

words.definition: if things are apart, they are not close to each other or touching each other; unusual, different, distinctive, isolated, separating
words.translation: 相隔；分开；除去；分离的；与众不同的

examples.en: They have offices in countries as far apart as India and Peru.
examples.zh: 他们的办事处远至印度、秘鲁等国。

examples.en: The police try to keep rival supporters apart at all matches.
examples.zh: 警方在所有的比赛中都设法将双方的支持者分开。

examples.en: A couple of men started fighting and we had to pull them apart .
examples.zh: 几名男子打起架来，我们不得不将他们拉开。

words.definition: to tell someone that you are sorry that you have done something wrong; square oneself, make an apology
words.translation: 道歉，谢罪，认错；道歉；辩解；赔不是；谢罪；辩白

examples.en: I’m so sorry, I do apologize.
examples.zh: 非常对不起，我真心道歉。

words.definition: something that you say or write to show that you are sorry for doing something wrong; justification, advocacy
words.translation: 道歉，认错，谢罪；道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物

examples.en: Edward can’t be here today, but he sends his apologies .
examples.zh: 爱德华今天来不了，他向大家表示歉意。

words.definition: the set of tools and machines that you use for a particular scientific, medical, or technical purpose; device, equipment, installation, furniture, facility, unit, organ
words.translation: 器械，仪器；器官；装置，[机]设备；[仪]仪器

examples.en: Astronauts have special breathing apparatus.
examples.zh: 航天员有专门的呼吸装装备。

words.definition: easy to notice; transparent, decided, patent
words.translation: 表面上的；明显的；显然的

examples.en: The difference in quality was immediately apparent .
examples.zh: 质量的差异显而易见。

examples.en: He left suddenly, for no apparent reason .
examples.zh: 不知什么原因，他突然离开了。

words.definition: used to say how something seems, especially from what you know about it or from what you can see; occur, figure, offer, come out
words.translation: 出现；来到；似乎；显得；出庭

examples.en: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
examples.zh: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

examples.en: He tried to make it appear that she had committed suicide.
examples.zh: 他试图制造她自杀的假象。

examples.en: It may be less useful than it appears at first.
examples.zh: 这可能没有一开始显得那么有用。

words.definition: a hard round fruit that has red, light green, or yellow skin and is white inside; customer, fellow, egg, guy, bird
words.translation: 苹果，苹果树；[园艺]苹果；家伙

examples.en: apple pie
examples.zh: 苹果馅饼

examples.en: an apple tree
examples.zh: 苹果树

examples.en: roast pork and apple sauce (=  a thick sauce made from cooked apples  )
examples.zh: 烤猪肉配苹果酱汁

words.definition: a piece of equipment, especially electrical equipment, such as a  cooker  or  washing machine  , used in people’s homes; device, apparatus, installation, unit, tool
words.translation: 用具，器具，器械；器具；器械；[机]装置

examples.en: The device most often used to do this is a load balancer, which is an appliance that accepts requests from the outside world and hands them off to the next available application server.
examples.zh: 进行这一操作最常用的设备是一个负载均衡器，这是一个从外部接收请求并将它们移交给下一个可用应用程序服务器的装置。

words.definition: if something is applicable to a particular person, group, or situation, it affects them or is related to them; becoming, shaped, likely, possible, meet
words.translation: 能应用的；适当的；[药]可适用的；可应用的；合适的

examples.en: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another.
examples.zh: 对一个家庭合理的标准对于另一个家庭并不适用。

words.definition: correct or suitable for a particular time, situation, or purpose; suitable, proper, adequate, becoming; engage, take up to
words.translation: 适当的，恰当的；适当的；占用；拨出

examples.en: The timing of the announcement was particularly appropriate .
examples.zh: 通告发布的时机很合适。

examples.en: Where appropriate , I delegate as much work as possible.
examples.zh: 只要合适，我就尽量把工作分派出去。

examples.en: Mark box 1 or 2, as appropriate .
examples.zh: 把方框1和2中的合适者标出来。

words.definition: to be close to a particular number; close to, border on; near, broad, round
words.translation: 近似的；近似；接近于；[数]近似于；[数]近似的；大概的

examples.en: For each approximate solution of a parameterized problem, the app also displays the margin of error.
examples.zh: 对于每一个参数化问题的近似结果，这个程序也会显示误差的边界。

words.definition: the fourth month of the year, between March and May
words.translation: 四月

examples.en: The changes will be introduced in April.
examples.zh: 这些变更将于4月实施。

words.definition: relating to Arabia or its people
words.translation: 阿拉伯的

examples.en: ...the Arabian Peninsula.
examples.zh: ...阿拉伯半岛。

words.definition: decided or arranged without any reason or plan, often unfairly; artificial, random, absolute
words.translation: 随心所欲的；专断的；[数]任意的；武断的；专制的

examples.en: an arbitrary decision
examples.zh: 武断的决定

examples.en: the arbitrary arrests of political opponents
examples.zh: 对政敌的任意逮捕

words.definition: the style and design of a building or buildings; architectural style
words.translation: 建筑学；建筑式样；[建]建筑学；建筑风格

examples.en: He studied architecture at university.
examples.zh: 他在大学里读的是建筑学。

words.definition: a particular part of a country, town etc; district, region, extent, boundary, spectrum, territory
words.translation: 面积；地区；领域；区域，[地理]地区；范围

examples.en: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
examples.zh: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

examples.en: Crime rates are much higher in urban areas.
examples.zh: 城镇地区的犯罪率要高很多。

words.definition: to disagree with someone in words, often in an angry way; debate, dispute about; debate, discuss, demonstrate, prove, satisfy
words.translation: 争论，争辩，辩论；争论，辩论；提出理由；辩论，争论；证明；说服

examples.en: We could hear the neighbours arguing.
examples.zh: 我们听到邻居在争吵。

words.definition: a situation in which two or more people disagree, often angrily; brush, reasoning, dispute
words.translation: 争论，辩论；理由；论证；论据；争吵；内容提要

examples.en: We need to provide a convincing argument as to why the system should be changed.
examples.zh: 我们得提出有说服力的论据，证明为何要改变体制。

words.definition: if a problem or difficult situation arises, it begins to happen; occur, raise, figure, offer, come out
words.translation: 出现；由…引起；上升；起立

examples.en: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
examples.zh: 外交部出现了危机。

examples.en: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
examples.zh: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

words.definition: the science of numbers involving adding, multiplying etc; algorithm, number
words.translation: 算术，四则运算；[数]算术，算法

examples.en: ...teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
examples.zh: …教授读、写、算的基本知识。

words.definition: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands; weapon, equipment, setup; war preparation
words.translation: 臂；臂状物；武器；手臂；袖子；[军]装备；武装；备战

examples.en: Dave has a broken arm .
examples.zh: 戴夫手臂断了。

examples.en: Tim’s mother put her arms around him.
examples.zh: 蒂姆的母亲伸出双臂搂着他。

examples.en: Pat was carrying a box under his arm .
examples.zh: 帕特腋下挟着一个盒子。

words.definition: the part of a country’s military force that is trained to fight on land in a war; battalion, heer
words.translation: 军队；陆军；陆军，[军]军队

examples.en: The army are helping to clear up after the floods.
examples.zh: 陆军部队正协助洪灾后的清理工作。

examples.en: an army officer
examples.zh: 陆军军官

examples.en: Army units launched attacks on bases near Jounieh port.
examples.zh: 陆军部队对朱尼耶港附近的基地发动了进攻。

words.definition: approximately, everywhere, throughout, something; round
words.translation: 在…周围；大约；到处；在附近；四处

examples.en: What an inspiration she was to all around her!
examples.zh: 她对于她周围所有的人是一种多么大的鼓舞!

examples.en: All those around him looked at him with amazement.
examples.zh: 周围的人都对他投射出惊异的眼光。

words.definition: to make you become interested, expect something etc; encourage, attract, cause, produce, occasion; make someone tick, wake up
words.translation: 引起，唤起；唤醒；引起；鼓励；激发；醒来；发奋

examples.en: Matt’s behavior was arousing the interest of the neighbors.
examples.zh: 马特的行为渐渐引起了邻居的兴趣。

words.definition: plans and preparations that you must make so that something can happen; preparation, positioning, preliminary, setting, provision
words.translation: 整理，排列；安排；布置；整理；准备

examples.en: Have you made all your travel arrangements?
examples.zh: 你的旅行都安排好了吗？

words.definition: when someone or something arrives somewhere; coming, advent
words.translation: 到达；到来；到达者

examples.en: Only the timely arrival of the police prevented the situation from becoming worse.
examples.zh: 警方及时赶到才阻止了事态恶化。

examples.en: Traffic problems account for one third of late arrivals.
examples.zh: 迟到的人有三分之一是因为交通问题。

words.definition: to get to the place you are going to; land, win, make good
words.translation: 到达；来临；达到；成功；达成；出生

examples.en: Give me a call to let me know you’ve arrived safely.
examples.zh: 打个电话给我，告诉我你已平安到达。

examples.en: By the time the police arrived on the scene, the burglars had fled.
examples.zh: 警方赶到现场时，窃贼已经逃跑了。

words.definition: a weapon usually made from a thin straight piece of wood with a sharp point at one end, that you shoot with a  bow
words.translation: 箭；箭状物

examples.en: Follow the arrows to the X-ray department.
examples.zh: 顺着箭头指示的方向去X光科。

words.definition: the use of painting, drawing,  sculpture  etc to represent things or express ideas; beaux-arts, artwork; artistic; are, am
words.translation: 艺术，美术；技术；艺术；美术；艺术品；艺术的；艺术品的；是（be的变体）

examples.en: the Museum of Modern Art in New York
examples.zh: 纽约现代艺术博物馆

examples.en: an example of early Indian art
examples.zh: 印度早期艺术的范例

words.definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine; item, provision, clause
words.translation: 文章；条款；物品；[法]条款；[语]冠词

examples.en: The paper’s leading article (=  the main article  ) described the government as weak.
examples.zh: 该报社论称政府软弱。

examples.en: newspaper articles
examples.zh: 报纸上的文章

words.definition: not real or not made of natural things but made to be like something that is real or natural; synthetic, false, simulated, arbitrary
words.translation: 人工的；娇揉造作的；人造的；[自]仿造的；虚伪的；非原产地的；武断的

examples.en: artificial flowers
examples.zh: 假花

examples.en: artificial light
examples.zh: 人造光

examples.en: artificial fertilizers
examples.zh: 化肥

words.definition: someone who produces art, especially paintings or drawings; pope, maestro
words.translation: 艺术家，美术家；艺术家；美术家（尤指画家）；大师

examples.en: an exhibition of paintings by local artists
examples.zh: 当地画家的画展

words.definition: relating to art or culture; art
words.translation: 艺术的；艺术家的；风雅的；有美感的

examples.en: artistic work
examples.zh: 艺术作品

examples.en: Opinion about the artistic merit of his paintings has been mixed.
examples.zh: 对于他的绘画作品的艺术价值，人们褒贬不一。

words.definition: while or when; because, although, since, for, seeing; in the light of, like; equally, similarly, same, likewise
words.translation: 当…的时候；因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时；如同；当作；以…的身份；同样地；和…一样的

examples.en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
examples.zh: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

examples.en: As time passed, things seemed to get worse.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，情况似乎变得更加糟糕了。

examples.en: Just as the two men were leaving, a message arrived.
examples.zh: 那两个男子刚要离开，消息就传来了。

words.definition: the soft grey powder that remains after something has been burned; ember
words.translation: 灰，灰末；骨灰；[化学][矿物]灰；灰烬

examples.en: cigarette ash
examples.zh: 香烟灰

examples.en: The house burnt to ashes.
examples.zh: 那房子烧成了灰烬。

words.translation: 亚洲

examples.en: The European powers extended their authority in Asia.
examples.zh: 欧洲列强在亚洲扩大他们的管辖权。

examples.en: The teacher chalked out a map of Asia on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 老师用粉笔在黑板上画了一张亚洲地图。

examples.en: His extensive experience in other parts of Asia helped him to overcome cultural barriers.
examples.zh: 在亚洲其他地区的广泛经历帮助他克服了文化障碍。

words.definition: from or relating to Asia, especially India or Pakistan; someone from Asia, or whose family originally came from Asia, especially India or Pakistan
words.translation: 亚洲的；亚洲人

examples.en: The financial crisis devitalized the economy of the Asian countries.
examples.zh: 这次金融危机使亚洲国家的经济大伤元气。

examples.en: The government predicates that the market collapse was caused by Asian financial crisis.
examples.zh: 政府宣布市场不景气是由于亚洲金融危机而引起的。

words.definition: moved to one side or away from you; away from, alongside; voice-over, whisper; at the side of
words.translation: 在旁边，到旁边；离开，撇开；在旁边；旁白；私语，悄悄话；离题的话；在…旁边

examples.en: He pushed his half-eaten salad aside and left.
examples.zh: 他推开吃了一半的色拉走了。

examples.en: He stepped aside to let Katherine go in first.
examples.zh: 他站到一边让凯瑟琳先进去。

examples.en: Mark drew me aside and explained the problem.
examples.zh: 马克把我拉到一边给我解释这个问题。

words.definition: to speak or write to someone in order to get an answer, information, or a solution; invite, lack, question, desire, exact; question, query
words.translation: 问；要求；邀请；问，询问；需要；讨价

examples.en: ‘What’s your name?’ she asked.
examples.zh: “你叫什么名字？”她问道 。

examples.en: Don’t ask him – he won’t know.
examples.zh: 别问他，他不知道。

examples.en: That kid’s always asking awkward questions .
examples.zh: 那孩子总是问一些尴尬的问题。

words.definition: sleeping; sleeping, stupid
words.translation: 睡着的，睡熟的；睡着的；麻木的；长眠的

examples.en: Quiet! The baby’s asleep.
examples.zh: 安静！ 宝宝在睡觉。

words.definition: one part of a situation, idea, plan etc that has many parts; direction, orientation, situation, side, respect
words.translation: 方面；样子，外表；[建]方向；形势；外貌

examples.en: a south-facing aspect
examples.zh: 朝南方向

words.definition: to help someone to do something
words.translation: 援助，帮助；搀扶

examples.en: The family decided to assist me with my chores.
examples.zh: 家人决定分担我的琐事。

words.definition: someone who helps someone else in their work, especially by doing the less important jobs; friend, aid, mate, helper; helpful, useful, subsidiary, auxiliary, aided
words.translation: 助手，助理；助教；助手，[管理]助理，助教；[纺]辅助的，[管理]助理的；有帮助的

examples.en: a clerical assistant
examples.zh: 文书助理

examples.zh: 仔细填写现金账簿，每次都要检查计算结果。

examples.zh: 观众拼命为他加油。

words.definition: something that is cheerful makes you feel happy because it is so bright or pleasant; happy, pleased, glad, good, bright

examples.zh: 一家明亮宜人的意大利餐馆

examples.zh: 他们经常在一起下国际象棋。

examples.zh: 这肉太老了，我几乎嚼不动！

words.translation: 教室，课堂；教室

examples.zh: 学生们蜂拥着跑出了教室。

words.translation: 通讯；传达；交通；通讯，[通信]通信；交流

words.translation: 共产党员

examples.zh: 如果所有这些问题的答案都为否，那么使用框架只会把事情变复杂。

words.translation: 压紧，压缩；压缩，压紧；精简

examples.en: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
examples.zh: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

examples.en: Isobel nodded, her lips compressed.
examples.zh: 伊索贝尔紧闭着双唇点了点头。

examples.en: The miners used rock drills and compressed air to drive through hard rock.
examples.zh: 矿工使用钻岩机和压缩空气来凿穿坚硬的岩石。

words.definition: to consist of particular parts, groups etc; involve, contain
words.translation: 包含，包括；构成；包含；由…组成

examples.en: The house comprises two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a living room.
examples.zh: 这座房子有两间卧室、一间厨房和一间起居室。

words.definition: an agreement that is achieved after everyone involved accepts less than what they wanted at first, or the act of making this agreement; harm, meet someone halfway; meet someone halfway, come to terms with; accommodation, reconciliation
words.translation: 妥协，和解；妥协；危害；让步；折衷

examples.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of marriage.
examples.zh: 妥协是婚姻生活中必不可少的。

examples.en: To stop the argument they decided on a compromise.
examples.zh: 为停止争吵，他们决定作出妥协。

examples.en: If moderates fail to reach a compromise , the extremists will dominate the agenda.
examples.zh: 如果温和派不能达成妥协，激进派就会主宰议事日程。

words.definition: to calculate a result, answer, sum etc; cast, figure; figure, cast; calculation, estimation, appraisal, valuation, count
words.translation: 计算，估计，估算；[数]计算；估算；用计算机计算；推断；估计

examples.en: Final results had not yet been computed.
examples.zh: 最终的结果还未计算出来。

words.definition: an electronic machine that stores information and uses programs to help you find, organize, or change the information; calculating machine, computing machine
words.translation: 计算机，电脑；计算机；[计]电脑；电子计算机

examples.en: a huge global computer network
examples.zh: 巨大的全球计算机网络

examples.en: the latest computer software
examples.zh: 最新的计算机软件

words.definition: socialists  or  communists  often call each other ‘comrade’, especially in meetings; partner, mates
words.translation: 同志，亲密的同伴；同志；伙伴

examples.en: Comrades, please support this motion.
examples.zh: 同志们，请支持这项动议。

words.definition: to hide something carefully; lock, pocket, to hide
words.translation: 把…隐藏起来；隐藏；隐瞒

examples.en: The shadows concealed her as she crept up to the house.
examples.zh: 她借着阴影蹑手蹑脚地走向房子。

examples.en: The path was concealed by long grass.
examples.zh: 小路隐藏在长长的草里。

examples.en: a concealed weapon
examples.zh: 藏匿的武器

words.definition: to think very carefully about something that you are doing; focus, collect, mass, crowd; centre, localise; compression, solidification
words.translation: 集中；聚集；浓缩；[物]浓缩；全神贯注；[物]浓缩，精选；浓缩液

examples.en: Now please concentrate.
examples.zh: 现在请集中注意力。

examples.en: Adrian was finding it difficult to concentrate.
examples.zh: 阿德里安觉得自己很难集中注意力。

words.definition: about or relating to; about, as for, with reference to, in relation to, in respect of; involving, relating
words.translation: 关于；就…而言；涉及；使关心（concern的ing形式）；忧虑

examples.en: calls from young children concerning lost pets
examples.zh: 小孩子打来的有关宠物走失的电话

examples.en: the facts concerning Marr’s car crash
examples.zh: 有关马尔撞车事故的事实

words.definition: a performance given by musicians or singers; accordance, unity, agreement, identity, keeping; coordinate with, attune; cooperate, sort
words.translation: 音乐会，演奏会；音乐会；一致；和谐；使协调；协同安排；协调；协力

examples.en: a rock concert
examples.zh: 摇滚音乐会

examples.en: a concert of French choral music
examples.zh: 法国合唱音乐会

examples.en: We were going to a concert in Bath Abbey.
examples.zh: 我们要去听一场在巴斯修道院内举行的音乐会。

words.definition: to decide that something is true after considering all the information you have; understand, condition; deduce from, draw the conclusion
words.translation: 推断出；结束；推断；决定，[劳经]作结论；断定；决定

examples.en: When the investigation is concluded, the results will be sent to the US Attorney’s office.
examples.zh: 等到调查结束后，结果会被送到联邦检察官办公室。

words.definition: to say very strongly that you do not approve of something or someone, especially because you think it is morally wrong; denounce, deplore
words.translation: 谴责，指责；判刑；谴责；判刑，定罪；声讨

examples.en: Politicians were quick to condemn the bombing.
examples.zh: 政治家们立即对爆炸事件进行了谴责。

words.definition: to make something that is spoken or written shorter, by not giving as much detail or using fewer words to give the same information; concentrate, to freeze; dewater, inspissate
words.translation: 压缩，使缩短；浓缩；凝结；使浓缩；使压缩

examples.en: the mist which condensed on every cold surface
examples.zh: 每个冰冷的表面上凝结的水汽

words.definition: the state that something is in, especially how good or bad its physical state is; circumstance, situation, context, qualification, thing; adapt, suit, season, conclude
words.translation: 状况，状态；环境；[数]条件；情况；身分；使适应；使健康；决定；以…为条件

examples.en: Profits increased by £1.5m, despite the difficult economic conditions.
examples.zh: 尽管经济形势不佳，利润还是增长了150万英镑。

words.definition: the way someone behaves, especially in public, in their job etc; lead through; manage, run, direct, represent, aim; going on, behavior, dealing, enforcement, administration
words.translation: 举止，行为；指导；导电；带领；管理；引导；表现；进行；行为；实施

examples.en: The Senator’s conduct is being investigated by the Ethics Committee.
examples.zh: 该参议员的行为正受到道德委员会的调查。

examples.en: an inquiry into the conduct of the police
examples.zh: 对警方行为的调查

examples.en: his arrest for disorderly conduct
examples.zh: 他因妨害治安行为而遭逮捕

words.definition: someone who stands in front of a group of musicians or singers and directs their playing or singing; leader, Moses, supervisor, administrator
words.translation: 售票员；(乐队)指挥；[电]导体；[交]售票员；领导者；管理人

examples.en: Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
examples.zh: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

words.definition: a large formal meeting where a lot of people discuss important matters such as business, politics, or science, especially for several days
words.translation: 会议，讨论会

examples.en: Representatives from over 100 countries attended the International Peace Conference in Geneva.
examples.zh: 来自一百多个国家的代表出席了在日内瓦举行的国际和平大会。

words.definition: to admit, especially to the police, that you have done something wrong or illegal; accept, recognize, agree, acknowledge, grant; accept, recognize
words.translation: 供认，承认；坦白；承认；忏悔；[法]供认

examples.en: Occasionally people confess to crimes they haven’t committed just to get attention.
examples.zh: 偶尔人们会承认自己并未犯过的罪行，那只是为了引人注意。

examples.en: Torture was used and Fian confessed.
examples.zh: 酷刑用过之后菲安就招供了。

words.definition: sure that something will happen in the way that you want or expect; sure, convinced, assured
words.translation: 确信的，自信的；自信的；确信的

examples.en: Despite her disability, Philippa is very confident.
examples.zh: 菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

words.definition: to keep someone or something within the limits of a particular activity or subject; boundary, border; block, set a limit to
words.translation: 限制；禁闭；界限，边界

examples.en: Vaughan is confined to a wheelchair .
examples.zh: 沃恩离不开轮椅。

words.definition: when you do not understand what is happening or what something means because it is not clear; chaos, disorder, involvement, mix, turmoil
words.translation: 混乱；骚乱；混淆；混淆，混乱；困惑

examples.en: To avoid confusion, the teams wore different colours.
examples.zh: 为了避免混淆，各队穿着不同颜色的服装。

words.definition: to tell someone that you are happy because they have achieved something or because something nice has happened to them; celebrate, felicitate
words.translation: 祝贺，向…道喜；祝贺；恭喜；庆贺

examples.en: He never even stopped to congratulate me.
examples.zh: 他甚至没有过来向我祝贺。

words.definition: when you tell someone that you are happy because they have achieved something or because something nice has happened to them; felicitation, gala
words.translation: 祝贺；祝贺词；贺辞

examples.en: letters of congratulation
examples.zh: 祝贺信

words.definition: a formal meeting of representatives of different groups, countries etc, to discuss ideas, make decisions etc; session, conversation, meeting, parliament
words.translation: 大会；国会，议会；国会；代表大会；会议；社交

examples.en: a congress of the ruling Labor Party
examples.zh: 执政党工党的代表大会

words.definition: a combination of different things that have come together by chance; combination, coupling, bond, wedding, join
words.translation: 接合，连接；连接词；结合；[语]连接词；同时发生

examples.en: The worksheets are designed to be used in conjunction with the new course books.
examples.zh: 这些活页练习题专门用来与新课本配套使用。

words.definition: to join two or more things together; couple, hand in hand; band, combine
words.translation: 连接，连结；联系；连接；联合；关连

examples.en: We’d like two rooms with connecting doors (= doors that join the rooms ) .
examples.zh: 我们想要两个有门相通的房间。

words.definition: the way in which two facts, ideas, events etc are related to each other, and one is affected or caused by the other; relationship, bearing, link, concern, junction
words.translation: 连接，联系；连贯性；连接；关系；连接件

examples.en: Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
examples.zh: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

examples.en: The evidence was there in the file but no one made the connection .
examples.zh: 证据就在档案里，但没有人把它们联系起来。

examples.en: Students often see little connection between school and the rest of their lives.
examples.zh: 学生往往看不到上学和今后生活的联系。

words.definition: to get control of a country by fighting; defeat, master; overcome, win the day
words.translation: 征服，战胜；破除；战胜，征服；攻克，攻取；胜利；得胜

examples.en: The Normans conquered England in 1066.
examples.zh: 诺曼人于 1066 年征服英格兰。

examples.en: Egypt was conquered by the Persian king Kambyses.
examples.zh: 埃及被波斯国王冈比西斯征服。

words.definition: the act of getting control of a country by fighting; prize, defeat, capture
words.translation: 攻取，征服；克服；征服，战胜；战利品

examples.en: the Norman Conquest (= the conquest of England by the Normans )
examples.zh: 诺曼征服

words.definition: noticing or realizing something; aware, intended, studied, designed
words.translation: 意识到的；有意的；故意的；神志清醒的

examples.en: The driver was still conscious when the ambulance arrived.
examples.zh: 救护车赶到时，司机仍然神志清醒。

words.definition: to think about something carefully, especially before making a choice or decision; expect, find, guess, feel, view; allow, think about, pore
words.translation: 认为；考虑；关心；考虑到；细想

examples.en: We will have to consider your offer carefully .
examples.zh: 我们得仔细考虑你的提议。

words.definition: careful thought and attention, especially before making an official or important decision; attention, compensation, payment, cause, matter
words.translation: 考虑，思考；体贴；考虑；原因；关心；报酬

examples.en: proposals put forward for consideration
examples.zh: 提请考虑的建议

words.definition: a set of basic laws and principles that a country or organization is governed by; formation, fabric, structure, build, make
words.translation: 章程；体质；构造；宪法

examples.en: The right to speak freely is written into the Constitution of the United States.
examples.zh: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

words.definition: to build something such as a house, bridge, road etc; found, institute, frame, structure, father; concept, formulation, idea, notion
words.translation: 建造；建设；构筑；建造，构造；创立；构想，概念

examples.en: There are plans to construct a new road bridge across the river.
examples.zh: 有计划要建造一条新的跨河公路桥。

words.definition: if something such as a bag, box, or place contains something, that thing is inside it; involve, possess, regulate, manage, accept; restrain oneself, abstain
words.translation: 包含，容纳；等于；包含；控制；容纳；牵制（敌军）；含有；自制

examples.en: The thieves stole a purse containing bank-notes.
examples.zh: 小偷们偷到了一个里面有钞票的钱包。

examples.en: The museum contains a number of original artworks.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆藏有一些原创艺术品。

words.definition: something such as a box or bowl that you use to keep things in; vessel, pocket
words.translation: 容器；集装箱；[交]集装箱；[包装]容器

examples.en: ice cream in plastic containers
examples.zh: 塑料容器里的冰激凌

words.definition: a feeling that someone or something is not important and deserves no respect; despite, defiance
words.translation: 轻蔑；藐视；受辱；轻视，蔑视；耻辱

examples.en: The public is treated with contempt by broadcasters.
examples.zh: 公众受到了节目主持人的轻蔑对待。

examples.en: How could she have loved a man who so clearly held her in contempt ?
examples.zh: 她怎么会爱上一个明显看不起她的男人呢？

words.definition: a large mass of land surrounded by sea; mainland, earth, land; self-regulating, restrained
words.translation: 大陆；陆地；洲；[地理]大陆，洲，陆地；自制的，克制的

examples.en: the continents of Asia and Africa
examples.zh: 亚洲及非洲大陆

words.definition: continuing for a long time without stopping; frequent
words.translation: 不断的；连续的；持续不断的；频繁的

examples.en: five weeks of continual rain
examples.zh: 持续了五个星期的降雨

examples.en: the Japanese business philosophy of continual improvement
examples.zh: 日本人精益求精的经营哲学

words.definition: to not stop happening, existing, or doing something; run on, carry on with
words.translation: 继续，连续；延伸；继续，延续；仍旧，连续

examples.en: He will be continuing his education in the US.
examples.zh: 他将在美国继续求学。

examples.en: I felt too sick to continue.
examples.zh: 我感觉很难受，无法继续下去了。

words.definition: continuing to happen or exist without stopping
words.translation: 连续不断的，持续的

examples.en: continuous economic growth
examples.zh: 持续的经济增长

examples.en: a continuous flow of information
examples.zh: 源源不断的信息

words.definition: a difference between two statements, beliefs, or ideas about something that means they cannot both be true; conflict, discrepancy
words.translation: 矛盾，不一致；否认；[数]矛盾；反驳

examples.en: apparent contradictions in the defendant’s testimony
examples.zh: 被告证词中的明显矛盾

words.definition: contrary ideas, opinions, or actions are completely different and opposed to each other; used to add to a negative statement, to disagree with a negative statement by someone else, or to answer no to a question; opposite, adverse, counter, against, cross; counter, backward, conversely, inversely; inverse, verso
words.translation: 相反的；相反；对立的；相反地；反面

examples.en: Two contrary views emerged.
examples.zh: 出现了两种相反的观点。

examples.en: The men shouted contrary orders.
examples.zh: 这些人大声喊叫的命令互相矛盾。

words.definition: to make someone or something do what you want, or make something happen in the way that you want; the ability or power to make someone or something do what you want or make something happen in the way you want; governance, administration, management, supervision, checking; possess, manage, regulate, bottle, conduct
words.translation: 控制，克制；控制；[自]控制；[管理]管理；抑制；操纵装置

examples.en: Police had to be called in to control the crowds.
examples.zh: 只好调来警察控制人群。

examples.en: a skilled rider controlling a spirited horse
examples.zh: 驾驭烈马的一名技巧娴熟的骑手

words.definition: the quality of being suitable or useful for a particular purpose, especially by making something easier or saving you time; john, bathroom, toilet
words.translation: 便利，方便；厕所；便利；便利的事物

examples.en: Ready meals sell well because of their convenience.
examples.zh: 即食餐因为方便销路好。

words.definition: a formal agreement, especially between countries, about particular rules or behaviour; tradition, usage, institution, appointment, bond
words.translation: 习俗，惯例；公约；大会；[法]惯例；[计]约定；协定；习俗

examples.en: Playing together teaches children social conventions such as sharing.
examples.zh: 一起玩耍可教会儿童与人分享等社会常规。

words.definition: an informal talk in which people exchange news, feelings, and thoughts; congress, dialog
words.translation: 会话，非正式会谈；交谈；会话；社交

examples.en: a telephone conversation
examples.zh: 电话交谈

examples.en: Children quickly get bored by adult conversation.
examples.zh: 儿童对成年人的谈话很快就会厌倦。

examples.en: They had a short conversation in German and seemed to be disagreeing about something.
examples.zh: 他们用德语说了一会儿，好像对什么事有分歧。

words.definition: used when one situation is the opposite of another; contrary, counter, backward, inversely
words.translation: 相反地

examples.en: American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
examples.zh: 美国的消费者喜欢白色的鸡蛋，而英国的消费者却相反，他们喜欢棕色的鸡蛋。

words.definition: when you change something from one form, purpose, or system to a different one; transformation, reforming, switching, exchange, changing
words.translation: 转变，转化；改变；转换；变换；[金融]兑换；改变信仰

examples.en: ...the conversion of disused rail lines into cycle routes.
examples.zh: …把废弃的铁路改变成自行车道。

words.definition: to change something into a different form, or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way; transform, shift; idolater, proselytizer
words.translation: 使转变；使改变；转变，变换；皈依；改变信仰；皈依者；改变宗教信仰者

examples.en: a 19th-century converted barn
examples.zh: 由19世纪谷仓改建的房子

words.definition: to prepare food for eating by using heat; chef, kitchener
words.translation: 烹调，煮；烧菜；[劳经]厨师，厨子

examples.en: Where did you learn to cook?
examples.zh: 你在哪里学烹调的？

examples.en: Cook the sauce over a low heat for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把这调味汁用低火烧十分钟。

examples.en: slices of cooked ham
examples.zh: 熟的火腿片

words.definition: low in temperature, but not cold, often in a way that feels pleasant; philosophical, cracking; still; subside, blow over; calmly, soberly
words.translation: 凉的，冷静的；凉爽的；冷静的；出色的；使…冷却；使…平静下来；变凉；平息；冷静地

examples.en: She swam out into the cool water.
examples.zh: 她往外游向清凉的水里。

examples.en: The evening air was cool.
examples.zh: 夜晚的空气很凉爽。

examples.en: Relax in the sun with a cool drink.
examples.zh: 在阳光下喝杯清凉饮料放松一下。

words.definition: to work with someone else to achieve something that you both want; fit, work together
words.translation: 合作，协作；配合；合作，配合；协力

examples.en: They agreed to co-operate with Brazil on a programme to protect the rain forests.
examples.zh: 他们同意和巴西合作进行一个保护热带雨林的项目。

words.definition: to organize an activity so that the people involved in it work well together and achieve a good result; paratactic, tantamount; adjust, restructure; sort, concert
words.translation: 使协调，调节；并列的；[物化]同等的；调整；整合；协调

examples.en: The agencies are working together to co-ordinate policy on food safety.
examples.zh: 这些机构在共同合作为食品安全政策做协调工作。

words.definition: to succeed in dealing with a difficult problem or situation; manage, contest; gown, robe
words.translation: 对付，应付；处理；对付；竞争；长袍

examples.en: Sometimes I find it hard to cope.
examples.zh: 有时候我觉得很难应付。

examples.en: He coped quite well as manager while still captaining the team.
examples.zh: 他是球队的主教练，同时兼任队长，干得相当好。

words.definition: a soft reddish-brown metal that allows electricity and heat to pass through it easily, and is used to make electrical wires, water pipes etc. It is a chemical element: symbol Cu; police, pig; cupreous
words.translation: 铜；铜币，铜制器；[化学]铜；铜币；警察；铜的

examples.en: He offered to do the job for a few coppers.
examples.zh: 他说他来做这份工作，给他几个铜板就行。

words.definition: something that is made to be exactly like another thing; to deliberately make or produce something that is exactly like another thing; to duplicate, print off; repeat, lift; repeat, counterpart
words.translation: 抄件；抄写，复制；[印刷][计]复制；复印；抄袭；[印刷]副本；一册；摹仿

examples.en: back-up copies of your files
examples.zh: 你的文档的备份

words.definition: a piece of thick string or thin rope; chain, restriction, rope
words.translation: 细绳，粗线，索；绳索；束缚

examples.en: The robe was held at the waist by a cord.
examples.zh: 在袍子腰处束了根细绳。

examples.en: He pulled explosives and some tangled cord from his bag.
examples.zh: 他从他的包里掏出炸药和一些乱糟糟的绳子。

words.definition: friendly but quite polite and formal; genuine, heady; a shot in the arm, agonist
words.translation: 真诚的，诚恳的；热忱的，诚恳的；兴奋的；补品；兴奋剂；甜香酒，甘露酒

examples.en: The talks were conducted in a cordial atmosphere.

words.definition: to make someone believe something that is not true; take in sb, give the shaft
words.translation: 欺骗，蒙蔽，行骗；欺骗；行骗

examples.en: He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
examples.zh: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

words.definition: the 12th month of the year, between November and January
words.translation: 十二月

examples.en: In the dark of December.
examples.zh: 在十二月的黑夜里。

examples.en: Our summers are short and our winters long.In December, when it is darkest, we only have a few hours of very weak sunlight per day.
examples.zh: 我们的夏天很短但是冬天很长，在十二月，也就是最黑的时候，我们的一天中只有很短的时间可以看到微弱的阳光。

examples.en: I send out Valentine’s cards with the girls’ photo, instead of trying to mail cards in December.
examples.zh: ——我寄出有女孩子照片的情人节贺卡，以代替试图在十二月寄出的贺卡。

words.definition: to make a choice or judgment about something, especially after considering all the possibilities or arguments; settle, condition, conclude; will, determine to
words.translation: 决定，决心；解决；决定；判决；决定，下决心

examples.en: Has anything been decided yet?
examples.zh: 已经作出什么决定了吗？

examples.en: The trainees decide among themselves what programs to take.
examples.zh: 受训者自行选择课程。

examples.en: After a long discussion, they decided in favour of (= chose ) the older applicant.
examples.zh: 经过长时间的讨论，他们决定选那位较年长的求职者。

words.definition: a choice or judgment that you make after a period of discussion or thought; determination, resolution, push, backbone
words.translation: 决定，决心；果断；决议

examples.en: Do you ever wonder if you made the right decision?
examples.zh: 你怀疑过自己所作的决定是否正确吗？

examples.en: The judges’ decision is final (= it will not be changed ) .
examples.zh: 法官的裁决是最终判决。

words.definition: one of the levels on a bus, plane etc; board, storage room; paint, hang, dress oneself, array
words.translation: 甲板；舱面；层面；[船]甲板；行李仓；露天平台；装饰；[船]装甲板；打扮

examples.en: Eddie returned to the flight deck (= the part of an aircraft where the pilot sits ) .
examples.zh: 埃迪回到了驾驶舱。

words.definition: to state officially and publicly that a particular situation exists or that something is true; bill, state; to announce, hand down
words.translation: 断言；声明；表明；宣布，声明；断言，宣称；声明，宣布

examples.en: A state of emergency has been declared.
examples.zh: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

examples.en: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
examples.zh: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

examples.en: We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
examples.zh: 我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

words.definition: to become less or go down to a lower level, or to make something do this; reduction, loss; to cut down, fall off; shorten, weaken
words.translation: 减少，减少；减少，减小；减少量

examples.en: The number of people who have the disease has decreased significantly in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，这种病的患者人数明显下降。

examples.en: They want to decrease their reliance on oil.
examples.zh: 他们想减少对石油的依赖。

words.definition: to use the knowledge and information you have in order to understand something or form an opinion about it; understand, reason, conclude
words.translation: 演绎，推论，推断；推论，推断；[数][计]演绎出

examples.en: Alison cleverly deduced that I was the author of the letter.
examples.zh: 艾莉森聪明地推断出我是这封信的作者。

words.definition: something someone does, especially something that is very good or very bad; action, letter, certificate, act
words.translation: 行为；功绩；契约；行动；证书；[法]契据

examples.en: After the morning’s good deeds he deserved a rest.
examples.zh: 上午做了好事之后，他理应休息一下。

examples.en: She tried to strangle her baby and her lover helped her finish the evil deed .
examples.zh: 她试图掐死自己的宝宝，她的情人帮着完成了这个罪恶的勾当。

words.definition: going far in from the outside or from the front edge of something; depths, gulf; abstract, recondite; late, home
words.translation: 深的；纵深的；深处；深渊；[地质]深的；低沉的；深奥的；深入地；深深地；迟

examples.en: a deep wound
examples.zh: 很深的伤口

examples.en: She was sitting in a deep leather chair.
examples.zh: 她坐在一张很深的皮椅子里。

words.definition: a large wild animal that can run very fast, eats grass, and has horns
words.translation: 鹿

examples.en: The hunter wounded the deer.
examples.zh: 猎人打伤了鹿。

examples.en: The hound found the place where the deer lodged.
examples.zh: 猎狗找到了那头鹿躲藏过的地方。

examples.en: The lions in this area prey on deer and other wild animals.
examples.zh: 这个地方的狮子捕食鹿和其他野生动物。

words.definition: to win a victory over someone in a war, competition, game etc; down, get the best of; failure, loss, losing, reverse, collapse
words.translation: 战胜，击败；挫败；击败，战胜；使…失败；失败；战胜

examples.en: They hoped to defeat the enemy at sea.
examples.zh: 他们希望在海上击败敌人。

words.definition: a fault or a lack of something that means that something or someone is not perfect; deficiency, disadvantage, vice, fault, shortcoming; apostatize, rise up
words.translation: 缺点，缺陷，欠缺；缺点，[晶体][材]缺陷；不足之处；变节；叛变

examples.en: All the cars are tested for defects before they leave the factory.
examples.zh: 所有汽车在出厂前都经过品质检验。

examples.en: a genetic defect
examples.zh: 遗传缺陷

words.definition: something that you say or do in order to support someone or something that is being criticized; protection, reply, answer
words.translation: 防御；防务；辩护；[军]防御；防卫；答辩；防卫设备

examples.en: The land was flat, giving no scope for defence.
examples.zh: 土地非常平坦，无法做防卫之用。

words.definition: to do something in order to protect someone or something from being attacked; to claim, forefend; hold position
words.translation: 保卫，防守；[法]辩护；防护；保卫；防守

examples.en: a struggle to defend our homeland
examples.zh: 保卫我们祖国的斗争

words.definition: clearly known, seen, or stated
words.translation: 明确的；肯定的

examples.en: It’s impossible for me to give you a definite answer.
examples.zh: 我不可能给你明确的答复。

examples.en: We need to record sufficient data to enable definite conclusions to be reached.
examples.zh: 我们需要记录足够的数据，才能得出明确的结论。

examples.en: He’d shown definite signs of resigning himself to the situation.
examples.zh: 他明显表现出安于这种状况的样子。

words.definition: without any doubt; certainly, surely, specifically, particularly, plain
words.translation: 一定地，明确地；清楚地，当然；明确地，肯定地

examples.en: ‘Do you reckon Margot will be there?’ ‘ Definitely not .’
examples.zh: “你估计玛戈会在那里吗？” “肯定不会。”

examples.en: The hotel fitness centre is definitely worth a visit.
examples.zh: 这家酒店的健身中心绝对值得一去。

examples.en: I definitely need a holiday.
examples.zh: 我太需要休假了。

words.definition: a group of people who represent a company, organization etc; commitment, mission, authorization, warranty
words.translation: 代表团；授权；委托

examples.en: A trade delegation will visit Kuwait.
examples.zh: 一个贸易代表团将访问科威特。

words.definition: to remove something that has been written down or stored in a computer; expurgate, prune away
words.translation: 删除；擦掉；[计]删除

examples.en: His name was deleted from the list.
examples.zh: 他的名字从名单上删掉了。

examples.en: I deleted the file by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误删了这个文件。

words.definition: easily damaged or broken; subtle, female, refined, fine, fragile
words.translation: 纤细的；易碎的；微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；纤弱的；清淡可口的

examples.en: delicate hand-cut glass
examples.zh: 易碎的手工刻花玻璃

examples.en: The sun can easily damage a child’s delicate skin .
examples.zh: 阳光很容易晒伤小孩娇嫩的皮肤。

words.definition: very pleasant to taste or smell; palatable, delectable
words.translation: 美味的，怡人的；[食品]美味的；可口的

examples.en: ‘The meal was absolutely delicious,’ she said politely.
examples.zh: “这顿饭味道好极了。” 她礼貌地说道。

examples.en: the delicious smell of new-mown grass
examples.zh: 新修剪的草坪的芳香

words.definition: the act of bringing goods, letters etc to a particular person or place, or the things that are brought; labour, handing over
words.translation: 投递；交付；分娩；[贸易]交付；[妇产]分娩；递送

examples.en: Most Indian restaurants offer free delivery.
examples.zh: 大多数印度餐馆提供免费外送服务。

examples.en: You can expect delivery in a week to ten days.
examples.zh: 你可以在一周至十天内收到货物。

examples.en: fresh milk deliveries
examples.zh: 新鲜牛奶递送

words.definition: a system of government in which every citizen in the country can vote to elect its government officials
words.translation: 民主，民主制

examples.en: a return to democracy after 16 years of military rule
examples.zh: 16年军人统治后民主制度的恢复

words.definition: made of or containing a lot of things or people that are very close together; crass, beef-witted
words.translation: 密集的；浓厚的；[统计]稠密的；愚钝的

examples.en: a dense rurally-based population
examples.zh: 居住在乡村的密集人口

words.definition: to say that something is not true, or that you do not believe something; negative, disavow; object, refuse
words.translation: 否定；拒绝相信；否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求；否认；拒绝

examples.en: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
examples.zh: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

words.definition: to leave, especially when you are starting a journey; leave, split, vary, quit, get out
words.translation: 离开，起程；出发；离开；出发，起程；违反；去世

examples.en: Flights by Air Europe depart Gatwick on Tuesdays.
examples.zh: 欧洲航空公司的航班每逢周二从盖特威克机场起飞。

words.definition: an act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey; leaving, starting, violation, breach, quit
words.translation: 离开，出发，起程；离开；出发；违背

examples.en: There are several departures for New York every day.
examples.zh: 每天有好几个班次去纽约。

words.definition: If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally; hope, tie to
words.translation: 依靠，依赖；相信；依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖

examples.en: He depended on his writing for his income.
examples.zh: 他靠写作谋生。

words.definition: needing someone or something in order to exist, be successful, be healthy etc; under, servient
words.translation: 依靠的，依赖的；依靠的；从属的；取决于…的

examples.en: Jan’s mother was dependent on her for physical care.
examples.zh: 简的母亲要靠简来照顾。

examples.en: Do you have any dependent children (= who you are still supporting financially ) ?
examples.zh: 你有没有需要扶养的孩子？

words.definition: to put something down in a particular place; fund, saving, covers, sludge, precipitation; trust in, trust with; settle, to precipitate
words.translation: 使沉淀；存放；存款；[金融]保证金；[地质][电]沉淀物；[地质]使沉积；[电]沉淀

examples.en: The female deposits her eggs directly into the water.
examples.zh: 雌性把卵直接产在水中。

words.definition: to make someone feel very unhappy; drive down, weigh down
words.translation: 使沮丧；按下；压低；使萧条

examples.en: The thought of taking the exam again depressed him.
examples.zh: 想到要补考，他就心情沮丧。

examples.en: It depresses me that nobody seems to care.
examples.zh: 似乎没有人在乎，这让我感到很沮丧。

words.definition: the part that is furthest away from people, and most difficult to reach; profoundity, deepness
words.translation: 深度；深厚；深处；[海洋]深度；深奥

examples.en: Astronomers may one day travel to the depths of space.
examples.zh: 天文学家也许有一天可以到太空深处去。

words.definition: to move from a higher level to a lower one; decline, go down
words.translation: 下来，下降；下倾；下降；下去；下来；遗传；屈尊

examples.en: Our plane started to descend.
examples.zh: 我们的飞机开始下降。

examples.en: I heard his footsteps descending the stairs.
examples.zh: 我听到他下楼的脚步声。

words.definition: to say what something or someone is like by giving details about them; represent, trace, figure, depict
words.translation: 形容；描写，描绘；描述，形容；描绘

examples.en: The police asked her to describe the man.
examples.zh: 警察叫她描述一下那名男子。

examples.en: Another approach to the problem is described in Chapter 3.
examples.zh: 这个问题的另一种解决方法在第三章有所阐述。

words.definition: a piece of writing or speech that gives details about what someone or something is like; presentation, type, style, characterization
words.translation: 描写，形容；种类；描述，描写；类型；说明书

examples.en: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
examples.zh: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

examples.en: Berlin sounds fascinating from your description.
examples.zh: 从你的描述来看，柏林是个迷人的城市。

words.definition: to make a drawing or plan of something that will be made or built; the art or process of making a drawing of something to show how you will make it or what it will look like; project, engineer, style, schedule, frame; programming, device, pattern; project, engineer
words.translation: 设计；图样；计划；构思；图案

examples.en: The tower was designed by Gilbert Scott.
examples.zh: 这座塔楼是吉尔伯特·斯科特设计的。

words.definition: something that is desirable is worth having or doing; satisfying, fulfilling
words.translation: 值得相望的；可取的；令人满意的；值得要的

examples.en: The ability to speak a foreign language is highly desirable .
examples.zh: 能说一门外语是非常理想的。

examples.en: a desirable neighborhood
examples.zh: 理想的社区

examples.en: It is desirable that you should have some familiarity with computers.
examples.zh: 应该对电脑有所熟悉，这是很有益处的。

words.translation: 书桌，办公桌

words.definition: a feeling that you have no hope at all; to feel that there is no hope at all; hopelessness, acedia; throw up one's hands, lose heart
words.translation: 绝望；令人绝望的人或事；绝望，丧失信心

examples.en: The noise from the neighbours used to drive him to despair .
examples.zh: 过去，邻居的噪音常常吵得他心烦意乱。

words.definition: willing to do anything to change a very bad situation, and not caring about danger; venturous, devil-may-care
words.translation: 拼死的；绝望的；不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的

examples.en: I had no money left and was desperate.
examples.zh: 我身无分文，已经走投无路了。

examples.en: Time was running out and we were getting desperate .
examples.zh: 时间越来越少，我们越来越感到绝望。

examples.en: the missing teenager’s desperate parents
examples.zh: 失踪少年绝望的父母

words.definition: to dislike and have a low opinion of someone or something; slight, set light by
words.translation: 鄙视，蔑视；轻视，鄙视

examples.en: She despised her neighbours.
examples.zh: 她看不起她的邻居。

words.definition: the place that someone or something is going to; goal, end-point
words.translation: 目的地，终点；目标；[计]目的地，终点

examples.en: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
examples.zh: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

words.definition: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used or repaired; undermine, founder
words.translation: 破坏；消灭；打破；毁坏

examples.en: companies that are polluting and destroying the environment
examples.zh: 污染和破坏环境的公司

words.definition: to grow or change into something bigger, stronger, or more advanced, or to make someone or something do this; exploit, open up; grow, flower
words.translation: 发展；形成；开发；进步；使成长；使显影；发育；生长；进化；显露

examples.en: Knowledge in the field of genetics has been developing very rapidly.
examples.zh: 遗传学领域的知识发展非常迅速。

examples.en: Corsica has developed its economy around the tourist industry.
examples.zh: 科西嘉岛的经济是围绕旅游业发展起来的。

examples.en: exercises to develop muscle strength
examples.zh: 锻炼肌肉力量的运动

words.definition: the process of gradually becoming bigger, better, stronger, or more advanced; exploitation, growth, making, advance, progress
words.translation: 发展；开发；生长；[生物]发育；[建]住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）；[摄]显影

examples.en: child development
examples.zh: 儿童发育

words.definition: the most powerful evil spiritin some religions, especially in Christianity; apple, customer, egg, fellow, guy; harry, worry, trouble, tear, torture
words.translation: 魔鬼，恶魔；魔鬼；撒旦；家伙；恶棍；折磨

examples.en: The villagers believed a devil had taken control of his body.
examples.zh: 村民们认为他被邪魔附身了。

words.definition: to plan or invent a new way of doing something; design, engineer, style, project, frame; legacy, bequest
words.translation: 设计，发明；设计；想出；发明；图谋；遗赠给；遗赠

examples.en: She devised a method for quicker communications between offices.
examples.zh: 她想出一种加快办公室之间通信联络的方法。

words.definition: the small drops of water that form on outdoor surfaces during the night; drop, gutta; get wet, moisten
words.translation: 露，露水；珠，滴；露水；清新；（露水等）弄湿

examples.en: The dew gathered on the leaves.
examples.zh: 露水在叶片上聚集。

words.definition: a simple drawing or plan that shows exactly where something is, what something looks like, or how something works; chart, graph
words.translation: 图解，图表，简图；图表；[数]图解

words.definition: the round part of a clock, watch, machine etc that has numbers that show you the time or a measurement; to press the buttons or turn the dial on a telephone in order to make a telephone call; rotating disc, turntable
words.translation: 钟面；拨号盘；拨；转盘；[仪]刻度盘

examples.en: The lighted dial of her watch said 1.20.
examples.zh: 她手表上的夜光表面显示时间为1点20分。

examples.en: She looked at the dial to check her speed.
examples.zh: 她看了看仪表盘，以确认自己的速度。

words.definition: a form of a language which is spoken only in one area, with words or grammar that are slightly different from other forms of the same language; patois, provincialism
words.translation: 方言，土语，地方话；方言，土话；同源语；行话；个人用语特征

examples.en: the local dialect
examples.zh: 当地方言

words.definition: conversation, sesion
words.translation: 对话，对白；对话；会话

examples.en: In this dialog, you can only open an artifact in the editor.
examples.zh: 在这个对话框中，您只可以在编辑器中打开一个工件。

examples.en: For other pages/dialogs, it should go back one page or close the dialog.
examples.zh: 至于其他页面/对话框，它应该回退一个页面或者关闭对话框。

words.definition: a straight line from one side of a circle to the other side, passing through the centre of the circle, or the length of this line
words.translation: 直径

examples.en: ...a tube less than a fifth of the diameter of a human hair.
examples.zh: …一根直径不到头发五分之一的微管。

words.definition: a clear, very hard valuable stone, used in jewellery and in industry; sparkler, adamas; rhombic
words.translation: 金钢石，钻石；菱形；[宝]钻石，[矿物]金刚石；[数]菱形；方块牌；[数]菱形的；金刚钻的

examples.en: a diamond engagement ring
examples.zh: 订婚钻戒

words.definition: a book in which you write down the things that happen to you each day; journal, day book
words.translation: 日记，日记簿；日志，日记；日记簿

examples.en: Inge kept a diary (= wrote in a diary ) during the war years.
examples.zh: 英奇在战争年代里一直写日记。

words.definition: when you say words for someone to write down; instruction, bidding, order, word, charge
words.translation: 口授笔录，听写；听写；口述；命令

examples.en: There were no secretaries available to take dictation (= write down what someone is saying ) .
examples.zh: 身边没有秘书记录口授内容。

words.definition: a book that gives a list of words in alphabetical order and explains their meanings in the same language, or another language; lexicon, wordbook
words.translation: 词典，字典；字典；[语][计]词典

examples.en: a German-English dictionary
examples.zh: 一本德英词典

words.definition: to stop living and become dead; go out, angel of death; join the majority, end one's days; former block, cutting block
words.translation: 死，死亡；灭亡；死亡；凋零；熄灭；死，死于…；[机]冲模，钢模；骰子

examples.en: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
examples.zh: 他1985年去世，终年76岁。

examples.en: Her father died suddenly in an accident when she was only ten.
examples.zh: 她年仅10岁时父亲突然死于一场意外事故。

examples.en: She died peacefully in her sleep at the age of 98.
examples.zh: 她在睡眠中安然辞世，享年98岁。

words.definition: to be different from something in some way; divide
words.translation: 不同，相异；相异；意见分歧

examples.en: The two systems differ in many respects.
