words.translation: 剂量，用量；一剂；[药][核]剂量；一剂，一服；服药；给药；给…服药

examples.en: I quite like Jamie in small doses (= in limited amounts but not a lot or often ) .
examples.zh: 如果偶尔在一起的话，我还是蛮喜欢杰米的。

words.definition: a small round mark or spot; dowry, tocher
words.translation: 点，圆点；打点于；[数]点，圆点；嫁妆

examples.en: a pattern of dots
examples.zh: 圆点图案

words.definition: consisting of two parts that are similar or exactly the same; dual, two-fold; redouble; duplicate; twifold, twofold
words.translation: 两倍的；双的；双重的；加倍，加倍努力；快步走；使加倍；双重地；两倍地；弓身地

examples.en: a double sink
examples.zh: 双水槽

examples.en: a double wardrobe
examples.zh: 双门衣柜

examples.en: the great double doors of the cathedral
examples.zh: 大教堂宏伟的双开大门

words.definition: a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right; to think that something may not be true or that it is unlikely; challenge, question, query, suspicion; suspect of, be suspicious of
words.translation: 怀疑；疑虑；[法]怀疑；疑问；疑惑；不信；恐怕；拿不准

examples.en: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
examples.zh: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

words.definition: not sure that something is true or right; suspicious, questionable
words.translation: 难以预测的；怀疑的；可疑的；令人生疑的；疑心的；不能确定的

examples.en: ‘Everything’s going to be all right, you’ll see.’ Jenny looked doubtful .
examples.zh: “一切都会顺顺当当的，你等着看好了。” 珍妮看起来不大相信的样子。

words.definition: used when saying that something is almost certain to happen or be true; easily, no doubt, probably, clearly, possibly; established, fixed, defined, certain, positive
words.translation: 无疑地；很可能；确定地；大概，多半；无疑的；确定的

examples.en: Doubtless there would be lots of rumours.
examples.zh: 无疑会谣言四起。

words.definition: to or towards a lower place or position; below, under; descensive; pubescence, fur; along with; defeat, floor, fell; decline, descend
words.translation: 向下，在下面；向下，下去；在下面；向下的；软毛，[植]绒毛；[地质]开阔的高地；沿着，往下；打倒，击败；下降；下去

examples.en: David bent down to tie his shoelace.
examples.zh: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。

examples.en: Get down off the table.
examples.zh: 从桌子上下来。

examples.en: Tears were streaming down my face.
examples.zh: 我泪流满面。

words.definition: towards or on a lower floor of a building, especially a house; Downstairs means situated on the ground floor of a building or on a lower floor than you are; belowstairs
words.translation: 在楼下；楼下的

examples.en: Rosie ran downstairs to answer the door.
examples.zh: 罗茜跑下楼去开门。

examples.en: Charles was downstairs in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 查尔斯在楼下厨房里。

examples.en: She repainted the downstairs rooms and closed off the second floor.
examples.zh: 她重新粉刷了楼下的房间，并把二楼封上了。

words.definition: moving or pointing towards a lower position; If you move or look downward, you move or look toward the ground or a lower level; falling, descensive; alow, netherward
words.translation: 向下的；向下地；[数]向下的，下降的；[数]向下

examples.en: a gentle downward slope
examples.zh: 缓坡

examples.en: Benedict pointed downward again with his stick.
examples.zh: 贝内迪克特又用他的拐杖向下指了指。

words.definition: twelve
words.translation: 一打，十二个；[计量]十二个，一打

examples.en: a dozen eggs
examples.zh: 一打鸡蛋

examples.en: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
examples.zh: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

examples.en: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

words.definition: a piece of writing or a plan that is not yet in its finished form; to write a plan, letter, report etc that will need to be changed before it is in its finished form
words.translation: 草稿；汇票；起草

examples.en: the rough draft of his new novel
examples.zh: 他的新小说的草稿

examples.en: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
examples.zh: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

examples.en: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
examples.zh: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

words.definition: to pull something along the ground, often because it is too heavy to carry; cumber with, ball and chain; daggle; pull, tow
words.translation: 拖，拉；拖曳；拖累；拖拉；缓慢而吃力地行进；拖

examples.en: He grabbed her arm and dragged her into the room.
examples.zh: 他抓住她的手臂把她拖进房间。

words.definition: a large imaginary animal that has wings and a long tail and can breathe out fire; tiger, wyrm
words.translation: 龙；凶暴的人；凶暴的人，凶恶的人；严厉而有警觉性的女人

words.definition: something that continuously uses a lot of time, money etc; discharge of water; exhaust, use out; consumption, sewage
words.translation: 排去；放水；耗竭；排水；流干；喝光，耗尽；使流出；排掉水；下水道，[建]排水管；消耗

examples.en: He flushed the drain.
examples.zh: 他用水冲排水沟。

examples.en: The boat drifted helplessly along the drain until some people saw him.
examples.zh: 船儿无助地顺着排水沟漂流直到有人看见他。

words.definition: a play for the theatre, television, radio etc, usually a serious one, or plays in general
words.translation: 一出戏剧，剧本

examples.en: the great traditions of ancient Greek drama
examples.zh: 古希腊戏剧的伟大传统

examples.en: a new drama series for Saturday nights
examples.zh: 周六晚上播放的新连续剧

examples.en: a drama critic
examples.zh: 戏剧评论员

words.definition: connected with acting or plays; attractive, scenic
words.translation: 引人注目的，戏剧的；戏剧的；引人注目的；激动人心的

examples.en: the amateur dramatic society
examples.zh: 业余剧团

examples.en: the dramatic arts
examples.zh: 戏剧艺术

words.definition: to produce a picture of something using a pencil, pen etc; picture, absorb, pull, attract, engage; pull; lot, tie
words.translation: 画，划；拖；拨出；画；拉；吸引；平局；抽签

examples.en: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
examples.zh: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

examples.en: She asked the little girl to draw a picture of the man she’d spoken to.
examples.zh: 她让小女孩把刚才和她说话的那个男人画出来。

examples.en: Keith was drawing a complicated-looking graph.
examples.zh: 基思在画一张看上去很复杂的图表。

words.definition: part of a piece of furniture, such as a desk, that you pull out and push in and use to keep things in
words.translation: 抽屉

examples.en: She took a file from her desk drawer .
examples.zh: 她从书桌的抽屉里拿出了一个文件夹。

examples.en: The scissors are in the kitchen drawer (= drawer in a piece of kitchen furniture ) .
examples.zh: 剪刀在厨房的抽屉里。

words.definition: a picture that you draw with a pencil, pen etc; picture, traction; painting, gaining
words.translation: 图画，素描；绘图；图画；牵引；素描术；绘画；吸引（draw的ing形式）；拖曳

examples.en: I’ve never been very good at drawing.
examples.zh: 我向来不擅长画图。

words.definition: a strong fear of something that is going to happen or may happen; to feel anxious or worried about something that is going to happen or may happen; fear, terror; worry, concern about/for/over; terrible, horrible, awesome, fearful, dire
words.translation: 畏惧；恐怖；惧怕；恐惧；可怕的人（或物）；担心；可怕的

examples.en: The prospect of flying filled me with dread .
examples.zh: 想到要乘飞机我充满了恐惧。

examples.en: She lives in dread of (= is continuously very afraid of ) the disease returning.
examples.zh: 她整天担心着会旧病复发。

words.definition: a series of thoughts, images, and feelings that you experience when you are asleep; to think about something that you would like to happen or have; come to mind, bethink of; voice, aspirations; ideal, unreasonable
words.translation: 梦；梦想；做梦；做梦，梦见；想到；梦想，愿望；[心理]梦；梦的；理想的；不切实际的

examples.en: I had lots of dreams last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我做了很多梦。

words.definition: clothes for men or women of a particular type or for a particular occasion; apparel, clothe; frock, suit-dress
words.translation: 女服，童装；服装；给…穿衣；[服装]连衣裙；女装

examples.en: a gentleman in evening dress
examples.zh: 穿晚礼服的绅士

examples.en: The play was performed in modern dress (= clothes from the present time ) .
examples.zh: 这出戏里演员是现代装束。

words.definition: to move slowly on water or in the air; a slow movement of large numbers of people that has not been planned; tendency, direction, tide, trend, set; extravagate, knock about
words.translation: 漂流，漂泊；漂流；漂流，[电子]漂移；趋势；漂流物；漂泊

examples.en: Smoke drifted up from the jungle ahead of us.
examples.zh: 我们前方的丛林里有烟升起。

words.definition: military training in which soldiers practise marching, using weapons etc; to make a hole in something using a drill; training, discipline; bore a hole, counter sunk; discipline, coach
words.translation: 钻头；操练；钻孔；训练；[矿业]钻孔机；钻子；[农机]播种机；[农机]条播

examples.en: rifle drill
examples.zh: 步枪操练

words.definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it; an amount of liquid that you drink, or the act of drinking something; eat, absorb; wine, liquor; wine, liquor, beverage
words.translation: 饮；喝；饮料；喝，饮；吸收；举杯庆贺；喝酒；饮水；干杯；酒，饮料

examples.en: You should drink plenty of water.
examples.zh: 你应该大量喝水。

examples.en: What would you like to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝点什么？

examples.en: Take a seat while I get you something to drink .
examples.zh: 请坐，我去给你倒杯喝的。

words.definition: to let liquid fall in drops; one of the drops of liquid that fall from something; abound with, be imbued with; waterdrop; flood, emit
words.translation: 滴下；漏水；水滴；充满；漏下；水滴，[建]滴水声；静脉滴注；使人厌烦的人；使滴下；溢出，发出

examples.en: The tap’s dripping .
examples.zh: 水龙头在滴水。

examples.en: Her boots were muddy and her hair was dripping .
examples.zh: 她的靴子沾满了泥，头发在滴水。

words.definition: to force a person or animal to go somewhere; belt, jab at; launch, force, impulse; driving mechanism, propulsion
words.translation: 驾驶；打入；驱；开车；猛击；飞跑；推动，发动（机器等）；[交]驾驶（马车，汽车等）；驱赶；[机]驱动器；驾车；[动][心理]内驱力，推进力；快车道

examples.en: Torrential rain drove the players off the course.
examples.zh: 滂沱大雨迫使选手们离开了赛场。

examples.en: With a few loud whistles, they drove the donkeys out of the enclosure.
examples.zh: 随着几声响亮的哨声，他们把驴子赶出了围栏。

words.definition: someone who drives a car, bus etc; navigator
words.translation: 驾驶员，司机；[车辆]驾驶员；驱动程序；起子；[机]传动器

examples.en: a taxi driver
examples.zh: 出租车司机

examples.en: Do you think you’re a good driver?
examples.zh: 你认为自己是个好司机吗？

words.definition: to fall suddenly onto the ground or into something; kill, closure; decline, determine, finish, pass, go down; suggestion, falling, trace
words.translation: 使落下；降低；滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出；下降；终止；落下；空投；微量；滴剂

examples.en: Your button has dropped off.
examples.zh: 你的纽扣掉了。

words.definition: a long period of dry weather when there is not enough water for plants and animals to live; shortage, deficiency, need, short of, want
words.translation: 旱灾，干旱；[气候]干旱；缺乏

examples.en: ...a country where drought and famines have killed up to two million people during the last eighteen years.
examples.zh: …过去18年来干旱和饥荒致死达两百万人的一个国家。

words.definition: to die from being under water for too long, or to kill someone in this way; flood, flow
words.translation: 淹死，溺死；淹没；把…淹死

examples.en: Many people drowned when the boat overturned.
examples.zh: 船翻后许多人淹死了。

examples.en: Jane was drowned in the river.
examples.zh: 简在那条河里溺水身亡。

words.definition: a medicine, or a substance for making medicines; medicine, pharmacon; hit the pipe, hop up
words.translation: 药，药物，药材；[药]药；毒品；麻醉药；滞销货；吸毒

examples.en: a drug used in the treatment of cancer
examples.zh: 用于治疗癌症的一种药物

examples.en: (= ordered for people ) by doctors can be extremely hazardous if used in the wrong way.
examples.zh: 医生开的处方药如果使用不当是非常危险的。

examples.en: The big drug companies make huge profits.
examples.zh: 大型制药公司利润丰厚。

words.definition: a musical instrument made of skin stretched over a circular frame, played by hitting it with your hand or a stick; kettle
words.translation: 鼓；鼓状物，圆桶；鼓声

examples.en: a big bass drum
examples.zh: 一面低音大鼓

examples.en: 1,000 people marched, beating drums and carrying flags.
examples.zh: 1,000人打着鼓扛着旗游行。

examples.en: Jones played the drums in an all-girl band.
examples.zh: 琼斯在一个女子乐队里打鼓。

words.definition: unable to control your behaviour, speech etc because you have drunk too much alcohol; loaded, buffy
words.translation: 醉的；陶醉的；喝醉了的

examples.en: You’re drunk.
examples.zh: 你喝醉了。

examples.en: David would get drunk and I would have to take him home and put him to bed.
examples.zh: 戴维常会喝醉，我就得把他弄回家放到床上。

words.definition: without water or liquid inside or on the surface; exsuccous, thirsty; desiccate, exsiccate; dryout
words.translation: 干的，干燥的；[木]干的；口渴的；枯燥无味的；禁酒的；变干；干涸

examples.en: I need to change into some dry clothes .
examples.zh: 我要换上干衣服。

examples.en: Make sure that the surface is clean and dry before you start to paint.
examples.zh: 油漆之前一定先要确保表面清洁干燥。

examples.en: You should store disks in a cool, dry place.
examples.zh: 你应该把磁盘存放在阴凉干燥的地方。

words.definition: a very common water bird with short legs and a wide beak, used for its meat, eggs, and soft feathers; quacker, deary; jank, to dodge; avoid, stay away from
words.translation: 鸭，雌鸭；鸭肉；鸭子；（英）宝贝儿；零分；闪避；没入水中；躲避；猛按…入水

examples.en: roast duck with orange sauce
examples.zh: 烤鸭配橘子酱

words.definition: not interesting or exciting; slow, blunt; relax, benumb; to cut down, fall off
words.translation: 枯燥的；不鲜明的；钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的；使迟钝；使阴暗；缓和；减少；变迟钝

examples.en: Life is never dull when Elizabeth is here.
examples.zh: 有伊丽莎白在这里生活绝不会无聊。

examples.en: a dull movie
examples.zh: 一部沉闷的电影

examples.en: It sounded pretty dull to me.
examples.zh: 在我听来，这很无聊。

words.definition: someone who is dumb is not able to speak at all. Many people think that this use is offensive; tongueless, speechless
words.translation: 哑的；无言的；哑的，无说话能力的；不说话的，无声音的

examples.en: ...a young deaf and dumb man.
examples.zh: …一名年轻的聋哑人。

words.definition: the length of time that something continues; standing, persistence, abidance, continuance
words.translation: 持续，持久；持续

examples.en: The course is of three years’ duration.
examples.zh: 该课程为期三年。

words.definition: from the beginning to the end of a period of time; in time of
words.translation: 在…期间；在…的时候，在…的期间

examples.en: During the summer she worked as a lifeguard.
examples.zh: 夏天她当过救生员。

examples.en: He slept calmly during the early part of the night.
examples.zh: 他上半夜睡得很安稳。

examples.en: Foxes remain hidden during the day.
examples.zh: 狐狸白天一直躲藏着。

words.definition: the time before it gets dark when the sky is becoming less bright; dark, owl-light; darksome
words.translation: 薄暮，黄昏，幽暗；黄昏，[气象]薄暮；幽暗，昏暗；微暗的

examples.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
examples.zh: 街灯在黄昏时亮起来。

words.definition: something that you have to do because it is morally or legally right; liability, burden, trust, blame
words.translation: 职责；责任；税；[税收]关税；[管理]职务

examples.en: I promise I will do my duty .
examples.zh: 我保证会尽到我的责任。

examples.en: We feel it is our duty to help her.
examples.zh: 我们感到帮助她是我们的责任。

examples.en: Local authorities have a duty to keep the streets clean.
examples.zh: 地方当局有责任保持街道整洁。

words.definition: a house, apartment etc where people live; residence, accommodation; living
words.translation: 住处，寓所；住处；寓所；居住（dwell的现在分词）

examples.en: Some 3,500 new dwellings are planned for the area.
examples.zh: 大约三千五百套新住宅计划在这个地区新建。

words.definition: to give something a different colour using a dye; a substance you use to change the colour of your clothes, hair etc; dyeing, dyestuff; tint
words.translation: 染；染料；染色；[染料]染料；把…染上颜色

examples.en: The women prepared, spun, and dyed the wool.
examples.zh: 妇女们将羊毛预备、纺线并染色。

words.definition: happening just before someone dies; fey; death, deadness; perishing
words.translation: 垂死的；临终的；临终的，垂死的；死，死亡；枯萎；失去活力（die的ing形式）

examples.en: It was her dying wish to have a simple burial.
examples.zh: 她的临终遗愿是办个简朴的葬礼。

words.definition: full of energy and new ideas, and determined to succeed; vital, actional; trends, momentum, impetus
words.translation: 有活力的；动力的；[力]动态的；动力学的；动态；[力]动力

examples.en: dynamic and ambitious people
examples.zh: 精力充沛且雄心勃勃的人

words.definition: respective, several; apiece
words.translation: 各，各自；各；每；各自的；每个；各自

examples.en: They reviewed each aspect of the plan bit by bit.
examples.zh: 他们对计划的各个方面逐一地进行了审核。

words.definition: very keen and excited about something that is going to happen or about something you want to do; hungry, desired, anxious, sick, keen
words.translation: 渴望的，热切的；渴望的；热切的；热心的

examples.en: He’s a bright kid and eager to learn.
examples.zh: 他是个聪明的孩子，热爱学习。

examples.en: She’s a very hard worker and very eager to please.
examples.zh: 她工作很卖力，而且很希望别人满意。

examples.en: A crowd of eager young students were already waiting outside.
examples.zh: 一群急不可待的青年学生已经在外面等着。

words.definition: a very large strong bird with a beak like a hook that eats small animals, birds etc; hawk
words.translation: 鹰；鹰状标饰

examples.en: The eagle drooped its wings.
examples.zh: 那只鹰收拢双翅做俯冲。

examples.en: Maybe they could not hold on to the arrival of the spring, but the female eagle thought what if their father could bring back the food?
examples.zh: 它们或许已经挨不到春天的到来了。 雌鹰这样想，但如果它们的爸爸会把食物带来呢？

examples.en: She lacks the skill to accomplish this, but recognizes that an eagle can help her.
examples.zh: 她缺乏完成这项任务的能力，不过她认识到老鹰可以帮助她。

words.definition: one of the organs on either side of your head that you hear with; listen, auditory sensation; hear
words.translation: 耳朵；听力，听觉；穗；听觉；倾听；（美俚）听见；抽穗

examples.en: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
examples.zh: 她把头发拢到耳朵背后。

words.definition: before the usual, arranged, or expected time; in the first part of a period of time, event, or process; precocious, inchoate; before one's time
words.translation: 早；早的，早期的；早期的；早熟的；提早；在初期

examples.en: We arrived early.
examples.zh: 我们提早到了。

examples.en: They must have come home early.
examples.zh: 他们肯定提早回到家了。

words.definition: to receive a particular amount of money for the work that you do; acquire, buy, find, make, score
words.translation: 赚得，挣得；获得；赚，赚得；获得，挣得；使得到；博得

examples.en: He earns nearly £20,000 a year.
examples.zh: 他每年挣近20,000英镑。

examples.en: You don’t earn much money being a nurse.
examples.zh: 当护士挣钱并不多。

examples.en: He did all sorts of jobs to earn a living.
examples.zh: 他为谋生什么活都干。

examples.en: Please enclose a cheque with your order.
examples.zh: 请随订单附上支票。

words.definition: to experience something, especially problems or opposition; an occasion when you meet someone, or do something with someone you do not know; confront, bring up against; fell in with, lit on; bring up against, run into
words.translation: 遭遇，遇到；遭遇；遭遇，邂逅；遇到；遭遇，偶然碰见；偶然相遇

examples.en: The doctor had encountered several similar cases in the past.
examples.zh: 那位医生过去曾碰到过好几个类似病例。

words.definition: the part of a place or object that is furthest from its beginning or centre; to finish what you are doing; completion, death, target, goal, object; drop, determine, pass; conclude, bring to a close
words.translation: 末端；目标；结束；尽头；死亡；结束，终止；终结

examples.en: He wore spectacles perched on the very end of his nose.
examples.zh: 他的眼镜架在鼻尖上。

examples.en: The end of the pencil snapped.
examples.zh: 铅笔的笔尖啪的一声断了。

examples.en: Jo joined the end of the line.
examples.zh: 乔排到了队尾。

words.definition: the way that a story, film, activity etc finishes; conclusion, outcome
words.translation: 结尾，结局；死亡；结局；结尾

examples.en: Verbal nouns have the ending -ing.
examples.zh: 动名词以-ing结尾。

words.definition: very large in amount, size, or number; continuing, straight, running, serial, successive
words.translation: 无止境的；连续的；环状的；漫无目的的

examples.en: an endless stream of visitors
examples.zh: 川流不息的游客

examples.en: The possibilities are endless.
examples.zh: 有无限的可能性。

examples.en: He’s been in a lot of trouble – drugs, guns, blackmail – the list is endless.
examples.zh: 他麻烦太多了——毒品、枪支、敲诈——说都说不完。

words.definition: someone who hates you and wants to harm you; foe, hostes; hostile
words.translation: 敌人；仇敌；敌兵；敌人，仇敌；敌军；敌人的，敌方的

examples.en: She’s a dangerous enemy to have.
examples.zh: 与她为敌很危险。

examples.en: Cats and dogs have always been natural enemies.
examples.zh: 猫和狗向来是天敌。

examples.en: an old enemy of her father
examples.zh: 她父亲的一个宿敌

words.definition: power that is used to provide heat, operate machines etc; vitality, spirit, soul, mind, spring
words.translation: 活力；精力；能；[物]能量；[劳经]活力；精神

examples.en: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
examples.zh: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

examples.en: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
examples.zh: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

words.definition: to make people obey a rule or law; perform, actualize
words.translation: 实施，执行；强制；强迫，强制

examples.en: Parking restrictions will be strictly enforced.
examples.zh: 停车限制将会严格执行。

words.definition: someone whose job is to design or build roads, bridges, machines etc; gineer, sapper; design, style, project, frame, scheme; project, design
words.translation: 工程师，技师；[经管]工程师；工兵；火车司机；设计；策划；精明地处理；建造

examples.en: He trained as a civil engineer (= one who designs and builds roads, bridges etc ).
examples.zh: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

words.definition: the work involved in designing and building roads, bridges, machines etc; project; managing, planning, controlling, guiding
words.translation: 工程，工程学；设计；管理（engineer的ing形式）；建造

examples.en: Their inventions have contributed to the development of electrical engineering.
examples.zh: 他们的发明有助于电气工程学的发展。

words.translation: 英格兰；英国

words.definition: the language used in Britain, the US, Australia, and some other countries; relating to England or its people; Royal, British; Anglo, British person
words.translation: 英语；英国人的；英文的；英国的；英文；英国人；英格兰人

examples.en: Do you speak English?
examples.zh: 你会说英语吗？

examples.en: leaflets written in plain English
examples.zh: 用简单英语写的传单

words.definition: a man from England
words.translation: 英国男子

examples.en: He was the only Englishman present.
examples.zh: 他是在场的唯一一名英国人。

examples.en: Report writing, like motor car driving and lovemaking, is one of those activities that every Englishman thinks he can do well without instruction.
examples.zh: 写报告，像开车和做爱一样，是每个英国人都以为自己毋需指导就能做好的事。

examples.en: I wish I could be acquainted with the feelings and thoughts which must agitate the heart and present themselves to the mind of an enlightened Englishman, when he first lands on this continent.
examples.zh: 赫克托．圣约翰．克雷夫科尔 但愿我能熟悉那种必将鼓动人心的感情和思想，并且在一个开明的英国人首次踏上这片大陆时，将这种思想和感情原原本本地展现在他眼前。

words.definition: to get pleasure from something; to appreciate, feast
words.translation: 享受；欣赏，喜爱；欣赏，享受；喜爱；使过得快活

examples.en: Sandra enjoys her job in the city.
examples.zh: 桑德拉很喜欢她在城里的这份工作。

examples.en: I enjoyed every minute of it.
examples.zh: 我每一分钟都很享受。

words.definition: if you enlarge something, or if it enlarges, it increases in size or scale; extend, broaden; extend, grow
words.translation: 扩大，扩展；放大；扩大；详述；使增大；扩展

examples.en: an operation to enlarge her breasts
examples.zh: 她的丰胸手术

examples.en: Police will have the pictures enlarged in an attempt to identify the thief.
examples.zh: 为了确认窃贼的身份，警方会将这些照片放大。

words.definition: Enough is also an adjective; to the degree that is necessary or wanted; adequately, sufficiently; amplitude, ton, plenty of; adequate, plenitudinous
words.translation: 足够的；足够地；足够地，充足地；很多；充足；充足的

examples.en: Her disappearance and death would give proof enough of Charles' guilt.
examples.zh: 她的失踪和死亡将提供足够的证据证明查尔斯有罪。

words.definition: to start to take part in an activity, or become involved in a situation; institute, come into, participate in, go into, get into; participate in, take part in, go through; import, inputting
words.translation: 走进，进入；参加；进入；开始；参加，登场；进去；[计]输入；回车

examples.en: He entered the election as the clear favourite.
examples.zh: 他参加竞选时显然最有希望获胜。

examples.en: The rebels were prepared to enter negotiations (= start discussing something ).
examples.zh: 叛乱分子愿意参加谈判。

words.definition: to invite people to your home for a meal, party etc, or to take your company’s customers somewhere to have a meal, drinks etc; serve, invite, attend, contain, accept; welcome in
words.translation: 使欢乐；招待；娱乐；怀抱；容纳；款待

examples.en: Mark usually does the cooking when we entertain.
examples.zh: 我们招待客人时通常都是马克下厨。

examples.en: Do you get an allowance for entertaining clients?
examples.zh: 你招待客户有补助吗？

words.definition: a strong feeling of interest and enjoyment about something and an eagerness to be involved in it; passion, flame, fire, warmth
words.translation: 热情，热心，热忱；热心，热忱，热情

examples.en: Gillian and Darren greeted the speakers with great enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 吉利恩和达伦非常热情地接待了演讲者。

examples.en: We went along to the local diving club, full of enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 我们兴高采烈地去了当地的潜水俱乐部。

examples.en: They go about their tasks with little enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 他们执行任务时没多大干劲。

words.definition: feeling or showing a lot of interest and excitement about something; intense, warm, crazy, eager, tropical
words.translation: 热情的，热心的；热情的；热心的；狂热的

examples.en: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
examples.zh: 改革的热心支持者

words.definition: used when you want to emphasize that you mean all of a group, period of time, amount etc; overall, all, total, corporate, universal
words.translation: 全部的，整个的；[生物]全部的，整个的；全体的

examples.en: It was the worst day in my entire life.
examples.zh: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

examples.en: The entire staff agreed.
examples.zh: 全体员工都同意了。

examples.en: Have you drunk the entire bottle?
examples.zh: 你把整瓶酒都喝了吗？

words.definition: a door, gate etc that you go through to enter a place; threshold, access, portal, way in
words.translation: 入口，门口；进入；[建]入口

examples.en: the station entrance
examples.zh: 车站的入口处

words.definition: the act of going into something; threshold, registration, access, portal
words.translation: 入口处；登记；进入；入口；条目；报关手续；对土地的侵占

examples.en: There was no sign of a forced entry.
examples.zh: 没有强行闯入的迹象。

examples.en: How did the thieves gain entry (= get in )?
examples.zh: 窃贼是怎样进入的？

words.definition: a thin paper cover in which you put and send a letter; cover, involucrum
words.translation: 信封；封套；封皮；信封，封皮；包膜；[天]包层；包迹

examples.en: envelopes and stamps
examples.zh: 信封和邮票

examples.en: She tore open the envelope and frantically read the letter.
examples.zh: 她撕开信封慌忙看信。

examples.en: He got a job stuffing envelopes (= filling them with letters ) at the campaign headquarters.
examples.zh: 他找了一份在竞选总部装信封的工作。

words.definition: the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities; context, circumstance, setting, surrounding, condition
words.translation: 环境，外界；围绕；[环境]环境，外界

examples.en: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
examples.zh: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

examples.en: legislation to protect the environment
examples.zh: 保护环境的法规

examples.en: the effects of acid rain on the environment
examples.zh: 酸雨对环境的影响

words.definition: to wish that you had someone else’s possessions, abilities etc; jealousy, green-eyed monster; green eyed, be jealous
words.translation: 妒忌；羡慕；嫉妒，妒忌

examples.en: I really envy you and Ian, you seem so happy together.
examples.zh: 我真是羡慕你和伊恩，你俩在一起看起来多幸福。

examples.en: She has a lifestyle which most people would envy.
examples.zh: 她的生活方式会令大多数人感到羡慕。

words.definition: a statement in mathematics that shows that two amounts or totals are equal; eqs, equivalence
words.translation: 方程(式)；等式；[数]方程式，等式；相等；[化学]反应式

examples.en: In the equation 2x + 1 = 7, what is x?
examples.zh: 在方程式2x+1=7中，x的值为多少？

words.definition: to provide a person or place with the things that are needed for a particular kind of activity or work; prepare, provide
words.translation: 装备，配备

examples.en: They try to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency.
examples.zh: 他们尽量给他们的车辆配备各种小装置以应付任何可能的突发状况。

words.definition: the tools, machines etc that you need to do a particular job or activity; furniture, facility, plant, arm, fixture
words.translation: 装备，设备，配备；[机]设备，装备；器材

examples.en: a shop selling camping equipment
examples.zh: 出售露营装备的商店

examples.en: some brand new computer equipment
examples.zh: 一些全新的计算机设备

examples.en: a very useful piece of equipment
examples.zh: 一件非常有用的设备

words.definition: to build something such as a building or wall; construct, fit, fix, structure, frame; straight, upright; to stand on end, get it up
words.translation: 建造；使竖立；安装；竖立的；笔直的；因性刺激而勃起的；直立；勃起

examples.en: an imposing town hall, erected in 1892
examples.zh: 一座气势宏伟的市政厅，建于1892年

examples.en: Police have erected barriers across the main roads into the town.
examples.zh: 警察在进城的主要道路上设立了路障。

words.definition: a mistake; mistake, deviation, fault, sin, blame
words.translation: 错误，谬误；差错；误差；错误；过失

examples.en: an error message
examples.zh: 出错信息

words.definition: if gas, liquid, light, heat etc escapes from somewhere, it comes out; the act of getting away from a place, or a dangerous or bad situation; get out of, shun; get away, keep clear of; hijra, desertion
words.translation: 逃跑；逸出；逃避，避免；被忘掉；逃脱；避开；溜走；逃亡

examples.en: Vents allow any steam to escape if the system overheats.
examples.zh: 如果系统过热，排放口可使蒸汽逸出。

words.definition: used to emphasize that something is more important or happens more with one particular thing than with others; peculiarly, notably
words.translation: 特别，尤其，格外；特别；尤其；格外

examples.en: I never liked long walks, especially in winter.
examples.zh: 我向来不喜欢长距离散步，尤其在冬天。

examples.en: Art books are expensive to produce, especially if they contain colour illustrations.
examples.zh: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

words.definition: the continent that is north of the Mediterranean and goes as far east as the Ural Mountains in Russia
words.translation: 欧洲

examples.en: eastern Europe
examples.zh: 东欧

words.definition: relating to Europe or its people; someone from Europe
words.translation: 欧洲的；欧洲人

examples.en: European languages
examples.zh: 欧洲的语言

examples.en: our European partners
examples.zh: 我们的欧洲伙伴

words.definition: if a liquid evaporates, or if heat evaporates it, it changes into a gas; vapor; disappear, blank
words.translation: 使蒸发；蒸发；使……蒸发；使……脱水；使……消失；蒸发，挥发；消失，失踪

examples.en: Most of the water had evaporated.
examples.zh: 大部分的水都蒸发了。

examples.en: The sun evaporates moisture on the leaves.
examples.zh: 太阳会蒸发叶子上的水分。

words.definition: the night or day before an important day; evening, sunset
words.translation: 前夜，前夕，前一刻；前夕；傍晚；重大事件关头

examples.en: We’re arriving on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 我们将在平安夜到达。

examples.en: a New Year’s Eve party
examples.zh: 除夕之夜的派对

words.definition: used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying; flat, equivalent, equal, level; actually, really, too, effectively, yet; equate with; flatten out
words.translation: 甚至；甚至更，还；[数]偶数的；平坦的；相等的；即使；还；实际上；使平坦；使相等；变平；变得可比较；成为相等

examples.en: Most companies have suffered a drop in their profits, even very large companies.
examples.zh: 大多数公司的利润都出现下滑，甚至连很大的公司也不例外。

examples.en: It was quite difficult to see, even with the light on.
examples.zh: 这很难看得见，即使开着灯也没有用。

examples.en: He became quite successful and even appeared on a television show once.
examples.zh: 他相当成功，甚至还上了一次电视节目。

words.definition: the early part of the night between the end of the day and the time you go to bed; night, eve, sunset; bonsoir
words.translation: 傍晚，黄昏，晚上；晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期；晚上好（等于good evening）

examples.en: I do most of my studying in the evening.
examples.zh: 我学习大都在晚上。

examples.en: I’m usually out on Friday evenings.
examples.zh: 周五晚上我通常都不在家。

examples.en: What are you doing tomorrow evening?
examples.zh: 明天晚上你打算做什么？

words.definition: something that happens, especially something important, interesting or unusual; incident, occurrence, circumstance, outcome, item, scene, product
words.translation: 事件，大事；事变；[计][物][数]事件，大事；项目；结果

examples.en: one of the most important events in the history of mankind
examples.zh: 人类历史上最重大的事件之一

words.definition: after a long time, or after a lot of things have happened; finally, ultimately, lastly
words.translation: 终于；最后；最后，终于

examples.en: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
examples.zh: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

examples.en: Eventually, she got a job and moved to London.
examples.zh: 最终，她找到了工作并移居伦敦。

words.definition: a word meaning at any time; used mostly in questions, negatives, comparisons, or sentences with ‘if’; forever, always, once
words.translation: 在任何时候；曾经；永远；究竟

examples.en: Nothing ever seems to upset him.
examples.zh: 似乎从来没有什么事情会使他烦恼。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
examples.zh: 你去过巴黎吗？

examples.en: I don’t think I’ve ever been here before.
examples.zh: 我觉得我以前从未到过这里。

words.definition: Every is also an adjective
words.translation: 每一的；每隔…的

examples.en: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
examples.zh: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

words.definition: everyone
words.translation: 每人，人人

words.definition: ordinary, usual, or happening every day; daily, household, routine; peacetime
words.translation: 每天的，日常的；平时；寻常日子

examples.en: the problems of everyday life
examples.zh: 日常生活中的问题

examples.en: wearing everyday clothes
examples.zh: 穿平常衣服

examples.en: a simple, everyday object
examples.zh: 简单的日常物品

words.definition: every person; each one, everybody (a term of address), Every Body
words.translation: 每人，人人；每个人

examples.en: If everyone is ready, I’ll begin.
examples.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我就开始。

examples.en: Send my best wishes to everyone in the family.
examples.zh: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。

examples.en: Of course everyone else thought it was hilarious!
examples.zh: 当然其他所有人都觉得好笑极了！

words.definition: each thing or all things
words.translation: 每件事，事事

examples.en: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
examples.zh: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

examples.en: I decided to tell her everything.
examples.zh: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

examples.en: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
examples.zh: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

words.definition: in or to every place; around, throughout, about
words.translation: 到处，处处；到处

examples.en: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
examples.zh: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

examples.en: He’s travelled everywhere in Europe.
examples.zh: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

examples.en: The south should remain dry, but everywhere else will have heavy rain.
examples.zh: 南部持续干旱，但其他地区会下暴雨。

words.definition: completely correct in every detail; nice, accurate, precise, mathematical, strict; require, desire, call for
words.translation: 确切的；精确的；准确的，精密的；要求；强求；急需

examples.en: Police are still investigating the exact cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 警方还在调查这起事故的确切原因。

examples.en: What were his exact words?
examples.zh: 他的原话是什么？

examples.en: The timing had to be exact.
examples.zh: 对时机的把握必须精确。

words.definition: used when emphasizing that something is no more and no less than a number or amount, or is completely correct in every detail; accurately, correctly, properly, precisely, right
words.translation: 确切地；恰恰正是；恰好地；正是；精确地；正确地

examples.en: It’s exactly half past five.
examples.zh: 一分不差，正好5点半。

examples.en: The figures may not be exactly right, but they’re close enough.
examples.zh: 那些数字可能不是非常精确，但也相当接近。

words.definition: a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one
words.translation: 考试；检查，细查

examples.en: At the end of each level, there’s an exam.
examples.zh: 在每一级别结束时都有一次考试。

examples.en: How did you do in your exams?
examples.zh: 你考试考得怎么样？

words.definition: a spoken or written test of knowledge, especially an important one; inspection, checking, monitoring
words.translation: 考试；检查，细查；检查；查问

examples.en: The examination results will be announced in September.
examples.zh: 考试成绩将于9月公布。

examples.en: He’s already taken the entrance examination.
examples.zh: 他已经参加了入学考试。

words.definition: to look at something carefully and thoroughly because you want to find out more about it; inspect, review, survey; probe, check for
words.translation: 检查，仔细观察；检查；调查；检测；考试

examples.en: A team of divers was sent down to examine the wreck.
examples.zh: 一组潜水员被送到水下检查沉船。

examples.en: Hegel’s philosophy will be examined in detail in Chapter 4.
examples.zh: 黑格尔的哲学将在第4章作详细探讨。

words.definition: a specific fact, idea, person, or thing that is used to explain or support a general idea, or to show what is typical of a larger group; mirror, lead, sample; illustrate
words.translation: 例子，实例；模范；例子；榜样；举例

examples.en: Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
examples.zh: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

words.definition: to be more than a particular number or amount; better than, overcome, top, cap, outdo
words.translation: 超过，胜过；超出；超过；胜过

examples.en: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
examples.zh: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

examples.en: His performance exceeded our expectations.
examples.zh: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

words.definition: extremely; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 极端地，非常；非常；极其；极度地；极端

examples.en: Thank you. You’ve been exceedingly kind.
examples.zh: 谢谢，你真是太好了。

words.definition: object, sit down on, to oppose; unless, besides, in addition to; but for
words.translation: 除…之外；反对；除了；要不是

examples.en: They were all there except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

examples.en: We all went except him.
examples.zh: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

examples.en: They all howled with laughter except me.
examples.zh: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

words.definition: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager; warm, stir up; warm, fire, to agitate
words.translation: 使激动；引起；激起；刺激…，使…兴奋；激动

examples.en: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
examples.zh: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

words.definition: making you feel excited; infusive, thrilling; motivating, stimulating
words.translation: 令人兴奋的；使人激动的；激动；刺激（excite的ing形式）；唤起

examples.en: an exciting discovery
examples.zh: 激动人心的发现

examples.en: ‘Julia and Paul are getting married!’ ‘Oh, how exciting!’
examples.zh: “朱莉娅和保罗要结婚了！”“啊，太让人兴奋了！”

examples.en: I’ve got some very exciting news for you.
examples.zh: 我给你带来了一些很激动人心的消息。

words.definition: to say something suddenly and loudly because you are surprised, angry, or excited; bay, shout
words.translation: 呼喊；惊叫；呼喊，惊叫；大声叫嚷

examples.en: ‘No!’ she exclaimed in shock.
examples.zh: “不！”她惊呼道。

words.definition: solely
words.translation: 专门地；唯一地；专有地；排外地

examples.en: These are not involved as exclusively as ministers in "soul-work," but they certainly cultivate the inner life more than the third group.
examples.zh: 他们虽不像牧师那样专门做“灵魂方面的工作”，但是肯定比第三群体更注重于建造人类的生命。

words.definition: a short journey arranged so that a group of people can visit a place, especially while they are on holiday; skewing, short trip
words.translation: 远足；短途旅行；偏移；短程旅行；离题；游览圆

examples.en: a shopping excursion
examples.zh: 购物游

words.definition: to forgive someone for doing something that is not seriously wrong, such as being rude or careless; a reason that you invent to explain an action and to hide your real intentions; reason, sake, account, blind, occasion; forgive, pardon for; beg for mercy
words.translation: 原谅；免除；借口；理由；为…申辩；给…免去；作为借口；请求宽恕；表示宽恕

examples.en: I’ll excuse you this time, but don’t be late again.
examples.zh: 这次我原谅你，但别再迟到了。

examples.en: Please excuse my bad handwriting.
examples.zh: 请原谅，我的字写得不好。

words.definition: to kill someone, especially legally as a punishment; perform, implement, enforce
words.translation: 将…处死；实施；实行；执行；处死

examples.en: 13 people were summarily executed (= killed without any trial or legal process ) by the guerrillas.
examples.zh: 有13人被游击队员就地处决。

words.definition: relating to the job of managing a business or organization and making decisions; a group of people who are in charge of an organization and make the rules; administrative, front-office; manager, gerente
words.translation: 执行的；执行者；[计]行政的；经营的；执行的，经营管理的；经理；执行委员会；[计]执行者；经理主管人员

examples.en: a commission with executive powers
examples.zh: 有执行权的委员会

words.definition: physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger; movement, sport, ceremony, campaign, practice; make use of, fashion, occupy, alarm, employ; motion, do sport
words.translation: 锻炼，训练；练习；运动；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼；锻炼；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

examples.en: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
examples.zh: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

examples.en: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
examples.zh: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

words.definition: to use your power, influence etc in order to make something happen; handle, to put to use
words.translation: 尽(力)，运用；运用，发挥；施以影响

examples.en: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
examples.zh: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

examples.en: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
examples.zh: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

words.definition: to show something in a public place so that people can go to see it; introduce, reveal, prove, make clear, prefer; proof, witness
words.translation: 显示；陈列，展览；展览；提出（证据等）；[贸易]展览品；证据；展示会

examples.en: Her paintings have been exhibited all over the world.
examples.zh: 她的绘画作品在世界各地展出。

words.definition: to happen or be present in a particular situation or place; occur, live, harbor
words.translation: 存在；生存，生活；生存；生活；继续存在

examples.en: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家仍存在包办婚姻的习俗。

examples.en: Opportunities exist for students to gain sponsorship.
examples.zh: 学生有机会获得资助。

examples.en: Stop pretending that the problem doesn’t exist.
examples.zh: 别再假装这个问题不存在了。

words.definition: the state of existing; presence, being, entity, life, is
words.translation: 存在，实在；生存；[计]存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物

examples.en: Scientists have many theories about how the universe first came into existence (= started to exist ).
examples.zh: 关于宇宙的起源，科学家有多种理论。

words.definition: a door or space through which you can leave a public room, building etc; to stop using a computer program; door, channel, route, way out; to quit, back out
words.translation: 出口；退场；退出；出口，通道；[计]退出；离去

examples.en: We made for the nearest exit.
examples.zh: 我们走向最近的出口。

examples.en: an exit door
examples.zh: 出口门

examples.en: Two men were blocking her exit.
examples.zh: 两个男人挡住了她出去的路。

words.definition: when something increases in size, range, amount etc; inflation, exposition
words.translation: 扩大，扩充；扩张；膨胀；阐述；扩张物

examples.en: The industry underwent a period of rapid expansion.
examples.zh: 该产业经历了一轮快速扩张。

words.definition: to think that something will happen because it seems likely or has been planned; promise oneself, guess, find, feel, make; look foward to, to look forward to
words.translation: 预料，预期；等待；期望；指望；认为；预料；期待；预期

examples.en: He will be hard to beat. I fully expect (= am completely sure about ) that and I’m ready.
examples.zh: 他很难击败。我确信这一点，不过我准备好了。

examples.en: ‘Who are you?’ he murmured, only half expecting (= thinking it was possible, but not likely ) her to answer.
examples.zh: “你是谁？”他低声问道，预计她可能不会回答。

examples.en: He didn’t get his expected pay rise.
examples.zh: 他没有得到他预想的加薪。

words.definition: the amount of money that you spend on something; consumption, losing, price, cost, disadvantage
words.translation: 花费，消费；费用；损失，代价；消费；开支

examples.en: He borrowed £150,000 and used the money for legal expenses.
examples.zh: 他借了15万英镑用于支付律师费。

examples.en: Conference rooms were equipped at great expense.
examples.zh: 装备会议室花费巨大。

words.definition: costing a lot of money; rich, dear, costly
words.translation: 昂贵的，花钱多的；昂贵的；花钱的

examples.en: the most expensive restaurant in town
examples.zh: 城里最贵的餐馆

examples.en: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
examples.zh: 汽油越来越贵了。

examples.en: Photography is an expensive hobby.
examples.zh: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

words.definition: knowledge or skill that you gain from doing a job or activity, or the process of doing this; areer; suffer, live, undergo
words.translation: 经验，感受；经历；经验；体验

examples.en: The advice in the booklet reflects the practical experience we have gained (= experience gained by actually doing something, rather than knowledge from books etc ).
examples.zh: 小册子中的建议反映了我们所获得的实践经验。

examples.en: I had some experience in fashion design.
examples.zh: 我有一些时装设计方面的经验。

examples.en: She was turned down on the grounds of lack of experience.
examples.zh: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

words.definition: a scientific test done to find out how something reacts under certain conditions, or to find out if a particular idea is true; have a try, try one's hand; stroke, proof, try, go
words.translation: 实验；试验；尝试；进行实验；[试验]实验，试验

examples.en: The astronauts are conducting a series of experiments to learn more about how the body adapts to weightlessness.
examples.zh: 那些宇航员正在进行一系列实验，以便更多地了解人体如何适应失重状态。

words.definition: used for, relating to, or resulting from experiments; tentative, laboratorial
words.translation: 实验的，试验的；实验的；根据实验的；试验性的

examples.en: experimental animals
examples.zh: 用于实验的动物

words.definition: to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand; bring sb to do sth, go to show
words.translation: 解释；为…辩解；说明

examples.en: He carefully explained the procedure.
examples.zh: 他仔细解释了程序。

words.definition: the reasons you give for why something happened or why you did something; notes, interpretation, construction, legend, account
words.translation: 解释，说明；辩解；说明，解释

examples.en: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
examples.zh: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

words.definition: to burst, or to make something burst, into small pieces, usually with a loud noise and in a way that causes damage; blow apart, burst up; shoot, spring, blast
words.translation: 使爆炸；爆炸；爆炸，爆发；激增；推翻

examples.en: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
examples.zh: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

examples.en: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
examples.zh: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

words.definition: a substance that can cause an explosion; able or likely to explode; volatile, fulminic; blasting agent, detonator
words.translation: 炸药；爆炸的；[力]爆炸的；爆炸性的；爆发性的；[化工]炸药；[力]爆炸物

examples.en: ...one-hundred-and-fifty pounds of Semtex explosive.
examples.zh: …150磅的塞姆汀塑料炸药。

words.definition: to sell goods to another country; output, exit; output, bulk out
words.translation: 输出，出口；运走；输出，[贸易]出口；出口商品

examples.en: Italian food has been exported all over the world.
examples.zh: 意大利食品已传遍世界。

words.definition: to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions; a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly; voice, put; precise, decided, technical, rapid, specific; rapido, flier
words.translation: 表示；快车，快递；表达；快递；明确的；迅速的；专门的；[交]快车，快递，专使；捷运公司

examples.en: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
examples.zh: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

examples.en: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
examples.zh: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

examples.en: Many people have expressed their opposition to the proposals.
examples.zh: 许多人反对这些提议。

words.definition: something you say, write, or do that shows what you think or feel; utterance, representative of
words.translation: 词句；表达；表情；[数]表达，表示；[遗]表现力；措辞

examples.en: Student leaders are demanding greater freedom of expression (= the right to say what you think without being punished ).
examples.zh: 学生领袖要求得到更多的言论自由。

words.definition: to continue for a longer period of time, or to make something last longer; afford, allow, deal, deliver, finger; reach, spread, range, enlarge, push
words.translation: 延长；扩大；致；延伸；推广；伸出；给予；使竭尽全力；对…估价；伸展；使疏开

examples.en: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

words.definition: large in size, amount, or degree; widespread, massive, comprehensive, substantial, vast
words.translation: 广阔的；广泛的；大量的

examples.en: The house stands in extensive grounds.
examples.zh: 这栋房子占地面积很大。

examples.en: Fire has caused extensive damage to the island’s forests.
examples.zh: 大火严重毁坏了岛上的森林。

examples.en: the extensive use of pesticides
examples.zh: 杀虫剂的大量使用

words.translation: 广度；范围；程度

words.definition: on the outside of something; outer, outside, surface, facial; aspect, without, colour
words.translation: 外部的；对外的；表面的；外在的；外部；表面；外型；外貌

examples.en: The exterior walls need a new coat of paint.
examples.zh: 外墙需要刷新漆了。

words.definition: relating to the outside of something or of a person’s body; foreign, outer, outside, surface, out; outside, without, surface, face, garment
words.translation: 外部的，外面的；[药][动]外部的；表面的；外用的；外国的；外面的；外部；外观；外面

examples.en: the external appearance of the building
examples.zh: 大楼的外观

words.definition: more of something, in addition to the usual or standard amount or number; used to emphasize an adjective or adverb; specifically, particularly, badly, highly, greatly, too; walker-on, special edition; additional, added, excess
words.translation: 额外的；特别地；特别地，非常；另外；临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品；额外的，[经]另外收费的；特大的

examples.en: Could you get an extra loaf of bread?
examples.zh: 你能多拿一条面包吗？

examples.en: Allow extra time for your journey.
examples.zh: 要给你的旅程多留出点时间。

examples.en: Drivers are advised to take extra care.
examples.zh: 建议司机开车要格外小心。

words.definition: very great in degree; ultra, excessive; terminal, bottom
words.translation: 极度的；尽头的；极端的；偏激的；极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物

examples.en: Extreme poverty still exists in many rural areas.
examples.zh: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

examples.en: extreme cold
examples.zh: 严寒

examples.en: He had extreme difficulty getting hold of the ingredients.
examples.zh: 他费了极大的劲找配料。

words.definition: to a very great degree; badly, highly, greatly, too, rare
words.translation: 极端，极其，非常；非常，极其；极端地

examples.en: Earthquakes are extremely difficult to predict.
examples.zh: 地震非常难以预测。

examples.en: I’m extremely sorry to have troubled you.
examples.zh: 给你添了麻烦，我十分抱歉。

words.definition: one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with; viewpoint, vision, sight, perspective, outlook; watch, look, behold
words.translation: 眼睛；眼力；鉴赏力；[解剖]眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点；注视，看

examples.en: He’s got beautiful eyes.
examples.zh: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

examples.en: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
examples.zh: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

examples.en: Ow! I’ve got something in my eye!
examples.zh: 哎呀！我眼睛里进了什么东西！

words.definition: your ability to see; vision, sight, eye, seeing
words.translation: 视力，目力；视力；目力

examples.en: He had a problem with his eyesight.
examples.zh: 他的视力有问题。

words.definition: a traditional short story that teaches a moral lesson, especially a story about animals; allegory, parable; romance, cook up; invent, cook up
words.translation: 寓言；虚构的故事；无稽之谈；编寓言；虚构；煞有介事地讲述

examples.en: the fable of the fox and the crow
examples.zh: 狐狸和乌鸦的寓言故事

words.definition: cloth used for making clothes, curtains etc; cloth, organization, formation, construction, textile
words.translation: 织物，纺织品；结构；[纺]织物；布；组织；构造；建筑物

examples.en: our new range of fabrics and wallpapers
examples.zh: 我们新的织物和墙纸系列

words.definition: the front part of your head, where your eyes, nose, and mouth are; surface, outside, garment, look; open to; accept, agree, recognize, look, grant
words.translation: 脸；表面；外表；面子；面容；外观；威信；向；朝；面对；面向；承认；抹盖

examples.en: She had a beautiful face.
examples.zh: 她面容秀美。

examples.en: Her face was white with fear.
examples.zh: 她吓得脸煞白。

examples.en: A big smile spread across his face.
examples.zh: 他的脸上绽开了灿烂笑容。

words.definition: a piece of information that is known to be true; truth, reality, actuality
words.translation: 事实；实际，实情；实际；真相

examples.en: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
examples.zh: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

words.definition: one of several things that influence or cause a situation; element, deputy, agent, basic, essential
words.translation: 因素；因子，系数；[经]要素；[物]因数；代理人

examples.en: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
examples.zh: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

words.definition: a building or group of buildings in which goods are produced in large quantities, using machines; plant, mill, work, manufactory
words.translation: 工厂，制造厂；[工经]工厂；制造厂；代理店

examples.en: a car factory
examples.zh: 汽车制造厂

examples.en: factory workers
examples.zh: 工厂工人

words.definition: a particular skill that someone has; ability, capacity, competence, department, power
words.translation: 才能，能力；系，科；科，系；能力；全体教员

examples.en: the Engineering Faculty
examples.zh: 工程学院

words.definition: a scale of temperature in which water freezes at 32˚ and boils at 212˚; Farenheit thermometer, Fah
words.translation: 华氏温度计；华氏温标

examples.en: 72˚ Fahrenheit (= 72 degrees on the Fahrenheit scale )
examples.zh: 72华氏度

words.definition: to not succeed in achieving something; flag, founder, tube; disappoint, let down; flunk
words.translation: 失败；失灵；不能；失败，不及格；破产；缺乏；衰退；不及格；使失望；忘记；舍弃

examples.en: It looks likely that the peace talks will fail.
examples.zh: 看来和平谈判可能会失败。

examples.en: Millions of people have tried to quit smoking and failed miserably (= been completely unsuccessful ).
examples.zh: 数百万人戒过烟，都以惨败告终。

examples.en: his efforts to save his failing marriage
examples.zh: 他挽救自己濒危婚姻的努力

words.definition: a lack of success in achieving or doing something; loss, defeat, losing, fault, trouble
words.translation: 失败；失败的人；故障；失败者；[经]破产

examples.en: Successful people often aren’t very good at dealing with failure.
examples.zh: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。

words.definition: a very small or slight hope etc; fuzzy, weak, dark, vague; pass out, flake out; asphyxy, swound
words.translation: 微弱的；虚弱的；模糊的；头晕的；[医]虚弱的；衰弱的；昏倒；变得微弱；变得没气力；[中医]昏厥，昏倒

examples.en: a faint hope that they might be alive
examples.zh: 他们渺茫的生还希望

words.definition: more than a little, but much less than very; relatively, simply, comparatively, equally, reasonably
words.translation: 相当；公平地；相当地；简直

examples.en: The house had a fairly large garden.
examples.zh: 那幢房子有个不小的花园。

examples.en: She speaks English fairly well.
examples.zh: 她英语讲得还不错。

examples.en: The instructions seem fairly straightforward.
examples.zh: 操作指南似乎很简明。

words.definition: remaining loyal to a particular person, belief, political party etc and continuing to support them; loving, devoted
words.translation: 忠诚的；如实的；忠实的，忠诚的；准确可靠的

examples.en: a faithful friend
examples.zh: 忠诚的朋友

examples.en: years of faithful service to the company
examples.zh: 为公司多年忠诚的服务

examples.en: our faithful family dog, Bogey
examples.zh: 我家的忠犬博吉

words.definition: to move or drop down from a higher position to a lower position; become, come, lower; reduction, decline, autumn; floor, cut sth down; autumn
words.translation: 落下；跌倒；陷落；变成；来临；减弱；[气象]下降；秋天；瀑布；砍倒；击倒；秋天的

examples.en: The tree was about to fall.
examples.zh: 那棵树快要倒下了。

examples.en: The book fell from his hands.
examples.zh: 书从他手上跌落。

examples.en: Enough rain had fallen to flood the grounds.
examples.zh: 雨量很大，淹没了地面。

words.definition: You use false to describe objects which are artificial but which are intended to look like the real thing or to be used instead of the real thing; artificial, wrong, incorrect, improper, inaccurate; trickily
words.translation: 不真实的；伪造的；错误的；虚伪的；欺诈地

examples.en: ...a set of false teeth.
examples.zh: …一副假牙。

words.definition: the state of being known about by a lot of people because of your achievements; tradition, celebrity, tale
words.translation: 名声，名望；传闻，传说

examples.en: He claims he is not really interested in fame.
examples.zh: 他称自己对出名真的没有兴趣。

words.definition: a group of people who are related to each other, especially a mother, a father, and their children; household, folk, race; household, domestic, home
words.translation: 家，家庭；家族；家庭；家属；子女；亲属；僚属；家庭的，家族的

examples.en: Do you know the family next door?
examples.zh: 你认识隔壁那家人吗？

examples.en: The Webb family still has its farm over there.
examples.zh: 韦伯家依然保留着那里的农场。

examples.en: The family now live in London.
examples.zh: 那家人现居伦敦。

words.definition: a situation in which a large number of people have little or no food for a long time and many people die; hunger, fames
words.translation: 饥荒；严重的缺乏；饥饿，奇缺

examples.en: the great potato famine in Ireland
examples.zh: 爱尔兰严重的土豆荒

examples.en: A million people are facing famine .
examples.zh: 一百万人正面临饥荒。

words.definition: known about by many people in many places; noted, wonderful, excellent, super, great
words.translation: 著名的，出名的；著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的

examples.en: a famous actor
examples.zh: 著名演员

examples.en: Many famous people have stayed in the hotel.
examples.zh: 许多名人都曾下榻这家酒店。

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark (= a famous place or building that is easy to recognize ) .
examples.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是著名的地标。

words.definition: someone who likes a particular sport or performing art very much, or who admires a famous person; stimulate, egg; float, flutter; lover, aficionado
words.translation: (运动等)狂热爱好者；煽动；刺激；吹拂；成扇形散开；飘动；迷；[电]风扇；爱好者

examples.en: Groups of football fans began heading towards the ground.
examples.zh: 成群结队的球迷开始向球场走去。

words.definition: a long distance away; used to talk about how much progress someone makes, or how much effect something has; greatly, quite, badly, too, powerful; hoary, agelong; distance, distant place
words.translation: 远的；远，遥远；很；遥远地；久远地；到很远的距离；到很深的程度；久远的；远方

examples.en: We can walk to my house from here. It isn’t far.
examples.zh: 我们可以从这里步行去我家，不远。

examples.en: You could see the mountains in the far distance.
examples.zh: 你可以看到远处的群山。

words.definition: the price you pay to travel somewhere by bus, train, plane etc; round, advance; passenger, food, fee, charge, diet
words.translation: 车费，船费，票价；经营；进展；遭遇；过活；票价；费用；旅客；食物

examples.en: He could barely afford the fare.
examples.zh: 他几乎付不起车费。

words.definition: a party or dinner that you have because someone is leaving a job, city etc; the action of saying goodbye; adieux, leave-taking; tara; valedictory
words.translation: 再会；告别；告别，辞别；再见；别了！（常含有永别或不容易再见面的意思）；再会！；告别的

examples.en: 40 of her colleagues gathered for her farewell presentation.
examples.zh: 40位同事来参加了她的欢送会。

words.definition: an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals; follow the plough; grange, steading; till, plant crops
words.translation: 农场，农庄；饲养场；种田，务农；经营农场；[农经]农场；农家；[畜牧]畜牧场；养殖；耕种；佃出（土地）

examples.en: a 300-hectare farm
examples.zh: 一座300公顷的农场

examples.en: farm workers
examples.zh: 农场工人

examples.en: farm animals
examples.zh: 农场牲畜

words.definition: someone who owns or manages a farm; peasant, sodbuster
words.translation: 农民，农夫；农场主；农夫，[农]农民

words.definition: a greater distance than before or than something else; a  comparative  form of ‘far’; more distant; moreover, again, besides, then, additionally; further
words.translation: 更远地；更远的；此外；更进一步地；进一步的；更远的（far的比较级）

examples.en: We decided not to go any farther.
examples.zh: 我们决定不再往前走了。

examples.en: Most of them were locals, but some had come from farther afield (= a greater distance away ) .
examples.zh: 他们大部分是当地人，但也有一些来自较远的地方。

words.definition: in a particular way; mode, style, type; make use of, employ, influence, exercise, shift
words.translation: 样子，方式；风尚；时尚；[服装]时装；样式；时髦人物；使用；改变；做成…的形状

examples.en: Please leave the building in an orderly fashion.
examples.zh: 请大家有秩序地离开大楼。

examples.en: Perhaps they could sit down and discuss things in a civilised fashion.
examples.zh: 也许他们可以坐下来心平气和地商量事情。

examples.en: She will be working out her problems in her own fashion (= in the way that she usually does this ) .
examples.zh: 她会以自己的方式来解决她的问题。

words.definition: popular, especially for a short period of time; popular, going, modern, ruling, epidemic
words.translation: 流行的，时髦的；流行的；时髦的；上流社会的

examples.en: Strong colours are very fashionable at the moment.
examples.zh: 眼下流行艳丽的色彩。

words.definition: moving or able to move quickly; moving quickly; rapid, sudden, tight, forward, ready; quickly, rapidly, thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully; apastia, starvation
words.translation: 快的；偏快的；快；[摄]快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的；迅速地；紧紧地；彻底地；斋戒；绝食

examples.en: a fast car
examples.zh: 速度很快的汽车

examples.en: He’s one of the fastest runners in the world.
examples.zh: 他是世界上跑得最快的人之一。

words.definition: to firmly close a window, gate etc so that it will not open, or to become firmly closed; focus on, fix; pay attention, take hold
words.translation: 扎牢，扣住；使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于；扣紧；抓住；集中注意力

examples.en: Make sure all the windows are securely fastened before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前要确保所有的窗子都已关严。

words.definition: a male parent; dad, root, da, daddy, priest; found, construct, institute
words.translation: 父亲；神父；创始人；父亲，爸爸；祖先；前辈；发明，创立；当…的父亲

examples.en: Ask your father to help you.
examples.zh: 叫你父亲帮你。

examples.en: Andrew was very excited about becoming a father.
examples.zh: 安德鲁初为人父，非常激动。

examples.en: He’s been like a father to me.
examples.zh: 对我来说，他就像父亲一样。

words.definition: a bad or weak part of someone’s character; error, deficiency, defect, mistake, trouble; mistake, err in; carp at, trip up
words.translation: 缺点；过失；故障；[地质]断层；错误；毛病；（网球等）发球失误；弄错；产生断层；（通常用于疑问句或否定句）挑剔

examples.en: His worst fault is his arrogance.
examples.zh: 他最大的缺点是傲慢。

examples.en: I may have my faults , but ingratitude is not one of them.
examples.zh: 我可能有我的缺点，但我决不会忘恩负义。

examples.en: For all his faults (= in spite of his faults ) he was a good father.
examples.zh: 尽管他有缺点，但还是个好父亲。

words.definition: not working properly, or not made correctly; vicious, imperfect
words.translation: 有错误的，有缺点的；有错误的；有缺点的

examples.en: Customers may ask for a refund if the goods are faulty.
examples.zh: 商品有问题的话，顾客可以要求退货。

examples.en: a faulty gene that causes breast cancer
examples.zh: 引起乳腺癌的一种缺陷基因

words.definition: something that you do for someone in order to help them or be kind to them; acceptance, preference, good, mercy; enjoy, agree, aid, uphold
words.translation: 好感；赞同；恩惠；偏爱；善行；赞成；喜爱；有助于

examples.en: Could you do me a favour and tell Kelly I can’t make it?
examples.zh: 你帮个忙告诉凯莉说我来不了好吗？

examples.en: He hired John as a favour to his father.
examples.zh: 他雇约翰是给他父亲一个面子。

examples.en: Paul, can I ask you a favor ?
examples.zh: 保罗，能帮我一下吗？

words.definition: a favourable report, opinion, or reaction shows that you think that someone or something is good or that you agree with them; beneficial, advantageous, smooth; adventage, profitableness
words.translation: 有利的；赞成的；有利的，顺利的；有利

examples.en: favourable film reviews
examples.zh: 正面的影评

examples.en: The response has been overwhelmingly favorable.
examples.zh: 回应是一边倒的肯定。

words.definition: your favourite person or thing is the one that you like the most
words.translation: 特别受喜爱的

examples.en: a child’s favourite toy
examples.zh: 孩子最喜欢的玩具

examples.en: What’s your favourite colour?
examples.zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？

examples.en: a favorite spot for picnickers
examples.zh: 野餐者最喜欢的地方

words.definition: the feeling you get when you are afraid or worried that something bad is going to happen; to feel afraid or worried that something bad may happen; worry, afraid of; be nervous of, be afraid of
words.translation: 害怕；担心；[心理]恐惧；敬畏；为…担心

examples.en: I was sitting on the floor shivering with fear because a bullet had been fired through a window.
examples.zh: 我坐在地板上吓得浑身发抖，因为有一颗子弹射穿窗户打了进来。

words.definition: frightened that something bad might happen; worried, acute, terrible, afraid, serious
words.translation: 害怕的，可怕的；可怕的；担心的；严重的

examples.en: a shy and fearful child
examples.zh: 一个羞涩、胆怯的小孩

words.definition: a large meal where a lot of people celebrate a special occasion; enjoy, guest; festival, holiday; banquet
words.translation: 盛宴，筵席；节日；享受；款待，宴请；筵席，宴会；参加宴会

examples.en: a wedding feast
examples.zh: 婚筵

examples.en: The king promised to hold a great feast for all his people.
examples.zh: 国王允诺为全体子民举行盛宴。

words.definition: one of the light soft things that cover a bird’s body; plume; fledge
words.translation: 羽毛；翎毛；羽状物；用羽毛装饰；长羽毛

examples.en: an ostrich feather
examples.zh: 一根鸵鸟羽毛

words.definition: the second month of the year, between January and March
words.translation: 二月

examples.en: He joined the Army in February 1943.
examples.zh: 他1943年2月参军。

words.definition: a federal country or system of government consists of a group of states which control their own affairs, but which are also controlled by a single national government which makes decisions on foreign affairs, defence etc; confederal, fed.
words.translation: 联邦的；联盟的；同盟的

examples.en: Switzerland is a federal republic.
examples.zh: 瑞士是一个联邦共和国。

words.definition: an amount of money that you pay to do something or that you pay to a professional person for their work; charge, cost, tip
words.translation: 费，酬金；赏金；[会计]费用；[劳经]酬金；小费

examples.en: You can use the gym and pool for a fee of £35 a month.
examples.zh: 月付35英镑，即可使用健身房和游泳池。

words.definition: extremely weak; weak, small, thin
words.translation: 虚弱的；微弱的；微弱的，无力的；薄弱的

examples.en: His voice sounded feeble and far away.
examples.zh: 他的声音听上去既无力又遥远。

examples.en: She was too feeble to leave her room.
examples.zh: 她身体虚弱，无法走出自己的房间。

words.definition: to give food to a person or animal; grass, take care of, range; take food, flow into; meal, breeding, husbandry
words.translation: 喂(养)；吃饲料；喂养；供给；放牧；抚养（家庭等）；靠…为生；吃东西；流入；[畜牧]饲料；饲养；（动物或婴儿的）一餐

examples.en: Have you fed the cat?
examples.zh: 你喂猫了吗？

words.definition: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it; to give you a particular physical feeling, especially when you touch or hold something; expect, count, guess, find, make; fish for, poke about; consciousness, sense perception
words.translation: 有知觉；触，摸；感觉；认为；触摸；试探；觉得；摸索

examples.en: I am feeling very depressed.
examples.zh: 我感到很沮丧。

examples.en: Suddenly I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder.
examples.zh: 我突然感到肩部一阵剧痛。

examples.en: I felt as if all my strength had gone.
examples.zh: 我觉得好象自己的力气已经全没了。

words.definition: an emotion that you feel, such as anger, sadness, or happiness; mood, consciousness, emotion, affection, spirit; caring; sensing, handling
words.translation: 感情；感觉，知觉；[生理]感觉，触觉；[心理]感情，情绪；同情；有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的；[生理]感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸

examples.en: Knowing we’d won was a wonderful feeling.
examples.zh: 得知我们赢了，感觉真好。

words.definition: a man; apple, customer, friend, member, guy; companionate
words.translation: 人，家伙；伙伴；家伙；朋友；同事；会员；同伴的，同事的；同道的

examples.en: Paul’s an easy-going sort of fellow.
examples.zh: 保罗人很随和。

words.definition: an animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs; delicate, feminine; she, jenny
words.translation: 雌性的动物；女子；女性的；[生物]雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的；女人；[植][动]雌性动物

examples.en: As a group, females performed better on the test than males.
examples.zh: 整体来说，女性在这次测试中胜过男性。

words.definition: a structure made of wood, metal etc that surrounds a piece of land; bounding wall, perimeter wall; defend, forefend; prevaricate, tergiversate
words.translation: 栅栏；围墙；剑术；防护；用篱笆围住；练习剑术；击剑；搪塞；围以栅栏；跳过栅栏

examples.en: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills.
examples.zh: 村民们说栅栏将限制公众进入山区。

words.definition: fertile land or soil is able to produce good crops; rich, viable; pregnancy, enrichment
words.translation: 肥沃的；多产的；富饶的，肥沃的；[植]能生育的；肥沃，多产

examples.en: 800 acres of fertile cropland
examples.zh: 800英亩的肥沃耕地

words.definition: a substance that is put on the soil to make plants grow; manure
words.translation: 肥料；[肥料]肥料；受精媒介物；促进发展者

examples.en: ...farming without any purchased chemical, fertilizer or pesticide.
examples.zh: …不使用任何购买的化学品、肥料或杀虫剂的耕作。

words.definition: a special occasion when people celebrate something such as a religious event, and there is often a public holiday; holiday, joy, celebration; cheerful, enjoyable
words.translation: 节日；音乐节；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐；节日的，喜庆的；快乐的

examples.en: Christmas is one of the main festivals in the Christian Calendar.
examples.zh: 圣诞节是基督教历的重大节日之一。

words.definition: an illness or a medical condition in which you have a very high temperature; abandon, febricity; fanaticize; run a temperature, go wild
words.translation: 发热，发烧；狂热；[医]发烧，[临床]发热；[医]使发烧；使狂热；使患热病；[医]发烧；患热病

examples.en: Andy has a fever and won’t be coming into work today.
examples.zh: 安迪发烧了，今天不来上班。

examples.en: I woke up this morning with a fever and an upset stomach.
examples.zh: 今天早上醒来时我发烧了，胃也不舒服。

examples.en: She’s running a fever (= has a fever ) .
examples.zh: 她在发烧。

words.definition: Few is also an adjective; tiny, little, small
words.translation: 很少的；少数的；几乎没有的

examples.en: ...spending her few waking hours in front of the TV.
examples.zh: …把她清醒的个把钟头花在电视机前。

words.definition: the parts of plants that you eat but cannot  digest  . Fibre helps to keep you healthy by moving food quickly through your body.; fiber, funicle
words.translation: 纤维，纤维质；[材]纤维；纤维制品

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are high in fibre content .
examples.zh: 水果和蔬菜的纤维素含量很高。

examples.en: food that is high in dietary fibre
examples.zh: 富含膳食纤维的食物

words.definition: an area of land in the country, especially one where crops are grown or animals feed on grass; domain, province, territory, world, kingdom, universe; wild, feral
words.translation: 田野；田；运动场；领域；牧场；旷野；战场；扫描场；田赛的；野生的

examples.en: a view of green fields and rolling hills
examples.zh: 田野青翠、丘陵起伏的景色

words.definition: done with a lot of energy and strong feelings, and sometimes violence; fell, violent, hard
words.translation: 凶猛的，狂热的；凶猛的；猛烈的；暴躁的

examples.en: fierce fighting in the city
examples.zh: 城里的激烈战斗

words.definition: the number 15; galleon
words.translation: 十五；十五个；十五人组成的橄榄球队

examples.en: a coastal village fifteen miles south of Tourane
examples.zh: 土伦以南15英里的一个滨海村落

examples.en: They met when she was fifteen (= 15 years old ) .
examples.zh: 他们相遇那年她15岁。

words.definition: one of five equal parts of something; Quincy
words.translation: 第五；五分之一

examples.en: a fifth of bourbon
examples.zh: 五分之一加仑的波旁威士忌酒

words.definition: the number 50; legion
words.translation: 五十，五十个；五十的；五十个的；众多的

examples.en: Standards of living rose in the fifties.
examples.zh: 50年代生活水平提高了。

words.definition: to take part in a war or battle; combat, war; struggle with; action, combat
words.translation: 打(仗)；斗争；搏斗，斗争；打架；打仗；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案；战斗，搏斗；斗志

examples.en: Neither country is capable of fighting a long war .
examples.zh: 两个国家都没有能力打持久战。

examples.en: Later the Indians fought the Anglo settlers.
examples.zh: 后来，印第安人跟英国殖民者打起了仗。

words.definition: a set of papers, records etc that contain information about a particular person or subject; to keep papers, documents etc in a particular place so that you can find them easily; document, portfolio, paper, record, folder; introduce, present, prefer, advance, put in; procession
words.translation: 档案；把…归档；[计]文件；文件夹；[机]锉刀；提出；锉；琢磨；列队行进；用锉刀锉

examples.en: We will keep your details on file (= store them for later use ) .
examples.zh: 我们将把你的详细资料存档。

words.definition: if a container or place fills, or if you fill it, enough of something goes into it to make it full; full of, fulfill, freight, meet; swell with, intumesce; satisfaction, content
words.translation: 装满，盛满；占满；装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职；被充满，膨胀；填满的量；装填物

examples.en: He poured her a drink, then filled his own glass.
examples.zh: 他给她倒了一杯，然后将自己的杯子斟满。

examples.en: My job was filling the flour sacks.
examples.zh: 我的工作是装面粉袋。

examples.en: Take a deep breath and allow your lungs to fill.
examples.zh: 深吸一口气，让肺部涨满。

words.definition: a story that is told using sound and moving pictures, shown at a cinema or on television; movie, membrane, cinema; cinematograph
words.translation: 影片；胶卷；薄层；[电影]电影；薄膜；[感光]胶卷；轻烟；在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影

examples.en: Have you seen any good films recently?
examples.zh: 你最近看过什么好的影片吗？

words.definition: to remove unwanted substances from water, air etc by passing it through a special substance or piece of equipment; something that you pass water, air etc through in order to remove unwanted substances and make it clean or suitable to use; sink in, seep into; strainer, percolator; penetrate, lauter
words.translation: 过滤；滤纸；滤过；渗入；慢慢传开；[电子][光]滤波器；[轻][核][化工]过滤器；筛选；滤光器；[轻][核][化工]过滤；渗透；用过滤法除去

examples.en: The water in the tank is constantly filtered.
examples.zh: 鱼缸里的水在不停地被过滤。

examples.en: The ozone layer filters harmful UV rays from the sun.
examples.zh: 臭氧层过滤掉有害的太阳紫外线。

words.definition: last in a series of actions, events, parts of a story etc; ultimate, crucial, critical, decisive; shoot-off, fight-off
words.translation: 最后的；决定性的；最终的；不可更改的；决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版

examples.en: The final episode will be shown tonight.
examples.zh: 最后一集将于今晚播出。

examples.en: students preparing for their final examinations
examples.zh: 正在准备期末考试的学生

examples.en: Stone is filming the final instalment of his Vietnam trilogy.
examples.zh: 斯通正在拍摄越战三部曲的最后一部。

words.definition: after a long time; eventually, ultimately, lastly
words.translation: 最后；不可更改的；终于；决定性地

examples.en: After several delays we finally took off at six o’clock.
examples.zh: 几经耽搁后，我们终于在六点起飞了。

examples.en: Finally, Karpov cracked under the pressure.
examples.zh: 最后，卡尔波夫承受不住压力崩溃了。

words.definition: to discover, see, or get something that you have been searching for; detect, earn, acquire, expect, count; discovery, occurrence, detection, anagnorisis
words.translation: 找到；发觉；找出；发现；认为；感到；获得

examples.en: I can’t find the car keys.
examples.zh: 我找不到汽车钥匙。

examples.en: Hold on while I find a pen.
examples.zh: 别挂电话，我找支笔。

examples.zh: 后来有人发现她的尸体被藏在了灌木丛里。
