words.definition: to cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in hot fat or oil; deep-fry, panbroil; deepfry
words.translation: 油煎，油炸，油炒；油炸；油煎

examples.en: Fry the potatoes, covered, for about 20 minutes.
examples.zh: 盖上盖，将马铃薯煎20分钟左右。

examples.en: I could smell onions frying.
examples.zh: 我闻到了煎洋葱的味道。

words.definition: a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that can be burned to produce heat or energy; if you fuel a vehicle, or if it fuels up, fuel is put into it; catalyst, elding
words.translation: 燃料；给…加燃料；[能源]燃料；刺激因素

examples.en: Coal is one of the cheapest fuels.
examples.zh: 煤是最廉价的燃料之一。

words.definition: to do or provide what is necessary or needed; accomplish, carry out, achieve, perform, complete
words.translation: 履行；满足；完成；实践

examples.en: There is little doubt that the scheme fulfils a need for our community.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，这计划会满足我们社区的需求。

words.definition: containing as much or as many things or people as possible, so there is no space left; complete, filled, abundant, whole, absolute; extremely, badly, totally, entirely, highly, completely, absolutely; integrity, entirety
words.translation: 满的；完全的；完全的，完整的；满的，充满的；丰富的；完美的；丰满的；详尽的；十分，非常；完全地；整整；全部；完整

examples.en: The train was completely full.
examples.zh: 火车坐得满满的。

examples.en: Don’t talk with your mouth full.
examples.zh: 嘴里塞满东西时不要说话。

examples.en: The class is full, but you can register for next term.
examples.zh: 这个班已经满了，不过你可以注册下学期的。

words.definition: an experience or activity that is very enjoyable and exciting; joke, joy, sport, sweet, enjoyment; fool, kid around, to play a joke, to joke
words.translation: 乐趣，娱乐；玩笑；乐趣；有趣的人或事；开玩笑

examples.en: There’s plenty of fun for all the family.
examples.zh: 可以让全家人玩得很开心。

examples.en: The children were having so much fun, I hated to call them inside.
examples.zh: 小孩子玩得很开心，我不忍心把他们叫进来。

words.definition: relating to the most basic and important parts of something; elementary, basic, essential, organic, primary; basic principle, ultimate, rationale
words.translation: 基础的，基本的；基本的，根本的；基本原理；基本原则

examples.en: We have to tackle the fundamental cause of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们必须解决问题的根本原因。

examples.en: the fundamental principles of liberty and equality
examples.zh: 自由和平等这两个基本原则

words.definition: a religious ceremony for burying or  cremating (= burning )  someone who has died; obsequies, interment; sepulchral
words.translation: 葬礼，丧礼，丧葬；葬礼；麻烦事；丧葬的，出殡的

examples.en: The funeral will be held at St. Martin’s Church.
examples.zh: 葬礼将在圣马丁教堂举行。

examples.en: Hundreds of mourners attended the funeral of the two boys.
examples.zh: 数百名哀悼者参加了那两个男孩的葬礼。

examples.en: the minister who conducted the funeral service
examples.zh: 主持葬礼的牧师

words.definition: making you laugh; colorful, fantastic; comedian
words.translation: 古怪的；滑稽的；有趣的；奇异的；滑稽人物

examples.en: the funniest man in Britain
examples.zh: 英国最滑稽的男人

examples.en: If this is your idea of a joke, I don’t find it at all funny .
examples.zh: 如果你觉得这是个玩笑，那我认为它一点也不好笑。

examples.en: Luckily, when I explained the situation, he saw the funny side (= recognized that it was partly funny ) .
examples.zh: 好在我把情况解释了以后，他看到了好笑的一面。

words.definition: the thick soft hair that covers the bodies of some animals, such as cats, dogs, and rabbits; down, tegument
words.translation: 软毛；毛皮，裘皮；皮，皮子；[皮革]毛皮

examples.en: a fur coat
examples.zh: 裘皮大衣

words.definition: very angry; acute, stinging
words.translation: 狂怒的；狂暴的；激烈的；热烈兴奋的；喧闹的

examples.en: She was absolutely furious .
examples.zh: 她怒不可遏。

words.definition: a large container for a very hot fire, used to produce power, heat, or liquid metal; stove, burner
words.translation: 炉子，熔炉；鼓风炉；[炉窑]火炉，熔炉

words.definition: to supply or provide something; afford, prepare, serve, tender, lend
words.translation: 供应，提供；装备；提供；供应

examples.en: Will these finds furnish more information on prehistoric man?
examples.zh: 这些发现是否能提供更多有关史前人类的资料？

words.definition: large objects such as chairs, tables, beds, and cupboards
words.translation: 家具；装置，设备

examples.en: I helped him choose the furniture for his house.
examples.zh: 我帮他挑选房子里用的家具。

examples.en: I can’t think of a single piece of furniture in my house that I bought new.
examples.zh: 我想不出家里有哪件家具是新买的。

examples.en: office furniture
examples.zh: 办公室家具

words.definition: a greater distance, or beyond a particular place; more or additional; moreover, besides, also; farther; facilitate, promote, boost, improve
words.translation: 更远地；更远的；进一步地；而且；深一层的；促进，助长；增进

examples.en: They walked a little further.
examples.zh: 他们又往前走了一点。

examples.en: His hands moved further down her back.
examples.zh: 他的手在她背上继续往下滑。

examples.en: They’ve never been further south than San Diego.
examples.zh: 他们从没有到过比圣迭戈更往南的地方。

words.definition: in addition to what has already been said; moreover, besides, again, also, additionally
words.translation: 而且，此外；此外；而且

examples.en: He is old and unpopular. Furthermore, he has at best only two years of political life ahead of him.
examples.zh: 他年纪已老，又不得人心，而且他最多也只有两年的政治生命了。

words.definition: what someone or something will do or what will happen to them in the future; tomorrow, prospect; prospective, ulterior
words.translation: 将来，未来；前途；未来；期货；将来时；将来的，未来的

examples.en: The islands should have the right to decide their own future.
examples.zh: 这些岛屿应当有权决定自己的未来。

examples.en: a leader who will shape the organization’s future
examples.zh: 将决定该组织未来的一位领导者

words.definition: to obtain or achieve something you want or need; an advantage or improvement, especially one achieved by planning or effort; enhancement, increase, profit, margin, harvest; acquire, earn, enhance, buy, score; improve, advantage, accelerate, grow in
words.translation: 获得；增加；增进；利润；收获；赚到；获利

examples.en: After gaining independence in 1957, it was renamed ‘Ghana’.
examples.zh: 1957年获得独立后，该国改名为“加纳”。

words.definition: a unit for measuring liquids, equal to eight pints. In Britain this is 4.55 litres, and in the US it is 3.79 litres.; gal
words.translation: 加仑；加仑（容量单位）

examples.en: a 20 gallon fish tank
examples.zh: 一个20加仑的鱼缸

examples.en: The car does about 50 miles per gallon.
examples.zh: 这辆车每加仑油能开50英里左右。

words.definition: a children’s activity in which they play with toys, pretend to be someone else etc; competition, play, sport, tournament, match; brave, stronghearted; gamble, shake the elbows
words.translation: 游戏；比赛；猎物；勇敢的；赌博

examples.en: The boys were playing a game in the backyard.
examples.zh: 男孩们在后院里玩游戏。

words.definition: a group of criminals who work together; cluster, bunch, qun
words.translation: 一帮，一伙；群；一伙；一组

examples.en: Several gangs were operating in the area.
examples.zh: 有好几个犯罪团伙在这个地区活动。

examples.en: Armed gangs have hijacked lorries.
examples.zh: 武装犯罪团伙劫持了卡车。

words.definition: waste material, such as paper, empty containers, and food thrown away; refuse, waste, junk, rubbish, trash
words.translation: 垃圾，污物，废料；[环境]垃圾；废物

examples.en: Can you take out the garbage when you go?
examples.zh: 你走的时候把垃圾带出去好吗？

words.definition: the area of land next to a house, where there are flowers, grass, and other plants, and often a place for people to sit; taman, bagh
words.translation: 花园，菜园；公园；[建]花园；菜园

examples.en: He’s outside in the garden.
examples.zh: 他在外面花园里。

examples.en: Grace brought us some flowers from her garden.
examples.zh: 格雷丝给我们送来一些她花园里的花。

words.definition: someone whose job is to work in gardens; groundskeeper, horticulturist
words.translation: 园丁，花匠；园丁；花匠；园艺家

examples.en: She employed a gardener.
examples.zh: 她雇了一个园丁。

words.definition: a substance such as air, which is not solid or liquid, and usually cannot be seen; gasoline, wase; oil, to fill the tank; to fill the tank, Pump It
words.translation: 煤气；气体；汽油；[矿业]瓦斯；毒气；加油；毒（死）；放出气体；空谈

examples.en: hydrogen gas
examples.zh: 氢气

words.definition: like gas or in the form of gas; gasiform, gassy
words.translation: 气体的，气态的；[物]气态的，气体的；无实质的

examples.en: Freon exists both in liquid and gaseous states.
examples.zh: 氟利昂既有液态也有气态。

words.definition: a liquid obtained from petroleum, used mainly for producing power in the engines of cars, trucks etc; gas, benzine
words.translation: (美)汽油；[油气]汽油

examples.en: A gasoline engine drives the motorboat.
examples.zh: 汽油引擎推动汽船。

examples.en: No cars in Brazil run on pure gasoline anymore. The government requires that all vehicles run on blended fuel of about one-quarter ethanol.
examples.zh: 如今巴西不再使用单纯靠汽油驱动的汽车，政府要求所有机动车均采用含四分之一乙醇的混合燃料。

words.definition: blow, rare; puff out; broken wind, pursiness
words.translation: 气喘，喘息；喘气；喘息；渴望；气喘吁吁地说；喘着气说话

examples.en: ‘My leg!’ he gasped. ‘I think it’s broken!’
examples.zh: “我的腿！”他倒抽一口气喊道，“我觉得腿断了！”

words.definition: the part of a fence or outside wall that you can open and close so that you can enter or leave a place; portal, main entrance
words.translation: 大门；篱笆门；[建]大门；出入口；门道

examples.en: We went through the gate into the orchard.
examples.zh: 我们穿过大门进了果园。

examples.en: the wrought-iron gates of the palace
examples.zh: 宫殿的锻铁大门

words.definition: to come together and form a group, or to make people do this; crop, harvest; concentrate, collect, mass, crowd; collection, clustering
words.translation: 聚集；集合vt收集；收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起；化脓；皱起；衣褶；收获量

examples.en: A crowd gathered to watch the fight.
examples.zh: 一群人聚拢来围观打架。

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered outside the embassy.
examples.zh: 大使馆外面聚集了数千人。

examples.en: During the air raids, we gathered the children around us and sang songs.
examples.zh: 空袭期间，我们把孩子们聚集在身边唱歌。

words.definition: to measure or calculate something by using a particular instrument or method; an instrument for measuring the size or amount of something; batcher, measuring chamber; sound, scale, estimate
words.translation: 量，测量；量器；计量器；标准尺寸；容量规格；测量；估计；给…定规格

examples.en: The thermostat will gauge the temperature and control the heat.
examples.zh: 恒温器可测量温度并控制热量。

words.definition: bright or attractive; festival, cheerful, enjoyable; homosexual person, homophile
words.translation: 快乐的；鲜明的；放荡的；艳丽的；同性恋者

examples.en: gay colours
examples.zh: 鲜艳的色彩

words.definition: to look at someone or something for a long time, giving it all your attention, often without realizing you are doing so; watch, regard; regard, immediate attention
words.translation: 凝视，盯，注视；凝视；注视

examples.en: Patrick sat gazing into space  (= looking straight in front, not at any particular person or thing ).
examples.zh: 帕特里克坐着，茫然地看着前方。

words.definition: involving the whole of a situation, group, or thing, rather than specific parts of it; ordinary, integrated, synthetic, comprehensive, average; strategos, aga
words.translation: 总的；一般的n将军；一般的，普通的；综合的；大体的；一般；将军，上将；常规

examples.en: There has been a general decline in standards.
examples.zh: 道德水准普遍下降。

examples.en: ways to improve your general health
examples.zh: 全面提高身体素质的方法

words.definition: used to introduce a statement that is true in most cases but not always; usually, mostly, commonly, currently, normally
words.translation: 一般地；通常地；通常；普遍地，一般地

examples.en: Generally speaking, the more expensive the stereo, the better it is.
examples.zh: 一般说来，立体声音响越贵的越好。

words.definition: a machine that produces electricity; producer, electrical machine
words.translation: 发电机；发生者；[电]发电机；[计][制冷]发生器；生产者

examples.en: an emergency generator
examples.zh: 应急发电机

words.definition: a very high level of intelligence, mental skill, or ability, which only a few people have; energy, gift, spirit, soul, mind
words.translation: 天才，天赋，天资；天才，天赋；精神

examples.en: The film reveals Fellini’s genius.
examples.zh: 这部影片展现了费里尼的天赋。

examples.en: a work of pure genius
examples.zh: 天才之作

words.definition: kind and careful in the way you behave or do things, so that you do not hurt or damage anyone or anything; pacific, moderate, soft, mild, temperate; soften, milden; grubworm, maggot
words.translation: 和蔼的；轻柔的；温和的；文雅的；使温和，使驯服；蛆，饵

examples.en: Arthur was a very gentle, caring person.
examples.zh: 阿瑟是一个非常温柔体贴的人。

words.definition: a man who is always polite, has good manners, and treats other people well; sir, don, Mister, Monsieur
words.translation: 绅士；有教养的人；先生；有身分的人

examples.en: Martin – always the perfect gentleman – got to his feet when my mother walked in.
examples.zh: 马丁在我母亲进来时站了起来——他一向是十足的绅士派头。

examples.en: Mr Field was a real gentleman .
examples.zh: 菲尔德先生是位真正的君子。

words.definition: in a gentle way; lightly, friendly, soft
words.translation: 有礼貌地；柔和地；轻轻地；温柔地，温和地

examples.en: ‘You go back to bed now,’ he said gently.
examples.zh: “你回去睡觉吧。”他温柔地说道。

examples.en: She kissed me gently on the cheek.
examples.zh: 她温柔地亲吻我的脸颊。

examples.en: Gently cook the peppers for 10-15 minutes.
examples.zh: 用文火将辣椒煮10到15分钟。

words.definition: the study of the countries, oceans, rivers, mountains, cities etc of the world; terrain, landform
words.translation: 地理，地理学；[地理]地理；地形

examples.en: a geography lesson
examples.zh: 地理课

words.definition: the study in  mathematics  of the angles and shapes formed by the relationships of lines, surfaces, and solid objects in space
words.translation: 几何，几何学

examples.en: ...the very ordered way in which mathematics and geometry describe nature.
examples.zh: …数学和几何学描述自然的条理性。

words.definition: a very small living thing that can make you ill; seed, plantule; burgeon, spring up
words.translation: 微生物，细菌，幼芽；[植]胚芽，萌芽；[微]细菌；萌芽

examples.en: Put disinfectant down the toilet to kill any germs.
examples.zh: 在抽水马桶里投放消毒剂杀菌。

words.definition: relating to Germany, its people, or its language; someone from Germany
words.translation: 德国的；德国人

examples.en: German history
examples.zh: 德国历史

words.translation: 德意志，德国

words.definition: to obtain something by finding it, asking for it, or paying for it; acquire, make, earn, buy, find; generation, reproduction; become, land
words.translation: 变得，成为；到达；使得；获得；受到；变成；生殖；幼兽；成为；变得

examples.en: We need to get help quickly!
examples.zh: 我们需要马上得到帮助！

examples.en: It would be a good idea to get professional advice.
examples.zh: 征求专业人士的意见，这个主意很好。

examples.en: You may be able to get a grant from the local authority.
examples.zh: 你也许可以从当地政府获得拨款。

words.definition: the spirit of a dead person that some people think they can feel or see in a place; shadow, jumbie
words.translation: 鬼，灵魂；鬼魂；鬼，幽灵

examples.en: They say the young girl’s ghost still haunts (= often appears in ) the house.
examples.zh: 他们说那个少女的鬼魂依旧在那房子里出没。

examples.en: He looked as if he’d seen a ghost (= he looked very frightened ) .
examples.zh: 他看上去像见到了鬼似的。

words.definition: an extremely tall strong man, who is often bad and cruel, in children’s stories; Titan, jotun; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
words.translation: 巨人；巨物；伟人；[植][动]巨大的动物；[动]巨大的；巨人般的

examples.en: ...a Nordic saga of giants.
examples.zh: …一部关于巨人的北欧传奇。

words.definition: a female child; daughter, bride
words.translation: 女孩子，姑娘；女儿；女孩，姑娘；女朋友

examples.en: Both boys and girls can apply to join the choir.
examples.zh: 男孩和女孩均可申请加入合唱团。

examples.en: Girls! Please be quiet.
examples.zh: 姑娘们！请安静。

examples.en: a teenage girl
examples.zh: 十几岁的女孩

words.definition: to let someone have something as a present, or to provide something for someone; award, effect, form, grant, inspire; flexibility, curve, elasticity; look, make a contribution to
words.translation: 做，作；送给；给；产生；让步；举办；授予；弹性；弯曲；伸展性；捐赠；面向；有弹性；气候转暖

examples.en: Researchers were given a £10,000 grant to continue their work.
examples.zh: 研究人员得到一万英镑的经费以继续他们的研究。

examples.en: I’ve got some old diaries that my grandmother gave me years ago.
examples.zh: 我有几本旧日记本，是多年前祖母给我的。

examples.en: I didn’t steal it! Maria gave it to me!
examples.zh: 我不是偷的！是玛丽亚给我的！

words.definition: pleased and happy about something; happy, pleased, willing, delighted; pleasure, satisfy
words.translation: 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的；使高兴

examples.en: We’re so glad you came.
examples.zh: 你来了我们真高兴。

examples.en: ‘I’ve decided to accept the job.’ ‘I’m glad.’
examples.zh: “我决定接受这份工作。”“我很高兴。”

words.definition: to quickly look at someone or something; a quick look; dekko, shufti; run one's eyes over, catch a glimpse of
words.translation: 看一下；一瞥；一滑；闪光；扫视，匆匆一看；反光；瞥闪，瞥见；扫视；瞥见；擦过

examples.en: Wyatt glanced around the restaurant.
examples.zh: 怀亚特环视了一下餐馆。

examples.en: Emily glanced over her shoulder.
examples.zh: 埃米莉回头看了一眼。

words.definition: to shine with a very strong bright light which hurts your eyes; a bright unpleasant light which hurts your eyes; dazzle
words.translation: 瞪眼；刺眼；[光]耀眼的光；受公众注目

examples.en: The sun glared down on us.
examples.zh: 刺眼的阳光照在我们身上。

words.definition: a transparent solid substance used for making windows, bottles etc; mirror, vitrum; image, to reflect
words.translation: 玻璃；玻璃杯；[玻璃]玻璃；玻璃制品；镜子；反映；给某物加玻璃

examples.en: a glass bowl
examples.zh: 玻璃碗

examples.en: a piece of broken glass
examples.zh: 一块碎玻璃片

examples.en: the cathedral’s stained glass windows
examples.zh: 教堂的彩色玻璃窗

words.definition: to move smoothly and quietly, as if without effort; a smooth quiet movement that seems to take no effort; slippage, portamento; ebb away
words.translation: 滑动；消逝；滑行；滑翔；滑移；滑音；悄悄地走

examples.en: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
examples.zh: 侍者们托着一盘盘的意大利面食在拥挤的餐桌间自如穿行。

words.definition: to see someone or something for a moment without getting a complete view of them; a quick look at someone or something that does not allow you to see them clearly; glance, dekko; catch sight of
words.translation: 瞥见；一瞥，一看

examples.en: I glimpsed a figure at the window.
examples.zh: 我瞥见窗前有个身影。

words.definition: to shine brightly with flashing points of light; brightness consisting of many flashing points of light; flare light, lightning flash; stroboflash, coruscation
words.translation: 闪闪发光；闪光；[光]闪光；闪烁；灿烂

examples.en: The river glittered in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 阳光下河面波光粼粼。

words.definition: a round object with a map of the Earth drawn on it; this earthly round, terra; sphere; conglobate
words.translation: 地球，世界；地界仪；[天]地球；地球仪；球体；使…成球形；成球状

examples.en: We export our goods all over the globe.

examples.zh: 刺激经济增长的措施

words.definition: to protect a person, place, or object by staying near them and watching them; the act or duty of protecting places or people, or of preventing prisoners from escaping; vigilance, alertness; keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled; watching, shield
words.translation: 守卫；看守；卫兵；警戒；护卫队；[安全]防护装置；警惕；保卫；监视

examples.en: The Sergeant told Swift to guard the entrance.
examples.zh: 中士叫斯威夫特守着入口。

examples.en: a lioness guarding her cubs
examples.zh: 守护着幼狮的母狮

words.definition: to try to answer a question or form an opinion when you are not sure whether you will be correct; expect, count, find, feel, make; speculate; speculation, theory, projection
words.translation: 猜测，推测；猜测；认为；推测；猜中；猜

examples.en: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
examples.zh: 我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。

examples.en: What star sign are you? No, let me guess .
examples.zh: 你是什么星座的？别说，让我来猜猜看。

words.definition: someone who is invited to an event or special occasion; customer, client, consumer; serve, invite, attend; board, stay over
words.translation: 客人，宾客；旅客；客人，[经]宾客；顾客；款待，招待；作客，寄宿

examples.en: a banquet for 250 distinguished guests
examples.zh: 250位贵宾出席的宴会

examples.en: Among the invited guests were Jerry Brown and Elihu Harris.
examples.zh: 受邀的嘉宾中有杰里·布朗和伊莱休·哈里斯。

examples.en: The actress was guest of honour (= the most important guest ) at the launch.
examples.zh: 这位女演员是首发式上的贵宾。

words.definition: help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life; direction, aiming, lead, steering
words.translation: 引导，指导，领导；指导，引导；领导

examples.en: a missile with a sophisticated electronic guidance system
examples.zh: 有精密电子制导系统的导弹

words.definition: someone whose job is to take tourists to a place and show them around; If you guide someone around a city, museum, or building, you show it to them and explain points of interest; manual, enchiridion; aim, man
words.translation: 导游者；给…导游；指南；向导；入门书；[计]引导；带领；操纵

examples.en: a tour guide
examples.zh: 导游

examples.en: an experienced mountain guide
examples.zh: 一位有经验的登山向导

examples.en: ...a young Egyptologist who guided us through tombs and temples with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: …一位热心地领着我们参观陵墓和寺庙的年轻的埃及学家。

words.definition: feeling very ashamed and sad because you know that you have done something wrong; sinful, culpable
words.translation: 内疚的；有罪的

examples.en: She looked self-conscious and guilty.
examples.zh: 她看上去很不自然，很内疚的样子。

examples.en: It was his guilty conscience that made him offer to help.
examples.zh: 他是因为良心上过意不去才提出帮忙的。

words.definition: a large area of sea partly enclosed by land; bay, deep, variance; engulf, swallow
words.translation: 海湾；[地理]海湾；深渊；分歧；漩涡；吞没

examples.en: the Gulf of Mexico
examples.zh: 墨西哥湾

words.definition: a metal weapon which shoots bullets or  shells; gunman, rodman
words.translation: 枪，炮，手枪；枪枝；枪状物；持枪歹徒

examples.en: I’ve never fired a gun in my life.
examples.zh: 我这辈子从来没开过枪。

examples.en: Jake was pointing a gun at the door.
examples.zh: 杰克用枪对着门口。

examples.en: Two policemen were killed in a gun battle .
examples.zh: 两名警察在一次枪战中丧生。

words.definition: an explosive substance used in bombs and  fireworks; powder
words.translation: 黑色火药；有烟火药；[军]火药

words.definition: a  gym; gym, sports palace
words.translation: 体育馆，健身房；体育馆；健身房

examples.en: I have found a new gymnasium.
examples.zh: 我找到一个新的健身房。

examples.en: The next day, the arsonist was arrested at a gymnasium.
examples.zh: 第二天，纵火犯在一家体育馆被逮捕了。

examples.en: After computer printers and duffle bags had been carried to dorm rooms, everyone gathered in the gymnasium, students on one side of the bleachers, parents on the other.
examples.zh: 电脑打印机和行李包都运进了宿舍之后，所有人都到学校的体育馆集合，学生在露天看台的一侧，家长们在另一侧。

words.definition: something that you do regularly or usually, often without thinking about it because you have done it so many times before; manner, custom, behaviour, weakness, way; attire
words.translation: 习惯；习性；习惯，[生物]习性；嗜好；使穿衣

examples.en: Regular exercise is a good habit.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼是个好习惯。

examples.en: Thinking negatively can become a habit.
examples.zh: 消极的思维方式会成为一种习惯。

examples.en: She has a habit of playing with her hair when she’s nervous.
examples.zh: 她有一个习惯，一紧张就拨弄自己的头发。

words.definition: doing something from habit, and unable to stop doing it; used, frequent, confirmed
words.translation: 习惯性的，惯常的；习惯的；惯常的；习以为常的

examples.en: James took his habitual morning walk around the garden.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯又像往常习惯的那样绕花园作晨间散步去了。

words.definition: the mass of things like fine threads that grows on your head; capello, poil; pilar
words.translation: 头发，毛发；毛；头发；[解剖]毛发；些微；[解剖]毛发的；护理毛发的；用毛发制成的

examples.en: Her hair was short and dark.
examples.zh: 她的头发又短又黑。

examples.en: a short fat man with no hair on his head
examples.zh: 光头的矮胖男人

words.definition: when you have a haircut, someone cuts your hair for you; frisure, hair style
words.translation: 理发；发型

examples.en: Do you like my new haircut?
examples.zh: 你喜欢我的新发型吗？

words.definition: exactly or about 50% (1/2) of an amount, time, distance, number etc; Half is also an adjective; moiety; partly; incomplete, synsemantic
words.translation: 半，一半；一半的；一半；半场；半学年；一半地；部分地；不完全的；半途的

examples.en: Only half the guests had arrived by seven o’clock.
examples.zh: 7点钟前只来了一半客人。

examples.en: If you look at our members, at least half are women.
examples.zh: 看看我们的会员，至少有一半是女性。

examples.en: ...a half measure of fresh lemon juice.
examples.zh: …半量杯的新鲜柠檬汁。

words.definition: the area just inside the door of a house or other building, that leads to other rooms; passage, corridor
words.translation: 门厅；过道；会堂；门厅，走廊；[建]会堂；食堂；学生宿舍

examples.en: a huge tiled entrance hall
examples.zh: 铺着地砖的大门厅

words.definition: to prevent someone or something from continuing - used especially in news reports; a stop or pause; desist from, come to a stop; break, stop, rest, stay, stand; put a stop to
words.translation: 停止；立定；停住；踌躇，犹豫；休息；使停止；使立定

examples.en: The government has failed to halt economic decline.
examples.zh: 政府没能阻止经济衰退。

examples.en: Safety concerns have led them to halt work on the dam.
examples.zh: 出于安全方面的顾虑，他们已经停止水坝的施工。

words.definition: a flat round piece of finely cut beef(= meat from a cow ) which is cooked and eaten in a bread bun; burger, beefburger
words.translation: 汉堡包，牛肉饼；汉堡包，汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉

examples.en: The whole stadium stink of the hamburger.
examples.zh: 整个体育场内散发着汉堡包的香味。

examples.en: 'Why go out for hamburger when you have steak at home?' he once remarked.
examples.zh: 纽曼曾经说道，“如果家里有了牛排，为什么要出去找汉堡？”

examples.en: I order a soda and a hamburger for myself. Then another person gets coffee for me.
examples.zh: 嗯， 我为自己点了一杯苏打和一个汉堡包， 然后另外一人给我拿了杯咖啡。

words.definition: the part of a gun that hits the explosive charge that fires a bullet; to hit something with a hammer in order to force it into a particular position or shape; read back; tupid, malleus
words.translation: 锤，榔头；锤击；敲打；重复；铁锤；链球；[解剖]锤骨；音锤

examples.en: I had no hammer,so I had to pound the nail in with a stone.
examples.zh: 我没有锤子，所以只得用石头把钉子敲进去。

words.definition: the part of your body at the end of your arm, including your fingers and thumb, that you use to hold things; assistance, craft, aid, index, finger; encourage, carry, second, back, transfer
words.translation: 手；人手；指针；[解剖]手，手艺；帮助；插手；传递，交给；支持；搀扶

examples.en: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

examples.en: In her hand was a tattered old photograph.
examples.zh: 她手中拿着的是一张破旧的老照片。

words.definition: an amount that you can hold in your hand; fewness, the minority
words.translation: 一把；少数，一小撮；少数；棘手事

examples.en: There were only a handful of people there.
examples.zh: 那里只有几个人。

words.definition: a piece of cloth that you use for drying your nose or eyes; hanky, noserag
words.translation: 手帕；头巾，围巾

examples.en: He flicked at spot with handkerchief.
examples.zh: 他轻轻地用手帕拂拭污点。

examples.en: She waved away his offer of the handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她挥手拒绝了他递过来的手帕。

examples.en: Before sweeping the house she bound up her hair in a large handkerchief.
examples.zh: 打扫房屋前， 她把头发用一块大手帕扎起来。

words.definition: a handsome victory is important and impressive; generous, liberal
words.translation: 英俊的；相当大的；（男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的

examples.en: They won a handsome victory in the elections.
examples.zh: 他们在选举中取得了重大的胜利。

words.definition: the style of someone’s writing; writing, calligraphy
words.translation: 笔迹，手迹，书法；[法]笔迹；书法；书写；手稿

examples.en: I recognised her handwriting on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我认出了信封上她的笔迹。

examples.en: My handwriting has never been very neat.
examples.zh: 我的字从来都写得不够工整。

words.definition: useful; sharp, quick, smart, keen, fly
words.translation: 手边的；便于使用的；便利的；手边的，就近的；[水运]容易取得的；敏捷的

examples.en: It’s quite a handy little tool.
examples.zh: 这件小工具非常有用。

examples.en: It’s very handy having a light above your desk.
examples.zh: 书桌上方有盏灯很有用。

examples.en: Take your swimming trunks with you – they might come in handy (= be useful ).
examples.zh: 带上你的游泳裤，可能会派上用场的。

words.definition: to kill someone by dropping them with a rope around their neck, or to die in this way, especially as a punishment for a serious crime; paint, swing from; trail; moratorium, pause
words.translation: 挂，悬；吊死；悬挂，垂下；装饰；绞死；使悬而未决；悬着，垂下；被绞死；悬而不决；悬挂；暂停，中止

examples.en: If he is found guilty, he will almost certainly hang.
examples.zh: 如果被判有罪，他几乎肯定会被处以绞刑。

words.definition: when something happens, there is an event, especially one that is not planned; occur, proceed, chance
words.translation: 发生；碰巧，恰好；碰巧；偶然遇到

examples.en: When did the accident happen?
examples.zh: 事故什么时候发生的？

examples.en: It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
examples.zh: 不可能预测接下来会发生什么。

examples.en: She carried on as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 她继续干，似乎什么都未曾发生。

words.definition: the state of being happy; welfare, xingfu, eudemonia
words.translation: 幸福，幸运；快乐；幸福

examples.en: Juliet’s eyes shone with happiness.
examples.zh: 朱丽叶的双眼闪耀着幸福的光芒。

examples.en: We want our children to have the best possible chance of happiness.
examples.zh: 我们希望自己的孩子得到追求幸福的最佳机会。

words.definition: having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life; pleased, glad, blessed, smart
words.translation: 快乐的；幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的

examples.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
examples.zh: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

examples.en: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
examples.zh: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

examples.en: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
examples.zh: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

words.definition: an area of water next to the land where the water is calm, so that ships are safe when they are inside it; to protect and hide criminals that the police are searching for; secrete; haven, home
words.translation: 海港，港口；庇护；藏匿；入港停泊；海港（等于harbor）；避难所

examples.en: as they sailed into Portsmouth Harbour
examples.zh: 当他们驶入朴次茅斯港的时候

words.definition: firm, stiff, and difficult to press down, break, or cut; difficult, severe, fierce, tight, violent; closely, heavily, strong
words.translation: 硬的；困难的；努力的；辛苦的；[医]确实的；严厉的；猛烈的；冷酷无情的；努力地；困难地；辛苦地；接近地；猛烈地；牢固地

examples.en: a hard wooden chair
examples.zh: 一把硬木椅

examples.en: the hardest substance known to man
examples.zh: 已知的最硬物质

examples.en: After months without rain, the ground was too hard to plough.
examples.zh: 数月无雨，土地坚硬难犁。

words.definition: to become firm or stiff, or to make something firm or stiff; stiffen
words.translation: 使变硬；变硬；变硬，变坚固；变坚强；变冷酷

examples.en: It will take about 24 hours for the glue to harden.
examples.zh: 胶水干透大约需要24小时。

words.definition: almost not; just, ill, fresh, scarcely, barely
words.translation: 几乎不，简直不；刚刚

examples.en: My parents divorced when I was six, and I hardly knew my father.
examples.zh: 我六岁时父母离婚，我对父亲几乎一无所知。

examples.en: The children were so excited they could hardly speak.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴奋得几乎连话都说不出来了。

examples.en: I can hardly believe it.
examples.zh: 这简直让我难以置信。

words.definition: something that makes your life difficult or unpleasant, especially a lack of money, or the condition of having a difficult life; affliction, bitterness
words.translation: 艰难，困苦；困苦；苦难；艰难险阻

examples.en: an economic policy that caused great hardship for many people
examples.zh: 造成许多人贫困的经济政策

examples.en: Many students are suffering severe financial hardship.
examples.zh: 许多学生经济非常困难。

words.definition: computer machinery and equipment, as opposed to the programs that make computers work; brightwork
words.translation: 五金器具；硬件；计算机硬件

examples.en: ...a shop from which an uncle had sold hardware and timber.
examples.zh: …一家叔叔曾经在那里卖五金器具和木材的店铺。

words.definition: an animal like a rabbit but larger, which can run very quickly; rabbit, klipdas
words.translation: 野兔；[脊椎]野兔

examples.en: Because it makes its home in an extreme environment, the desert hare is biologically designed to radiate excess heat through its lanky limbs and oversized ears.
examples.zh: 因为生长在极端环境中，沙漠兔子形成了独特的生物学构造，通过瘦长的四肢和超大的耳朵辐射多余的热量。

examples.en: He found the shin-bone of a hare lying on the grass.
examples.zh: 他在草地上发现一根野兔的胫骨，骨头上有个洞；

words.definition: a set of leather bands used to control a horse or to attach it to a vehicle it is pulling; keep on top; saddlery, coat of mail
words.translation: 治理；马具，挽具；套；驾驭；披上甲胄；马具；甲胄；挽具状带子；降落伞背带

examples.en: We must harness the rivers which overflow annually.
examples.zh: 我们必须治理那些每年泛滥的河流。

words.definition: hurry, hasty indeed; hurry, rush; hurry up, get a move on, shake it up, snap it up
words.translation: 急速，急忙；草率；匆忙；急忙；轻率；赶紧；赶快

examples.en: I soon regretted my haste.
examples.zh: 我很快就对自己的仓促感到后悔。

words.definition: to make something happen faster or sooner; crowd, soup; hurry up, get a move on
words.translation: 催促；赶紧；加速；使赶紧；赶快；急忙

examples.en: Their departure was hastened by an abnormally cold winter.
examples.zh: 那个冬天异常寒冷，所以他们提前走了。

words.definition: done in a hurry, especially with bad results; brief, rushed
words.translation: 急速的；仓促的；轻率的；匆忙的；草率的；性怠的

examples.en: He soon regretted his hasty decision.
examples.zh: 他很快就对自己仓促作出的决定感到后悔了。

examples.en: a hasty breakfast
examples.zh: 匆忙吃下的一顿早餐

words.definition: a piece of clothing that you wear on your head; cap, chapeau, titfer
words.translation: 帽子(一般指有边的)；帽子

examples.en: Maria was wearing a beautiful new hat.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚戴着一顶漂亮的新帽子。

words.definition: if an egg hatches, or if it is hatched, it breaks, letting the young bird, insect etc come out; incubation; engineer, scheme; incubate
words.translation: 孵出；(蛋)孵化；孵化；[船][航]舱口；[动]孵；策划

examples.en: The eggs take three days to hatch.
examples.zh: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

words.definition: to dislike something very much; detest, turn away from; despite, hatred
words.translation: 恨，憎恨；不喜欢；憎恨；厌恶；遗憾；反感

examples.en: It’s the kind of movie you either love or hate.
examples.zh: 这是那种你要么喜欢要么讨厌的电影。

examples.en: He hates his job.
examples.zh: 他讨厌自己的工作。

words.definition: very bad, unpleasant, or unkind; detestable, blanky
words.translation: 可恨的，可恶的；可憎的；可恨的；可恶的

examples.en: It was all the fault of that hateful man!
examples.zh: 都是那个可恶的人造的孽！

words.definition: an angry feeling of extreme dislike for someone or something; hate, despite, spite
words.translation: 憎恶，憎恨，仇恨；憎恨；怨恨；敌意

examples.en: A look of pure hatred flashed across her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上闪过十足的仇恨表情。

examples.en: the old hatreds and prejudices that simmered below the surface
examples.zh: 长久以来憋在心中的仇恨与偏见

words.definition: used with past participles to form perfect tenses; undertake, let, pursue, address, carry
words.translation: aux已经；有；吃；让；拿；从事；允许

examples.en: Our guests have arrived.
examples.zh: 我们的客人到了。

examples.en: Has anyone phoned?
examples.zh: 有人打过电话来吗？

examples.en: We’ve been spending too much money.
examples.zh: 我们已经花掉太多钱了。

words.definition: a large bird that hunts and eats small birds and animals; tout, cough up; have a cough; eagle
words.translation: 鹰，隼；兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出；清嗓；咳嗽；像鹰一般地袭击；[鸟]鹰；鹰派成员；掠夺他人的人

words.definition: long grass that has been cut and dried, used as food for cattle; hey, stover
words.translation: 干草

examples.en: ...bales of hay.
examples.zh: …一捆捆的干草。

words.definition: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about; boy, guy, man, jack, male
words.translation: (主格)他；男孩，男人；它（雄性动物）

examples.en: ‘Where’s Paul?’ ‘He’s gone to the cinema.’
examples.zh: “保罗在哪儿？”“他去看电影了。”

examples.en: It was he who first suggested the idea.
examples.zh: 是他先提出这个想法的。

words.definition: the top part of your body that has your face at the front and is supported by your neck; to be in charge of a team, government, organization etc; intelligence, understanding; to go forward, make one's way; leave, set out; primary, major, central, leading, great
words.translation: 头；上端；率领；[解剖]头；头痛；最前的部分；理解力；前进；用头顶；作为…的首领；站在…的前头；给…加标题；出发；成头状物；船驶往；头的；主要的；在顶端的

examples.en: He kissed the top of her head.
examples.zh: 他吻了一下她的头顶。

examples.en: Alan fell asleep as soon as he put his head on the pillow.
examples.zh: 艾伦头一挨枕头就睡着了。

examples.en: They dived head first into the water.
examples.zh: 他们一头跳进水中。

words.definition: a pain in your head; trouble, cephalalgia
