words.definition: having an empty space inside; empty, artificial, false, bare, vacant; hole, cavity; cavitate; thoroughly, entirely, completely, fully, tight
words.translation: 空的；空洞的；中空的，空腹的；凹的；虚伪的；洞；山谷；窟窿；形成空洞；彻底地；无用地

examples.en: a hollow tree
examples.zh: 空心树

words.definition: connected with God and religion
words.translation: 神圣的；圣洁的

examples.en: the holy city of Varanasi
examples.zh: 圣城瓦拉纳西

words.definition: the house, apartment, or place where you live; relating to or belonging to your home or family; door, residence, haven, harbor, habitat; deep; domestic, valid, internal, available, effective, virtual
words.translation: 家；家乡；家庭的；家，住宅；产地；避难所；在家，回家；深入地；国内的，家庭的；有效的

examples.en: They have a beautiful home in California.
examples.zh: 他们在加州有个美丽的家。

examples.en: Good luck in your new home!
examples.zh: 祝你在新家一切顺利！

examples.en: A family of birds made their home (= started living ) under the roof.
examples.zh: 一窝鸟在屋顶下安了家。

words.definition: someone who is honest always tells the truth and does not cheat or steal; responsible, effective, transparent, reliable, tried
words.translation: 诚实的；可敬的；诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的

examples.en: He was a hard-working, honest man.
examples.zh: 他勤奋老实。

examples.en: Ann had an honest face.
examples.zh: 安有一张诚实的面孔。

words.definition: a sweet sticky substance produced by  bees  , used as food; sweet, mel; luscious, nectared; lick one's boots, make up to
words.translation: 蜜，蜂蜜；甜，甜蜜；[蜂]蜂蜜；宝贝；甜蜜；甘美的；蜂蜜似的；奉承；说甜言蜜语

words.definition: a holiday taken by two people who have just got married
words.translation: 蜜月

examples.en: By 1987, the honeymoon was over .
examples.zh: 到1987年，蜜月期已经过去。

words.definition: something that makes you feel very proud; glory, respect, medal, worship; accept, regard, esteem, worship
words.translation: 光荣；尊敬，敬意；荣誉；尊敬；勋章；[金融]承兑；承兑远期票据

examples.en: Over 100 players competed for the honour of representing the county in the National Finals.
examples.zh: 100多位选手为争取代表郡参加全国总决赛的荣誉进行角逐。

words.definition: an honourable action or activity deserves respect and admiration; straight, square, just
words.translation: 诚实的；光荣的；荣誉的；值得尊敬的；表示尊敬的；正直的

examples.en: My father didn’t think acting was an honorable profession.
examples.zh: 我父亲认为当演员不是受人尊敬的职业。

words.definition: a curved piece of metal or plastic that you use for hanging things on; to bend your finger, arm, or leg, especially so that you can pull or hold something else; towing eye, drawhook; hitch
words.translation: 钩，挂钩；钩住；挂钩，[机]吊钩；[口腔]引上钩

examples.en: Tom hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
examples.zh: 汤姆把外套挂在门后的衣钩上。

words.definition: to want something to happen or be true and to believe that it is possible or likely; wish, pleasure, confidence, promise, anticipation; want, desire to; rely, depend, expect, like, trust
words.translation: 希望；期望；信心；期待；信赖

examples.en: I do hope everything goes well.
examples.zh: 我真心希望一切顺利。

examples.en: It was hoped that the job would be filled by a local person.
examples.zh: 希望该职位由当地人来担任。

examples.en: Let’s just hope someone finds her bag.
examples.zh: 希望有人找到她的提包。

words.definition: believing that what you hope for is likely to happen; promising, likely
words.translation: 有希望的；有前途的

examples.en: The vote is a hopeful sign that attitudes in the church are changing.
examples.zh: 投票结果是个好兆头，表明教会的态度正在转变。

words.definition: if something that you try to do is hopeless, there is no possibility of it being successful; forlorn, broken-hearted
words.translation: 没有希望的，绝望的；绝望的；不可救药的

examples.en: We tried to stop the flames from spreading, but we knew it was hopeless.
examples.zh: 我们试图阻止火势蔓延，但我们知道这是不可能的。

examples.en: Getting your work published often seems a hopeless task .
examples.zh: 想让自己的作品出版似乎总是徒劳的。

examples.en: I kept on struggling forward, even though I knew it was hopeless .
examples.zh: 虽然知道无望，我还是奋力挣扎向前。

words.definition: the line far away where the land or sea seems to meet the sky; extent, boundary, region, spectrum, territory, area
words.translation: 地平线；眼界，见识；[天]地平线；视野；眼界；范围

examples.en: In the distance, the dot of a boat appeared on the horizon.
examples.zh: 远处小黑点般的一条小船出现在地平线上。

words.definition: flat and level; level, aclinic; hydrostatic level, horizon line
words.translation: 地平的；水平的；[测][天]水平的；地平线的；同一阶层的；[测]水平线，水平面；水平位置

examples.en: a horizontal surface
examples.zh: 水平面

words.definition: a container in the shape of an animal’s horn, used in the past for drinking from, carrying  gunpowder  etc; angle, hao
words.translation: 号角；警报器；角；[电子]喇叭，号角；[动]角

examples.en: A mature cow has horns.
examples.zh: 成年母牛头上长有角。

words.definition: when a situation or event is very unpleasant or shocking; fright, naupathia
words.translation: 恐怖；战栗；憎恶；惊骇；惨状；极端厌恶；令人恐怖的事物

examples.en: Dense smoke surrounded them, adding to the horror of the situation.
examples.zh: 浓烟包围了他们，情形变得更加恐怖。

examples.en: Only when the vehicle was lifted did the full horror of the accident become clear.
examples.zh: 当车辆被吊起来时才知道事故到底有多可怕。

words.definition: a large strong animal that people ride and use for pulling heavy things; prad, yarraman; play tricks on, play tricks with; ride
words.translation: 马；马科动物；[畜牧]马；骑兵；脚架；海洛因；使骑马；系马于；捉弄；骑马；作弄人

examples.en: a horse and cart
examples.zh: 一辆马车

examples.en: Lee had never ridden a horse before.
examples.zh: 李以前从未骑过马。

words.definition: a unit for measuring the power of an engine, or the power of an engine measured like this; soup
words.translation: 马力；马力（功率单位）

examples.en: a two-hundred horsepower engine
examples.zh: 两百马力的发动机

examples.en: the superior horsepower of a Volkswagen
examples.zh: 大众汽车的强劲动力

words.definition: a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment; infirmary
words.translation: 医院；[医]医院

examples.en: They are building a new hospital.
examples.zh: 他们正在建一家新医院。

words.definition: someone at a party, meal etc who has invited the guests and who provides the food, drink etc; lots of, sea, hundred, master, thousands of; to chair, preside over; pack, troop
words.translation: 主人；东道主；[计]主机；主持人；许多；主持；当主人招待；群集；做主人

examples.en: Our host greeted us at the door.
examples.zh: 主人在门口迎接我们。

words.definition: a woman at a party, meal etc who has invited all the guests and provides them with food, drink etc; goodwife, mistress
words.translation: 女主人；空姐；女主人，女老板；女服务员；舞女；女房东

examples.en: The hostess introduced them.
examples.zh: 女主人介绍了他们。

words.definition: angry and deliberately unfriendly towards someone, and ready to argue with them; adverse, enemy, opposed; opposition, antagonism
words.translation: 敌方的；不友善的；敌对的，敌方的；怀敌意的；敌对

examples.en: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
examples.zh: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

examples.en: Carr wouldn’t meet Feng’s stare, which was openly hostile .
examples.zh: 卡尔不愿意面对冯公然敌视的目光。

examples.en: his hostile attitude
examples.zh: 他敌对的态度

words.definition: food that tastes hot has a burning taste because it contains strong spices; thermal, intense, excited, warm, tropical; enhance, boost, jack, mount, gain
words.translation: 热的；刺激的；辣的；[通信]热的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的；增加；给…加温

examples.en: a hot curry
examples.zh: 一种辛辣的咖喱

words.definition: a building where people pay to stay and eat meals; restaurant, inn
words.translation: 旅馆；旅馆，[经]饭店；客栈

examples.en: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
examples.zh: 我已订好机票和酒店。

examples.en: We’ll be staying at the Hotel Ibis.
examples.zh: 我们将住在宜必思酒店。

words.definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour, and 24 hours in one day.; period, stunde
words.translation: 小时；时间，时刻；钟头；课时；…点钟

examples.en: The interview will last about two hours.
examples.zh: 面试大概要持续两小时。

examples.en: I study for an hour every night.
examples.zh: 我每晚学习一小时。

examples.en: I’ll be back in three hours .
examples.zh: 我三小时以后回来。

words.definition: a company, especially one involved in a particular area of business; residence, organization, machinery, family, home; invest, sheet, roof, cap
words.translation: 房屋，住宅；商号；[建]住宅；家庭；机构；议会；某种用途的建筑物；覆盖；给…房子住；把…储藏在房内

examples.en: America’s oldest publishing house
examples.zh: 美国历史最悠久的出版社

examples.en: a small independent software house
examples.zh: 一家小型的独立软件公司

examples.en: an auction house
examples.zh: 一家拍卖行

words.definition: a married woman who works at home doing the cooking, cleaning etc, but does not have a job outside the house; materfamilias, frow
words.translation: 家庭主妇

examples.en: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
examples.zh: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

words.definition: used to ask or talk about the way in which something happens or is done; somewhat; way of, manner, method, mode, approach, system
words.translation: 怎么；怎样；多少；如何；多么；方法；方式

examples.en: How do you spell your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字怎么拼写？

examples.en: How can I help you?
examples.zh: 我怎么帮你？

examples.en: I’d like to help in some way, but I’m not sure how.
examples.zh: 我想帮点忙，可不知道该怎么做。

words.definition: used when you are adding a fact or piece of information that seems surprising, or seems very different from what you have just said; anyway, at all events; whereas, while, nevertheless, but, yet
words.translation: 然而；不管怎样；无论如何；可是

examples.en: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
examples.zh: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

examples.en: an extremely unpleasant disease that is, however, easy to treat
examples.zh: 一种让人极其难受却容易治疗的病

words.definition: extremely large in size, amount, or degree; enormous, tremendous, massive, macro, vast
words.translation: 巨大的，庞大的；巨大的；庞大的；无限的

examples.en: a huge dog
examples.zh: 一条大狗

examples.en: huge crowds
examples.zh: 大群大群的人

examples.en: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
examples.zh: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

words.definition: belonging to or relating to people, especially as opposed to machines or animals; a person; demic, hominine; person, mankind, man, creature, homo
words.translation: 人的，人类的；人；人的；[人类]人类的；[人类]人；人类

examples.en: There are many different cell types in the human body .
examples.zh: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

examples.en: the power of the human mind
examples.zh: 人脑的威力

examples.en: The desire for joy lies deep within the human spirit .
examples.zh: 对快乐的渴求藏在人类心灵深处。

words.definition: not considering yourself or your ideas to be as important as other people’s
words.translation: 谦逊的；地位低下的

examples.en: a modest and humble man
examples.zh: 一个谦卑的男人

words.definition: if the weather is humid, you feel uncomfortable because the air is very wet and usually hot; wet, moisty
words.translation: 湿的，湿气重的；[气象][物]潮湿的；湿润的；多湿气的

examples.en: Tokyo is extremely humid in mid-summer.
examples.zh: 仲夏的东京十分潮湿。

words.definition: funny and enjoyable; funny, witty
words.translation: 富于幽默的，诙谐的；诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的

examples.en: humorous stories
examples.zh: 诙谐的故事

examples.en: The film has some mildly humorous moments.
examples.zh: 那部电影中有些略显幽默的片段。

words.definition: the ability or tendency to think that things are funny, or funny things you say that show you have this ability; drollness, pleasantry; content, gratify
words.translation: 幽默，诙谐，幽默感；幽默（等于humor）；诙谐；迁就；使满足

examples.en: his humour and charm
examples.zh: 他的幽默感和魅力

examples.en: Greg’s feeble attempt at humour
examples.zh: 格雷格干巴巴的幽默

examples.en: English humour
examples.zh: 英国式幽默

words.definition: completely; a very large number of things or people; lots of, sea, host, thousands of, much; numerous, multiple, many
words.translation: 百，百个；许多；一百；一百的；许多的

examples.en: I’m not a hundred percent sure where she lives.
examples.zh: 我不能完全确定她住在哪里。

words.definition: lack of food, especially for a long period of time, that can cause illness or death; aspiration, famine; rare, aspire
words.translation: 饿，饥饿；渴望；饿，[生理]饥饿；挨饿

examples.en: Try to satisfy your hunger by eating some fruit.
examples.zh: 吃些水果充充饥吧。

words.definition: wanting to eat something; eager, desired, anxious, sick, keen
words.translation: 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的

examples.en: I was cold, tired, and hungry.
examples.zh: 我又冷，又累，又饿。

examples.en: If you get hungry , there’s some cold chicken in the fridge.
examples.zh: 你要是饿了，冰箱里有些冷鸡肉。

examples.en: Do you still feel hungry?
examples.zh: 你还觉得饿吗？

words.definition: an occasion when people chase animals in order to kill or catch them; to chase animals and birds in order to kill or catch them; seek, beat for; search, nose about; search, shoot
words.translation: 打猎；搜寻；追猎；搜索；狩猎

examples.en: The couple had helped in the hunt for the toddlers.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇曾帮着寻找那些蹒跚学步的孩子。

words.definition: to do something or go somewhere more quickly than usual, especially because there is not much time; to make someone do something more quickly; hasty indeed, haste; hasten; get a hump on, make haste
words.translation: 赶紧；催促；匆忙，急忙；使赶紧；使匆忙，使急忙；赶紧，赶快；匆忙

examples.en: If we hurry, we’ll get there in time.
examples.zh: 要是赶紧的话，我们能及时到那里。

examples.en: I hate having to hurry a meal.
examples.zh: 我讨厌匆匆忙忙地吃饭。

examples.en: We’ll have to hurry, otherwise we’ll miss the start.
examples.zh: 我们得赶紧，否则就会错过开头部分了。

words.definition: to injure yourself or someone else; wound, blast; pain; smart, painfulness; injured, painful, wounded, bitter
words.translation: 使受伤；使痛心；损害；使疼痛；感到疼痛；有坏处；带来痛苦；痛苦；危害；痛苦的原因；受伤的；痛苦的；受损的

examples.en: Was anyone hurt in the accident?
examples.zh: 事故中有人受伤吗？

examples.en: Put that thing down - you might hurt someone with it.
examples.zh: 快把那东西放下，你会伤着别人的。

words.definition: the man that a woman is married to; hubby, worse half
words.translation: 丈夫

examples.en: Have you met my husband Roy?
examples.zh: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

words.definition: a small simple building with only one or two rooms; shed, cottage, cabin; station; quarter
words.translation: 小屋，棚屋；小屋；临时营房；使住在小屋中；驻扎；住在小屋中

examples.en: a wooden hut
examples.zh: 小木屋

words.definition: Hydrogen is a colourless gas that is the lightest and commonest element in the universe
words.translation: 氢

examples.en: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水含有氢和氧。

examples.en: Water can be reduced to oxygen and hydrogen by electrolysis.
examples.zh: 水通过电解可以分解为氧和氢。

examples.en: The first bubbles to escape from the liquid are a mixture of air and hydrogen.
examples.zh: 从该液体中最先逸出的气泡是空气和氢的混合物。

words.definition: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself
words.translation: (主格)我

examples.en: I moved to this city six years ago.
examples.zh: 六年前我搬到了这个城市。

examples.en: I’m not late again, am I?
examples.zh: 我没有又迟到吧？

examples.en: My husband and I enjoy going to the theatre.
examples.zh: 我和丈夫喜欢去剧院看戏。

words.definition: water that has frozen into a solid state; gelato, reservedness; glacial
words.translation: 冰，冰块；冰镇；[水文][制冷]冰；冰淇淋；矜持；冰的

examples.en: Would you like some ice in your drink?
examples.zh: 你饮料中要放点冰块吗？

examples.en: Her hands were as cold as ice.
examples.zh: 她双手冰冷。

examples.en: The city spent $7 million to remove snow and ice from the roads.
examples.zh: 市政府花费了700万美元用于清除路上的冰雪。

words.definition: a plan or suggestion for a possible course of action, especially one that you think of suddenly; concept, notion, construct, think
words.translation: 想法；思想；意见；主意；概念

examples.en: You should talk to Ken – he's always full of good ideas.
examples.zh: 你应该和肯谈谈，他总是满脑子好主意。

examples.en: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
examples.zh: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

examples.en: It was my wife’s idea to move house.
examples.zh: 要搬家是我妻子的主意。

words.definition: the best or most suitable that something could possibly be; perfect, full, unreasonable, dream; pink, quintessence
words.translation: 理想的；观念的；[数]理想的；完美的；想象的；不切实际的；[数]理想；典范

examples.en: advice on how to reach your ideal weight
examples.zh: 如何达到理想体重的建议

examples.en: The scheme offers an ideal opportunity for youngsters to get training.
examples.zh: 该计划为年轻人提供了获得培训的极好机会。

examples.en: With so much rain, conditions are far from ideal.
examples.zh: 雨水这么多，天气情况很不理想。

words.definition: a group of words that has a special meaning that is different from the ordinary meaning of each separate word. For example, ‘under the weather’ is an idiom meaning ‘ill’.; phrase, dialect
words.translation: 习语，成语；成语，习语；土话

examples.en: the new musical idiom
examples.zh: 新的音乐风格

words.definition: not working or producing anything; stopped, lazy; sit around, lie about; moon, dream away
words.translation: 空闲的；懒散的；闲置的；懒惰的；停顿的；无所事事；虚度；[机]空转；[机]使空转

examples.en: I cannot afford to leave the land lying idle.
examples.zh: 我不能让土地闲置。

examples.en: The whole team stood idle, waiting for the mechanic.
examples.zh: 整队人干站着等技工来。

examples.en: The workers have been idle for the last six months.
examples.zh: 最近六个月工人们都很闲。

words.definition: used when talking about something that might happen or be true, or might have happened; whether, provided; condition, qualification, conception, assumption
words.translation: 假如，如果；（表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如；条件；设想

examples.en: We’ll stay at home if it rains.
examples.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: If you need money, I can lend you some.
examples.zh: 如果你需要钱，我能借给你一些。

examples.en: If I didn’t apologize, I’d feel guilty.
examples.zh: 如果我不道歉，我会感到内疚。

words.definition: suffering from a disease or not feeling well; to think or say unpleasant things about someone; bad, evil, black, ugly; badly, barely, adversely; illness, disaster, disease, sickness, evil
words.translation: 有病的；坏的；坏；生病的；邪恶的；不吉利的；不利地；恶劣地；几乎不；疾病；不幸

examples.en: Bridget can’t come – she’s ill.
examples.zh: 布里奇特不能来了，她生病了。

examples.en: I was feeling ill that day and decided to stay at home.
examples.zh: 我那天不太舒服，决定留在家里。

examples.en: a hospice for the terminally ill
examples.zh: 晚期病人的安养院

words.definition: a disease of the body or mind, or the condition of being ill; disease, ill, sickness, complaint, maladie
words.translation: 病，疾病；病；[医]疾病

examples.en: She had all the normal childhood illnesses.
examples.zh: 儿童的常见病她小时候都得过。

examples.en: Her mother was recovering from a serious illness.
examples.zh: 她母亲重病后正在逐渐康复。

examples.en: I’ve never missed a day’s work through illness.
examples.zh: 我从未因病耽误过一天工作。

words.definition: a picture in a book, article etc, especially one that helps you to understand it; explanation, notes, legend, diagram
words.translation: 说明，图解；例证；说明；[印刷]插图；[经]例证；图解

examples.en: The book contains 62 pages of illustrations.
examples.zh: 这本书有62页插图。

words.definition: the ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind; vision, revery
words.translation: 想象；想象力；空想；[心理]想象力；幻想物

examples.en: a storyteller with an incredible imagination
examples.zh: 想象力极丰富的讲故事者

examples.en: It does not take much imagination to understand their grief.
examples.zh: 不难想象他们是多么悲伤。

examples.en: With a little imagination, you can find great inexpensive gifts.
examples.zh: 稍微动点脑筋，你就会找到物美价廉的礼物。

words.definition: to form a picture or idea in your mind about what something could be like; picture, think of; think of, suppose
words.translation: 想象，设想；料想；想像；猜想；臆断；想像起来

examples.en: Perhaps she’d never really been there at all – perhaps she’d just imagined it.
examples.zh: 可能她从未到过那儿——也许这都是她的幻想。

words.definition: happening or done at once and without delay; instant, direct, right
words.translation: 立即的；直接的；最接近的

examples.en: Our immediate response to the attack was sheer horror.
examples.zh: 我们对攻击的第一反应就是非常惊恐。

examples.en: They promise immediate action to help the unemployed.
examples.zh: 他们承诺立即采取行动帮助失业者。

examples.en: If the eyes are affected, seek immediate medical attention.
examples.zh: 如果眼睛感染了要立即就医。

words.definition: very soon before or after something; rapidly, directly, soon, now, shortly; directly, than
words.translation: 立即；直接地；立即，立刻；一…就

examples.en: Those most immediately involved in the disaster will be given support.
examples.zh: 灾害最直接受害者将获得援助。

words.definition: extremely large; huge, tremendous, enormous, massive, macro
words.translation: 巨大的；极好的；巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的

examples.en: People who travel by rail still read an immense amount.
examples.zh: 人们坐火车旅行时仍然会读很多书。

examples.en: Regular visits from a social worker can be of immense value to old people living alone.
examples.zh: 对于独居老人来说社工的经常探望很重要。

words.definition: someone who enters another country to live there permanently; emigratory; migration, transplantation
words.translation: 移民；移民的；迁入的；移民，侨民

examples.en: an illegal immigrant
examples.zh: 非法移民

examples.en: a new wave of immigrants from the Middle East
examples.zh: 来自中东的一股新兴的移民浪潮

words.translation: 不耐烦的，急躁的

examples.en: The impatient drivers were beeping their horns.
examples.zh: 不耐烦的司机们在按喇叭发嘟嘟声。

examples.en: One thing I’ve noticed is that when people have to wait, they become impatient or uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 我注意到一件事，就是当人们在等待的时候，人们会变的没有耐心、焦躁不安。

words.definition: the quality of being important; moment, price, value, worth, magnitude
words.translation: 重要；重要性；价值；重大；傲慢

examples.en: He was full of his own importance (= he behaved in an annoying way which showed that he thought he was very important ).
examples.zh: 他自以为很了不起。

words.definition: an important event, decision, problem etc has a big effect or influence on people’s lives or on events in the future; crucial, considerable, material, big, significant
words.translation: 重要的；有势力的；重要的，重大的；有地位的；有权力的

examples.en: a very important meeting
examples.zh: 很重要的会议

examples.en: The accident taught him an important lesson.
examples.zh: 那次事故给了他很大的教训。

examples.en: Happiness is more important than money.
examples.zh: 快乐比金钱更重要。

words.definition: something that is impossible cannot happen or be done; incorrect, unbearable; a blue moon
words.translation: 不可能的，办不到的；不可能的；不可能存在的；难以忍受的；不真实的；不可能；不可能的事

examples.en: ‘I want to speak to Mr Franks.’ ‘I’m afraid that’s impossible.’
examples.zh: “我想和弗兰克斯先生谈谈。”“恐怕不行。”

examples.en: It’s impossible to be accurate about these things.
examples.zh: 这些事情不可能准确无误。

examples.en: The noise made sleep impossible.
examples.zh: 噪音吵得人无法睡觉。

words.definition: to make someone feel admiration and respect; propagate; print, mark, characteristic, trace
words.translation: 给…深刻印象；盖印；强征；传送；给予某人深刻印象；印象，印记；特征，痕迹

examples.en: Steve borrowed his dad’s sports car to impress his girlfriend.
examples.zh: 史蒂夫借来他爸爸的跑车向女友炫耀。

examples.en: ‘He’s a lawyer?’ Mum looked suitably impressed (= as impressed as you would expect ).
examples.zh: “他是个律师？”妈妈看上去果然对他印象颇好。

words.definition: the opinion or feeling you have about someone or something because of the way they seem; infection, effect, influence, affection, print
words.translation: 印；印象；印记；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想

examples.en: When we looked around the school we got a very good impression.
examples.zh: 我们参观了学校，对它的印象很好。

examples.en: I got the impression that she wasn’t very happy with her job.
examples.zh: 我有这样的印象，她的工作干得并不愉快。

words.definition: something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important etc; affecting, heart-warming
words.translation: 给人印象深刻的；感人的；令人钦佩的；给人以深刻印象的

examples.en: The figures certainly look impressive.
examples.zh: 这些数字看上去确实很可观。

examples.en: Among the guests was an impressive array of authors and critics.
examples.zh: 来宾中有不少出色的作家和评论家。

words.definition: to put someone in prison or to keep them somewhere and prevent them from leaving; prison, jail
words.translation: 关押，监禁；限制；监禁；[法]关押；使…下狱

examples.en: The government imprisoned all opposition leaders.
examples.zh: 政府把反对派领导人全部监禁起来。

examples.en: She was imprisoned within his strong arms.
examples.zh: 她被他强壮的手臂搂着。

words.definition: to make something better, or to become better; further, build up; gain, accelerate, grow in
words.translation: 使更好；改善；改善，增进；提高…的价值；增加；变得更好

examples.en: a course for students wishing to improve their English
examples.zh: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

examples.en: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
examples.zh: 医生说她正在康复。

examples.en: You could use the money for improving your home.
examples.zh: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

words.definition: the act of improving something or the state of being improved; reforming, amendment, enrichment, amelioration
words.translation: 改进，改善；改进处

examples.en: Our results have shown some improvement this month.
examples.zh: 我们的成绩这个月有所提高。

words.definition: used with the name of a container, place, or area to say where someone or something is; within, inside; modern, fashionable, tony
words.translation: 在…里ad进，入；按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内；在里面的；时髦的

examples.en: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 碗橱里有一些糖。

examples.en: My mother was in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我母亲在厨房里。

examples.en: He took us for a drive in his new car.
examples.zh: 他开着他的新车载我们去兜风。

words.definition: a unit for measuring length, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.; height, little, touch; worm
words.translation: 英寸；身高；少许；慢慢前进

examples.en: The curtains were an inch too short.
examples.zh: 窗帘短了一英寸。

examples.en: Rainfall here is under 15 inches a year.
examples.zh: 本地的年降雨量不到15英寸。

words.definition: an event, especially one that is unusual, important, or violent; event, circumstance, occurrence, scene, happening; incoming
words.translation: 发生的事；事件；事件，事变；插曲；[光]入射的；附带的；易发生的，伴随而来的

examples.en: Am I at risk because of some incident in my sexual past?
examples.zh: 我过去性生活中的某件事会使我处于危险境地吗？

examples.en: Roads were sealed off because of a major incident.
examples.zh: 因为发生重大事故，道路被封锁了。

words.definition: the money that you earn from your work or that you receive from investments, the government etc; revenue, proceeds, earning, yield, receipt
words.translation: 收入；收益；进款；收入，[会计]收益；[经]所得

examples.en: low-income families
examples.zh: 低收入家庭

words.definition: not correct or true; false, impossible, wrong, improper, unhappy
words.translation: 不正确的，错误的；错误的，不正确的；不适当的；不真实的

examples.en: The information you gave us was incorrect.
examples.zh: 你给我们的信息不准确。

words.definition: if you increase something, or if it increases, it becomes bigger in amount, number, or degree; enhancement, growth, gain, raising, advance; improve, gain, accelerate, breed, make; enhance, boost, jack, mount, hot
words.translation: 增加；增加，增长；提高；增加，增大；繁殖；增加，加大

examples.en: The population increased dramatically in the first half of the century.
examples.zh: 该世纪上半叶，人口大幅度增加。

examples.en: political tensions that might increase the likelihood of war
examples.zh: 或许会增加战争爆发可能性的紧张政治局面

examples.en: Visits to the site have increased threefold since May.
examples.zh: 来这里的参观者自5月起已增至原来的三倍。

words.definition: more and more all the time; pyramidally, cumulatively
words.translation: 日益，越来越多地；越来越多地；渐增地

examples.en: Marketing techniques are becoming increasingly sophisticated.
examples.zh: 市场营销技巧越来越巧妙。

examples.en: Increasingly, young people distrust all forms of government.
examples.zh: 年轻人越来越不相信任何形式的政府。

words.definition: used to emphasize a statement or answer; just, sure, even
words.translation: 真正地；确实；的确；实在；甚至

examples.en: The blood tests prove that Vince is indeed the father.
examples.zh: 验血证明文斯确实是父亲。

examples.en: ‘Would it help if you had an assistant?’ ‘It would indeed.’
examples.zh: “你要是有个助手，会有帮助吗？”“那是肯定的。

words.definition: not clear or exact; fuzzy, huge, dark, infinite, unsure
words.translation: 不明确的；不定的；不确定的；无限的；模糊的

examples.en: Teachers find the report’s terminology so indefinite that it is confusing.
examples.zh: 老师们发现报告的专门用语含义不明确，令人费解。

words.definition: political freedom from control by the government of another country; freedom, juche
words.translation: 独立，自主，自立；独立性，自立性；自主

examples.en: The country has made great advances since independence.
examples.zh: 该国自独立以来发展迅速。

words.definition: an independent organization is not owned or controlled by, or does not receive money from, another organization or the government; alone, free, isolated, separate, specialty
words.translation: 独立的；自主的；单独的；无党派的；不受约束的

examples.en: There are plans to split the corporation into a number of smaller independent companies.
examples.zh: 有计划要把这家大企业分割成一些独立的小公司。

examples.en: an independent charity
examples.zh: 独立的慈善机构

examples.en: small independent bookshops
examples.zh: 私营小书店

words.definition: an alphabetical list of names, subjects etc at the back of a book, with the numbers of the pages where they can be found; finger, indicatrix; to point out, to indicate
words.translation: 索引；指数；指标；[图情]索引；指针；指出；编入索引中

examples.en: ...the consumer price index.
examples.zh: …消费价格指数。

words.translation: 印度

examples.en: Burma borders on India.
examples.zh: 缅甸与印度毗邻。

examples.en: This book treats of the caste system in India.
examples.zh: 这本书论述了印度的种姓制度。

examples.en: If you come to India for just one thing, this should be it.
examples.zh: 如果你只为一件事来到印度，那就到这儿来吧。

words.definition: relating to India or its people; someone from India; hindu; Injun, Red Indian
words.translation: 印度的；印度人；印第安人的；印第安语的；印第安人；印第安语

examples.en: ...the Indian government.
examples.zh: ...印度政府。

words.definition: instruction, symbol, breath, pointing, evidence
words.translation: 指示；表示；表明；指示，指出；迹象；象征

examples.en: Could you give me some indication as to when I am likely to receive a reply?
examples.zh: 你能给我透露一下什么时候我能收到回复吗？

words.definition: angry and surprised because you feel insulted or unfairly treated; aggrieved
words.translation: 愤慨的，义愤的；愤愤不平的；义愤的

examples.en: an indignant reply
examples.zh: 愤慨的回复

words.definition: not directly caused by something; circular, consequential
words.translation: 间接的；不坦率的；[试验]间接的；迂回的；非直截了当的

examples.en: Losing weight is an indirect result of smoking cigarettes.
examples.zh: 吸烟间接导致体重减轻。

examples.en: The indirect effects of climate change may be profound.
examples.zh: 气候变化造成的间接影响可能是深远的。

words.definition: into or inside a building
words.translation: 在室内，在屋里

examples.en: Let’s go indoors and have something to eat.
examples.zh: 我们进屋吃点东西吧。

examples.en: It rained all day so we had to stay indoors.
examples.zh: 雨下了整整一天，我们只好留在屋里。

words.definition: relating to industry or the people working in it
words.translation: 工业的；产业的

examples.en: By 1900, Britain was a mainly industrial society.
examples.zh: 到1900年英国已基本进入工业社会。

words.definition: When a country industrializes or is industrialized, it develops a lot of industries
words.translation: 使工业化

examples.en: Energy consumption rises as countries industrialize.
examples.zh: 能源消耗随着各国工业化而增加。

words.definition: businesses that produce a particular type of thing or provide a particular service; domain, manufacturing
words.translation: 工业，产业；勤劳；产业；[工业]工业；勤勉

examples.en: I work in the oil industry.
examples.zh: 我在石油行业工作。

examples.en: Italy’s thriving tourist industry
examples.zh: 意大利蓬勃发展的旅游业

words.definition: not using time, money, energy etc in the best way; helpless, talentless
words.translation: 效率低的，无能的；无效率的，效率低的；无能的

examples.en: an inefficient use of resources
examples.zh: 资源的浪费

examples.en: Local government was inefficient.
examples.zh: 地方政府效率低下。

words.definition: cheap – use this to show approval; cheap, ten-cent
words.translation: 花费不多的，廉价的；便宜的

examples.en: a good selection of inexpensive wines
examples.zh: 可供选择的各种价格公道的葡萄酒

examples.en: Painting is a relatively inexpensive way to enhance your home.
examples.zh: 粉刷是美化居室的一种相对较便宜的方式。

words.definition: a baby or very young child; intended for babies or very young children; baby, minor; earlier, young, baby, minor, tender
words.translation: 婴儿；婴儿的；幼儿；未成年人；幼稚的；初期的；未成年的

examples.en: An infant’s skin is very sensitive.
examples.zh: 幼儿的皮肤非常敏感。

words.definition: to give someone a disease; affect, contract, catch, disease, communicate
words.translation: 传染；感染；[医]感染，传染

examples.en: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
examples.zh: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

words.definition: to form an opinion that something is probably true because of information that you have; understand, conclude, reason; conclude, deduce from
words.translation: 推论，推断；猜想；推断；推论；作出推论

examples.en: I inferred from what she said that you have not been well.
examples.zh: 我从她的话里推断出你身体一直不大好。

words.definition: not good, or not as good as someone or something else; junior, lower; lessness, subordinate
words.translation: 下等的；劣等的；差的；自卑的；[植]下级的，下等的；下级；次品

examples.en: I felt very inferior among all those academics.
examples.zh: 与那些大学教师在一起，我自惭形秽。

examples.en: wine of inferior quality
examples.zh: 劣质葡萄酒

examples.en: inferior goods
examples.zh: 质量低劣的商品

words.definition: to officially tell someone about something or give them information; message, bring in on; tell on, blow the whistle
words.translation: 通知，向…报告；通知；告诉；报告；告发；告密

examples.en: They decided to inform the police.
examples.zh: 他们决定通知警察。

words.definition: facts or details that tell you something about a situation, person, event etc; feedback, advice, notice, knowledge of, cognition
words.translation: 消息，信息；通知；[计][通信]信息，资料；知识；[图情]情报

examples.en: I need more information.
examples.zh: 我需要更多信息。

words.definition: if animals or people inhabit an area or place, they live there; people, occupy, bag; belong, room, harbor, live, dwell
words.translation: 居住于，栖息于；栖息；居住于；占据；（古）居住

examples.en: The woods are inhabited by many wild animals.
examples.zh: 很多野生动物栖居在这片森林里。

examples.en: inhabited islands
examples.zh: 有人居住的岛屿

words.definition: one of the people who live in a particular place; liver, resident, dweller, habitant
words.translation: 居民，住户；居民；居住者

examples.en: a city of six million inhabitants
examples.zh: 有600万居民的城市

words.definition: happening at the beginning; premier, original
words.translation: 最初的；词首的；[数]最初的；字首的

examples.en: an initial investment of £5,000
examples.zh: 5,000英镑的初始投资

examples.en: The initial response has been encouraging.
examples.zh: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

words.definition: an act of putting a drug into someone’s body using a special needle; congestion, inoculability
words.translation: 注射，注入；充满；注射；注射剂；充血；射入轨道

examples.en: The nurse gave me a tetanus injection.
examples.zh: 护士给我打了破伤风预防针。

examples.en: The children hate having injections.
examples.zh: 孩子们讨厌打针。

examples.en: The only sure treatment is antibiotics, preferably by injection.
examples.zh: 唯一有效的治疗方法是使用抗生素，最好是注射使用。

words.definition: a wound or damage to part of your body caused by an accident or attack
words.translation: 损害，伤害；受伤处

examples.en: She was taken to hospital with serious head injuries.
examples.zh: 她头部受重伤被送到医院。

examples.en: Beckham has missed several games through injury
examples.zh: 贝克汉姆因伤错过了几场比赛。

examples.en: He’s a lawyer who specializes in personal injury claims.
examples.zh: 他是个专门从事人身伤害索赔的律师。

words.definition: a coloured liquid that you use for writing, printing or drawing; sign, endorse; atrament
words.translation: 墨水，油墨；签署；涂墨水于；[轻]墨水，墨汁；[印刷]油墨

examples.en: Please write in black ink.
examples.zh: 请用黑色墨水书写。

words.definition: a small hotel or pub, especially an old one in the countryside; hotel, roadhouse
words.translation: 小旅店；小酒店；[经]客栈；旅馆

examples.en: We’re staying at the Holiday Inn.
examples.zh: 我们住在假日酒店。

words.definition: on the inside or close to the centre of something; internal, mental, inside, spiritual; interior, inside
words.translation: 内部的；内心的；精神的；内部

examples.en: an inner room
examples.zh: 内室

examples.en: inner London
examples.zh: 伦敦中心区

examples.en: the inner ear
examples.zh: 内耳

words.definition: information that is put into a computer; investment, introjection; type in, carry in
words.translation: 输入；投入的资金；投入；输入电路；[计][自][电子]输入；将…输入电脑

examples.en: If the input data specified it, the file will close and the process terminates.
examples.zh: 如果输入数据指定，该文件就会关闭，数据处理终止。

words.definition: a small creature such as a fly or ant, that has six legs, and sometimes wings; ratfink, warb
words.translation: 昆虫，虫；[昆]昆虫；卑鄙的人

examples.en: an insect bite
examples.zh: 昆虫的叮咬

examples.en: flying insects
examples.zh: 飞虫

examples.en: Don’t forget to bring insect repellant (= a chemical to keep insects away ).
examples.zh: 不要忘记带上驱虫剂。

words.definition: to put something inside or into something else; bed, build in; inlet, impaler
words.translation: 插入；嵌入；登载；[建]嵌入；[建]插入物

examples.en: He took a small key from his pocket and slowly inserted it into the lock.
examples.zh: 他从衣袋里掏出一把小钥匙，然后缓缓地将其插入锁孔里。

words.definition: the inner part of something, which is surrounded or hidden by the outer part; interior, within, inner; internal, inner, secret, underground, chamber; within, under, in
words.translation: 在…里面；内部；里面；内情；内脏；里面的；内部的；秘密的；少于；在…之内

examples.en: He concealed the key inside his tie.
examples.zh: 他把钥匙藏在领带里面。

words.definition: to examine something carefully in order to find out more about it or to find out what is wrong with it; examine, review, visit
words.translation: 检查，审查；检阅；检查；视察

examples.en: I got out of the car to inspect the damage.
examples.zh: 我下车查看损坏情况。

examples.en: Police inspected the scene and interviewed all the staff.
examples.zh: 警察仔细检查了现场并询问了所有员工。

words.definition: an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed; examination, checking, monitoring
words.translation: 检查，审查；检阅；视察，检查

examples.en: An inspection was carried out at the school.
examples.zh: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

words.definition: immediately; promptly, offhandedly
words.translation: 立即，即刻；立即地；马上地；即刻地

examples.en: All four victims died instantly.
examples.zh: 四名受害人全部当即死亡。

examples.en: The information was instantly available.
examples.zh: 信息即时可得。

words.definition: used to say what is not used, does not happen etc, when something else is used, happens etc
words.translation: 代替，顶替；反而

examples.en: You probably picked up my keys instead of yours.
examples.zh: 你可能没拿你的钥匙而错拿了我的。

examples.en: Could I have tuna instead of ham?
examples.zh: 我可否要金枪鱼来代替火腿？

examples.en: Instead of being annoyed, he seemed quite pleased.
examples.zh: 他没有生气，反而似乎很高兴。

words.definition: a natural tendency to behave in a particular way or a natural ability to know something, which is not learned; intuition, natural ability; abrim
words.translation: 本能；直觉；生性；[生物]本能，直觉；[心理]天性；充满着的

examples.en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 直觉告诉她有些不对劲。

words.definition: not enough, or not great enough; short, deficient, lacking, wanting; shortage, short of, lack, scarcity
words.translation: 不足的；不适当的；不足的，不充足的；不足

examples.en: Insufficient resources have been devoted to the health service.
examples.zh: 用于医疗保健服务的资源不足。

words.definition: an arrangement with a company in which you pay them money, especially regularly, and they pay the costs if something bad happens, for example if you become ill or your car is damaged; assurance, safety, premium, compensation
words.translation: 保险；保险费；[保险]保险；保险契约；赔偿金

examples.en: Your father took out insurance to cover the mortgage.
examples.zh: 你父亲购买了抵押借款保险。

words.definition: to buy insurance so that you will receive money if something bad happens to you, your family, your possessions etc; undertake, assure; to ensure, snake stare
words.translation: 给…保险；确保；确保，保证；投保

examples.en: Have you insured the contents of your home?
examples.zh: 你给家庭财产投保了吗？

words.definition: an intelligent, well-educated person who spends time thinking about complicated ideas and discussing them; relating to the ability to understand things and think intelligently; wise, bright, clever, smart, understanding; clerisy
words.translation: 知识分子；智力的；[心理]智力的；聪明的；理智的；[劳经]知识分子；凭理智做事者

examples.en: a leading British intellectual
examples.zh: 一位顶尖的英国知识分子

words.definition: the quality of being felt very strongly or having a strong effect; stress, tension, brightness
words.translation: 强烈，剧烈；强度；[物]强度；强烈；[电子]亮度；紧张

examples.en: The intensity of the hurricane was frightening.
examples.zh: 飓风的猛烈程度令人恐惧。

words.definition: involving a lot of activity, effort, or careful attention in a short period of time; enhanced, reinforced, concentrated, searching, mass
words.translation: 加强的；精耕细作的；[经]集中的；透彻的；加强语气的

examples.en: a one-week intensive course in English
examples.zh: 为期一周的英语强化课程

examples.en: a day of intensive negotiations
examples.zh: 紧张谈判的一天

words.definition: done deliberately and usually intended to cause harm; studied, designed, conscious
words.translation: 故意的，有意识的；故意的；蓄意的；策划的

examples.en: I did trip him, but it wasn’t intentional.
examples.zh: 我的确把他绊倒了，但不是故意的。

words.definition: a process by which two or more things affect each other; reciprocity, mutual effect
words.translation: 相互作用；干扰；[数][物]相互作用；交互作用

examples.en: But you only get the maximum benefit if you implement all of them, because their power comes from their interaction.
examples.zh: 但您只有在实现所有方法的情况下才能获得最多的收益，因为它们的力量来自于它们之间的相互作用。

words.definition: if you have an interest in something or someone, you want to know or learn more about them; like, fond of
words.translation: 兴趣；利益；利息；兴趣，爱好；[金融]利息；趣味；同行

examples.en: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
examples.zh: 我看了前几集，但很快就失去了兴趣。

examples.en: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
examples.zh: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

examples.en: Our survey reveals a disturbing lack of interest in teacher training.
examples.zh: 我们的调查显示人们对教师培训失去了兴趣，这很令人不安。

words.definition: if something is interesting, you give it your attention because it seems unusual or exciting or provides information that you did not know about
words.translation: 有趣的，引人入胜的

examples.en: That’s an interesting question.
examples.zh: 那是一个有趣的问题。

examples.en: a really interesting TV programme
examples.zh: 十分有趣的电视节目

examples.en: Did you meet any interesting people?
examples.zh: 你见过什么有意思的人吗？

words.definition: to deliberately get involved in a situation where you are not wanted or needed; influence in, meddle in; impact, collide with
words.translation: 干涉，干预；妨碍；干涉；打扰；冲突；介入

examples.en: My daughter-in-law said that I was interfering, but I was only trying to help.
examples.zh: 我的儿媳说我多管闲事，但我只是想帮忙。

words.definition: an act of interfering; conflict, disturbance, war, obstacle, collision
words.translation: 干涉，干预；阻碍；[通信][物][医]干扰，冲突；干涉

examples.en: Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
examples.zh: 劳资关系应不受政府干预。

words.definition: inside or indoors; essence, principle, texture, entity, inner; inner, domestic, essential, inside, home
words.translation: 内的；内地的n内部；内部；本质；内部的；国内的；本质的

examples.en: The interior walls are all painted white.
examples.zh: 室内墙壁都粉刷成了白色。

words.definition: an intermediate stage in a process of development is between two other stages; mid, medium, middle, secondary; medium, intermediary agent
words.translation: 中间的；中级的；[化学]中间的，中级的；[化学][生化]中间物；媒介

examples.en: an intermediate stage during which the disease is dormant
examples.zh: 疾病处于潜伏状态的中期

words.definition: within a particular country; inner, inherent, domestic, inside, home
words.translation: 内的；国内的；[药]内部的；内在的

examples.en: We have no interest in interfering in the internal affairs of other countries.
examples.zh: 我们对干涉其他国家内政不感兴趣。

examples.en: the threat to internal security
examples.zh: 对国内安全的威胁

examples.en: internal markets
examples.zh: 国内市场

words.definition: relating to or involving more than one nation; mundane
words.translation: 国际的，世界(性)的；国际的；世界的

examples.en: the response of the international community
examples.zh: 国际社会的反响

examples.en: the UN and other international organizations
examples.zh: 联合国和其他国际组织

words.definition: someone who changes spoken words from one language into an-other, especially as their job; expounder
words.translation: 译员，口译者；解释者；口译者；注释器

examples.en: Speaking through an interpreter (= using an interpreter ), Ahmed said, ‘I’m very worried about my wife and children.’
examples.zh: 艾哈迈德通过口译者说:“我很担心我的妻子和孩子们。”

words.definition: to stop someone from continuing what they are saying or doing by suddenly speaking to them, making a noise etc; let, violate; cut in on, to break in on; break, broken off
words.translation: 打断，打扰；中止；中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍；打扰

examples.en: Will you stop interrupting me!
examples.zh: 别打断我的话！

examples.en: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you to come downstairs.
examples.zh: 很抱歉打扰了，我得请你下楼来。

words.definition: the period of time between two events, activities etc; separation, distance
words.translation: 间隔；休息；间距；幕间休息

examples.en: He left the room, returning after a short interval with a message.
examples.zh: 他离开房间，过了一会儿就带回来一条消息。

words.definition: having an extremely close friendship; private, close, perfect, chamber; confidant, alter ego; bill, message
words.translation: 亲密的；个人的；私人的；精通的；有性关系的；知己；至交；暗示；通知；宣布

examples.en: an intimate friend of Picasso’s
examples.zh: 毕加索的一个密友

examples.en: an intimate relationship
examples.zh: 亲密的关系

examples.en: She’s on intimate terms with people in government.
examples.zh: 她与政府官员关系密切。

words.definition: to the inside or inner part of a container, place, area etc
words.translation: 进，入；进入到

examples.en: Come into the office.
examples.zh: 到办公室里来。

examples.en: He thrust his hand into his coat pocket.
examples.zh: 他把手插进大衣口袋里。

examples.en: There must be another way into the cave.
examples.zh: 一定有其他的路可以进入洞穴。

words.definition: if you introduce someone to another person, you tell them each other’s names for the first time; present, recommend, prefer, file, advance
words.translation: 介绍；引进，传入；引进；提出；采用

examples.en: Have you two been introduced? Tom, this is Greg.
examples.zh: 有人给你们俩互相介绍了吗？汤姆，这位是格雷格。

words.definition: the act of formally telling two people each other’s names when they first meet; presentation, adoption
words.translation: 介绍；引进；引言；采用；入门；传入

examples.en: Pete, are you going to make the introductions?
examples.zh: 皮特，你来作一下介绍吧。

examples.en: Our first contestant needs no introduction (= everyone already knows the person ).
examples.zh: 我们的第一位参赛者就不用介绍了。

words.definition: when the army of one country enters another country by force, in order to take control of it; violence, aggression, infringement
words.translation: 入侵，侵略；侵犯；[医]侵袭

examples.en: the annual invasion of teenagers for the Glastonbury Festival
examples.zh: 每年前来参加格拉斯顿伯里音乐节的青少年的涌入

words.definition: to make, design, or think of a new type of thing; father, coin
words.translation: 发明，创造；捏造；发明；创造；虚构

examples.en: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
examples.zh: 亚历山大 · 格雷厄姆 · 贝尔于1876年发明了电话。

words.definition: a useful machine, tool, instrument etc that has been invented; fiction, contrivance
words.translation: 发明，创造；捏造；[专利]发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能

examples.en: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
examples.zh: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。

words.definition: someone who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things; creator, artificer
words.translation: 发明者；发明家；[专利]发明家；发明人；创造者

examples.en: ...Alexander Graham Bell, the inventor of the telephone.
examples.zh: …亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔，电话的发明者。

words.definition: an official attempt to find out the truth about or the cause of something such as a crime, accident, or scientific problem; research, probe
words.translation: 调查，调查研究；调查；调查研究

examples.en: The investigation continued for nearly three years.
examples.zh: 调查持续了近三年。

examples.en: a criminal investigation
examples.zh: 刑事调查

examples.en: A private detective was hired to conduct the investigation.
examples.zh: 雇了一名私人侦探进行调查。

words.definition: the use of money to get a profit or to make a business activity successful, or the money that is used; input, introjection
words.translation: 投资，投资额，投入；[经]投资；投入；封锁

examples.en: We plan to buy some property as an investment.
examples.zh: 我们打算买些房地产作为投资。

words.definition: something that is invisible cannot be seen; intangible, discarnate, aeriform
words.translation: 看不见的，无形的；无形的，看不见的；无形的；不显眼的，暗藏的

examples.en: The house was surrounded by trees, and invisible from the road.
examples.zh: 这所房子树木环绕，从路上是看不见的。

words.definition: a written or spoken request to someone, inviting them to go somewhere or do something; calling, temptation
words.translation: 邀请，招待；请柬；邀请；引诱

examples.en: They were always dropping by, usually without invitation.
examples.zh: 他们常常来串门，通常不请自来。

words.definition: to ask someone to come to a party, wedding, meal etc; serve, attend, ask, court, guest; calling, invitation to
words.translation: 邀请，聘请；招待；邀请，招待；招致；邀请

examples.en: I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
examples.zh: 恐怕我没有受到邀请。

words.definition: If something moves or faces inward, it moves or faces toward the inside or centre of something; internal, inner, mental, familiar, spiritual; inboard; interior, inner, inside, familiar
words.translation: 里面的；向内；[计]向内的；内部的；精神的；本质上的；熟悉的；内心里；内部；内脏；密友

examples.en: He pushed open the front door, which swung inward with a groan.
examples.zh: 他推开前门，门呀的一声向里开了。

words.definition: a common hard metal that is used to make steel, is  magnetic  , and is found in very small quantities in food and blood. It is a chemical  element  : symbol Fe; sadiron, flatiron; cruel, ferrous
words.translation: 铁；烙铁；烫(衣)；熨斗；[服装]烙铁；坚强；铁的；残酷的；刚强的

examples.en: the iron and steel industry
examples.zh: 钢铁工业

examples.en: a driveway with large iron gates
examples.zh: 安装了大铁门的私家车道

examples.en: the absorption of iron from food
examples.zh: 对食物中铁的吸收

words.definition: a piece of land completely surrounded by water; isle, safety strip; to stand alone
words.translation: 岛，岛屿；岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物；孤立；使成岛状

examples.en: The Cayman Islands
examples.zh: 开曼群岛

examples.en: the Greek island of Crete
examples.zh: 希腊克里特岛

words.translation: 使隔离，使孤立；[生物]使隔离；使孤立；使绝缘；[生物]隔离；孤立；[生物]隔离的；孤立的

examples.zh: 洪水使该镇与外界隔绝。

examples.zh: 美国一直想在经济和政治上孤立古巴。

words.definition: used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, idea etc that has already been mentioned or is already known about
words.translation: 这，那，它

examples.en: ‘Where’s your office?’ ‘It’s on the third floor.’
examples.zh: “你的办公室在哪儿？”“在三楼。”

examples.en: I love the spring – it’s a wonderful time of the year.
examples.zh: 我喜欢春季——这是一年里最美妙的时节。

examples.en: There were people crying, buildings on fire. It was terrible!
examples.zh: 有人在哭喊，楼房在燃烧―太可怕了！

words.definition: relating to Italy, its people, or its language; ginzo, dino
words.translation: 意大利的n意大利人；意大利人；意大利语
它的

examples.zh: 他向我强调它的重要性。

examples.en: The child read the story but did not comprehend its meaning.
examples.zh: 这个孩子读了这篇故事，但不能理解它的意思。

examples.en: The company disseminated information about its new programmes.
examples.zh: 公司传播有关其新计划的信息。

words.definition: used to show that a thing, organization, animal, or baby that does something is affected by its own action
words.translation: 它自己；自身

examples.en: The cat lay on the sofa, washing itself.
examples.zh: 猫躺在沙发上把自己舔干。

examples.en: The machine switches itself off when the process is complete.
examples.zh: 工作程序结束，机器会自动关闭。

examples.en: a small local enterprise that has transformed itself into a highly successful company
examples.zh: 已发展为业绩喜人的公司的一家小型地方企业

words.definition: a short light coat; jerkin, lammy
words.translation: 短上衣，茄克衫；夹克；[服装]短上衣

examples.en: Gene has to wear a jacket and tie to work.
examples.zh: 吉恩上班得穿西装打领带。

words.definition: a place where criminals are kept as part of their punishment, or where people who have been charged with a crime are kept before they are judged in a law court; to put someone in jail; prison, big house; prison, imprison
words.translation: 监狱；监禁；[法]监狱；监牢；拘留所；下狱

examples.en: He’s been in jail for three months already.
examples.zh: 他已经入狱三个月。

words.definition: a thick sweet substance made from boiled fruit and sugar, eaten especially on bread
words.translation: 果酱

examples.en: strawberry jam
examples.zh: 草莓酱

examples.en: a jam sandwich
examples.zh: 果酱三明治

examples.en: jam jars
examples.zh: 果酱罐

words.definition: the first month of the year, between December and February
words.translation: 一月

examples.en: We always have snow in January.
examples.zh: 我们这里1月份总会下雪。

words.definition: lacquerware
words.translation: 日本，日本国；[轻]漆器；[涂料]日本亮漆

words.definition: relating to Japan, its people, or its language; people from Japan
words.translation: 日本的；日本人

examples.en: a Japanese car
examples.zh: 日本(汽)车

words.definition: a glass container with a wide top and a lid, used for storing food such as jam or honey, or the amount it contains; pot, shock; collide with, conflict with; stimulate, fan, shock
words.translation: 罐子，坛子，广口瓶；[陶瓷]罐；[轻]广口瓶；震动；刺耳声；冲突；不一致；震惊；发刺耳声；刺激；使震动

examples.en: a jam jar
examples.zh: 果酱罐

examples.en: half a jar of peanut butter
examples.zh: 半瓶花生酱

words.definition: one of the two bones that your teeth are in; chin, jowl; rabbit on; lesson
words.translation: 颌，颚；[脊椎]颌；下巴；[地质]狭窄入口；唠叨；教训；对…唠叨

examples.en: a broken jaw
examples.zh: 碎裂的颌骨

words.definition: a type of music that has a strong beat and parts for performers to play alone; Jass, rumpus; louse around, potter about; enliven, activate; loud
words.translation: 爵士音乐，爵士舞曲；爵士乐，爵士舞；喧闹；奏爵士乐，跳爵士舞；游荡；奏爵士乐；使活泼；爵士乐的；喧吵的

examples.en: a jazz band
examples.zh: 爵士乐队

examples.en: a jazz club
examples.zh: 爵士乐俱乐部

examples.en: modern jazz
examples.zh: 现代爵士乐

words.definition: feeling unhappy because someone has something that you wish you had; leary, leery
words.translation: 妒忌的；猜疑的；唯恐失去的；戒备的

examples.en: She got insanely jealous and there was a terrible fight.
examples.zh: 她变得过分地猜忌，接着是一场激烈的打斗。

words.definition: a fast plane with a jet engine; emission, ejection nozzle; coal-black, jet-black; shoot out, send up
words.translation: 喷气式飞机；喷嘴；[流]喷射，[机]喷嘴；[航]喷气式飞机；黑玉；墨黑的；射出；[航]乘喷气式飞机

examples.en: He owns a private jet.
examples.zh: 他拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

words.definition: a valuable stone, such as a diamond; gem, gemstone
words.translation: 宝石；宝石饰物；[宝]宝石；珠宝

examples.en: She loved dressing up and wearing priceless jewels.
examples.zh: 她喜欢穿上盛装，戴上极为昂贵的珠宝首饰。

words.definition: Jewish means belonging or relating to the religion of Judaism, or to Jews as an ethnic group
words.translation: 犹太人的

examples.en: ...the Jewish festival of Passover.
examples.zh: …犹太逾越节。

words.definition: the regular paid work that you do for an employer; profession, employment, career, pursuit, work; contract with
words.translation: 职业；工作；零活；[劳经]职业；承包；代客买卖

examples.zh: 你喜欢自己的工作吗？

examples.zh: 这是我第一份拿工资的工作。

examples.en: He’s been in the job for six years.
examples.zh: 他干这份工作有六年了。

words.translation: 参加；连接；结合；[计]连接；加入；接合点

examples.zh: 许多人牺牲周末时间，加入了寻找失踪女孩的行动。

examples.zh: 参加我们的退休金计划的好处

examples.zh: 教会领袖参与了禁止猎狐的运动。

words.definition: something that you say or do to make people laugh, especially a funny story or trick; to say things that are intended to be funny and that you do not really mean; fun, sport; make sport of, play trick on; fool, kid around
words.translation: 笑话；说笑话；玩笑，笑话；笑柄；开…的玩笑；开玩笑

examples.en: I couldn’t go out with someone for a joke, could you?
examples.zh: 我可不能拿谈恋爱当儿戏，对不对？

words.definition: happy and enjoying yourself; good, bright, grateful, fragrant, cheerful; greatly, quite, badly, extremely, too, highly, far; fool, kid around, to play a joke, to joke

examples.zh: 大家的心情都非常轻松愉快。

words.translation: 日报，杂志；日志；日报，[图情]杂志；日记；分类账

words.definition: the fact of no longer having something, or of having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens; reduction, failure, decrease, losing, reverse

examples.zh: 公司要关闭其中的两家工厂，这将造成430人失业。

examples.zh: 减肥应该循序渐进。

words.definition: a large amount or number; fate, destiny, fortune, portion, crowd; plot, to divide; draw straws, draw cuts; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too

examples.zh: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

examples.zh: “你有多少张CD？”“多着呢。”

words.definition: making a lot of noise; ceaseless, unceasing; aloud, ringingly

examples.zh: 书砰的一声掉落到地上。

examples.zh: 音乐太响了，我只得大声地喊。

examples.zh: “是谁？” 戴维大声问道。

words.definition: a piece of equipment used to make sounds louder; speaker, mike, horn, amplifier
words.translation: 扬声器，喇叭；[电子]喇叭，扬声器；扩音器

examples.en: The loudspeaker announced the arrival of the train.
examples.zh: 广播说火车进站了。

words.definition: to have a strong feeling of  affection  for someone, combined with sexual attraction; a strong feeling of caring about someone, especially a member of your family or a close friend; passion, amativeness; worship, take a fancy to

examples.zh: 我爱你，特雷西。

examples.zh: 他是她唯一爱过的男人。

words.definition: beautiful or attractive; pleasant, pretty, taking, grateful, cute

examples.zh: 她有一张漂亮的脸蛋。

examples.zh: 多么漂亮的房子啊！

examples.zh: 你穿那条连衣裙很漂亮。

examples.zh: 他杀了妻子的情人。

examples.zh: 我和尼古拉以前是情人。

examples.zh: 一对年轻的情侣

examples.zh: 他们的安全标准似乎相当低。

words.definition: smaller in number or amount; to move something down from higher up; take the edge off, feather out; bring down, play down; junior, inferior
words.translation: 较低的；放下；减弱，减少；放下，降下；贬低；降低；减弱；跌落；下游的；下级的；下等的

words.translation: 忠诚的，忠心的；忠贞的

examples.zh: 球队的忠实支持者

examples.zh: 她在公司多年的忠诚服务

examples.en: loyal customers
examples.zh: 忠实客户

words.definition: good things that happen to you by chance; fortune, chance, mercy; have one's day, strike it rich

examples.zh: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

examples.zh: 今年他种玫瑰的运气不错。

words.definition: having good luck; fortunate, providential
words.translation: 幸运的；吉祥的；侥幸的

examples.zh: 我并不知道你的名字―只是运气好猜中的。

examples.zh: 他们搜查他的行李看是否藏有毒品。

words.translation: 午餐，(美)便餐；午餐

examples.zh: 午饭吃什么？

words.translation: 肺脏，肺；[解剖]肺；呼吸器

examples.zh: 吸烟会引起肺癌。

examples.zh: 他在澳大利亚过着豪华舒适的生活。

examples.en: The dress is lambswool – pure luxury.
examples.zh: 礼服是用羔羊毛制作的——绝对奢华。

words.translation: 机器；机械；机械，[机]机器；机构；机械般工作的人

examples.zh: 给我从自动饮料机里买一罐咖啡好吗？

examples.zh: 传真机坏了。

examples.en: Did you put my dirty shirts in the machine (= washing machine ) ?
examples.zh: 你把我的脏衬衫放进洗衣机里了吗？

examples.zh: 他不可能按时完成的。他一定是疯了！

examples.zh: 如果我整天困在家里我会发疯的。

examples.zh: 他真让我受不了！

examples.zh: 杂志中的文章

examples.zh: 她扫了一眼杂志架。

words.definition: the power to make impossible things happen by saying special words or doing special actions; medicine, witchcraft, wizardry; mysterious, fantastic, miraculous

examples.zh: 把一颗钉子挂在一个磁体上再用这颗钉子去吸起另一颗钉子是可能的。

words.translation: 磁的，有吸引力的；地磁的；有磁性的；有吸引力的

examples.zh: 这个衣着华丽的花花公子在枝形吊灯灯光下翩翩起舞。

examples.zh: 这些壮丽的古代建筑显示了劳动人民的高度智慧。

examples.zh: 厨房女佣人

examples.zh: 你不应该看别人的信件。

examples.zh: 他发现有堆积如山的邮件等着他处理。

examples.zh: 她答应把我的邮件转寄到我的新地址。

examples.zh: 居住在西班牙的主要原因是天气。

examples.zh: 我们最关心的是保证孩子们的安全。

examples.zh: 希腊一海岛和本土之间的航班

examples.zh: 她的病主要是由精神压力引起的。

examples.zh: 员工主要是女性。

examples.zh: 我不大出去，主要是因为我得照看孩子们。

words.translation: 维持，保持；维修；维护，维修；保持；[经]生活费用

examples.zh: 维修保养费

examples.zh: 我来教你怎么做一个箱子存放工具。

examples.zh: 一窝老鼠在屋顶上安了家。

examples.zh: 她的婚纱是自己做的。

examples.zh: 低沉的男声

examples.zh: 传统的男性价值观

examples.zh: 赛车基本上是男人的专利。

examples.zh: 车上有两男一女。

examples.zh: 他是个非常和蔼的人。

examples.zh: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

examples.zh: 管理一支足球队比你想象的要难。

examples.en: The company had been very badly managed.
examples.zh: 公司管理非常糟糕。

words.definition: the activity of controlling and organizing the work that a company or organization does; governance, supervision, regulation, control, conservancy
words.translation: 管理；经营，处理；[管理]管理；管理人员；管理部门；操纵；经营手段

examples.zh: 缺乏管理技巧

examples.zh: 一个管理顾问

examples.zh: 管理培训课程

examples.zh: 我们的一位地区经理

examples.en: a middle manager in a computer company
examples.zh: 一家计算机公司的中层管理人员

words.definition: all humans considered as a group; humanity, people
words.translation: 人类；男性

examples.zh: 人类自远古以来就对火很感兴趣。

examples.zh: 人类历史上最重要的事件之一

words.translation: 男子气概的，果断的；男子气概的；强壮的；适于男人的

examples.zh: 低沉雄浑的嗓音

words.translation: 方式；态度；礼貌；习惯；种类；规矩；风俗

examples.zh: 她以这种方式死去，他心里有些内疚。

examples.zh: 这个问题将用对双方都公平的方式来解决。

examples.en: criticism of the manner in which the bishop was appointed
examples.zh: 对主教任命方式的批评

words.definition: manual work involves using your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind; a book that gives instructions about how to do something, especially how to use a machine; handmade, mechanic; guide, handbook, notebook
words.translation: 体力的；手册；手工的；手册，指南

examples.zh: 干体力活的人预期寿命较短。

words.translation: 制造商；制造厂；[工业]制造商；[经]厂商

examples.zh: 使用新洗碗机之前，请先阅读厂家的说明书。

examples.zh: 那台冰箱被退还给厂家了。

words.translation: 许多的；许多人

examples.zh: 在他的众多爱好中有饲养名马。

examples.zh: 印刷机赋予了少数人为多数人改变世界的力量。

examples.zh: 从地图上看，我们应该左拐。

examples.zh: 柱子是白色的大理石。

examples.zh: 大理石雕像

examples.zh: 我3月初飞到了密尔沃基。

words.definition: relating to the sea and the creatures that live there; nautical, sea-born; shipping industry, bluejacket
words.translation: 海的；海上的；船舶的；[海洋]海生的；海产的；航海的，海运的；海运业；舰队；水兵；（海军）士兵或军官

examples.zh: 海洋生物繁多的种类

examples.zh: 石油污染对海洋哺乳动物的影响

examples.en: marine biology
examples.zh: 海洋生物学

words.translation: 斑点；记号；标明；标志；马克；符号；痕迹；做标记于；打分数

examples.zh: 小猫身体基本为白色，背上有黑色斑点。

examples.zh: 我们的主要海外市场是日本。

examples.zh: 她前一次婚姻生了三个女儿。

examples.zh: 他们已经结婚八年了。

examples.en: A man came to read the electricity meter .
examples.zh: 有个男的来抄电表。

examples.en: The taxi driver left the meter running while I ran in to pick up my bags.
examples.zh: 我跑进去拿行李时，出租车司机让计价器继续走字。

words.definition: a planned way of doing something, especially one that a lot of people know about and use; approach, way, system, medium, how
words.translation: 方法，办法；教学法；方法；条理；类函数

examples.en: traditional teaching methods
examples.zh: 传统的教学法

examples.en: I think we should try again using a different method.
examples.zh: 我想我们应该用不同的方法再试一次。

examples.en: effective methods for the storage and retrieval of information
examples.zh: 信息存储和检索的有效方法

words.definition: the basic unit for measuring length in the  metric system; meter, rhythm
words.translation: 米，公尺；米；公尺；韵律

examples.en: She's running the 1,500 metres here.
examples.zh: 她正在这儿跑1500米。

words.definition: using or connected with the  metric system  of weights and measures
words.translation: 公制的，米制的

examples.en: a metric tonne
examples.zh: 一公吨

examples.en: The parts all come in metric sizes now.
examples.zh: 现在配件都采用公制规格。

words.definition: a small computer
words.translation: 微型计算机，微机

examples.en: The merchant sold electrical appliances, such as microcomputer, microphone, microprocessor and microwave ovens.
examples.zh: 商人卖一些电器，比如微型计算机，话筒，微处理器和微波炉。

examples.en: Or, as in my case, turning on the old antique microcomputer to read my single-sided, single-density floppies might lead to a fire and the quick end of your weekend data retrieval project.
examples.zh: 或者，像我所作的那样，打开一个旧的古董微型计算机来读取我的单面单密度磁盘，而这有可能引起一场火灾，以及你的周末数据检索计划的快速完结。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that you speak into to record your voice or make it louder when you are speaking or performing in public; mike, amplifier
words.translation: 话筒，麦克风；[电讯][电子]扩音器，麦克风

examples.en: She spoke confidently into the microphone.
examples.zh: 她自信地对着麦克风说话。

examples.en: They searched the room for hidden microphones.
examples.zh: 他们在屋里翻找隐藏的话筒。

words.definition: a scientific instrument that makes extremely small things look larger
words.translation: 显微镜

examples.en: The slightest movement will defocus the microscope.
examples.zh: 最轻微的运动都会使显微镜散焦。

examples.en: The microscope magnified the object two hundred times.
examples.zh: 这架显微镜把实物放大了200倍。

examples.en: The microscope capacitates small objects to be observed.
examples.zh: 显微镜可以观察到微小的物体。

words.definition: the middle of the day, at or around 12 o’clock; midnoon, noon sharp; noonday
words.translation: 正午，中午；中午；正午；正午的

examples.en: We stopped off in Colchester for our midday meal .
examples.zh: 我们中途在科尔切斯特停留吃了午饭。

examples.en: the full heat of the midday sun
examples.zh: 正午烈日的酷热

words.definition: the part that is nearest the centre of something, and furthest from the sides, edges, top, bottom etc; nearest the centre and furthest from the edge, top, end etc; medium, mid, intermediary, secondary, moderate; center, waist; double up, double back; double over
words.translation: 中部；中部的；中间的，中部的；中级的，中等的；中间，中央；腰部；把…放在中间，把…对折；放在中间，对折

examples.en: There are plenty of small houses for sale, and quite a lot of very large ones, but very little in the middle.
examples.zh: 在售的小房子很多，大房子也有不少，但是不大不小的很少。

words.definition: 12 o’clock at night; pitch-dark, inky
words.translation: 午夜，子夜，夜半；半夜的；漆黑的

examples.en: You can’t phone her now – it’s gone midnight (= after midnight ) !
examples.zh: 你现在不能打电话给她，都过午夜了！

examples.en: By the time he arrived, it was well past midnight (= after midnight ) .
examples.zh: 他到的时候早已经是后半夜了。

examples.en: He’s gone for a midnight swim.
examples.zh: 他深更半夜去游泳了。

words.definition: in a particular group; middle; among, in the middle of
words.translation: 中部，中间，当中；当中，中间；在…中间（等于amidst）

examples.en: I fear we have an enemy in our midst.
examples.zh: 我担心我们中间有内奸。

words.definition: used to suggest politely what someone should do; strength, force, muscle, power, influence; should
words.translation: aux可能，会，也许；力量；威力；势力；可能；也许

examples.en: If you need more information, you might try the Internet.
examples.zh: 如果你需要更多的信息，可以试试因特网。

examples.en: I thought we might go to the new Chinese restaurant on the High Street.
examples.zh: 我想我们可以到大街上新开的那家中国餐馆去。

examples.en: It might be a good idea to put those plants in the shade.
examples.zh: 把那些植物放在阴凉处也许是个好主意。

words.definition: fairly warm; pacific, gentle, moderate, soft, slight
words.translation: 和缓的；温柔的；温和的；轻微的；淡味的；文雅的；不含有害物质的的

examples.en: We had an exceptionally mild winter last year.
examples.zh: 去年冬天我们这里异常暖和。

examples.en: a mild climate
examples.zh: 温和的气候

words.definition: a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,760  yard s  or about 1,609 metres
words.translation: 英里

examples.en: It’s 40 miles from here to the Polish border.
examples.zh: 从这里到波兰边界有40英里。

examples.en: an area 50 miles wide and 150 miles long
examples.zh: 一片50英里宽、150英里长的地区

examples.en: We walked about half a mile .
examples.zh: 我们大约走了半英里。

words.definition: a white liquid produced by cows or goats that is drunk by people; to take milk from a cow or goat; lait, creamery; extract, ream
words.translation: 乳，牛奶；挤(奶)；[食品]牛奶；[化学]乳状物；榨取；挤…的奶

examples.en: a bottle of milk
examples.zh: 一瓶奶

examples.en: Would you like some milk in your tea?
examples.zh: 你茶里要加点奶吗？

examples.en: a pint of semi-skimmed milk
examples.zh: 一品脱半脱脂奶

words.definition: a unit for measuring length. There are 1,000 millimetres in one metre.; strich, milimetre
words.translation: 毫米；公厘

examples.en: The creature is a tiny centipede, just 10 millimetres long.
examples.zh: 那个生物是一只很小的蜈蚣，只有10毫米长。

words.definition: the number; an extremely large number of people or things; mega, innumerability; thousand, countless, infinite
words.translation: 百万；许多；[数]百万；无数；[数]百万的；无数的

examples.en: The book sold more than a million copies.
examples.zh: 这本书售出了一百多万册。

examples.en: £37 million of new investment
examples.zh: 3,700万英镑的新投资额

words.definition: your thoughts or your ability to think, feel, and imagine things; opinion, intelligence, energy, memory, spirit; devote one's attention to, concentrate upon; take care of, take notice
words.translation: 头脑；理智；记忆；理智，精神；意见；[心理]智力；记忆力；介意；专心于；照料；注意

examples.en: It is impossible to understand the complex nature of the human mind .
examples.zh: 要想了解人类思维复杂的特性是不可能的。

examples.en: Mind and body are closely related.
examples.zh: 思想和肉体紧密相连。

examples.en: Meditation involves focusing the mind on a single object or word.
examples.zh: 冥想需要把思想集中在一个物体或单词上。

words.definition: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with himself or herself; ore, pit; exploit
words.translation: 我的；矿，矿藏；矿山，矿井；地雷，水雷；开采，采掘；在…布雷

examples.en: It was Glen’s idea, not mine.
examples.zh: 这是格伦的主意，不是我的。

examples.en: ‘Is that your car?’ ‘No, mine is parked over the road.’
examples.zh: “那是你的车吗？”“不是，我的车停在路对面。”

examples.en: You’ve got good legs – mine are too thin.
examples.zh: 你的腿很美——我的腿太细了。

words.definition: someone who works under the ground in a mine to remove coal, gold etc; collier, pitman
words.translation: 矿工；[矿业]矿工；开矿机

examples.en: Therefore, we should be more like a miner to stand in reality, excavate off wastes, and get gold mines.
examples.zh: 所以我们更应该像一个矿工一样为执著于现实，挖开渣滓，淘出金矿。

examples.en: From the standpoint of know-how the only difference between the miner of graphite in Ceylon and the logger in Oregon is in the type of know-how.
examples.zh: 从知道者的立场来看所谓的知道之间的不同不过是锡兰的矿工之于石墨和俄勒冈的伐木工人之间在某一类别的知道而已。

examples.en: A miner bought food from a makeshift shop set up in the trunk of a car near a roadblock by striking miners.
examples.zh: 一位矿工从搭建在车厢中的临时食品店中购买食物，附近的道路都被罢工的矿工们设置了路障。

words.definition: the smallest amount of something or number of things that is possible or necessary; the minimum number, degree, or amount of something is the smallest or least that is possible, allowed, or needed; lowest, least, smallest
words.translation: 最小量；最小的；[数]最小的；最低的

examples.en: This will take a minimum of one hour.
examples.zh: 这最少要用一个小时。

words.definition: a politician who is in charge of a government depart-ment, in Britain and some other countries; secretary, priest
words.translation: 部长，大臣；公使；部长；大臣；牧师

examples.en: a senior Cabinet minister
examples.zh: 资深的内阁部长

words.definition: a government department that is responsible for one of the areas of government work, such as education or health; division, department, sector
words.translation: (政府的)部；（政府的）部门

examples.en: ...the Ministry of Justice.
examples.zh: …司法部。

words.definition: a small group of people or things within a much larger group; ethnic minorities, nonage
words.translation: 少数；少数民族；少数派；未成年

examples.en: Gaelic is still spoken in Ireland by a tiny minority.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰仍有极少数人在说盖尔语。

words.definition: used to talk about a disadvantage of a thing or situation; used to show that one number or quantity is being  subtract ed  from another; less; shortage, short of, lack, insufficient; negative, nonpositive
words.translation: 负的；减(去)；[数]减，减去；[数]负号，减号；不足；负数；减的

examples.en: ‘Any minus points ?’ ‘Well, the engine is rather noisy.’
examples.zh: “有什么毛病吗？”“嗯，发动机噪音很大。”

examples.en: On the minus side, there is no free back-up service if things go wrong.
examples.zh: 不足之处是出了问题没有免费的技术支持服务。

words.definition: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour; cent, moments, note, while, penny; tiny, strict, micro, detailed, particular
words.translation: 分，分钟；一会儿；[计量][数]分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录；微小的，详细的

examples.en: It takes me ten minutes to walk to work.
examples.zh: 我步行上班要用十分钟。

examples.en: The train arrived at four minutes past eight.
examples.zh: 火车于八点零四分到达。

examples.en: He returned a few minutes later.
examples.zh: 几分钟后他回来了。

words.definition: something very lucky or very good that happens which you did not expect to happen or did not think was possible; phenomenon, wonder
words.translation: 奇迹，令人惊奇的人；奇迹，奇迹般的人或物；惊人的事例

examples.en: It’s a miracle you weren’t killed!
examples.zh: 你没有死真是奇迹！

examples.en: By some miracle, we managed to catch the plane.
examples.zh: 我们奇迹般地赶上了飞机。

examples.en: the economic miracle of the 1950s
examples.zh: 20世纪50年代的经济奇迹

words.definition: a piece of special glass that you can look at and see yourself in; if one thing mirrors another, it is very similar to it and may seem to copy or represent it; example, lead; glass, image, echo
words.translation: 镜子；反映，反射；[轻]镜子；真实的写照；榜样；[光]反射；反映

examples.en: He spends hours in front of the mirror !
examples.zh: 他老是照镜子！

examples.en: When I looked in the mirror I couldn’t believe it. I looked fantastic!
examples.zh: 我看着镜子简直不敢相信，我看上去棒极了！

words.definition: used in front of the family name of a woman who is not married to address her politely, to write to her, or to talk about her; lose, let slip
words.translation: 小姐；漏掉；错过；想念

examples.en: I’d like to make an appointment with Miss Taylor.
examples.zh: 我想约一下泰勒小姐。

words.definition: a weapon that can fly over long distances and that explodes when it hits the thing it has been aimed at; dejectile
words.translation: 发射物；导弹；[航][军]导弹；投射物

examples.en: a nuclear missile
examples.zh: 核导弹

examples.en: a missile attack
examples.zh: 导弹袭击

words.definition: something that is missing is not in its usual place, so that you cannot find it; absent; losing, sighing
words.translation: 缺掉的，失去的；失踪的；缺少的；错过（miss的ing形式）；想念；漏掉

examples.en: We found the missing piece of the jigsaw under the chair.
examples.zh: 我们在椅子下面找到了那块丢失的拼图。

examples.en: The keys have been missing for ages.
examples.zh: 钥匙早已丢失了。

words.definition: a light cloud low over the ground that makes it difficult for you to see very far; gauze; fog; fog, obfuscate
words.translation: 薄雾；[气象]薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物；下雾；变模糊；使模糊；使蒙上薄雾

examples.en: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
examples.zh: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

examples.en: He vanished into the mist.
examples.zh: 他消失在雾中。

examples.en: The hills were shrouded in mist (= covered in mist, so that you could not see them ) .
examples.zh: 山峦笼罩在雾霭之中。

words.definition: something that has been done in the wrong way, or an opinion or statement that is incorrect; to understand something wrongly; error, fault, sin, blame, misunderstanding; err in, go wrong; fault, err in
words.translation: 错误；误解，弄错；误会；过失；弄错；误解

examples.en: The most common mistake is to plant them too deep.
examples.zh: 最常见的错误就是把它们种得太深了。

words.definition: Men are sometimes addressed as mister, especially by children and especially when the person talking to them does not know their name; sir, don, gentleman
words.translation: 先生；平民

examples.en: Look, Mister, we know our job, so don't try to tell us what to do.
examples.zh: 哎，先生，我们了解自己的工作，所以你不必告诉我们该干什么。

words.definition: the female owner of a dog, horse etc; other woman, moll
words.translation: 女主人；夫人；情妇；主妇；女教师；女能人

examples.en: The maid looked nervously at her mistress.
examples.zh: 女仆紧张地看着女主人。

words.definition: if you mix two or more substances or if they mix, they combine to become a single substance, and they cannot be easily separated; confuse with; participate, travel, company, sort; mixture, hybrid, chaos, disorder, confusion
words.translation: 使混合，混淆；配制；混淆；使混和；使结交；参与；相混合；交往；混合；混合物；混乱

examples.en: Oil and water don’t mix.
examples.zh: 油和水不相融。

words.definition: a combination of two or more different things, feelings, or types of people; mix, hybrid, compound
words.translation: 混合；混合物；[热][化学][化工]混合；[药]混合剂

examples.en: Pour the mixture into four small dishes.
examples.zh: 把混合料倒入四个小碟子里。

words.definition: a long low sound expressing pain, unhappiness, or sexual pleasure; to make a long low sound expressing pain, unhappiness, or sexual pleasure; beef about, repine; regret, lamentation; beef about, rail against
words.translation: 呻吟声；呻吟；抱怨，悲叹；悲叹；抱怨；呻吟着说

examples.en: She gave a little moan of pleasure.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地发出一声快乐的呻吟。

examples.en: a low moan
examples.zh: 低沉的呻吟声

words.definition: not fixed in one position, and easy to move and use in different places; variable, liquid, motor, unstable
words.translation: 运动的；流动的；[生物]机动的；易变的，；非固定的

examples.en: mobile air-conditioners
examples.zh: 移动式空调器

words.definition: a particular way or style of behaving, living or doing something; way of, manner, pattern, fashion, style
words.translation: 方式，样式；模式；方式；风格；时尚

examples.en: Set the monitor to 256 colour mode.
examples.zh: 把显示器调成256色彩模式。

words.definition: a small copy of a building, vehicle, machine etc, especially one that can be put together from separate parts; matrix, former, shape, fashion, type; mold, simulate, pattern, form, imitate
words.translation: 模型；模式；模特儿；典型；模范；样式；模拟；塑造；模仿

examples.en: a working model (= one with parts which move ) of a steam engine
examples.zh: 蒸汽机车的活动模型

words.definition: having opinions or beliefs, especially about politics, that are not extreme and that most people consider reasonable; pacific, medium, secondary, soft, middle; weaken; deny oneself, allay
words.translation: 温和的；有节制的；稳健的，温和的；适度的，中等的；变缓和，变弱；节制；减轻

examples.en: the more moderate members of the party
examples.zh: 党内观点较为温和的党员

examples.en: a moderate politician
examples.zh: 温和派政治家

words.definition: belonging to the present time or most recent time; recent, fashionable, in, tony; Homo sapiens sapiens
words.translation: 现代的，近代的；时髦的；现代人；有思想的人

examples.en: Such companies must change if they are to compete in the modern world .
examples.zh: 此类公司如果想在现代社会中与别人竞争，就必须有所改变。

examples.en: They are the youngest children in modern times to face murder charges.
examples.zh: 他们是近代面临谋杀指控儿童中年龄最小的。

examples.en: Smaller families are a feature of modern society .
examples.zh: 家庭规模变小是现代社会的一个特征。

words.definition: someone who is modest does not want to talk about their abilities or achievements; odest, inobtrusive
words.translation: 有节制的；谦虚的；谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的；端庄的；羞怯的

examples.en: You’re too modest! You’ve been a huge help to us.
examples.zh: 你太谦虚了！你帮了我们大忙呢。

words.definition: to make small changes to something in order to improve it and make it more suitable or effective; alter, dizen; alter, touch up
words.translation: 更改，修改；修饰；修改，修饰；更改；修改

examples.en: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
examples.zh: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

examples.en: The regulations can only be modified by a special committee.
examples.zh: 这些法规只能由特别委员会来修改。

words.definition: slightly wet, especially in a way that is pleasant or suitable; wet, humid; dampness, humidification
words.translation: 湿润的；多雨的；[气象][物]潮湿的；含泪的；[气象][物]潮湿

examples.en: Make sure the soil is moist before planting the seeds.
examples.zh: 播种之前要确保土壤湿润。

examples.en: a rich, moist chocolate cake
examples.zh: 香浓软润的巧克力蛋糕

examples.en: warm moist air
examples.zh: 温暖湿润的空气

words.definition: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in the ground; rainfall, humidity content
words.translation: 潮湿，湿气；温度；水分；湿度；[气象][物]潮湿；降雨量

examples.en: When the soil is dry, more moisture is lost from the plant.
examples.zh: 土壤干燥时，植物就会失去更多的水分。

words.definition: the smallest unit into which any substance can be divided without losing its own chemical nature, usually consisting of two or more atoms; numerator of a fraction, microne
words.translation: 分子，克分子；[化学]分子；微小颗粒，微粒

examples.en: The molecules of oxygen gas contain just two atoms.
examples.zh: 氧分子中只有两个原子。

words.definition: a particular point in time; importance, breath, second, magnitude, instant
words.translation: 片刻，瞬间，时刻；重要，契机；瞬间；重要时刻；指定时刻

examples.en: It was one of the most exciting moments in his life.
examples.zh: 这是他一生中最激动人心的时刻之一。

examples.en: She may be in trouble at this very moment and trying to call you.
examples.zh: 此时此刻她可能遇到了麻烦，正想方设法给你打电话。

examples.en: I remember the moment when I first saw him after the operation.
examples.zh: 我还记得手术后第一次见到他的那一刻。

words.definition: the day between Sunday and Tuesday
words.translation: 星期一

examples.en: The president announced Monday that he would cancel the debt.
examples.zh: 总统周一宣布他会取消这笔债务。

words.definition: what you earn by working and can use to buy things. Money can be in the form of notes and coins or cheques, and can be kept in a bank; currency, wealth, treasure, fortune, QIAN
words.translation: 货币；金钱，财富；钱；[金融]货币；财富

examples.en: Don’t spend all your money on the first day of your holiday!
examples.zh: 别在度假的第一天就把钱都花完了！

examples.en: The repairs will cost quite a lot of money.
examples.zh: 修理要花一大笔钱。

words.definition: a small brown animal with a long tail, which uses its hands to climb trees and lives in hot countries; urchin, simian; horse around, mess about; guy, make game of
words.translation: 猴子，猿；猴子；顽童；胡闹；捣蛋；嘲弄

examples.en: The monkey is beating up and down.
examples.zh: 那只猴子到处乱窜。

examples.en: The monkey engulfed the food whole.
examples.zh: 这只猴子囫囵吞下食物。

examples.en: The monkey had deflowered an entire section of the garden.
