examples.zh: 我想他肯定是警察，他不断地转弯抹角地打听消息。

words.definition: a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization; deal, programm
words.translation: 政策，方针；[保险]保险单

examples.en: ...plans that include changes in foreign policy and economic reforms.
examples.zh: …包括外交政策调整和经济改革的计划。

words.definition: grace, buffing; furbish; Polak
words.translation: 磨光；使优美；[机]磨光，擦亮；上光剂，擦亮剂；优雅，精良；[机]磨光，使发亮；波兰的

examples.en: They just need to polish their technique.
examples.zh: 他们只需要改进一下自己的技艺。

words.definition: behaving or speaking in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people’s needs and feelings; civil, elegant, gentle, mild, courteous
words.translation: 有礼貌的；有教养的；有礼貌的，客气的；文雅的；上流的；优雅的

examples.en: She’s always very polite.
examples.zh: 她总是很有礼貌。

examples.en: polite, well-behaved children
examples.zh: 懂礼貌、守规矩的孩子

examples.en: a clear but polite request
examples.zh: 明确但客气的请求

words.definition: Political means relating to the way power is achieved and used in a country or society; governmental, clannish
words.translation: 政治的，政治上的；政治的；党派的

examples.en: All other political parties there have been completely banned.
examples.zh: 那里的其他所有政党都已经完全被取缔了。

examples.en: The government is facing another political crisis.
examples.zh: 该政府正面临着另一场政治危机。

words.definition: someone who works in politics, especially an elected member of the government; statesman
words.translation: 政治家；政客；政治家，政客

examples.en: politicians who are trying to get the minority vote
examples.zh: 努力争取少数族群选票的政治家

examples.en: a British Labour politician
examples.zh: 英国工党政治家

words.definition: ideas and activities relating to gaining and using power in a country, city etc; department of political science
words.translation: 政治，政治学；政纲；政治活动

examples.en: a good understanding of politics in China
examples.zh: 对中国政治很好的了解

examples.en: modern American politics
examples.zh: 现代美国政治

examples.en: Politics have always interested Anita.
examples.zh: 阿妮塔一直对政治感兴趣。

words.definition: to make air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty and not suitable for people to use; cloud, poison
words.translation: 弄脏，污染，沾污；污染；玷污；败坏

examples.en: beaches polluted by raw sewage
examples.zh: 受未经处理的污水污染的海滩

examples.en: The factory pollutes the air and water.
examples.zh: 那家工厂污染了空气和水。

words.definition: the process of making air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty and not suitable for people to use, or the state of being dangerously dirty; contamination, impureness
words.translation: 污染；[环境]污染

examples.en: California’s tough anti-pollution laws
examples.zh: 加利福尼亚州严厉的反污染法

words.definition: a small area of fresh water that is smaller than a lake, that is either natural or artificially made; tank, mere
words.translation: 池塘；[水文]池塘

examples.en: The path descends to  the pond.
examples.zh: 小路下斜通到池塘。

examples.en: This pond often catches in winter.
examples.zh: 这个池塘在冬天常常结冰。

examples.en: Wild flowers and grasses rimmed the little pond.
examples.zh: 各种野花和野草环绕着这个小池塘。

words.definition: a hole or container that has been specially made and filled with water so that people can swim or play in it; billiard ball
words.translation: 水塘，游泳池，水池；联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金

examples.en: They have a nice pool in their backyard.
examples.zh: 他们后院有个漂亮的游泳池。

examples.en: a shallow pool suitable for children
examples.zh: 适合儿童的浅水池

words.definition: having very little money and not many possessions; mean, base, dirty
words.translation: 贫穷的；贫乏的；可怜的；卑鄙的

examples.en: Her family were so poor they couldn’t afford to buy her new clothes.
examples.zh: 她家穷得甚至买不起新衣服给她。

examples.en: an area where poor people lived
examples.zh: 穷人居住区

examples.en: one of the poorest countries in the world
examples.zh: 世界上最贫穷的国家之一

words.definition: liked by a lot of people; democratic, fashionable, going, welcome, pop
words.translation: 民众的；流行的；流行的，通俗的；受欢迎的；大众的；普及的

examples.en: Hilary was popular at school.
examples.zh: 希拉里在学校里很受欢迎。

examples.en: a popular holiday resort
examples.zh: 人们喜欢的度假胜地

examples.en: Coffee is probably the most popular drink in the world.
examples.zh: 咖啡很可能是世界上最受欢迎的饮料。

words.definition: the number of people living in a particular area, country etc; syngen, species group
words.translation: 人口；全体居民；种群，[生物]群体

examples.en: Nearly 70 percent of the population still live in the countryside.
examples.zh: 人口中差不多有70%仍住在乡村。

words.definition: the meat from pigs; pig, pigmeat
words.translation: 猪肉

examples.en: pork chops
examples.zh: 猪排

words.definition: a place where ships can be loaded and unloaded; haven, bunder
words.translation: 港，港口；[水运]港口，口岸；（计算机的）[电子][计]端口；[航][船]左舷；舱门

examples.en: Britain’s largest port
examples.zh: 英国最大的港口城市

words.definition: able to be carried or moved easily; luggable, hand-held
words.translation: 轻便的；手提的；手提的，便携式的

examples.en: a portable radio
examples.zh: 便携式收音机

words.definition: a part of something larger, especially a part that is different from the other parts; part, proportion, fate, percent, lot; part, to allocate
words.translation: 一部分；一分；部分；一份；命运；分配；给…嫁妆

examples.en: Do you have any children’s portions?
examples.zh: 你们有儿童餐吗？

words.definition: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person; description, image, icon
words.translation: 消像，画像；肖像；描写；半身雕塑像

examples.en: a family portrait
examples.zh: 全家福

examples.en: She’s been commissioned to paint Jackson’s portrait .
examples.zh: 她已受托为杰克逊画肖像。

words.definition: if you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think about what is good in a situation rather than what is bad; active, established, practical, actual, fixed, effective, sincere
words.translation: 确定的；积极的；[电]积极的；[摄][物][数]正的，[化学][医]阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的

examples.en: the power of positive thinking
examples.zh: 正向思考的力量

examples.en: ‘ Think positive !’ she advised herself.
examples.zh: “往好的方面想！”她劝自己。

words.definition: to have a particular quality or ability; contain, regulate, bit, bottle, manage
words.translation: 占用，拥有(财产)；控制；使掌握；持有；迷住

examples.en: Different workers possess different skills.
examples.zh: 不同的工人拥有不同技能。

examples.en: He no longer possessed the power to frighten her.
examples.zh: 他再也吓不倒她了。

words.definition: if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere; estate, property, treasure, worth
words.translation: 有，所有；占有物；拥有；财产；领地；自制；着迷

examples.en: That information is not in our possession.
examples.zh: 那则信息不归我们所有。

examples.en: How did the painting come into your possession (= how did you get it ) ?
examples.zh: 这幅画是怎么到你手上的？

examples.en: The finance company now has possession of the house.
examples.zh: 这家金融公司目前拥有这所房子。

words.definition: if there is a possibility that something is true or that something will happen, it might be true or it might happen; probability, feasibility, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可能；可能的事；可能性；可能发生的事物

examples.en: There’s always a possibility that he might go back to Seattle.
examples.zh: 他也许会回到西雅图去，这种可能性一直存在。

examples.en: the possibility of an enemy attack
examples.zh: 敌人进攻的可能性

examples.en: There was no possibility of changing the voting procedure.
examples.zh: 改变投票程序是不可能的。

words.definition: if something is possible, it can be done or achieved; reasonable, feasible, applicable, logical, rational; probability, feasibility, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可能的；可能存在的；合理的；合适的；可能性；合适的人；可能的事物

examples.en: Is it possible toget tickets for the game?
examples.zh: 有没有可能弄到比赛的门票？

examples.en: It might be possible for the documents to be sent over.
examples.zh: 这些文件也许可以发送过去。

examples.en: Computer technology makes it possible for many people to work from home.
examples.zh: 计算机技术让很多人可以在家里工作。

words.definition: used when saying that something may be true or likely, although you are not completely certain; probably, maybe, perhaps, potentially
words.translation: 可能地；也许；大概

examples.en: This last task is possibly the most difficult.
examples.zh: 这最后一项任务也许是最难的。

examples.en: It will take three weeks, possibly longer.
examples.zh: 要花三个星期，也许更久。

examples.en: ‘Will you be here tomorrow?’ ‘Possibly.’
examples.zh: “你明天到这儿来吗？”“也许吧。”

words.definition: a strong upright piece of wood, metal etc that is fixed into the ground, especially to support something; to send a letter, package etc by post; mail, dak; paste, publish
words.translation: 柱，桩，杆；贴出；[劳经]岗位；邮件；[测]标杆；张贴；公布；邮递；布置

examples.en: a fence post
examples.zh: 篱笆桩

words.definition: the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post; taxe, franking
words.translation: 邮费，邮资；[邮]邮资，邮费

examples.en: How much is the postage for a postcard?
examples.zh: 寄一张明信片的邮资是多少？

words.definition: someone whose job is to collect and deliver letters; letter carrier, mailman
words.translation: 邮递员；邮差

examples.en: That postman is in charge of this route.
examples.zh: 那个邮递员负责这条投递线路。

examples.en: The old man often stands here to watch out for the postman.
examples.zh: 老人常常站在这儿等邮递员。

words.definition: to change the date or time of a planned event or action to a later one; adjourn; stave off, time delay
words.translation: 延迟，推迟，延缓；使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面；延缓，延迟；延缓发作

examples.en: The match had to be postponed until next week.
examples.zh: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

examples.en: His trial has been postponed indefinitely (= no one knows when it will happen ) .
examples.zh: 对他的审判被无限期推迟了。

words.definition: a container used for cooking which is round, deep, and usually made of metal; basin, kettle; flight, take a shot at
words.translation: 锅，壶，罐，盆；[轻]壶；盆；罐；把…装罐；射击；节略

examples.en: herbs growing in pots
examples.zh: 长在花盆里的草本植物

words.definition: a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or pale yellow skin, that grows under the ground; murphy, tater
words.translation: 马铃薯，土豆；土豆，[作物]马铃薯

examples.en: Marie stood at the sink, peeling potatoes (= cutting off the skin ) .
examples.zh: 玛丽站在洗涤槽边削土豆皮。

words.definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 16  ounce s  or 0.454 kilograms; prison, devel; hold, prison; drive, belt
words.translation: 磅；英磅；英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所；捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留；连续重击，猛击

examples.en: Moira weighs about 130 pounds .
examples.zh: 莫伊拉的体重约为130磅。

examples.en: The grapes cost $2 a pound .
examples.zh: 葡萄的价格是2美元一磅。

words.definition: to make a liquid or other substance flow out of or into a container by holding it at an angle; if a lot of liquid or smoke pours out, it comes out from somewhere in very large amounts; issue, flux, dumping; shed; flow
words.translation: 灌，倒；倾泻；流出；骤雨；灌，注；倒；倾吐；涌流；斟茶

examples.en: She poured coffee for everyone.
examples.zh: 她为每个人都倒了咖啡。

words.definition: the situation or experience of being poor; difficulty, shortage, hardness, want
words.translation: 贫穷，贫困；贫困；困难；缺少；低劣

examples.en: Millions of elderly people live in poverty .
examples.zh: 数百万老年人生活在贫困之中。

examples.en: We need an effective strategy to fight poverty .
examples.zh: 我们需要制定一个有效的对策来与贫困作斗争。

examples.en: continued efforts to alleviate poverty and raise living standards
examples.zh: 缓解贫困和提高生活水平的不懈努力

words.definition: a dry substance in the form of very small grains; dust, dirt; pulverize
words.translation: 粉末；药粉；火药；[材]粉；[化工][军]火药；尘土；使成粉末；撒粉；搽粉于

examples.en: curry powder
examples.zh: 咖喱粉

examples.en: talcum powder
examples.zh: 滑石[爽身]粉

examples.en: Grind the sugar into a powder .
examples.zh: 把糖碾成粉末。

words.definition: the ability or right to control people or events; strength, ability, competence, regime, force; stimulate, bestir; make good time
words.translation: 能力；力；权；幂；[物]功率；力量；政权；势力；[数]幂；激励；供以动力；使…有力量；快速前进

examples.en: They seized power in a military coup.
examples.zh: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

words.definition: a powerful person, organization, group etc is able to control and influence events and other people’s actions; formidable, cogent; greatly, quite, badly, extremely, too, highly, far
words.translation: 强有力的；有权威的；强大的；很；非常

examples.en: He was one of the most powerful men in Bohemia.
examples.zh: 他是波希米亚最有权势的人物之一。

examples.en: a very influential and powerful family
examples.zh: 很有权势的家庭

examples.en: rich and powerful nations
examples.zh: 富强的国家

words.definition: relating to real situations and events rather than ideas, emotions etc; actual, effective, real, pragmatic, positive
words.translation: 实践的；实用的；实际的；实用性的

examples.en: Candidates should have training and practical experience in basic electronics.
examples.zh: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

examples.en: the practical problems of old age
examples.zh: 老年的实际问题

examples.en: They provide financial and practical help for disabled students.
examples.zh: 他们为残障学生提供经济上的援助以及实际的帮助。

words.definition: almost; almost, nearly, actually, really, most
words.translation: 实际上；几乎；实际地；事实上

examples.en: I’ve read practically all of his books.
examples.zh: 我差不多读过他所有的书。

examples.en: She sees him practically every day.
examples.zh: 她几乎天天见到他。

examples.en: It’s practically impossible to predict what will happen.
examples.zh: 将会发生什么，几乎不能预料。

words.definition: when you do a particular thing, often regularly, in order to improve your skill at it; tradition, convention, usage, exercise; exercise, bring to pass; execute, exercise
words.translation: 实践；练习；业务；惯例；[劳经]实习；实行

examples.en: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

examples.en: With a little more practice you should be able to pass your test.
examples.zh: 稍微再练一练，你应该能通过考试了。

examples.en: We have choir practice on Tuesday evening.
examples.zh: 星期二晚上我们要练习合唱。

words.definition: to do an activity, often regularly, in order to improve your skill or to prepare for a test; exercise, wage; execute, exercise, fulfil, enforce
words.translation: 练习，实习，训练；练习，实践；实施，实行；从事

examples.en: They moved the furniture back to practise their dance routine.
examples.zh: 他们把家具往后挪以便练习舞蹈动作。

examples.en: It gives students the opportunity to practice their speaking skills.
examples.zh: 这给学生提供了锻炼口才的机会。

words.definition: to speak to God in order to ask for help or give thanks; beseech, obsecrate; cry on, appeal to sb for sth
words.translation: 请求；祈祷；恳求；央求；请

examples.en: They went to the mosque to pray.
examples.zh: 他们去清真寺祷告。

words.definition: something you do in order to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening; prevention, prophylaxis; keep one's eye on the ball, keep one's eyes peeled
words.translation: 预防；警惕；预防，警惕；预防措施；预先警告

examples.en: Fire precautions were neglected.
examples.zh: 防火措施被忽视了。

examples.en: Vets took precautions to prevent the spread of the disease.
examples.zh: 兽医们为防止疾病蔓延采取了预防措施。

words.definition: happening or coming before the time, place, or part mentioned; prior, prius
words.translation: 在前的；在先的；前述的

examples.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
examples.zh: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

words.definition: something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care; golden, valued
words.translation: 珍贵的，宝贵的；宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的

examples.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
examples.zh: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

examples.en: our planet’s precious resources
examples.zh: 我们星球上的宝贵资源

words.definition: precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct; accurate, strict, mathematical, rigid, decided
words.translation: 精确的，准确的；精确的；明确的；严格的

examples.en: precise sales figures
examples.zh: 准确的销售数据

examples.en: It was difficult to get precise information.
examples.zh: 很难得到确切的消息。

examples.en: ‘She’s a lot older than you, isn’t she?’ ‘Fifteen years, to be precise .’
examples.zh: “她比你大很多，是不是？”“准确地说，大了15岁。”

words.definition: the quality of being very exact or correct; fidelity, rigor; nice, accurate, mathematical, strict, rigid
words.translation: 精确，精密，精密度；[数]精度，精密度；精确；[数]精密的，精确的

words.definition: an introduction at the beginning of a book or speech; prolegomena, perface; begin with, open with
words.translation: 序言，前言，引语；前言；引语；为…加序言；以…开始

examples.en: ...the preface to Kelman's novel.
examples.zh: …凯尔曼小说的前言。

words.definition: introduce, promote, present, upgrade, file; affect, take a fancy to
words.translation: 宁可，宁愿；更喜欢；宁愿；提出；提升；喜欢；愿意

words.definition: better or more suitable; Mair
words.translation: 更可取的，更好的；更好的，更可取的；更合意的

examples.en: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
examples.zh: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

examples.en: In warm weather, clothes made of natural fabrics are infinitely preferable (= much better ) .
examples.zh: 天气暖和的时候，穿天然织物的衣服要舒适得多。

words.definition: happening before something that is more important, often in order to prepare for it; preparation, arrangement, provision; opening, rudimentary
words.translation: 预备的，初步的；准备；预赛；初步措施；初步的；开始的；预备的

examples.en: the preliminary stages of the competition
examples.zh: 竞赛的预赛阶段

examples.en: a preliminary draft
examples.zh: 初稿

words.definition: the process of preparing something or preparing for something; arrangement, preliminary, provision
words.translation: 准备，预备；制备；预备；准备

examples.en: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
examples.zh: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

examples.en: Plans for the new school are now in preparation .
examples.zh: 新学校的设计图正在绘制中。

examples.en: a course in food service and food preparation
examples.zh: 餐饮服务和备菜课程

words.definition: a word that is used before a noun,  pronoun  , or  gerund  to show place, time, direction etc. In the phrase ‘the trees in the park’, ‘in’ is a preposition.
words.translation: 前置词，介词

examples.en: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
examples.zh: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。

words.definition: to stipulate, to formulate; define, regulate, state, rule
words.translation: 命令；处(方)；规定；开药方；开处方

examples.en: The physician examines the patient then diagnoses the disease and prescribes medication.
examples.zh: 内科医生检查了病人，然后对疾病作出诊断，并开出药方。

words.definition: when someone or something is present in a particular place; existence, being, entity, is
words.translation: 出席，到场；在；[植]存在；出席；参加；风度；仪态

examples.en: Your presence is requested at the club meeting on Friday.
examples.zh: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

words.definition: in a particular place; at this time; prefer, file, advance, recommend, assume; current, now; gift, giving, aiming, training, tribute
words.translation: 现在的；目前；提出；介绍；呈现；赠送；出席的；现在；礼物；瞄准

examples.en: the present situation of the millions of people who are suffering poverty and disease
examples.zh: 遭受贫困和疾病折磨的数百万人民的现状

words.definition: in a short time; soon, erelong
words.translation: 一会儿；目前；（美）目前；不久

examples.en: The doctor will be here presently.
examples.zh: 医生一会儿就到。

examples.en: Presently, I fell asleep.
examples.zh: 一会儿我就睡着了。

words.definition: the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen; principal, prez
words.translation: 总统；校长；会长；董事长

examples.en: President Bush
examples.zh: 布什总统

words.definition: to push something firmly against a surface; push, hug; clic, news bulletin
words.translation: 压，按，揿；催促；压；按；逼迫；紧抱；新闻；出版社；[印刷]印刷机

examples.en: Manville kept his back pressed flat against the wall.
examples.zh: 曼维尔后背紧紧地贴在墙上。

examples.en: She pressed the gas pedal and the car leapt forwards.
examples.zh: 她踩下油门，汽车向前冲了出去。

examples.en: He pressed a card into her hand before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开之前他往她手里塞了一张卡片。

words.definition: an attempt to persuade someone by using influence, arguments, or threats; heat, compression force; reduce to, compel
words.translation: 压力；压，按；[力]压力；压迫，[物]压强；迫使；密封；使……增压

examples.en: They are putting pressure on people to vote yes.
examples.zh: 他们正在向民众施加压力，要求他们投赞成票。

examples.en: You must never give in to pressure .
examples.zh: 你绝不能屈从压力。

words.definition: to behave as if something is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun; simulate, come; act, fox; affected, assumed, simulate
words.translation: 假托，借口vi假装；假装；假扮；伪称；假装的

examples.en: Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.
examples.zh: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

examples.en: He’s not asleep – he’s just pretending.
examples.zh: 他并没睡着，不过是装睡而已。

examples.en: To pretend ignorance of the situation would be irresponsible.
examples.zh: 装作不知情是不负责任的做法。

words.definition: a woman or child who is pretty has a nice attractive face; lovely, taking, smart, cute, tony; relatively, fairly, comparatively, reasonably, considerably
words.translation: 漂亮的，标致的；漂亮的；可爱的；优美的；相当地；颇

examples.en: a pretty little girl
examples.zh: 漂亮的小姑娘

examples.en: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
examples.zh: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

words.definition: the amount of money you have to pay for something; importance, value, expense, rate, figure
words.translation: 价格，价钱；代价；[物价]价格；价值；[贸易]代价

examples.en: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
examples.zh: 为了短短几年的辉煌，他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

words.definition: a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved; to be especially proud of something that you do well, or of a good quality that you have; selfrespect, pretension; exalt; glory, be proud of
words.translation: 骄傲；自豪；自夸；自尊心；使得意，以…自豪

examples.en: He wore his medals with pride.
examples.zh: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

examples.en: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
examples.zh: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

examples.en: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
examples.zh: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

words.definition: most important; greatest, major, elementary, central, main; excellently, famously; youth, morning, essence, elite, flower; ready; provide
words.translation: 首要的；春，青春；主要的；最好的；基本的；极好地；初期；青年；精华；全盛时期；使准备好；填装；作准备

examples.en: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
examples.zh: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

examples.en: Our prime concern is providing jobs for all young school leavers.
examples.zh: 我们的头等大事是为所有的年轻毕业生提供工作。

examples.en: He was named as the prime suspect in the murder investigation.
examples.zh: 在那宗谋杀案的调查中他被定为主要嫌疑人。

words.definition: the son of a king, queen, or prince; noble, infante
words.translation: 王子，亲王；王子，国君；亲王；贵族

examples.en: Prince William
examples.zh: 威廉王子

words.definition: a close female relation of a king and queen, especially a daughter; infanta, rani
words.translation: 公主，王妃；公主；王妃；女巨头

examples.en: Princess Anne
examples.zh: 安妮公主

words.definition: most important; the main person in a business or organization, who can make important business decisions and is legally responsible for them; president, client, party, headmaster; supreme, main, lead
words.translation: 主要的；负责人；校长；委托人，当事人；资本；主犯；首要的；最重要的

examples.en: His principal reason for making the journey was to visit his family.
examples.zh: 他那次旅程的首要目的是探访家人。

examples.en: Teaching is her principal source of income.
examples.zh: 教书是她主要的收入来源。

examples.en: the principal character in the book
examples.zh: 书里的主人公

words.definition: to produce many printed copies of a book, newspaper etc; writing that has been printed, for example in books or newspapers; impression, seal; strike off; bring out, get out
words.translation: 印刷；正片；[印刷]印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记；[印刷]印刷；[计]打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样；出版

examples.en: Over five million copies of the paper are printed every day.
examples.zh: 这份报纸每日印量超过五百万。

examples.en: When the book was first written no publisher would print it.
examples.zh: 这本书刚写成时没有出版商愿意出版。

words.definition: existing or arranged before something else or before the present situation; preferred, underlying; before, antecedently
words.translation: 在先的；优先的；[数]优先的；在先的，在前的；在前，居先

examples.en: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
examples.zh: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

examples.en: Changes may not be made without the prior approval of the council.
examples.zh: 未经委员会事先同意，不得作出改变。

examples.en: Vegetarian meals are provided by prior agreement.
examples.zh: 经事先协商可提供素食。

words.definition: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial; jail, big house; imprison, jail
words.translation: 监狱，监禁；[法]监狱；监禁；拘留所；监禁，关押

examples.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
examples.zh: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

examples.en: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
examples.zh: 里基现已出狱三年。

examples.en: They’ll probably put him in prison for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

words.definition: someone who is kept in a prison as a legal punishment for a crime or while they are waiting for their  trial; capture, galley slave
words.translation: 囚犯；囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
examples.zh: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

examples.en: Prisoners here only serve short sentences.
examples.zh: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

examples.en: The organization is arguing for the release of political prisoners (= people in prison because of their political opinions ) .
examples.zh: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

words.definition: a special advantage that is given only to one person or group of people; franchise, peculiar
words.translation: 特权，优惠；[计]特权；优待；基本权利

examples.en: He had no special privileges and was treated just like every other prisoner.
examples.zh: 他不享受特权，待遇和任何其他犯人一样。

words.definition: something that is given to someone who is successful in a competition, race, game of chance etc; to think that someone or something is very important or valuable; award, capture; assess, acquire, evaluate, value, rate
words.translation: 奖赏，奖金；珍视；[劳经]奖品；奖赏；战利品；捕获；估价

examples.en: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
examples.zh: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

examples.en: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
examples.zh: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

examples.en: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
examples.zh: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

words.definition: how likely something is, sometimes calculated in a mathematical way; possibility, feasibility, potential, maybe, chance
words.translation: 可能性；概率；机率；[数]或然率

examples.en: You must decide whether, on the balance of probabilities , he committed the crime.
examples.zh: 你们一定要权衡正反两方面的可能性，然后再裁定他是否犯罪。

words.definition: likely to exist, happen, or be true; likely, trusted, authentic
words.translation: 或有的；大概的；很可能的；可信的

examples.en: The probable cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

examples.en: Success is highly probable .
examples.zh: 成功的希望相当大。

words.translation: 或许，大概

words.definition: a situation that causes difficulties; conundrum, puzzler; debatable, stubborn
words.translation: 问题；习题，问题；难题；引起麻烦的人；成问题的；难处理的

examples.en: She was older than me, but that wasn’t really a problem.
examples.zh: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

words.definition: to continue to do something that has already been planned or started; occur, happen, travel, pursue
words.translation: 进行；继续进行；开始；发生；行进

examples.en: Before proceeding further, we must define our terms.
examples.zh: 我们必须先定义术语，然后再往下展开。

words.definition: a line of people or vehicles moving slowly as part of a ceremony; train, cavalcade; file
words.translation: 队伍，行列；一列，一排；列队行进

examples.en: They marched in procession to the Capitol building.
examples.zh: 他们列队向国会大厦行进。

words.definition: to cause a particular result or effect; attract, cause, operate, occasion, induce; manufacture, work, agricultural products; turn out, bring in
words.translation: 生产；产生；展现；引起；创作；农产品，产品；生产，创作

examples.en: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
examples.zh: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

examples.en: a rise in sea level produced by climatic change
examples.zh: 由气候变化引起的海平面升高

examples.en: As a policy, it did not produce the desired effect .
examples.zh: 作为一项政策，它并未产生预期的效果。

words.definition: something that is grown or made in a factory in large quantities, usually in order to be sold; outcome, event, result, manufacture, writing
words.translation: 产品，产物；(乘)积；[经]产品；结果；[数]乘积；作品

examples.en: The London factory assembles the finished product .
examples.zh: 伦敦工厂组装成品。

examples.en: He works in marketing and product development.
examples.zh: 他从事营销和产品开发。

words.definition: the process of making or growing things to be sold, especially in large quantities; feedback, outcome, writing, manufacture, work
words.translation: 生产；产品；总产量；成果；[经]生产；作品

examples.en: That model won't go into production before late 2007.
examples.zh: 那种型号要到2007年底才会投入生产。

words.definition: a job that needs a high level of education and training; employment, career, calling, pursuit, statement, occupation
words.translation: 职业；职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白

examples.en: people who work in the professions
examples.zh: 从事专业性工作的人

examples.en: nurses, social workers, and other people in the caring professions
examples.zh: 护士、社工和其他从事护理行业的人

words.translation: 教授

examples.en: The professor improvised a poem in the class.
examples.zh: 教授在课堂上即兴创作了一首诗。

examples.en: The professor lambasted me for my careless mistake.
examples.zh: 教授严厉批评了我的粗心错误。

examples.en: We were laughing about that absent-minded professor.
examples.zh: 我们都在笑那个心不在焉的教授。

words.definition: money that you gain by selling things or doing business, after your costs have been paid; to be useful or helpful to someone; behalf, margin, benefit, gain, sake; advantage, gain; benefit, be good for
words.translation: 益处；利润；得益；[会计]利润；利益；获利；有益；有益于

examples.en: The shop’s daily profit is usually around $500.
examples.zh: 这家商店每天的利润一般在500美元左右。

examples.en: She sold the business and bought a farm with the profits.
examples.zh: 她卖了公司，用所得利润买下了一座农场。

examples.en: They sold their house at a healthy profit .
examples.zh: 他们卖掉房子，赚了一大笔钱。

words.definition: a set of instructions given to a computer to make it perform an operation; procedure, routine, plan, scheme, project
words.translation: 节目单；大纲；程序；[计]程序；计划

examples.en: a word processing program
examples.zh: 文字处理程序

words.definition: the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something; development, growth, making, advancement; wage, do, go ahead
words.translation: 前进，进展；进步；进步，发展；前进；前进，进步；进行

examples.en: We made good progress despite the snow.
examples.zh: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

words.definition: supporting new or modern ideas and methods, especially in politics and education; advanced, ascensive
words.translation: 进步的；向前进的；[数]进步的；先进的

examples.en: a progressive administration
examples.zh: 进步的政府

examples.en: progressive and forward-looking policies
examples.zh: 有前瞻性的进步政策

words.definition: a statement that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will definitely happen; to tell someone that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will happen; wish, hope, pleasure; pledge, vouchsafe
words.translation: 诺言；指望；允诺；许诺，允诺；希望；允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望

examples.en: If you make a promise, you should keep it.
examples.zh: 如果你许下一个诺言，你就应该遵守它。

words.definition: a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, such as ‘he’ instead of ‘Peter’ or ‘the man’
words.translation: 代名词

examples.en: Now if we could only figure out the pronoun problem.
examples.zh: 现在我们可以解决这个代词问题了。

words.definition: to make the sound of a letter, word etc, especially in the correct way; declare, pass sentence; articulate
words.translation: 发…的音；宣布；发音；宣判；断言；作出判断

examples.en: How do you pronounce your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字怎么念？

words.definition: the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced; sonation, vocalization
words.translation: 发音，发音法；发音；读法

examples.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
examples.zh: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

words.definition: facts, information, documents etc that prove something is true; authentication, certification, demonstration, confirmation, witness; try out, put to test
words.translation: 证据；证明；校样；考验；验证；试验；校对；使不被穿透

examples.en: There is no proof that the document is authentic.
examples.zh: 没有证据证明这份文件是真的。

words.definition: right, suitable, or correct; suitable, appropriate, adequate, typical, becoming; totally, entirely, completely, absolutely, thoroughly, strictly, fully
words.translation: 适合的；合乎体统的；适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的；完全地

examples.en: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
examples.zh: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

examples.en: the proper way to clean your teeth
examples.zh: 正确的刷牙方法

examples.en: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
examples.zh: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

words.definition: the thing or things that someone owns; performance, nature, ownership, estate, capability
words.translation: 财产，资产；性质；性质，性能；[经]财产；[法]所有权

examples.en: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
examples.zh: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

examples.en: Some of the stolen property was found in Mason’s house.
examples.zh: 在梅森家里找到了部分被盗财物。

words.definition: something that is proportional to something else is in the correct or most suitable relationship to it in size, amount, importance etc; relative, matching, uniform, worthy
words.translation: 比例的；相称的；[数]比例的，成比例的；相称的，均衡的

examples.en: The fee charged by the realtor is directly proportional to the price of the property.
examples.zh: 房产代理人收取的费用和房产价格是成正比的。

examples.en: a proportional increase in costs
examples.zh: 成本的相应提高

words.definition: to suggest something as a plan or course of action; to ask someone to marry you, especially in a formal way; schedule, design, map, think, purpose; aim, offer
words.translation: 提议；求婚；建议；打算，计划；打算

examples.en: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
examples.zh: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

examples.en: the proposed budget cuts
examples.zh: 所提出的预算削减

words.definition: rich and successful; flourishing, booming
words.translation: 繁荣的，昌盛的；繁荣的；兴旺的

examples.en: a prosperous landowner
examples.zh: 富裕的土地拥有者

words.definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or illness; secure, watch, preserve
words.translation: 保护，保卫，警戒；保护，防卫；警戒

examples.en: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
examples.zh: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

words.definition: when someone or something is protected; lee, safeguard, conservation, defence, pass
words.translation: 保护，警戒；保护；防卫；护照

examples.en: protection money
examples.zh: 保护费

words.definition: used or intended for protection; phylactic, shielded
words.translation: 保护的，防护的；防护的；关切保护的；保护贸易的

examples.en: protective clothing
examples.zh: 防护服

examples.en: Sunscreen provides a protective layer against the sun’s harmful rays.
examples.zh: 防晒霜提供了一层抵挡阳光中有害光线的防护层。

words.definition: one of several natural substances that exist in food such as meat, eggs, and beans, and which your body needs in order to grow and remain strong and healthy; albumose; glaireous
words.translation: 蛋白质，朊；[生化]蛋白质；朊；[生化]蛋白质的

examples.en: Where do you get your protein?
examples.zh: 你从哪里获得蛋白质？

examples.en: I know that I get around 90g of protein from that.
examples.zh: 我知道我会从中得到90克左右的蛋白质。

words.definition: feeling pleased about something that you have done or something that you own, or about someone or something you are involved with or related to; beamish, complacent
words.translation: 骄傲的；自豪的；得意的；自负的

examples.en: Seth was the proud owner of a new sports car.
examples.zh: 赛思因为有了新跑车而扬扬得意。

words.definition: to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc; demonstrate, reveal, make clear, argue
words.translation: 证明；结果是；检验；显示

examples.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
examples.zh: 你错了，我可以证明。

examples.en: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
examples.zh: 为了证明自己的观点，他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

words.definition: to give something to someone or make it available to them, because they need it or want it; afford, define, regulate, tender, state; take care of, prime
words.translation: 提供；装备，供给；规定；准备；装备；抚养；作准备

examples.en: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
examples.zh: 有茶水和饼干供应。

words.translation: 以…为条件

words.definition: one of the large areas into which some countries are divided, and which usually has its own local government; domain, territory, world, universe, kingdom
words.translation: 省；领域，部门；领域；职权

examples.en: a Chinese province
examples.zh: 中国的一个省

words.definition: when you provide something that someone needs now or in the future; item, preparation, arrangement, preliminary, do
words.translation: 供应；预备；存粮；规定；条款；准备；[经]供应品

examples.en: He made provisions for his wife and his children in his will.
examples.zh: 在遗嘱里他为妻子和孩子都做好了安排。

words.definition: relating to all the ordinary people in a country, who are not members of the government or do not have important jobs; ordinary people who do not work for the government or have any special position in society; governmental, commonable; society, ambiente
words.translation: 公众的；公众；政府的；公用的；公立的；社会；公共场所

examples.en: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (= helpful or useful to ordinary people ) .
examples.zh: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

examples.en: full public access to information
examples.zh: 公众对信息的充分知情权

examples.en: Public opinion is gradually shifting in favor of the imprisoned men.
examples.zh: 舆论渐渐倾向于同情入狱的男子。

words.definition: The publication of a book or magazine is the act of printing it and sending it to stores to be sold; announcement
words.translation: 公布；出版；出版物；发表

examples.en: The guide is being translated into several languages for publication near Christmas.
examples.zh: 这本指南正被翻译成好几种语言，准备在圣诞节前后出版。

words.definition: to arrange for a book, magazine etc to be written, printed, and sold; deliver, post; print, bring out
words.translation: 公布；发表；出版；发行；刊印

examples.en: The first edition was published in 1765.
examples.zh: 第一版于1765年出版。

examples.en: They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
examples.zh: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

words.definition: to use your hands to make something or someone move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving; draw, snake; draw; tension, digging rope
words.translation: 拉，拖；拉，拉力；拉；拔；拖；拉，拉绳；拉力，[交]牵引力

examples.en: Mom! Davey’s pulling my hair!
examples.zh: 妈妈! 戴维拽我的头发！
