examples.zh: 我们需要解决失业和贫穷这两个实际问题。

examples.en: There is no real reason to worry.
examples.zh: 没有什么真正的理由需要担心。

words.definition: what actually happens or is true, not what is imagined or thought; fact, actuality, sincerity, true
words.translation: 现实；真实；实际

examples.en: the distinction between fantasy and reality
examples.zh: 幻想和现实之间的区别

examples.en: TV is used as an escape from reality .
examples.zh: 电视成了逃避现实的一种方式。

examples.en: I think the government has lost touch with reality (= no longer understands what is real or true ) .
examples.zh: 我认为政府已经脱离了现实。

words.definition: to know and understand something, or suddenly begin to understand it; come true, accomplish, carry out, fulfill, implement
words.translation: 实现；认识到；了解；将某物卖得

examples.en: It took us a while to realize the extent of the tragedy.
examples.zh: 我们过了一段时间才意识到这场悲剧有多严重。

examples.en: It was only later that I realized my mistake.
examples.zh: 我到后来才认识到自己的错误。

words.translation: 真正地；实在

words.definition: a general area of knowledge, activity, or thought; domain, territory, kingdom, province, world, universe, extent
words.translation: 王国，国土；领域；领域，范围；王国

examples.en: the spiritual realm
examples.zh: 精神领域

words.definition: the back part of an object, vehicle, or building, or a position at the back of an object or area; cultivate, foster, plant, set, bed; rise, tower; fro, aback; latter, back; back, behind, ass
words.translation: 后部，后面；背面；培养；树立；栽种；暴跳；高耸；向后；在后面；[军]后方的；后面的；背面的；后面；屁股；后方部队

examples.en: Carole was left to bring up the rear.
examples.zh: 卡萝尔被落在最后。

words.definition: why something happens, or why someone does something; to form a particular judgment about a situation after carefully considering the facts; motivation, excuse, incentive, sake, account; ratiocinate, prevail with; discuss, debate, satisfy, convince, argue
words.translation: 理由；理性；推理；动机；推论；劝说；说服；辩论

examples.en: She has reason to feel guilty.
examples.zh: 她有理由感到内疚。

words.definition: fair and sensible; rational, logical, possible, just, legitimate
words.translation: 合情合理的；公道的；合理的，公道的；通情达理的

examples.en: a reasonable request
examples.zh: 合情合理的要求

examples.en: Be reasonable — you can’t expect her to do all the work on her own!
examples.zh: 要讲道理，你不能指望她一个人干所有的工作！

examples.en: I thought it was a perfectly reasonable (= completely reasonable ) question.
examples.zh: 我认为这个问题问得很有道理。

words.definition: to oppose or fight against someone in authority or against an idea or situation which you do not agree with; someone who opposes or fights against people in authority; strive against, come out against; rat, putschist; resistant, mutinous
words.translation: 造反；造反者；反叛；反抗；反叛者；叛徒；反抗的；造反的

examples.en: Voters rebelled against high property taxes.
examples.zh: 投票者们反对高额财产税。

words.definition: to remember a particular fact, event, or situation from the past; think of, come back; memory, recollection
words.translation: 回想；叫回；收回；召回；回想起，记起；取消；回忆；撤消

examples.en: You don’t happen to recall his name, do you?
examples.zh: 你不会恰巧还想得起他的名字吧？

examples.en: As I recall, it was you who suggested this idea in the first place.
examples.zh: 我记得，是你首先提出这个想法的。

words.definition: a piece of paper that you are given which shows that you have paid for something; income, proceeds, earning; receive from, to hand
words.translation: 收到；收条，收据；收据；收入

examples.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
examples.zh: 保留收据以备退货之需。

examples.en: Can you give me a receipt?
examples.zh: 你能给我一个收条吗？

words.definition: to be given something; acknowledge receipt of, to hand; take over
words.translation: 收到；得到；接待；接纳；接收

examples.en: All the children will receive a small gift.
examples.zh: 每个孩子都会收到一份小礼物。

examples.en: Lee received 324 votes (= 324 people voted for him ) .
examples.zh: 李得到324票。

words.definition: taker, acceptor
words.translation: 收受者，收件人；接收器；接受者；收信机；收款员，接待者

examples.en: The business is in the hands of the receivers .
examples.zh: 公司现在由破产管理人接管。

words.definition: having happened or started only a short time ago; latest, modern, current, nearest, last
words.translation: 新近的，最近的；[地质]最近的；近代的

examples.en: Irving’s most recent book
examples.zh: 欧文最新的书

examples.en: recent research into the causes of cancer
examples.zh: 近来对致癌原因的研究

examples.en: the recent past
examples.zh: 不久前

words.definition: not long ago; newly, new, of late, last
words.translation: 最近，新近；最近；新近

examples.en: He has recently been promoted to Assistant Manager.
examples.zh: 他最近晋升为经理助理。

examples.en: a recently published biography
examples.zh: 一部最近出版的传记

examples.en: Jerry lived in Cairo until quite recently .
examples.zh: 直至不久之前杰里一直住在开罗。

words.definition: the act of realizing and accepting that something is true or important; identification, discernment
words.translation: 认出，识别；承认；[计][免疫]识别；承认，认出；重视；赞誉；公认

examples.en: He stared at her, but there was no sign of recognition .
examples.zh: 他盯着她看，但似乎没认出她来。

words.definition: to know who someone is or what something is, because you have seen, heard, experienced, or learned about them in the past; identify, spot, accept, agree, grant; accept, confirm on
words.translation: 认识，认出；承认；认出，识别；确认，承认；具结

examples.en: I didn’t recognize you in your uniform.
examples.zh: 你穿上制服我认不出你了。

examples.en: It was malaria, but Dr Lee hadn’t recognized the symptoms.
examples.zh: 这是疟疾，但李医生没有认出症状。

words.definition: a suggestion to someone that they should choose a particular thing or person that you think is very good; suggestion, advice, proposal, instance
words.translation: 推荐，介绍；劝告；推荐；建议；推荐信

examples.en: Try to get letters of recommendation from bosses and colleagues.
examples.zh: 设法得到老板和同事的推荐信。

words.definition: information about something that is written down or stored on computer, film etc so that it can be looked at in the future; to write information down or store it in a computer or on film so that it can be looked at in the future; register, keep track of; keep track of, make notes of; disk, file, resume, disc
words.translation: 记录；履历；记录，记载；标明；将...录音；录音；档案，履历；[电子]唱片；最高纪录

examples.en: According to official records, five people were killed last year near that road junction.
examples.zh: 据官方记录，去年有五人在那个路口附近丧生。

words.definition: a piece of electrical equipment that records music, films etc; tape-recorder, dictating machine
words.translation: 记录者；录音机；[电讯]录音机；[法][仪][电子]记录器；记录员；八孔直笛

examples.en: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
examples.zh: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

words.definition: the process of getting better after an illness, injury etc
words.translation: 重获；痊愈，恢复

examples.en: Hopes of economic recovery are fading.
examples.zh: 经济复苏的希望越来越渺茫。

words.definition: having the colour of blood; the colour of blood; deficit, clred; erythroid, rojo
words.translation: 红色的；红色；[光]红色，[颜料][染料]红颜料；赤字；[光]红色的；红肿的，充血的

examples.en: We painted the door bright red .
examples.zh: 我们把门漆成鲜红色。

examples.en: a red balloon
examples.zh: 一个红气球

words.definition: a decrease in the size, price, or amount of something, or the act of decreasing something; loss, decrease, decline
words.translation: 减少，减小，缩减；减少；下降；缩小

examples.en: strategies for noise reduction
examples.zh: 减少噪音的对策

examples.en: The company promised they would make no staff reductions for at least two years.
examples.zh: 公司承诺至少两年不裁员。

words.definition: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them; deal with, to consult; deal with, to relate to
words.translation: 使求助于；谈到；参考；涉及；提到；查阅；委托；归诸于；使…求助于

examples.en: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.
examples.zh: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

words.definition: part of something you say or write in which you mention a person or thing; involved in, mention; quote; cite
words.translation: 参考；出处；提及；参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书；引用

examples.en: ...a reference from the Koran.
examples.zh: …一段《可兰经》的引文。

words.definition: something that shows what something else is like, or that is a sign of a particular situation; meditation, contemplation
words.translation: 反射；映象；反映；[热][光][物]反射；沉思

examples.en: Can you see your reflection in the glass?
examples.zh: 你能看到玻璃里你的影像吗？

words.definition: reverberation, repercussiveness
words.translation: 反射；映象；反映；反射作用（等于reflection）

examples.en: Maxwell equations: Lorentz force, plane electromagnetic waves, radiation, light waves, reflexion, refraction, Huyghens principle, diffraction, interference phenomena.
examples.zh: 麦克斯韦方程组：洛仑兹力，平面电磁波，辐射，光波，反射，折射，惠更斯原理，衍射，干涉现象。

words.definition: to improve a system, law, organization etc by making a lot of changes to it, so that it operates in a fairer or more effective way; transformation, correction, amendment; renovate, reconstitute; shake up, realign
words.translation: 改革，改良；改正；改革，革新；重新组成；重组；改过

examples.en: plans to radically reform the tax system
examples.zh: 彻底改革税收制度的计划

words.definition: to make someone feel less tired or less hot; renovate, to update; revive
words.translation: 使清新vi恢复精神；更新；使……恢复；使……清新；消除……的疲劳；恢复精神；喝饮料，吃点心；补充给养

examples.en: A shower will refresh you.
examples.zh: 洗个淋浴你就凉快了。

words.definition: a large piece of electrical kitchen equipment, shaped like a cupboard, used for keeping food and drink cool; icebox, freezer
words.translation: 冰箱，冷藏库；[制冷]冰箱，冷藏库

words.definition: to say firmly that you will not do something that someone has asked you to do; garbage, waste, junk, rubbish, trash; negative, turn down; object, turn down
words.translation: 拒绝；垃圾；[环境]废物；不愿；抵制

examples.en: She asked him to leave, but he refused.
examples.zh: 她叫他走，但他不肯。

examples.en: When he offered all that money, I could hardly refuse (= could not refuse ) , could I?
examples.zh: 他愿意给那么多钱，我怎么可能拒绝呢？

words.definition: to think about someone or something in a particular way; estimation, respect, notice, publicity; view, study, honor, think about; take care of, watch
words.translation: 把…看作；尊敬；注意；尊重；问候；凝视；注重，考虑；看待；与…有关；注意，注重；注视

examples.en: He was regarded as the most successful president of modern times.
examples.zh: 他被看成是近代最成功的总统。

words.definition: a word used especially in letters or speeches to introduce the subject you are writing or talking about; concerning, about, in the case of, with reference to, in relation to
words.translation: 关于；关于，至于

examples.en: Regarding your recent inquiry, I have enclosed a copy of our new brochure.
examples.zh: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

words.definition: without being affected or influenced by something; irregardless
words.translation: 不顾一切地；不管；不顾；不注意

examples.en: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
examples.zh: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

words.definition: a large area of a country or of the world, usually without exact limits; area, extent, boundary, zone, spectrum, territory
words.translation: 地区，地带；领域；[地理]地区；范围；[医]部位

examples.en: efforts to bring peace to the region
examples.zh: 给这个地区带来和平的努力

words.definition: an official list of names of people, companies etc, or a book that has this list; book in, book down; entry, page, enrollment
words.translation: 登记，注册；登记；[专利]注册；记录；挂号邮寄；把…挂号；正式提出；挂号；寄存器；登记簿

examples.en: Have you signed the hotel register ?
examples.zh: 你在酒店登记簿上签名了吗？

examples.en: Police want a national register of DNA samples.
examples.zh: 警方想要一个全国范围的DNA样本登记册。

words.definition: used in official letters or statements when saying that you are sorry or sad about something; sadness that you feel about something, especially because you wish it had not happened; pity, sorriness; grieve over, mourn over
words.translation: 懊悔；抱歉；遗憾；悲叹；后悔；惋惜；哀悼

examples.en: We regret any inconvenience caused to our customers.
examples.zh: 我们对于给顾客造成的不便表示歉意。

words.definition: to tell someone about events that have happened to you or to someone else; narrate, recount; deal with, identify
words.translation: 叙述；使联系；使…有联系；涉及；认同；符合；与…有某种联系

examples.en: I don’t understand how the two ideas relate.
examples.zh: 我不明白这两个观点有什么联系。

words.definition: a connection between two or more things; connection, statement, bearing, concern, story
words.translation: 关系，联系；家属；[计]关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系

examples.en: The price the meat is sold for bears no relation to (= is not connected to ) the price the farmer receives.
examples.zh: 肉的售价和农民拿到的价格无关。

words.definition: the way in which two people or two groups feel about each other and behave towards each other; connection, correlation, bearing, concern, link
words.translation: 关系，联系；关系；关联

examples.en: He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
examples.zh: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

words.definition: the relationship in  physics  between time, space, and movement according to Einstein’s  theory; relative theory, pertinency
words.translation: 相关性；相对性；[相对]相对论

words.definition: if you relax a part of your body or it relaxes, it becomes less stiff or less tight; to rest or do something that is enjoyable, especially after you have been working; lighten up, ease down; rest, lighten up
words.translation: 使松弛；松弛；放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养；放松；使休息；缓和；使松懈

examples.en: Gentle exercise can relax stiff shoulder muscles.
examples.zh: 和缓的运动可以使僵硬的肩部肌肉放松。

words.definition: dependability, relable
words.translation: 可靠性；[自]可靠性

examples.en: I can assure you of the reliability of the information.
examples.zh: 我可以向你保证这消息是可靠的。

examples.en: You have to work at it and design it in to your systems from the beginning, just like you have to design in scalability, performance, reliability and security.
examples.zh: 您从一开始就得学习它并将其设计到您的系统中，就像您在可伸缩性、性能、可靠性和安全性方面进行的设计一样。

examples.en: How will that affect reliability and other factors?
examples.zh: 将如何影响可靠性和其他因素？

words.definition: when something reduces someone’s pain or unhappy feelings; comfort, almsgiving
words.translation: 减轻；救济；援救；减轻，解除；安慰

examples.en: Marijuana can provide pain relief for some cancer patients.
examples.zh: 大麻可以为一些癌症患者减轻疼痛。

words.definition: a belief in one or more gods; deen, religious belief
words.translation: 宗教；宗教信仰

examples.en: The U.S. Constitution promises freedom of religion.
examples.zh: 美国宪法保证宗教信仰自由。

examples.en: a course on philosophy and religion
examples.zh: 关于哲学和宗教的课程

words.definition: relating to religion in general or to a particular religion; good, sacred; monk, cenobite
words.translation: 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的；修道的；修道士；尼姑

examples.en: I don’t share her religious beliefs .
examples.zh: 她的宗教信仰和我的不同。

examples.en: a religious school
examples.zh: 宗教学校

examples.en: the dates of major religious observances such as Easter or Christmas
examples.zh: 复活节和圣诞节等重要宗教节日的日期

words.definition: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly; trust, hope
words.translation: 依赖，依靠；信赖；依靠

examples.en: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers.
examples.zh: 他们非常依赖专业顾问的建议。

words.definition: to stay in the same place without moving away; stop, keep up; debris, relic
words.translation: 剩下，余留；保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存；遗迹；剩余物，残骸

examples.en: The refugees were allowed to remain in the UK.
examples.zh: 难民获准留在英国。

words.definition: something that you say when you express an opinion or say what you have noticed; regard, notice, publicity; observe on, to comment on; talk of, discourse
words.translation: 评论，谈论；注意；言辞；评论；觉察；谈论

examples.en: Unfortunately, a local journalist overheard the remark.
examples.zh: 不巧一名当地记者无意中听到了这些话。

words.definition: unusual or surprising and therefore deserving attention or praise; excellent, prominent, extraordinary, significant, wonder
words.translation: 异常的，非凡的；卓越的；非凡的；值得注意的

examples.en: She has made remarkable progress.
examples.zh: 她取得了显著的进步。

examples.en: a remarkable coincidence
examples.zh: 不寻常的巧合

examples.en: He’s a remarkable man .
examples.zh: 他是个了不起的人。

words.definition: to have a picture or idea in your mind of people, events, places etc from the past; to learn by heart, honour the memory of; think of, come back
words.translation: 记得，想起；记住；记得；牢记；纪念；代…问好；记得，记起

examples.en: Do you remember Rosa Davies?
examples.zh: 你记得罗莎·戴维斯吗？

examples.en: I can’t remember her exact words.
examples.zh: 我记不得她的原话了。

examples.en: I remember it well ; I’d never seen my mother so angry.
examples.zh: 这件事我记得很清楚；我从未见过母亲这么生气。

words.definition: to make someone remember something that they must do; jack, put in mind
words.translation: 提醒，使想起；提醒；使想起

examples.en: Yes, I’ll be there. Thanks for reminding me.
examples.zh: 是的，我会去那里的。 谢谢提醒。

examples.en: He made a few notes to remind himself of what he wanted to say.
examples.zh: 他记了几条，提醒自己要说些什么。

words.definition: far from towns or other places where people live; distant, lonely
words.translation: 相隔很远的；冷淡的；遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的

examples.en: a remote border town
examples.zh: 一个偏远的边境小镇

examples.en: a fire in a remote mountain area
examples.zh: 偏远山区的火灾

words.definition: the process of taking furniture from your old house to your new one; move, shift, migration, motion
words.translation: 移动；迁移；除掉；免职；排除；搬迁

examples.en: stain removal
examples.zh: 去污

words.definition: the money that someone pays regularly to use a room, house etc that belongs to someone else; to regularly pay money to live in a house or room that belongs to someone else, or to use something that belongs to someone else; letting, hire; lease out, hire out
words.translation: 租金，租；出租；[租赁]租金；租用；租借；[租赁]租

examples.en: I pay the rent at the beginning of every month.
examples.zh: 我每逢月初交付房租。

words.definition: to fix something that is damaged, broken, split, or not working properly; perform maintenance, fix up; restore, doctor, help; renovation, fixing
words.translation: 修理，修补；修理；修复；恢复；补救，纠正；修补部位

examples.en: Dad was up the ladder, repairing the roof.
examples.zh: 爸爸在梯子上修补屋顶。

examples.en: Where can I get my shoes repaired ?
examples.zh: 哪儿能修补鞋子？

words.definition: to say or write something again; an event that is very like something that happened before; read back, echo; counterpart, iterance; do over, begin again
words.translation: 重说，重做；重复；复制；背诵；副本；重做；重复发生

examples.en: Can you repeat your question?
examples.zh: 你能重复一遍你的问题吗？

examples.en: Sorry - could you repeat that?
examples.zh: 对不起——你能再说一遍吗？

examples.en: It is not, I repeat not, my fault.
examples.zh: 那不是我的错，我再说一遍，不是。

words.definition: many times; again and again, iteratively
words.translation: 重复地；一再；反复地；再三地；屡次地

examples.en: Graham was repeatedly warned not to work so hard.
examples.zh: 格雷厄姆一再被提醒工作不要这么拼命。

words.definition: doing or saying the same thing many times; reiteration, iterance
words.translation: 重复，反复；重复；背诵；副本

examples.en: Children used to learn by repetition.
examples.zh: 过去小孩子是通过背诵来学习的。

words.definition: to answer someone by saying or writing something; respond, answer; response, defence, answer; answer
words.translation: 回答，答复；[通信][计]回答；[法]答辩；回击；[计]回答；[通信]答复

examples.en: I asked Clive where he was going, but he didn’t reply.
examples.zh: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

examples.en: Sorry it took me so long to reply.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我过了这么久才回复。

examples.en: ‘Did you see Simon today?’ ‘Of course,’ Nathalie replied with a smile.
examples.zh: “你今天见到西蒙了吗？”“当然啦。”纳萨莉笑着答道。

words.definition: to give people information about recent events, especially in newspapers and on television and radio; advisory, rept; cover, give notice to; message, inform of
words.translation: 报告；汇报；报道；成绩单；报导；使报到；报到；写报导

examples.en: This is Gavin Williams, reporting from the United Nations in New York.
examples.zh: 我是加文·威廉斯，在纽约联合国总部为您报道。

examples.en: We aim to report the news as fairly as possible.
examples.zh: 我们力求公正地报道这一新闻。

examples.en: The incident was widely reported in the national press.
examples.zh: 这一事件在全国的媒体上被广泛报道。

words.definition: someone whose job is to write about news events for a newspaper, or to tell people about them on television or on the radio; journo, newsperson
words.translation: 记者，通讯员；记者

examples.en: a news reporter
examples.zh: 新闻记者

words.definition: a country governed by elected representatives of the people, and led by a president, not a king or queen; commonwealth, respublica
words.translation: 共和国，共和政体；共和国；共和政体

examples.en: the former Federal Republic of Germany
examples.zh: 前德意志联邦共和国

examples.en: Nine republics took part in the referendum.
examples.zh: 有九个共和国参加了全民公决。

words.definition: something that someone needs or asks for; do, necessity, desire, need, demand
words.translation: 需要；要求；必要条件；必需品

examples.en: The refugees’ main requirements are food and shelter.
examples.zh: 难民的主要需求是食物和住所。

words.translation: 水库；蓄水池

words.definition: legal permission to live in a country for a certain period of time; home, accommodation
words.translation: 居住；驻扎；住处；住宅，住处

examples.en: a residence permit
examples.zh: 居留许可证

words.definition: a formal decision or statement agreed on by a group of people, especially after a vote; settlement, decision, determination, push, backbone
words.translation: 坚决，坚定；决定；[物][电子][光]分辨率；决议；解决；决心

examples.en: a resolution calling for a ban on dumping nuclear waste
examples.zh: 要求禁止倾倒核废物的决议

examples.en: They have failed to comply with the resolution.
examples.zh: 他们没有遵守决议。

words.definition: when you must use or depend on something because nothing better is available; instrument, shift, road, tool, implement; appeal, ask for help
words.translation: 求助，凭借;诉诸于；凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地；求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法

examples.en: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs.
examples.zh: 他那累人的工作日程已经使他不得不求助于毒品了。

words.definition: used before a plural noun to refer to the different things that belong to each separate person or thing mentioned; several, each
words.translation: 各自的，各个的；分别的，各自的

examples.en: We all went back to our respective homes to wait for news.
examples.zh: 我们都各自回家等待消息。

examples.en: the respective roles of teachers and students
examples.zh: 教师和学生各自不同的角色

words.definition: to do something as a reaction to something that has been said or done; reply, answer; answering
words.translation: 作答；响应；回答；作出反应；承担责任；应答；唱和

examples.en: They are likely to respond positively to the president's request for aid.
examples.zh: 他们有可能积极地回应该总统的援助请求。

words.definition: unwilling to keep still or stay where you are, especially because you are nervous or bored; storm-tossed, twitchy
words.translation: 不安定的，焦虑的；焦躁不安的；不安宁的；得不到满足的

examples.en: After a few weeks in Marseille, I grew restless and decided to move on.
examples.zh: 在马赛住了几星期后，我开始待不住了，决定换个地方。

words.definition: to stop someone from doing something, often by using physical force; possess, regulate, contain, manage, bottle
words.translation: 抑制，遏制；限制；抑制，控制；约束；制止

examples.en: Renwick restrained a feeling of annoyance.
examples.zh: 伦威克忍住了不悦的情绪。

words.definition: calm sensible controlled behaviour, especially in a situation when it is difficult to stay calm; checking, control, suppression, inhibition, constraint
words.translation: 抑制；遏制；克制；[电子][通信]抑制，克制；约束

examples.en: The police were praised for their restraint in handling the demonstrators.
examples.zh: 警方因对待示威者时所表现出的克制而受到赞扬。

words.definition: if an activity or process resumes, it starts again after a pause; bio, abstract, brief, summary, record; recover, start over
words.translation: 恢复；重新开始；[管理]履历；个人简历；摘要；重新获得

examples.en: Peace talks will resume tomorrow.
examples.zh: 和平谈判明天重新启动。

words.definition: when a  jury  in a law court retires, they go away to consider whether someone is guilty or not; withdraw, beat a retreat; leave, split, quit; superannuation, sequestration
words.translation: 退下；引退；就寝；退休；撤退；退却；离开；收回；退隐；退兵信号

examples.en: At the age when most people retire, he is ready to face a new career.
examples.zh: 在大多数人退休的年纪，他准备要面对一项新事业。

words.definition: a refusal to accept someone’s authority or obey rules or laws; strive against, come out against; sicken; resistance, hate, rebellion
words.translation: 反抗，造反；反抗；反叛；反感，厌恶；使反感；使恶心；叛乱；反感

examples.en: The prime minister is now facing a revolt by members of his own party.
examples.zh: 首相现在面临着党内倒戈。

words.definition: completely new and different, especially in a way that leads to great improvements; someone who joins in or supports a political or social revolution; rotary, rolling
words.translation: 革命的；革命者；旋转的；大变革的

examples.en: The new cancer drug is a revolutionary breakthrough.
examples.zh: 这种抗癌新药是一个革命性突破。

examples.en: a revolutionary new drug
examples.zh: 一种革命性的新药

words.definition: a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements; meter, cadence
words.translation: 韵律，格律；节奏；韵律

examples.en: Drums are basic to African rhythm.
examples.zh: 非洲音乐节奏少不了鼓。

examples.en: complicated dance rhythms
examples.zh: 复杂的舞蹈节奏

words.definition: one of the 12 pairs of curved bones that surround your chest; costa, sparerib; fool with, kid
words.translation: 肋，肋骨；[解剖]肋骨；排骨；肋状物；戏弄；装肋于

examples.en: She was taken to hospital with a broken arm and ribs.
examples.zh: 她胳膊和肋骨断了，被送进医院。

examples.en: He was punched and kicked in the ribs.
examples.zh: 他的肋部遭到拳打脚踢。

words.definition: a narrow piece of attractive cloth that you use, for example, to tie your hair or hold things together; belt, band, strip
words.translation: 缎带，丝带；带；缎带；（勋章等的）绶带；带状物；勋表

examples.en: little girls with ribbons in their hair
examples.zh: 头发上系着丝带的小姑娘们

examples.en: a bundle of letters tied with pale blue ribbon
examples.zh: 一捆用淡蓝色丝带扎好的信

examples.en: The ribbon was cut and the new station was officially open.
examples.zh: 剪彩后，新车站正式开始运营。

words.definition: If you rid a place or person of something undesirable or unwanted, you succeed in removing it completely from that place or person; free from, debarrass
words.translation: 使摆脱，使去掉；使摆脱；使去掉

examples.en: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption.
examples.zh: 这些提议是使该国摆脱政治腐败的一种尝试。

words.definition: a long area of high land, especially at the top of a mountain; mountain range, cordillera
words.translation: 脊；岭，山脉；垄；[地理]山脊；山脉；[建]屋脊

examples.en: We made our way carefully along the ridge.
examples.zh: 我们沿着山脊小心前行。

words.definition: very silly or unreasonable; laughing, preposterous
words.translation: 荒谬的，可笑的；可笑的；荒谬的

examples.en: That’s a ridiculous idea!
examples.zh: 那主意很荒唐！

examples.en: Don’t be ridiculous!
examples.zh: 别傻了！

examples.en: I’d look ridiculous in a dress like that.
examples.zh: 我穿那样的裙子会显得很可笑。

words.definition: a long gun which you hold up to your shoulder to shoot; musket; steal away, spirit away
words.translation: 步枪，来复枪；[军]步枪；来复枪；用步枪射击；抢夺；偷走

examples.en: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
examples.zh: 他们用一支自动步枪在近距离射程内射中了他。

words.definition: rigid methods, systems etc are very strict and difficult to change; strict, precise, wooden, accurate, mathematical
words.translation: 刚硬的；僵硬的；严格的；僵硬的，死板的；坚硬的；精确的

examples.en: rigid and authoritarian methods of education
examples.zh: 死板、专断的教育方法

words.definition: ripe fruit or crops are fully grown and ready to eat; developed, mature, adult; examine, survey
words.translation: 熟的；时机成熟的；[植][医]熟的，成熟的；搜查；调查

examples.en: Those tomatoes aren’t ripe yet.
examples.zh: 那些番茄还没熟。

words.definition: the possibility that something bad, unpleasant, or dangerous may happen; venture, throw; hazard
words.translation: 风险，危险，冒险；风险；[保险]危险；冒险；冒…的危险

examples.en: It was a risk, sending a letter to my house.
examples.zh: 将信寄到我家是冒险。

words.definition: to make a deep, very loud noise; a deep, loud noise made by an animal such as a lion, or by someone’s voice; snarl, rave; gnar, huff and puff; yell out, huff and puff
words.translation: 吼叫；呼喊；吼；咆哮；轰鸣；喧闹；使……轰鸣

examples.en: We heard a lion roar.
examples.zh: 我们听到狮子在吼叫。

examples.en: The engines roared.
examples.zh: 引擎轰鸣。

words.definition: to cook something, such as meat, in an  oven  or over a fire, or to cook in this way; torrefy, bake; broil, toast; baking, broiled; bulgogi, bar-b-q
words.translation: 烤，炙，烘；烤，焙；烘，烘烤；暴露于某种热力下以得温暖；烤；烘；烘烤的；烤过的；烤肉；烘烤

examples.en: Are you going to roast the chicken?
examples.zh: 这鸡你是准备烤的吗？

examples.en: the delicious smell of meat roasting
examples.zh: 烤肉的香味

examples.en: We caught a rabbit and roasted it over an open fire.
examples.zh: 我们捉到一只兔子，放在火上烧烤。

words.definition: a machine that can move and do some of the work of a person, and is usually controlled by a computer; droid, golem
words.translation: 机器人；自动机；[自]机器人；遥控设备，自动机械；机械般工作的人

examples.en: cars built by robots
examples.zh: 机器人制造的汽车

words.definition: a long thin pole or bar; punishment, authority, payment, bar, discipline
words.translation: 杆，竿，棒；棒；惩罚；枝条；权力

examples.en: a measuring rod
examples.zh: 测量杆

words.definition: if something rolls, especially something round, or if you roll it, it moves along a surface by turning over and over; turn, wheel; wave, turn, screw, rock; book, volume
words.translation: 滚动；转动；卷；滚动，转动；辗；起伏，摇晃；卷，卷形物；名单；摇晃

examples.en: There was silence as the cameras started to roll.
examples.zh: 摄影机开始转动，大家安静了下来。

words.definition: a piece of equipment consisting of a tube-shaped piece of wood, metal etc that rolls over and over, used for painting, crushing, making things smoother etc; platen, tumbling barrel
words.translation: 滚柱，滚筒，滚轴；[机]滚筒；滚轴；辊子；滚转机

examples.en: a paint roller
examples.zh: 刷漆滚筒

examples.en: a garden roller
examples.zh: 碾草坪机

words.definition: A Roman was a citizen of ancient Rome or its empire; relating to ancient Rome or the Roman Empire
words.translation: 古罗马人；罗马的

examples.en: When they conquered Britain, the Romans brought this custom with them.
examples.zh: 当古罗马人征服不列颠时，他们把这一习俗也带了过去。

words.definition: showing strong feelings of love; fantastic, amorous
words.translation: 浪漫的；传奇的；多情的；空想的

examples.en: ‘Tom always sends me red roses on my birthday.’ ‘How romantic!’
examples.zh: “我过生日时汤姆总是给我送红玫瑰。”“多浪漫啊！”

words.definition: turning in a circle around a fixed point, like a wheel; rolling, revolutionary
words.translation: 旋转的，转动的；[机]旋转的，转动的；轮流的

examples.en: the rotary movement of the helicopter blades
examples.zh: 直升机螺旋桨叶的转动

words.definition: to turn with a circular movement around a central point, or to make something do this; wheel, circle, spin; turn, spin, swing
words.translation: 旋转；使旋转；循环；使转动；使轮流

examples.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
examples.zh: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。

examples.en: Rotate the pan halfway through the baking time.
examples.zh: 烘烤到一半时把盘子转一下。

words.definition: when something turns with a circular movement around a central point; revolution, rolling, circulation, turning, cycle
words.translation: 旋转，转动；循环；旋转；循环，轮流

examples.en: The blades spin at 100 rotations per minute.
examples.zh: 叶片每分钟转100圈。

words.definition: badly decayed and no longer good to use; weak, fallen, rank; extremely, badly, highly, greatly, too
words.translation: 腐烂的，发臭的；[木]腐烂的；堕落的；[环境]恶臭的；虚弱的；极坏的；非常

examples.en: the smell of rotten eggs
examples.zh: 坏鸡蛋的气味

examples.en: Some of the wood was completely rotten.
examples.zh: 有些木头完全腐烂了。

examples.en: The apples went rotten very quickly.
examples.zh: 苹果很快就腐烂了。

words.definition: having an uneven surface; crude, robust, tough, gross, coarse; harshen, draw up; arduousness; coarsely, crudely
words.translation: 表面不平的；粗略的；[机]粗糙的；粗野的；艰苦的；未经加工的；[机]使粗糙；粗暴对待；草拟；艰苦；高低不平的地面；未经加工的材料；粗糙的部分；[机]粗糙地；粗略地；粗暴地

examples.en: Her hands were rough from hard work.
examples.zh: 她的双手因为干重活而变得很粗糙。

examples.en: the rough terrain at the base of the mountains
examples.zh: 山脚下崎岖不平的地形

examples.en: We were bumping over the rough ground .
examples.zh: 我们在崎岖的地面上颠簸而行。

words.definition: to wake someone who is sleeping deeply; arouse, wake sb. up; wake up, waken up; arousal, wakefulness
words.translation: 唤醒，唤起；惊起；唤醒；激起，使振奋；醒来；奋起；觉醒

examples.en: His banging roused the neighbours.
examples.zh: 他重重的关门声把邻居都吵醒了。

words.definition: a way from one place to another; door, vector, exit, channel, thread
words.translation: 路，路线，路程；路线；[航]航线；通道

examples.en: the most direct route home
examples.zh: 最直接的回家路线

words.definition: the usual order in which you do things, or the things you regularly do; happening as a normal part of a job or process; procedure, program; daily, everyday, household
words.translation: 例行公事；日常的；[计]程序；日常工作；例行的

examples.en: John’s departure had upset their daily routine .
examples.zh: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

examples.en: Try to get into a routine (= develop a fixed order of doing things ) .
examples.zh: 尽量养成一套习惯。

examples.en: my daily exercise routine
examples.zh: 我每天的锻炼习惯

words.definition: a line of things or people next to each other; hong, range, line, rank, sound; boat, lock horns
words.translation: (一)排，(一)行；行，排；划船；街道；吵闹；争吵

examples.en: (= many rows ) of shelves stacked with books
examples.zh: 一排又一排堆满书的架子

words.definition: relating to or belonging to a king or queen; classical, distinguished; house-hold
words.translation: 王的；皇家的；盛大的；女王的；高贵的；第一流的；王室；王室成员

examples.en: the royal palace
examples.zh: 王宫

examples.en: the royal family
examples.zh: 王室

words.definition: a piece of thick cloth or wool that covers part of a floor, used for warmth or as a decoration; peruke, toupee
words.translation: 小地毯；毛毯；毛皮地毯；男子假发

examples.en: The old lady was seated in her chair at the window, a rug over her knees.
examples.zh: 这位老妇人坐在靠窗的椅子上，膝上盖着一块小毛毯。

words.definition: happening in or relating to the countryside, not the city; country, sylvan
words.translation: 农村的，田园的；农村的，乡下的；田园的，有乡村风味的

examples.en: a rural setting
examples.zh: 乡村环境

examples.en: rural bus routes
examples.zh: 乡村公共汽车路线

words.definition: to move very quickly, especially because you need to be somewhere very soon; to do or decide something too quickly, especially so that you do not have time to do it carefully or well; rapid, whitewater; sweep down, surprise attack; thread one's way, crash
words.translation: 冲，奔；催促；冲进；匆促；急流；[植]灯心草；使冲；突袭；匆忙地做；飞跃；冲；奔；闯；赶紧；涌现

examples.en: A small girl rushed past her.
examples.zh: 一个小女孩从她身边匆匆经过。

examples.en: Mo rushed off down the corridor.
examples.zh: 莫匆匆走过走廊。

words.definition: the reddish-brown substance that forms on iron or steel when it gets wet; to become covered with rust, or to make something become covered in rust; patination; eat, cauterize; dull
words.translation: 锈；生锈，氧化；[材][化工]锈；生锈；[植保]锈病；使生锈；腐蚀；成铁锈色；变迟钝

examples.en: There were large patches of rust on the car.
examples.zh: 车上有大片锈斑。

words.definition: when someone is dismissed from their job; gunny bag, burlap bag; get the boot, dehire
words.translation: 袋，麻袋；开除；麻布袋；洗劫；解雇；把……装入袋；劫掠

examples.en: They’ve never actually given anyone the sack .
examples.zh: 他们从未真的辞退过什么人。

examples.en: He got the sack for stealing.
examples.zh: 他因偷东西而被解雇。

examples.en: She claimed she’d been threatened with the sack.
examples.zh: 她称自己受到过解雇的威胁。

words.definition: when you decide not to have something valuable, in order to get something that is more important; offering, victimization; immolate, martyr; offer, devote  to
words.translation: 牺牲；南祭；祭品；供奉；献祭；亏本出售；奉献

examples.en: The minister stressed the need for economic sacrifice.
examples.zh: 部长强调了在经济上作出牺牲的必要性。

examples.en: The workforce were willing to make sacrifices in order to preserve jobs.
examples.zh: 雇员为了保住饭碗情愿作出牺牲。

examples.en: She brought three children up single-handedly, often at great personal sacrifice .
examples.zh: 她独自一人把三个孩子带大，常常需要作出巨大的个人牺牲。

words.definition: a leather seat that you sit on when you ride a horse; sella; absorb, burden
words.translation: 鞍子，马鞍；鞍，鞍状物；[车辆]车座；拖具；承受；使负担；装以马鞍

examples.en: It looks like a saddle.
examples.zh: 它看起来像一个马鞍。

examples.en: The saddle is secure.
examples.zh: 这鞍子安得很牢。

words.definition: a large piece of strong cloth fixed onto a boat, so that the wind will push the boat along; to travel on or across an area of water in a boat or ship; voyage, put forth; navigation, velamentum; log
words.translation: 帆；船；航行；启航，开船；[船]帆，篷

examples.en: a yacht with white sails
examples.zh: 扬着白帆的游艇

words.definition: in order to help, improve, or please someone or something; goals, intention, purpose, behalf, objective
words.translation: 缘故，理由；目的；利益；理由；日本米酒

examples.en: He moved to the seaside for the sake of his health.
examples.zh: 他为了健康而迁居海滨。

examples.en: I only went for Kay’s sake.
examples.zh: 我是为了凯才去的。

examples.en: I hope he’s told the truth for his own sake (= because it will be good for him ) .
examples.zh: 为了他自己好，我希望他已经说出了真相。

words.definition: a small part or amount of something that is examined in order to find out something about the whole; essay, have a try; example, pattern
words.translation: 样品；实例，标本；取样；尝试；抽样检查；[图情]样本；例子

examples.en: They took a blood sample to test for hepatitis.
examples.zh: 他们取了血样做肝炎化验。

words.definition: a machine that has been sent into space and goes around the Earth, moon etc, used for radio, television, and other electronic communication; moon, suite
words.translation: 卫星；人造卫星；[天]卫星；[航]人造卫星；随从；卫星国家

examples.en: the launch of a communications and weather satellite
examples.zh: 气象通信卫星的发射

words.definition: something that is satisfactory seems good enough for you, or good enough for a particular situation or purpose; content, well-pleasing
words.translation: 令人满意的，良好的；满意的；符合要求的；赎罪的

examples.en: His progress this term has been satisfactory.
examples.zh: 他这学期的进步令人满意。

words.definition: a small round plate that curves up at the edges, that you put a cup on; eye, optic
words.translation: 茶托，浅碟；浅碟形物；眼睛

examples.en: a china cup and saucer
examples.zh: 一套瓷茶杯和杯托

words.definition: a small tube of skin filled with a mixture of meat, spices etc, eaten hot or cold after it has been cooked; wust, wurst
words.translation: 香肠，腊肠；[食品]香肠；腊肠；装香肠的碎肉

examples.en: pork sausages
examples.zh: 猪肉香肠

words.definition: a tool that you use for cutting wood. It has a flat blade with an edge cut into many V shapes.; to cut something using a saw; rip; saying, proverb
words.translation: 锯子；锯，锯开；[木]锯；锯成；锯开；谚语

examples.en: She was in the back yard sawing logs.
examples.zh: 她在后院锯木头。

words.definition: to express an idea, feeling, thought etc using words; let, point out, suppose; make a gesture, to express
words.translation: 比如说[用于举例]；讲；说明；例如；声称；假设；指明；表示；念；假定；背诵

examples.en: ‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
examples.zh: “我太累了。”她说。

examples.en: ‘Don’t cry,’ he said softly.
examples.zh: “别哭了。”他柔声说道。

examples.en: Don’t believe anything he says.
examples.zh: 他说什么都不要相信。

words.definition: to examine an area carefully but quickly, often because you are looking for a particular person or thing; glance through, look through; survey, scrutiny
words.translation: 细看；浏览；扫描；详细调查；标出格律；审视

examples.en: He scanned the horizon, but there was no sign of the ship.
examples.zh: 他朝地平线处仔细眺望，但是找不到那艘船的踪影。

examples.en: She scanned his face, looking for signs of what he was thinking.
examples.zh: 她端详着他的脸，想知道他在想些什么。

examples.en: Video cameras scanned the car park.
examples.zh: 摄像机监视着停车场。

words.definition: almost not or almost none at all; ill, barely
words.translation: 仅仅；几乎不；几乎不，简直不；简直没有

examples.en: The city had scarcely changed in 20 years.
examples.zh: 这座城市20年中几乎没有什么改变。

examples.en: The country had scarcely any industry.
examples.zh: 该国几乎没有工业。

examples.en: He scarcely ever left the region.
examples.zh: 他几乎没有离开过这个地区。

words.definition: if someone scatters a lot of things, or if they scatter, they are thrown or dropped over a wide area in an irregular way; spread around, spread about; disject, disperse; dissemination, decentralization
words.translation: 使消散；撒；散播；分散，散开；[军]散射；[军]使散射；使散开，使分散；使散播，使撒播；分散；散播，撒播

examples.en: The sound of gunfire made the crowd scatter in all directions.
examples.zh: 枪声使人群四散奔逃。

words.definition: the natural features of a particular part of a country that you can see, such as mountains, forests, deserts etc; landscape, view, picture, prospect, outlook
words.translation: 舞台布景；风景；景色

examples.en: The best part of the trip was the fantastic scenery.
examples.zh: 此次旅行最精彩之处就是那美妙绝伦的风景。

words.definition: an official plan that is intended to help people in some way, for example by providing education or training; plan, programme, system, organization, fraud; design, map, propose, project, engineer
words.translation: 计划，规划；诡计；计划；组合；体制；策划

examples.en: The money will be used for teacher training schemes.
examples.zh: 这笔钱将用于教师培训计划。

examples.en: a pension scheme
examples.zh: 退休金计划

words.definition: an intelligent and well-educated person; student, academic
words.translation: 学者(尤指文学方面)；学者；奖学金获得者

examples.en: the great Dutch scholar Erasmus
examples.zh: 荷兰的大学问家伊拉斯谟

words.definition: about or related to science, or using its methods; systematic
words.translation: 科学(上)的；科学的，系统的

examples.en: We believe in investing in scientific research.
examples.zh: 我们相信科学研究的投资价值。

examples.en: the limits of scientific knowledge
examples.zh: 科学知识的极限

examples.en: decisions based on scientific evidence
examples.zh: 根据科学证据作出的决定

words.definition: a tool for cutting paper, cloth etc, made of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle, with holes for your finger and thumb; forfex, cutting tools
words.translation: 剪刀，剪子；[五金]剪刀；剪式跳法

examples.en: a pair of scissors
examples.zh: 一把剪刀

words.definition: the number of points that each team or player has won in a game or competition; marks, twenty; acquire, earn, buy, find, value; bull point
words.translation: 得分，比数，成绩；分数；二十；配乐；[木]刻痕；获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下；得分；记分

examples.en: At half-time the score was one all.
examples.zh: 半场时的比分是一比一。

examples.en: What’s the score?
examples.zh: 比分是多少？

examples.en: Is anybody keeping score (= making a record of the score ) ?
examples.zh: 有没有人负责记分？

words.definition: a soldier, plane etc that is sent to search the area in front of an army and get information about the enemy; searching, scanning; detect, watching, dog, guard; spy, make one's rounds
words.translation: 侦察员，侦察机；搜索，[航][军]侦察；侦察员；侦察机；[航][军]侦察；跟踪，监视；发现；巡视；嘲笑

examples.en: He sent three scouts ahead to take a look at the bridge.
examples.zh: 他派出三名侦察兵到前面侦察大桥的情况。

words.definition: to remove something from a surface using the edge of a knife, a stick etc; difficulty, corner, dilemma, fix; raw, brush burn; shave off
words.translation: 刮，擦；刮掉；擦痕；困境；刮擦声；刮；擦伤；挖成；刮出刺耳声

examples.en: Scrape the carrots and slice them thinly.
examples.zh: 把这些胡萝卜去皮切成薄片。

examples.en: The two of them scraped their dishes clean .
examples.zh: 他们两个把盘子擦得干干净净。

words.definition: a thin pointed piece of metal that you push and turn in order to fasten pieces of metal or wood together; to fasten or close something by turning it, or to be fastened in this way; force, enforce; spiral, helix; turn, roll
words.translation: 螺旋，螺丝；拧紧；旋，拧；压榨；强迫；螺旋；[机]螺丝钉；吝啬鬼；转动，拧

examples.en: Fix the frame in position and tighten the screws .
examples.zh: 把框子固定在正确位置上，拧紧螺丝。

words.definition: a piece of  wax  , paper, wire etc that you have to break in order to open a container, document etc; to close an entrance or a container with something that stops air, water etc from coming in or out of it; symbol, print; pressure, air proof
words.translation: 封蜡；印记；封；[机]密封；印章；[皮革][脊椎]海豹；封条；标志；盖章

examples.en: The seal on the box broke when it fell from its hiding-place.
examples.zh: 盒子从隐藏处掉下时上面的封口破了。

words.definition: not as important as something else; medium, supporting, middle, minor, moderate; deputy, agent, factor, proxy
words.translation: 第二的；次要的；[数][地质]第二的；中等的；[电]次要的；中级的；副手；代理人

examples.en: the novel’s secondary characters
examples.zh: 这本小说中的次要人物

words.definition: someone who works in an office  typing  letters, keeping records, answering telephone calls, arranging meetings etc; moonshee, clerk
words.translation: 秘书；书记；大臣；部长

examples.en: My secretary will fax you all the details.
examples.zh: 我的秘书会把所有的细节发传真给你。

words.definition: one of the separate parts of a structure, piece of furniture etc that you fit together to form the whole; ministry, region, division, department, area
words.translation: 切片；一段；部门；截面；地区；章节

examples.en: The plane’s tail section was found in a cornfield.
examples.zh: 飞机的尾部在玉米田里找到了。

words.definition: one of the small hard objects in a fruit such as an apple or orange, from which new fruit trees grow; foundation, child; sow, gather head; sow
words.translation: 种(子)，籽，萌芽；[植]种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由；播种；结实；成熟；去…籽；（植物）结实

examples.en: I sow the seed in pots of soil-based compost.
examples.zh: 我把种子种在一盆盆施有堆肥的土里。

words.definition: to look for someone or something; explore, try to find; explore, cast about for
words.translation: 寻找，探索；试图；寻求；寻找；探索；搜索

examples.en: new graduates seeking employment
examples.zh: 正在求职的刚毕业的大学生

examples.en: Attractive woman, 27, seeks male, 25-35, for fun and friendship.
examples.zh: 魅力女性，27岁，欲觅25-35岁男子为友，同玩共乐，发展友情。

words.definition: a substance, such as  silicon  , that allows some electric currents to pass through it, and is used in electronic equipment; quasi-conductor
words.translation: n.；半导体；[电子][物]半导体

examples.en: In semiconductor receivers transistors take the place of vacuum tubes.
examples.zh: 在半导体收音机中晶体管代替了真空管。

examples.en: What was happening was this: in its pure state of repeating units of one titanium and two oxygen atoms, titanium dioxide is a semiconductor.
examples.zh: 发生的事是这样的：在纯净的一个钛和两个氧原子组成的重复单位下，二氧化钛是一种半导体。

examples.en: They can then be printed onto a roll of metal foil that becomes a continuous semiconductor.
examples.zh: 然后他们可以把这种墨水印刷在一卷金属箔上，从而制成连续的半导体。

words.definition: the smaller and more important of the two parts of the government with the power to make laws, in countries such as the US, Australia, and France; Red Chamber, curia
words.translation: 参议院，上院；（古罗马的）元老院

examples.en: The Senate approved the bill.
examples.zh: 参议院批准了这项议案。

words.definition: not joined to or touching something else; split, divorce; come between, to break; alone, independent, divided, isolated, sole; partition, fall-away
words.translation: 分离的；个别的；使分离；使分开；使分居；分开；隔开；分居；单独的；分开的；抽印本

examples.en: The gym and the sauna are in separate buildings.
examples.zh: 健身房和桑拿浴室在不同的大楼里。

words.definition: the order that something happens or exists in, or the order it is supposed to happen or exist in; order, consecutiveness
words.translation: 连续，继续；次序；[数][计]序列；顺序；续发事件

examples.en: Be careful to perform the actions in the correct sequence .
examples.zh: 注意要按正确的顺序来完成动作。

words.definition: several events or actions of a similar type that happen one after the other; succession, progression
words.translation: 连续，系列；丛书；系列，连续；[电]串联；[数]级数

examples.en: the series of events that led to the outbreak of war
examples.zh: 导致战争爆发的一系列事件

examples.en: The police are investigating a series of attacks in the area.
examples.zh: 警方在调查该地区发生的一连串袭击事件。

examples.en: There’s been a whole series of accidents on this road.
examples.zh: 这条路上发生了一连串的交通事故。

words.definition: to help the customers in a shop, especially by bringing them the things that they want
words.translation: 为…服务；招待

examples.en: There was only one girl serving customers .
examples.zh: 只有一个女孩在接待顾客。

words.definition: If you settle yourself somewhere or settle somewhere, you sit down or make yourself comfortable; deposit, beach, work out, figure out; decide, schedule, budget, place in, work out
words.translation: 安排；安放；调停；解决；定居；沉淀；下陷；使…定居

examples.en: Albert settled himself on the sofa.
examples.zh: 阿尔伯特在沙发安坐下来。

words.definition: an official agreement or decision that ends an argument, a court case, or a fight, or the action of making an agreement; transactions, disposal, resolution, treatment, handling
words.translation: 解决；殖民，殖民地；解决，处理；[会计]结算；沉降；殖民

examples.en: Union leaders and company bosses will meet tomorrow in an attempt to reach a settlement .
examples.zh: 工会领导人和公司老板将于明天举行会议以期达成协议。

examples.en: His lawyers are understood to be negotiating a settlement .
examples.zh: 据说他的律师正在商谈一个协议。

examples.en: Hopes grew that a workable peace settlement might emerge.
examples.zh: 达成一项可行的和平协定的希望越来越大。

words.definition: to use a needle and thread to make or repair clothes or to fasten something such as a button to them; seam, oversew; needle work
words.translation: 缝制；缝纫；缝合，缝上；缝纫，缝

examples.en: I learned to sew at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校学会了缝纫。

words.definition: to cut off hair very close to the skin, especially from the face, using a  razor; razor, oversweep; scrape through, squeeze through
words.translation: 剃，刮；修面；剃；掠过；刮脸；勉强通过

examples.en: He hadn’t shaved for days.
examples.zh: 他已经好几天没刮脸了。

examples.en: Brian had cut himself shaving .
examples.zh: 布赖恩刮胡子时割破了脸。

words.definition: to cut the wool off a sheep; crop, clip; trim off, to prune; cutting back, clipper
words.translation: 剪；剥夺；修剪；[机]剪切；[力]切变；大剪刀

examples.en: Though shorn of some of its powers, the party remains in control.
examples.zh: 虽然被削去了一些权力，该党仍然掌握着控制权。

words.definition: to drop something or allow it to fall
words.translation: 流出；散发；脱落

examples.en: He strode across the bathroom, shedding wet clothes as he went.
examples.zh: 他大步走过浴室，边走边把湿衣服脱下来。

words.definition: a large piece of thin cloth that you put on a bed to lie on or lie under; slice, laminae; invest, house, roof, cap; lamellate
words.translation: 被单；纸张；薄板；薄片，纸张；[材]薄板；床单；覆盖；盖上被单；使成大片；片状的

examples.en: I’ll go and find you some clean sheets and blankets.
examples.zh: 我去给你们找些干净的床单和毯子。

examples.en: white cotton sheets
examples.zh: 白色的棉布床单

words.definition: a long flat narrow board attached to a wall or in a frame or cupboard, used for putting things on; etagere, bink
words.translation: 搁板，架子；架子；[家具]搁板；搁板状物

examples.en: shelves of books
examples.zh: 一层层书架的书

examples.en: supermarket shelves
examples.zh: 超级市场的货架

examples.en: the amount of shelf space available
examples.zh: 可用的货架空间

words.definition: protection from danger or from wind, rain, hot sun etc; housing, haven, shadow, home, covering; secure, preserve; stay away from, to dodge
words.translation: 隐蔽处；掩蔽，庇护；[法]庇护；避难所；遮盖物；保护；使掩蔽；躲避，避难

examples.en: The men took shelter in a bombed-out farmhouse.
examples.zh: 那些男人躲在一间被炸毁的农舍里。

examples.en: All around me, people were running for shelter .
examples.zh: 我周围的人都在奔跑着寻找地方躲避。

words.definition: something that protects a person or thing from harm or damage; to protect someone or something from being harmed or damaged; dong, fendering; avoid, shadow, guard, curtain; protect sb./sth. from sth.
words.translation: 盾；防护物；保护；保护者；遮蔽；包庇；避开；保卫；防御；起保护作用

examples.zh: 他用左手遮挡反射过来的阳光。

words.definition: to change a situation, discussion etc by giving special attention to one idea or subject instead of to a previous one; a change in the way people think about something, in the way something is done etc; variation, removal, move, instrument, motion; to move, forward motion; influence, fashion, vary
words.translation: 替换，转移；转换；移动；变化；手段；轮班；转变；[遗]转换；转移；改变；替换

examples.en: They need to shift from farming to industry, and they need to do so desperately.
examples.zh: 他们需要从农业领域转移到工业领域。 他们需要拼命地那么做。

words.definition: to shake slightly because you are cold or frightened; a slight shaking movement of your body caused by cold or fear; chip, debris; quake, judder; quaver, to break up
words.translation: 颤抖，哆嗦；冷颤；颤抖，战栗；碎片；颤抖；哆嗦；打碎

examples.en: Jake stood shivering in the cold air.
examples.zh: 大冷天里，杰克站着冻得瑟瑟发抖。

words.definition: to deliberately kill or injure someone using a gun; the part of a plant that comes up above the ground when it is just beginning to grow, or a new part that grows on an existing plant; flight, pot, screen, spring; put, screen, pop; photography, rapid, rush
words.translation: 发射；射中；发芽；射击，射中；[摄]拍摄；使爆炸；给…注射；射击；拍电影；摄影；狩猎；急流

examples.en: Police shot one suspect when he pulled a gun on them.
examples.zh: 警方在一名嫌疑人拔枪指着他们时击毙了他。

examples.en: Smith killed his wife, and then shot himself.
examples.zh: 史密斯杀死妻子，然后开枪自杀。

examples.en: A woman was shot dead in an attempted robbery.
examples.zh: 一名女子在一桩未遂抢劫案中中枪身亡。

words.definition: the land along the edge of a large area of water such as an ocean or lake; support, uphold, sustain; leg, backbone, stay
words.translation: 滨，岸；支撑，使稳住；用支柱撑住；海滨；支柱

examples.en: We could see a boat about a mile from shore.
examples.zh: 我们看见离岸边大约一英里的地方有一艘船。

examples.en: Only a few survivors reached the shore.
examples.zh: 仅有几个生还者到达岸边。

examples.en: She began to swim to shore.
examples.zh: 她开始朝岸边游去。

words.definition: a situation in which there is not enough of something that people need; poverty, short of, deficiency, need, drought
words.translation: 不足，缺少，不足额；缺乏，缺少；不足

examples.en: There is no heating available due to fuel shortages.
examples.zh: 因为燃料短缺，所以没有供暖。

examples.en: There is no shortage of funds.
examples.zh: 不缺资金。

words.definition: soon; soon, immediately, now
words.translation: 立刻；简短地；唐突地

examples.en: Ms Jones will be back shortly.
examples.zh: 琼斯女士很快就会回来。

words.definition: small metal balls that are shot, many at a time, from a  shotgun; emission, sending, launch, shell, projection; varied, shabby
words.translation: 发射；弹丸；射门；[军]发射；炮弹；射手；用尽的；破旧的；杂色的，闪光的

examples.zh: 他射出了所有的子弹却没有一发命中。

words.definition: a piece of equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body; blast, flood; have a bath
words.translation: 阵雨；(一)阵；淋浴；（倾泻般出现的）一阵，一大批；[气象]阵雨；[气象]下阵雨

examples.en: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
examples.zh: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

examples.en: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
examples.zh: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

examples.en: The bathroom has a separate shower cubicle (= a shower in a separate part of the room ) .
examples.zh: 卫生间里有一个独立的淋浴间。

words.translation: 尖声喊叫；尖叫声；尖叫；促人注意；尖声；尖锐的响声

examples.zh: 他们哭喊着被人从家里拖出去。

examples.en: He shrieked in agony.
examples.zh: 他痛苦地尖叫起来。

words.definition: a mark or shape that has a particular meaning; symbol, breath, evidence, mark, motion; subscribe; ink, endorse
words.translation: 符号；招牌；签名；迹象；记号；手势；签署；示意

examples.en: the dollar sign
examples.zh: 美元符号

examples.en: a minus sign
examples.zh: 减号

words.definition: The significance of something is the importance that it has, usually because it will have an effect on a situation or shows something about a situation; meaning, stress, weight, consequence
words.translation: 意义，意味；重要性；意义；意思

examples.en: Ideas about the social significance of religion have changed over time.
examples.zh: 有关宗教的社会意义的观念已随时间的流逝发生了改变。

words.definition: complete quiet because nobody is talking; to make someone stop talking, or stop something making a noise; still, quiescence; becalm, extinguish
words.translation: 沉默；使沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态；使安静；压制；消除噪音

examples.zh: 沉默了片刻才有人回答。

words.translation: 类似地，相似地；同样地；类似于

examples.en: The first letter she wrote me was less than a page long, and her second letter was similarly brief.
examples.zh: 她写给我的第一封信不到一页，第二封信也一样简短。

examples.zh: 吃穿的费用近年来下降了。 同样地，燃料价格也有大幅 回落。

examples.zh: 简单地说，这次减税意味着普通人的收入将增加 3% 左右。

examples.zh: 对木工之类的熟练工匠需求量很大。

examples.zh: 黑格的声明并非完全出乎意料。

words.definition: being the same in all its parts or among all its members; a particular type of clothing worn by all the members of a group or organization such as the police, the army etc; united, consistent, corresponding, matching, same; monkey suit, livery

examples.zh: A 级鸡蛋必须大小相同。

words.definition: an organization formed by workers to protect their rights; alliance, league, unity, combination, combined with
words.translation: 联合；团结；协会；联盟，协会；工会

examples.en: Are you planning to join the union?
examples.zh: 你打算加入工会吗？

examples.en: {"COLLOINEXA":["union members"]}
examples.zh: 工会会员

words.definition: an amount of something used as a standard of measurement; device, apparatus, installation, components, parts
words.translation: 单位；单元；部件；[计量]单位，单元；装置；[军]部队；[机]部件

examples.en: The man is in the hospital’s intensive care unit.
examples.zh: 那名男子在医院的重症监护室。

words.definition: if different people or organizations unite, or if something unites them, they join together in order to achieve something; intermix; league, band, combine, connect, rally
words.translation: 联合；使联合；使…混合；使…联合；使…团结；团结；混合

examples.en: Our goal is to unite the opposition parties and defeat the President.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是联合各反对党挫败总统。

words.definition: when a group of people or countries agree or are joined together; accordance, agreement, alliance, identity, combination, union, association
words.translation: 单一；统一；团结；一致；联合；个体

examples.en: economic unity
examples.zh: 经济统一

examples.en: European unity
examples.zh: 欧洲的一体化

words.definition: not known about; strange, sealed; XYZ, pronumeral
words.translation: 不知道的；未知的；[数]未知的；陌生的，默默无闻的；[数]未知数；未知的事物，默默无闻的人

examples.en: The murderer’s identity remains unknown.
examples.zh: 杀人凶手身份仍然不明。

examples.en: For some unknown reason, Mark quit his job and moved to Greece.
examples.zh: 不知何故，马克辞掉工作移居希腊了。

examples.zh: 穿越未知海域的航行

words.definition: used to say that something will happen or be true if something else does not happen or is not true; besides, except as, in addition to
words.translation: 除非，如果不；除…之外

examples.en: Unless some extra money is found, the theatre will close.
examples.zh: 要是不能找到更多资金，剧院将要关闭。

examples.en: I think you should complain – unless, of course, you are happy with the way things are.
examples.zh: 我觉得你应该发发牢骚——当然，除非你对现状很满意。

examples.en: He won’t go to sleep unless you tell him a story.
examples.zh: 要是你不给他讲故事他就不睡觉。

words.definition: not alike; completely different from a particular person or thing; different, diverse, varying, another, dissimilar
words.translation: 不同的；不象…；不同的，不相似的

examples.en: Now I see that, unlike her, they were my positive models.
examples.zh: 现在我知道了，那些人不像她，他们是我的正面的表率。

words.definition: not likely to happen; not necessarily
words.translation: 未必的，未必可能的；未必

examples.en: Donna might be able to come tomorrow, but it’s very unlikely.
examples.zh: 唐娜明天也许能来，不过这可能性很小。

words.definition: to remove a load from a vehicle, ship etc; debark; discharge of goods, load off
words.translation: 卸(货)；卸货；卸；摆脱…之负担；倾销；退子弹

examples.en: Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly.
examples.zh: 从小船上卸下所有的货物并彻底地清洗。

words.definition: in a higher position than something else; higher, over
words.translation: 上面的；地位较高的；[流][地质]上面的，上部的；较高的

examples.en: the upper lip
examples.zh: 上唇

words.definition: standing or sitting straight up; honest, vertical, straight, standing, square; verticalness, perpendicularity
words.translation: 垂直的；正直的；正直的，诚实的；垂直的，直立的；笔直的；合乎正道的；垂直；竖立

examples.en: Katie was still awake, sitting bolt upright(= sitting with her back very straight ) staring at the television.
examples.zh: 凯蒂还醒着，坐得笔直，眼睛盯着电视。

words.definition: to push something over without intending to; disorder, subvert; tip, keel over; chaotic, troubled, confused; disorder, chaos, confusion, turmoil, involvement
words.translation: 弄翻，打翻，倾覆；使心烦；颠覆；扰乱；翻倒；心烦的；混乱的；弄翻的；混乱

examples.en: He upset a bowl of soup.
examples.zh: 他打翻了一碗汤。

words.definition: increasing to a higher level; upgrade, rising, up, climbing; up, zenithward
words.translation: 向上的，上升的；向上的；上升的；向上

examples.en: upward pressure on bank interest rates
examples.zh: 针对银行利率的越来越大的压力

words.definition: relating to towns and cities; city
words.translation: a.；都市的,住在都市的；城市的；住在都市的

examples.en: unemployment in urban areas
examples.zh: 城市地区的失业状况

examples.en: the deprived sections of the urban population
examples.zh: 城市人口中的贫困群体

words.definition: formal to make someone or something move by shouting, pushing them etc; a strong wish or need; crowd, rush up; impulse, driving force; scream for
words.translation: 推进；催促；冲动；力劝，催促；驱策，推进；强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力；强烈要求

examples.en: The charity urged quick action.
examples.zh: 慈善机构敦促迅速采取行动。

words.definition: very important and needing to be dealt with immediately; emergency, instant
words.translation: 紧急的；强求的；急迫的

examples.en: He was in urgent need of medical attention.
examples.zh: 他急需治疗。

examples.en: The report called for urgent action to reduce lead in petrol.
examples.zh: 报告呼吁迅速采取行动，减少汽油中的铅含量。

examples.en: an urgent message
examples.zh: 一封急报

words.definition: the way that words are used in a language; employment, utilization, tradition, use, convention
words.translation: 使用，对待；惯用法；使用；[语]用法；惯例

examples.en: a book on modern English usage
examples.zh: 关于现代英语用法的书

words.translation: 利用

examples.en: We must consider how best to utilize what resources we have.
examples.zh: 我们必须考虑怎样充分利用现有的资源。

words.definition: You can use utmost to emphasize the importance or seriousness of something or to emphasize the way that it is done; the most that can be done; limitation, threshold, terminal; excessive, extreme
words.translation: 最远的；极限；最大可能；极度的

examples.en: It is a matter of the utmost urgency to find out what has happened to these people.
examples.zh: 当务之急是弄清楚这些人出了什么事。

examples.en: Security matters are treated with the utmost seriousness.
examples.zh: 安全问题受到极为严肃的对待。

words.definition: complete – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong; release, put, voice, project, let go; thorough, full, complete, absolute, total
words.translation: 完全的，彻底的；发出，表达；发射；完全的；彻底的；无条件的

examples.en: That’s utter nonsense!
examples.zh: 真是一派胡言！

examples.en: This company treats its employees with utter contempt.
examples.zh: 这家公司对其员工不屑一顾。

examples.en: I watched in complete and utter horror as he pulled out a gun.
examples.zh: 我惊恐万分地看着他拔出枪来。

words.definition: a vacant seat, building, room or piece of land is empty and available for someone to use; available, empty, blank, leisure, hollow
words.translation: 空的；未被占用的；空虚的；空缺的；空闲的；茫然的

examples.en: Only a few apartments were still vacant.
examples.zh: 只有几套公寓仍然空着。

examples.en: There was only a vacant lot (= empty unused area of land in a city ) where her house used to be.
examples.zh: 她以前房子所在的地方只剩下一块空地了。

words.definition: a space that is completely empty of all gas, especially one from which all the air has been taken away; room, gamma space
words.translation: 真空；真空吸尘器；[真空]真空；空间

examples.zh: 他的出现应该能填补过去几天中形成的权力空缺。

words.definition: unclear because someone does not give enough detailed information or does not say exactly what they mean; fuzzy, dark, uncertain

examples.zh: 州长只是含糊地大致说了一下他的税务计划。

words.definition: someone who is vain is too proud of their good looks, abilities, or position – used to show disapproval; empty, blank
words.translation: 徒劳的；自负的；虚荣的；空虚的

examples.en: Men can be just as vain as women.
examples.zh: 男人有时会和女人一样虚荣。

words.definition: a vehicle used especially for carrying goods, which is smaller than a truck and has a roof and usually no windows at the sides; vanguard, pioneer
words.translation: 大篷车，运货车；先锋；厢式货车；增值网

examples.zh: 运货车

examples.en: a van driver
examples.zh: 小型货车司机

words.definition: a mass of very small drops of a liquid which float in the air, for example because the liquid has been heated
words.translation: 汽，蒸气

examples.en: water vapour
examples.zh: 水蒸气

words.translation: 易变的；变量；[生物][数][光]变量的；可变的；易变的，多变的；变异的，畸变的

examples.zh: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

examples.zh: 利率有时会大幅波动。

words.definition: a difference between similar things, or a change from the usual amount or form of something; shift, change, differentiation, diversification, turn
words.translation: 变化，变动；变异；变化；[生物]变异，变种

examples.zh: 他的大部分诗作都是有关爱情主题的形式不同的作品。

words.definition: if there are various things, there are several different types of that thing; varieties of, miscellaneous
words.translation: 各种各样的，不同的；各种各样的；多方面的

examples.en: The jacket is available in various colours.
examples.zh: 这种夹克有好多种颜色可选。

examples.zh: 有多种方法可以回答你的问题。

examples.zh: 出于种种原因，他决定辍学。

examples.zh: 大量难民涌过边境。

examples.zh: 过去的五年内，毕业率大幅度提高。

words.definition: the speed of something that is moving in a particular direction; speed rate, expedition
words.translation: 速度，速率；[力]速率；迅速；周转率

examples.zh: 光速

examples.zh: 快艇的时速达到了120英里。

examples.zh: 高速子弹

words.translation: 冒险；敢于；投机；企业；风险

examples.zh: 天黑以后，他就会壮着胆子出去。

words.definition: to state that something is true; touch bottom, check on
words.translation: 证实，查证；证明；核实；查证

examples.en: His statement was verified by several witnesses.
examples.zh: 他的说法得到了几位证人的证实。

words.definition: pointing up in a line that forms an angle of 90˚ with a flat surface; standing, perpendicular; perpendicular plane, perpendicular line
words.translation: 垂直的，竖式的；[测]垂直的，直立的；[解剖][天]头顶的，顶点的；[数]垂直线，垂直面

examples.en: a vertical line
examples.zh: 垂直线

examples.en: the vertical axis of a graph
examples.zh: 图的纵轴

examples.en: vertical window blinds
examples.zh: 垂直百叶窗

words.definition: a ship or large boat; container, ship, pocket
words.translation: 容器；船，飞船；管；[船]船，舰；[组织]脉管，血管；容器，[轻]器皿

examples.en: a fishing vessel
examples.zh: 渔船

words.definition: someone who has been a soldier, sailor etc in a war; old moustache, warhorse; seasoned

examples.zh: 越战老兵

words.definition: if something vibrates, or if you vibrate it, it shakes quickly and continuously with very small movements; swing, hesitate; oscillate
words.translation: 使颤动；颤动；振动；摇摆；踌躇；使振动

examples.zh: 地板随着音乐的节奏在颤动。

examples.zh: 气流通过我们的声带，使之产生振动。

examples.zh: 打击街头犯罪

examples.en: The police have smashed a vice ring (= a group of criminals involved in vice ) in Chicago.
examples.zh: 警方捣毁了芝加哥的一个犯罪团伙。

words.translation: 朝气蓬勃的；有力的；精力充沛的

examples.zh: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.

examples.zh: 制作红酒醋油沙司，将油、醋和芥末放在一个中等大小的碗里一起搅拌，直到混合均匀。

examples.zh: 在烹饪中，醋可以单独食用，也可以用作食物调味料不附加任何卡路里，但如果我们把它涂抹到头发上呢？

words.translation: 猛烈的；狂暴的；暴力的

examples.en: the increase in violent crime
examples.zh: 暴力犯罪的增多

examples.en: violent clashes between the police and demonstrators
examples.zh: 警方与示威者之间发生的暴力冲突

examples.en: 31 people have been injured in violent incidents throughout the day.
examples.zh: 今天一天有31人在暴力事件中受伤。

words.definition: a plant with small dark purple flowers, or sometimes white or yellow ones; Violet Mist, johnny-jump-up; Tyrian purple

examples.zh: 她一边闻紫罗兰的芳香， 一边说“好香啊！”

words.translation: 善；美德；优点；贞操；功效

examples.zh: 女性常被用作美德的象征。

words.translation: 视；想象力；梦幻；[生理][眼科]视力；美景；眼力；幻象；想象；显现；梦见

examples.zh: 她头部受撞击以后出现暂时性失明。

examples.zh: 泪水模糊了她的视线。

words.translation: 看的；看得见的；[眼科][生理]视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的

examples.en: Artists translate their ideas into visual images.
examples.zh: 画家把自己的思想转换成视觉画面。

words.translation: 维生素，维他命；[生化]维生素；维他命

examples.zh: 尽量吃富含维生素和矿物质的食物。

words.definition: vivid memories, dreams, descriptions etc are so clear that they seem real; telling, live, bright
words.translation: 鲜艳的；生动的；鲜明的

examples.zh: 我对那年夏天记忆犹新。

examples.en: He had a vivid picture of her in his mind.
examples.zh: 他的脑海中清晰地留着她的形象。

words.definition: a mountain with a large hole at the top, through which lava(= very hot liquid rock ) is sometimes forced out
words.translation: 火山

examples.zh: 庞贝城于公元79年在火山爆发中毁灭。

words.translation: 伏特，伏；伏特（电压单位）；环骑；闪避

examples.en: That is one electron volt.
examples.zh: 就是一单位的电子伏特。

examples.en: If I multiply these two, what is the coulomb times a volt?
examples.zh: 如果我把这两个乘起来，库仑乘以伏特是多少？

words.definition: electrical force measured in volts; electric tension, electrical pressure
words.translation: 电压；[电]电压

examples.en: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
examples.zh: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

words.definition: the amount of sound produced by a television, radio etc; lots of, wealth, ocean, sea, bulk; massive, extensive, substantial, macro, much
words.translation: 卷，册；容积；音量；量；[物]体积；[计]卷；大量；[图情]册；大量的

examples.en: the volume of trade
examples.zh: 贸易量

words.definition: a long journey in a ship or spacecraft; navigation, salling; put, sail; wing, cross
words.translation: 航海，航空；字；航行；[水运][航]航程；旅行记；[水运]航海；飞过；渡过

examples.zh: 过去从英格兰到印度要航行六个月。

examples.en: the Titanic’s maiden voyage
examples.zh: “泰坦尼克”号的首航

examples.en: I don’t want to make the voyage single-handed.
examples.zh: 我不想独自航行。

words.definition: progress, do; price, expense, pay, cost; do, carry with
words.translation: 开展(运动)；进行；发动；从事；工资；代价；报偿；开展

examples.en: The government, along with the three factions that had been waging a civil war, signed a peace agreement.
examples.zh: 政府和发动了内战的3方一起签订了1份和平协议。

words.translation: 四轮运货马车

words.definition: to wake up, or to wake someone up; arouse, wake sb. up; wake up, awake
words.translation: 醒来；弄醒；唤醒；使觉醒；觉醒

examples.zh: 她轻轻地唤醒睡梦中的孩子。

words.definition: to walk away from where you are supposed to stay; lose oneself, hang about; range, louse around
words.translation: 漫游；迷路；离题；徘徊；漫步；游荡，漫游

examples.zh: 不要让任何一个小孩走开去。

words.definition: used to say that you do not have or cannot find what you need in a particular situation; ask, would have, claim; necessity, shortage, need, poverty, deficiency; wish, have need of
words.translation: 需要；缺乏；希望；应该；缺少；贫困；必需品

examples.zh: 那家画廊由于缺乏资金关闭了。

words.translation: 暖和，温暖；热烈；温暖；热情；激动

examples.zh: 她被火的温暖吸引着，走进了房间。

words.definition: the clear liquid without colour, smell, or taste that falls as rain and that is used for drinking, washing etc; if you water plants or the ground they are growing in, you pour water on them; seawater, eau; shed tears, pipe one's eye
words.translation: 水；使湿，灌溉；海水；雨水；海域，大片的水；加水；流泪

examples.zh: 浴室地面上都是水。

examples.en: Does anyone want a drink of water?
examples.zh: 有谁想喝杯水吗？

examples.en: a glass of sparkling mineral water
examples.zh: 一杯有气矿泉水

words.definition: not allowing water to enter; splashproof, hose-proof; rainproof
words.translation: 不透水的，防水的；防水的，[建]不透水的；使防水

examples.en: a waterproof jacket

examples.en: a follower of Christ
examples.zh: 耶稣的门徒

words.definition: an exciting and unusual experience or situation you imagine happening to you, but which will probably never happen; fancy, illusion; visional; imagine, picture, think of; stargaze
words.translation: 想象， 幻想；想象的产物；[心理]幻想；白日梦；幻觉；虚幻的；空想；想像；耽于幻想；奏幻想曲（等于phantasy）

examples.en: I used to have fantasies about living in Paris with an artist.
examples.zh: 我过去常幻想着在巴黎与一位艺术家同住。

examples.zh: 性幻想

examples.en: Young children sometimes can’t distinguish between fantasy and reality.
examples.zh: 小孩子有时不能区分幻想与现实。

words.definition: if something frustrates you, it makes you feel annoyed or angry because you are unable to do what you want; defeat, discomfit; founder, come to naught; thwarted, unprofitable

examples.zh: 他们在我腰间系了一根粗绳子，把我拉了上去。

examples.en: The man was coiling a length of rope.
examples.zh: 那人正在卷一段绳子。

words.definition: good sense and judgment, based especially on your experience of life; wit, scholarship
words.translation: 智慧， 才智；名言；智慧，才智；明智；学识；至理名言

examples.zh: 一个有大智慧的男人

examples.zh: 戴夫总能冒出几句至理名言。

words.definition: an object that you use to protect yourself against rain or hot sun. It consists of a circular folding frame covered in cloth.; shadow, bumbershoot
words.translation: 伞， 雨伞；雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构

examples.zh: 开始下雨了，所以特里西娅停下来撑起雨伞。

examples.zh: 那天我就在海滩上度过，躺在海滩遮阳伞下面看书。

words.definition: Halfway means in the middle of a place or between two points, at an equal distance from each of them; at a middle point in space or time between two things; intermediary, inexhaustive

examples.zh: 他梯子上到了一半。

words.translation: 直到最近的， 现代的；跟上时代的；最新的，最近的；现代的，新式的

examples.en: ...the most up-to-date information available on foods today.
examples.zh: …今日有关食品的最新消息。

words.definition: when you translate something, or something that has been translated; interpretation, version

examples.zh: 她看了信，给我们大概翻译了一下。

examples.en: I’ve only read ‘Madame Bovary’ in translation (= not in its original language ) .
examples.zh: 我只读过《包法利夫人》的翻译本。

examples.en: Much of the book’s humour has been lost in translation (= is no longer effective when translated ) .
examples.zh: 本书的许多幽默元素已在翻译过程中丢失。

words.definition: to hit or knock against something; an area of skin that is raised because you have hit it on something; tumor, knub; hit, impact on, crash; to run into, to hit; suddenly, heavily, strong, sharp, hard

examples.zh: 屋顶很低，他都碰到头了。

words.definition: used to say that you are thinking about a particular fact when you are giving your opinion; given, saving; when
words.translation: 鉴于， 考虑到， 顾及；考虑到；就...而论

examples.zh: 考虑到对方实力强大，我们能攻进两球已经很不错了。

examples.zh: 她言辞激烈，令他们俩都很惊讶。

examples.zh: 缉毒警官

examples.en: He pulled out his badge and said he was a cop.
examples.zh: 他拿出警徽说自己是警察。

examples.zh: 我能喝一杯水吗？ 我太渴了。

examples.zh: 你不必非要买更多的书。

examples.zh: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。

examples.zh: 加一瓣压碎的大蒜。

examples.zh: 医生必须对病人的病历完全保密。

examples.zh: 这个国家陷入了经济大混乱。

examples.zh: 她紧张地站在台侧等待出场的提示。

words.translation: 日出；朝霞；[天]日出；黎明

examples.zh: 富士山日出的照片

examples.zh: 这家银行能为你提供外币。

examples.zh: 这是一条非常重要的法规。

examples.zh: 一个秘书每个星期来两次处理他的信件。

examples.zh: 停火声明

examples.zh: 从前按照伊斯兰法律，作简单的声明就可以离婚。

examples.zh: 在这艰难时期我们时刻思念你，为你祈祷。

examples.zh: 孩子们做完祷告后上床睡觉了。

examples.zh: 她没有勇气承认自己的欺骗行为。

examples.zh: 在休斯敦地区，任何一天医院的床位都有一半是空的。

words.translation: 律师， 法律顾问

examples.zh: 一家小型律师事务所

examples.zh: 录像制作

words.translation: 武器， 兵器；武器，[军]兵器

examples.zh: 他们都持有棍棒，打算当武器用。
