examples.en: In an official statement, she formally announced her resignation.
examples.zh: 在一份官方声明中，她正式宣布辞职。

words.definition: something that you are trying to achieve, such as a total, an amount, or a time; to make something have an effect on a particular limited group or area; goal, object, end, cause, aim
words.translation: 目标；把…作为目标；瞄准；靶子

examples.en: There is no target date for completion of the new project.
examples.zh: 这个新的项目何时完工没有预定日期。

examples.en: The government may fail to meet (= achieve ) its target of recycling 25% of domestic waste.
examples.zh: 政府可能达不到回收利用25%的生活垃圾的目标。

examples.en: Jiang set annual growth targets of 8–9%.
examples.zh: 江确定了8%至9%的年增长目标。

words.definition: used to emphasize that the way you are describing something is really true; sincerely, really, true
words.translation: 真正地；忠实地；真实地，不假；真诚地

examples.en: His work is truly original.
examples.zh: 他的作品确实十分独特。

examples.en: Fawcett was a truly remarkable man.
examples.zh: 福西特是一位真正不同凡响的人。

examples.en: a truly great work of medieval literature
examples.zh: 一部真正伟大的中世纪文学作品

words.definition: a part of a cell in a living thing that controls what it looks like, how it grows, and how it develops. People get their genes from their parents; hereditary factor
words.translation: 基因；[遗]基因，遗传因子

examples.en: human genes
examples.zh: 人类基因

examples.en: the genes that regulate cell division
examples.zh: 控制细胞分裂的基因

words.definition: the act of killing yourself; Dutch act, self-destruction; self-destruct; kill oneself, take one's own life
words.translation: 自杀；自杀行为；自杀者；自杀的

examples.en: More people commit suicide at Christmas than at any other time.
examples.zh: 圣诞节期间自杀的人比其他任何时候都多。

examples.en: My mother attempted suicide on many occasions.
examples.zh: 我母亲多次试图自杀。

examples.en: He apparently left a suicide note (= letter explaining his reasons for killing himself ) on his desk.
examples.zh: 他显然在桌上留了封绝笔信。

words.definition: all the money that you have saved, especially in a bank; economy, fund, deposit; economical, managing; considering, given
words.translation: 节省， 节约；储蓄金， 存款；[经]节约；挽救；存款；[经]节约的；挽救的；补偿的；[法]保留的；考虑到；除...之外

examples.en: Buying a house had taken all their savings.
examples.zh: 买房子花掉了他们所有的积蓄。

words.definition: the narrow part in the middle of the human body; middle, loin
words.translation: 腰， 腰部；腰，腰部

examples.en: The skirt was too big around the waist.
examples.zh: 那条裙子腰围太大。

words.definition: a British spelling of  connection; contact, link, junction, join
words.translation: connection的英式拼法；连接，联系（等于connection）

words.definition: to angrily criticize someone, especially a child, about something they have done; rate, hop on; talking-to, opprobrium
words.translation: 责骂， 训斥；责骂；叱责；骂；爱责骂的人

examples.en: Do not scold the puppy, but simply and firmly say ‘no’.
examples.zh: 不要责骂小狗，但要干脆利落地说“不”。

words.definition: to feel very angry about something and show this in the way you behave or speak; a strong feeling of uncontrollable anger; anger, wrath; obtain, anger
words.translation: 狂吹；汹涌；激烈进行；发怒， 发火；狂怒，盛怒；风靡一时的事物，时尚；愤怒；狂暴，肆虐；情绪激动；大怒，发怒；流行，风行

examples.en: ‘How was I to know!’ Jenny raged.
examples.zh: “我怎么会知道！”珍妮怒道。

words.definition: a system of rules about the correct way to behave on an official occasion; agreement, ceremony, understanding, treaty, accord; study out
words.translation: 礼仪， 礼节；草案， 议定书；协议；草案；礼仪；拟定

examples.en: a breach of diplomatic protocol
examples.zh: 违反外交礼节

words.definition: a very large animal that lives in the sea and looks like a fish, but is actually a mammal; slaughter; bouncer, colossus
words.translation: 鲸；猛揍；使惨败；[脊椎]鲸；巨大的东西

examples.en: The whale nearest to the photographer is releasing air to aid its descent.
examples.zh: 这只离摄影师最近的白鲸正呼出空气以帮助其下潜。

examples.en: This type of whale is notable for its elongated beak. It dives deeper than 500 metres for food.
examples.zh: 这种鲸因其瘦长的喙而闻名。它能够潜入深度超过500米的海中寻找食物。

examples.en: They do not have a set migration pattern, unlike some other whale species - which raises questions about how they may adapt in future, if the projected declines in summer Arctic sea ice materialise.
examples.zh: 它们没有一套迁徙的模式，不像其他的鲸类――假如夏季北极海冰像预计那样减少而成为现实的话，这就引起了关于它们如何适应未来的问题。

words.definition: a small wooden musical instrument that you hold under your chin and play by pulling a bow(= special stick ) across the strings; fiddle
words.translation: 小提琴；小提琴手

examples.en: He plays the violin in an orchestra.
examples.zh: 他在管弦乐队中演奏小提琴。

examples.en: She is first violin of an orchestra .
examples.zh: 她是管弦乐队的第一小提琴手。

examples.en: All this from playing the violin and the cello.
examples.zh: 所有这些都来自于小提琴和大提琴的演奏。

words.definition: to tell someone that you strongly disapprove of something they have said or done; correct, blame for; object, protest against sth
words.translation: 抗议；责备，告诫；表示异议；抗议，反对；进谏；告诫

examples.en: He remonstrated with the referee.
examples.zh: 他曾向裁判抗议。

words.definition: If you cruise an ocean, river, or canal, you travel around it or along it on a cruise; A cruise is a holiday during which you travel on a ship or boat and visit a number of places; range, expatiate; range, roam about
words.translation: 航游，巡航；缓慢巡行；航游， 游弋；巡航，巡游；漫游

examples.en: She wants to cruise the canals of France in a barge.
examples.zh: 她想坐驳船游览法国的运河。

examples.en: ...a holiday cruising around the Caribbean.
examples.zh: …环游加勒比海的度假航行。

examples.en: He and his wife were planning to go on a world cruise.
examples.zh: 他和妻子那时正计划进行一次环球海上航游。

words.definition: a subject that people talk or write about; theme, subject, titles, motive
words.translation: 题目， 论题， 话题；主题（等于theme）；题目；一般规则；总论

examples.en: The environment is a popular topic these days.
examples.zh: 如今环境是一个热门话题。

examples.en: The main topic for discussion will be the proposed new supermarket.
examples.zh: 讨论的主要议题是拟建中的超级市场。

examples.en: a wide range of topics
examples.zh: 广泛的话题

words.definition: erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct; false, wrong, improper, incorrect, inaccurate
words.translation: 错误的， 不正确的；错误的；不正确的

examples.en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
examples.zh: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。

words.definition: a short attack on a place by soldiers, planes, or ships, intended to cause damage but not take control; robbery, assault; hit, descend on
words.translation: 袭击；突入查抄， 突入搜捕；劫掠；[军]袭击；突袭；搜捕；抢劫；[军]袭击，突袭

examples.en: a bombing raid
examples.zh: 轰炸

examples.en: an air raid warning siren
examples.zh: 空袭警报

words.definition: a school for children aged two to five; play school, nursery school
words.translation: 幼儿园；幼稚园

examples.en: I to the kindergarten at the age of three.
examples.zh: 在我记忆中，我三岁就被送去幼儿园了。

examples.en: She took me to the kindergarten and home every day, in spite of rain and wind.
examples.zh: 无论是下雨还是刮风，她每天带我在幼儿园和家之间穿梭。

words.definition: someone whose job is to receive or pay out money in a shop; teller, treasurer; get the boot, to sack
words.translation: 出纳；[会计]出纳员；司库；解雇；抛弃

examples.en: Do you have any experience as a cashier?
examples.zh: 你是否有出纳员的工作经验？

words.definition: straight up or down in an almost vertical line; to change direction suddenly, especially in order to avoid something; a sheer drop, cliff, slope etc is very steep and almost vertical; strict, absolute, transparent, positive, crystal; very, quite a; yaw; crab; yaw, leeway
words.translation: 垂直地，陡峭地；急转向， 偏离；完全的，十足的；陡峭的，垂直的；极薄的，透明的；绝对的；透明的；峻峭的；完全；陡峭地；偏航；使偏航；使急转向；[纺]透明薄织物

examples.en: cliffs which rose sheer from the sea
examples.zh: 从海面垂直拔起的悬崖

words.definition: the period during the 1930s when there was not much business activity and not many jobs; recession, disappointment
words.translation: 抑郁， 沮丧；不景气， 萧条；洼地， 凹陷；沮丧；[地理]洼地；[经]不景气；忧愁

examples.en: Mr. Thomas was suffering from depression.
examples.zh: 托马斯先生当时正受抑郁症折磨。

words.definition: prison, imprison; prison, jail, big house, slammer, correctional facility
words.translation: 监禁；监狱

examples.en: Hundreds and thousands of africans are thrown into gaol each year under pass laws.
examples.zh: 由于《通行证法》，每年有成千上万的南非黑人被关进监狱。

words.definition: a thick cooked liquid that is served with food to give it a particular taste; soy, shoyu; season
words.translation: 调味汁， 作料；酱油；沙司；调味汁；使增加趣味；给…调味

examples.en: spaghetti sauces
examples.zh: 意大利面酱

words.definition: to become smaller, or to make something smaller, through the effects of heat or water; contract, recoil from; astrict, constringe; contraction, necking down
words.translation: 起皱；收缩；退缩， 畏缩；畏缩；使缩小，使收缩

examples.en: I’m worried about washing that shirt in case it shrinks.
examples.zh: 我不太敢洗那件衬衫，怕它会缩水。

words.definition: determined or trying very hard to be more successful than other people or businesses; played, rival
words.translation: 竞争的， 比赛的；好竞争的， 求胜心切的；有竞争力的；竞争的；比赛的；求胜心切的

examples.en: Some US industries are not as competitive as they have been in the past.
examples.zh: 美国有些行业不如以前有竞争力了。

examples.en: The team seems to have lost its competitive edge recently (= its ability to compete well ) .
examples.zh: 这支球队近来好像丧失了竞争优势。

words.definition: question, quaere
words.translation: 询问；[计]询问，[贸易]询盘

examples.en: We are pleased to receive your enquiry.
examples.zh: 我们很高兴收到您的询问函。

examples.en: She has taken my enquiry as a personal affront.
examples.zh: 她将我的询问当成了人身侮辱。

examples.en: When fresh supplies come into the market, we can revert to your enquiry.
examples.zh: 等新货上市时，我们才能回头考虑你们的询盘。

words.definition: the sound of many people hitting their hands together and shouting, to show that they have enjoyed something; acclamation, cheer
words.translation: 鼓掌， 掌声；欢呼，喝采；鼓掌欢迎

examples.en: She got a round of applause (=  a short period of applause  ) when she finished.
examples.zh: 她结束的时候获得一阵掌声。

words.definition: someone who works on a ship; matlo, matelot
words.translation: 水手， 海员；水手，海员；乘船者

examples.en: Six British sailors drowned.
examples.zh: 六名英国海员溺水身亡。

examples.en: We were both experienced sailors.
examples.zh: 我们两个都是经验丰富的水手。

words.definition: question, probe, examine, query; question, query, inquire of
words.translation: 询问；调查；问候（等于inquire）；打听

examples.en: Day and day I take pains to enquire myself my reason for doing so, in no time will I stoop so low as to beg you sympathy, though I can feel your scoff all the time.
examples.zh: 日复一日，我不厌其详地询问我自己，我在任何时候都这样低俯恳求你同情，但我能感受到你对这一切一切嗤之以鼻。

examples.en: We have obtained your company information from china. alibaba. com. So we are Emailing you to enquire whether you would be willing to establish new business relations with us.
examples.zh: 我们从阿里巴巴网站上得到贵公司资讯。我们传送此封邮件给您是想询问您是否愿意与我们建立新的业务关系。

words.definition: when something or someone is liked or supported by a lot of people; prevalence, diffusedness
words.translation: 普及， 流行；声望；普及，流行；名气；受大众欢迎

examples.en: The president’s popularity has declined considerably.
examples.zh: 总统的支持率大大下降了。

words.definition: Oval things have a shape that is like a circle but is wider in one direction than the other; a shape like a circle, but wider in one direction than the other; elliptical, ovate; ellipse, elliptical shape
words.translation: 椭圆形的；椭圆形；椭圆的；[数]卵形的；[数]卵形

examples.en: ...the small oval framed picture of a little boy.
examples.zh: …一个小男孩的镶在椭圆形框架里的小幅照片。

words.definition: to become part of a group or society and be accepted by them, or to help someone do this（; become one flesh; complete, absolute, full, total, round; gleichschaltung
words.translation: 成为一体， 合并；求积分；取消隔离；成为一体；整合的；完全的；一体化；集成体

examples.en: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life.
examples.zh: 他没有成功融入到意大利的生活方式中去。

words.definition: someone who continues to live after an accident, war, or illness; leavings
words.translation: 生还者；残存物；幸存者

examples.en: Don’t worry about Kurt; he’s a survivor.
examples.zh: 不用担心库尔特，他是个坚强的人。

words.definition: to find out what illness someone has, or what the cause of a fault is, after doing tests, examinations etc; tell, figure out; judge of, pass upon
words.translation: 诊断；断定；判断

examples.en: He could diagnose an engine problem simply by listening.
examples.zh: 他仅靠听就能判断发动机出了什么问题。

examples.en: This product is not intended to diagnose, treat or prevent any disease.
examples.zh: 此产品并不供作诊断、治疗或预防任何疾病之用。

examples.en: You can also diagnose your weaknesses with this simple exercise.
examples.zh: 这样的简单练习还可以诊断你的缺点。

words.definition: a small creature with eight legs, which catches insects using a fine network of sticky threads; araneid, tripod
words.translation: 蜘蛛；[无脊椎]蜘蛛；设圈套者；三脚架

examples.en: What should I find but an enormous spider!
examples.zh: 我居然发现了一只巨大的蜘蛛！

examples.en: Do you think that the spider can web anything?
examples.zh: 你觉得这蜘蛛能用网捕住什么吗?

examples.en: I should not have to live my eternity away from my little spider.
examples.zh: 我不会离开我的小蜘蛛而孤凄地度过那无边岁月的。

words.definition: to make someone feel frightened; a sudden feeling of fear; take aback; spook; panic, pavor; haircurling, terrifying
words.translation: 吓， 使害怕；受惊吓， 感到害怕；惊恐，恐慌；惊吓；把…吓跑；受惊；恐慌；惊恐；（美）骇人的

examples.en: Loud noises can scare animals or birds.
examples.zh: 噪声太大会惊吓到鸟兽。

words.definition: timid, tremulous
words.translation: 引起惊慌的；提心吊胆的；胆小的

words.definition: a company that gives advice on a particular subject; consulting firm, consultation company
words.translation: 咨询公司；顾问工作

examples.en: a management consultancy
examples.zh: 管理咨询公司

examples.en: a consultancy firm
examples.zh: 咨询公司

words.definition: Homogeneous is used to describe a group or thing which has members or parts that are all the same; conspecific
words.translation: 同种类的， 同性质的， 有相同特征的；[化学]均匀的；[数]齐次的；[生物]同种的

examples.en: The unemployed are not a homogeneous group.
examples.zh: 失业者并不都是同一类人。

words.definition: to make a difficult subject or idea able to be easily understood by ordinary people who have no special knowledge about it; gain ground, vulgarize
words.translation: 普及；使通俗化

examples.en: Skinner was the psychologist who popularized behavior modification.
examples.zh: 斯金纳就是那位使行为矫正概念得到普及的心理学家。

words.definition: if two armies, groups etc clash, they start fighting – used in news reports; a short fight between two armies or groups – used in news reports; interference, conflict, war, collision, warfare; tang, collide with
words.translation: 发生冲突；不协调；砰地相撞，发出刺耳的撞击声；冲突；刺耳的撞击声；冲突，不协调；碰撞声，铿锵声；冲突，抵触；砰地相碰撞，发出铿锵声

examples.en: Troops clashed near the border.
examples.zh: 军队在边境附近发生了冲突。

words.definition: to officially accept or allow something; official orders or laws stopping trade, communication etc with another country, as a way of forcing its leaders to make political changes; approval, penalty, holding, support, adhesion; encourage, confirm, heart, uphold
words.translation: 批准，认可；批准， 认可；约束因素， 约束力；国际制裁；制裁，处罚；认可；支持；批准；鼓励

examples.en: The church refused to sanction the king’s second marriage.
examples.zh: 教会拒绝批准国王的第二次婚姻。

words.definition: If you sin, you do something that is believed to break the laws of God; an action that is against religious rules and is considered to be an offence against God; error, evil, crime, mistake, blame; commit a crime, offend against
words.translation: 犯戒律， 犯过失；罪，罪孽；罪恶；罪孽；过失；犯罪；犯过失

examples.en: The Spanish Inquisition charged him with sinning against God and man.
examples.zh: 西班牙宗教法庭指控他违背了上帝和人类的律法。

words.definition: a historic event or act is very important and will be recorded as part of history
words.translation: 历史上著名的， 具有重大历史意义的

examples.en: a historic meeting of world leaders
examples.zh: 具有历史意义的世界领导人会议

examples.en: ‘It is a historic moment ,’ he told journalists.
examples.zh: “那是历史性的一刻。”他告诉新闻记者。

words.definition: a select group of people or things is a small special group that has been chosen carefully; to choose something or someone by thinking carefully about which is the best, most suitable etc; pack, choose from; wonderful, excellent, famous, chosen, choice; choose from, pick on
words.translation: 精选的， 挑选出来的；优等的， 第一流的；选择，挑选；挑选；选拔；精选的；挑选出来的；极好的

examples.en: The party was small and select.
examples.zh: 团里人员不多，都是经过精心挑选的。

examples.en: Honorary degrees are handed out to a select few .
examples.zh: 荣誉学位颁给挑选出的少数几个人。

words.definition: accomplish, carry out, come true, implement, meet
words.translation: 履行， 实现， 完成；满足， 使满意；履行；实现；满足；使结束（等于fulfil）

words.definition: unusual or interesting enough to be easily noticed; prominent, obvious, marked, tremendous, noted; beating
words.translation: 显著的， 突出的；惹人注目的， 容貌出众的；显著的，突出的，惊人的；打击的；[劳经]罢工的；打（strike的ing形式）

examples.en: a dark man with striking features
examples.zh: 相貌出众、肤色黝黑的男子

words.definition: a child or young person; young adult, stripling
words.translation: 青年， 年轻人， 孩子；年轻人；少年

examples.en: Other youngsters are not so lucky.
examples.zh: 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。

words.definition: a thinking person is intelligent and tries to think carefully about important subjects; your opinion or ideas about something, or your attitude towards it; ideological, noematic; idea, opinion, concepts, view, eye
words.translation: 深思的， 有理性的；想法，意见，见解；思考的；思想的；有理性的；好思考的；思考；思想；想法；意见；见解

examples.en: the thinking man’s pop band
examples.zh: 有思想的男士喜欢的流行乐队

words.definition: someone who has been elected or chosen to speak, vote, or take decisions for a group; to choose someone to do a particular job, or to be a representative of a group, organization etc; representation, deputy, behalf of, ambassador
words.translation: 代表， 代表团成员；委派…为代表；授 ， 把…委托给；代表

examples.en: Around 350 delegates attended the conference.
examples.zh: 大约有350名代表参加了大会。

words.definition: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has existed for a long time, or these beliefs, customs etc in general; convention, usage, heritage, tale, prescription
words.translation: 传统， 惯例；惯例，传统；传说

examples.en: the traditions of South East Asia
examples.zh: 东南亚的传统

examples.en: the tradition that the eldest son inherits the property
examples.zh: 长子继承家产的传统

examples.en: By tradition, it’s the bride’s parents who pay for the wedding.
examples.zh: 根据传统习俗，婚礼的费用由新娘的父母承担。

examples.zh: 一束阳光

words.definition: if something is scarce, there is not very much of it available; rare, short, lacking, insufficient, deficient; merely, simply, just, only, but
words.translation: 缺乏的， 不足的；稀少的， 罕见的；缺乏的，不足的；稀有的；仅仅；几乎不；几乎没有

examples.en: Food was often scarce in the winter.
examples.zh: 冬季常常粮食短缺。

examples.en: There was fierce competition for the scarce resources .
examples.zh: 对这些紧缺资源的争夺非常激烈。

words.definition: something such as useful land, or minerals such as oil or coal, that exists in a country and can be used to increase its wealth; financial ability
words.translation: 资源；财力；应付办法， 谋略；[计][环境]资源，财力；办法；智谋

examples.en: Canada’s vast mineral resources
examples.zh: 加拿大丰富的矿产资源

examples.en: a country rich in natural resources
examples.zh: 自然资源丰富的国家

words.definition: extremely unattractive and unpleasant to look at; evil, ill, black, wicked
words.translation: 丑陋的；可怕的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的

examples.en: a very ugly man
examples.zh: 非常丑陋的男子

examples.en: the ugliest building in town
examples.zh: 城里最难看的建筑

examples.en: Nick’s dog is as ugly as sin (= very ugly ).
examples.zh: 尼克的狗难看得要命。

words.definition: an amount of money that you must pay to the government according to your income, property, goods etc and that is used to pay for public services; to charge a tax on something; scot, heavy burden
words.translation: 税，税款；负担；对…征税；使负担重， 使费尽力气；税金；重负

examples.en: No-one enjoys paying tax.
examples.zh: 没人喜欢缴税。

words.definition: the feeling of being excited; stimulus, incentive, needle
words.translation: 刺激， 激动， 兴奋；令人兴奋的事， 刺激的因素；兴奋；刺激；令人兴奋的事物

examples.en: We were both new to the excitements of life in the big city.
examples.zh: 我们俩都是初次感受大城市多姿多彩的生活。

words.definition: a very frightening dream; paroniria, oneirodynia; terrible, horrible, awesome, fearful, dire
words.translation: 噩梦；可怕的事物， 无法摆脱的恐惧；恶梦；梦魇般的经历；可怕的；噩梦似的

examples.en: a recurring nightmare
examples.zh: 一再出现的噩梦

words.definition: a group of officials who represent their government in a foreign country, or the building they work in; ambassade, chancellery
words.translation: 大使馆；大使馆全体成员；大使馆全体人员

examples.en: the American Embassy in Paris
examples.zh: 美国驻巴黎大使馆

words.definition: the scientific study of societies and the behaviour of people in groups; demotics, synecology
words.translation: 社会学；群体生态学

examples.en: Basic courses in sociology and psychology as well as other humanities courses give students plenty of opportunity to explore their own emotions.
examples.zh: 社会学和心理学的基础，以及其他人文学科的课程，赋予学生大量的机会去探索其个人情感。

examples.en: The mistress hunters are mostly women and are all psychology, sociology or law graduates.
examples.zh: “情妇猎手”大多为女性，且都是心理学、社会学或法学的毕业生。

words.definition: to leave somewhere very quickly, in order to escape from danger; lift, disappear, blank; escape, desert
words.translation: 逃走， 逃掉， 逃离；避开， 逃避；逃走；消失，消散；逃跑，逃走；逃避

examples.en: His attackers turned and fled.
examples.zh: 袭击他的人转身逃走了。

examples.en: Masaari spent six months in prison before fleeing the country .
examples.zh: 正有蹲了六个月监狱，然后逃出了该国。

words.definition: not firm or strong; to walk slowly and with difficulty because one leg is hurt or injured; the way someone walks when they are limping; weak, soft, tender, ductile; hirple, hilch; claudication, hirple
words.translation: 软的；不强壮的；〔因一腿受伤而〕跛行，一瘸一拐地走；跛行；柔软的，无力的；软弱的；跛行，一拐一拐地走；缓慢费力地前进

examples.en: a limp handshake
examples.zh: 无力的握手

examples.en: His body suddenly went limp.
examples.zh: 他突然身子一软。

words.definition: reacting quickly, in a positive way; answering
words.translation: 响应的；敏感的， 易受影响的；应答的；回答的

examples.en: a car with highly responsive steering
examples.zh: 方向盘操纵灵活的汽车

words.definition: a group of people or things that are all of the same type; variety, classification, kind, manner, sort, nature
words.translation: 种类， 类， 类别；种类，分类；[数]范畴

examples.en: people in the over-45 age category
examples.zh: 属45岁以上年龄组的人

examples.en: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
examples.zh: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

examples.en: Williams’ style does not fit easily into the category of jazz.
examples.zh: 威廉斯的风格不能轻易归入爵士乐的范畴。

words.definition: to break with a sudden sharp noise, or to make something do this; a judgment or decision made quickly, without careful thought or discussion; a sudden loud sound, especially made by something breaking or closing; pull cut; bite, gnaw at; splutter; sudden, unannounced
words.translation: 咔嚓折断，啪地绷断；吧嗒一声；猛咬；厉声说话，怒声责骂；仓促的， 突然的；吧嗒声；快照；突然折断，拉断；啪地关上；咬；厉声说；咯嗒一声关上；劈啪声；突然折断；突然的

examples.en: A twig snapped under my feet.
examples.zh: 一根细枝在我脚下嚓一声断开了。

examples.en: The wind snapped branches and power lines.
examples.zh: 大风刮断了树枝和输电线。
